對話路徑測試模式即將啟用
	你要不要聽取角色的提示語音，並在畫面上顯示出來？�

entries.source:
Locklear fretted.
	Miles away from the objective he knew they should pursuing, he managed to assuage his nagging concerns by noting the fact that there óhad been far fewer assassins in their way since they had taken the diversionary route away from Krondor. Inevitably, they would of course head to the Prince, but in his gut he knew none of the assassins would have suspected them to head into the hills south of Highcastle...�
entries.translation:
洛克利爾憂心忡忡。
	他們此刻離該追尋的目標還有好幾哩遠，好在他能靠一個事實稍稍安撫自己揮之不去的不安——自從他們繞道遠離克朗多之後，擋在路上的刺客明顯ó少了許多。他們終究還是得去見親王，這點無可避免，但他直覺告訴他，沒有一個刺客會料到他們竟朝高堡以南的丘陵地帶而去……�

entries.source: We've probably come far enough east to have thrown any other assassins off the track. You have a better idea of what Delekhan would throw at us, Gorath. What do you think?�
entries.translation: 我們往東走的距離，應該已經足以甩開其他刺客的追蹤了。戈拉斯，你比我們更清楚迪勒肯會派什麼手段來對付我們。你怎麼看？�

entries.source: I think that if I were he, I would hunt us in the same way that one hounds a fox. You chase him and snap at his heels, all the while driving him out of fear into his hole...�
entries.translation: 我想，換作是我，會像獵狐一樣獵殺我們——緊追不捨、咬著腳跟不放，一路把獵物嚇得逃回自己的洞穴……�

entries.source: And in this instance, the hole is Krondor. If he doesn't already suspect our destination, he can't stay unaware of it too long. But he couldn't lay his trap for us óin Krondor itself. Even a large contingent of elves there is enough to stir up a ruckus.�
entries.translation: 這麼說，那個洞穴就是克朗多了。就算他現在還沒猜到我們的目的地，也不會蒙在鼓裡太久。可他沒辦法在ó克朗多本地布下陷阱等我們。光是一大群精靈出現在那裡，就足以引起軒然大波了。�

entries.source: I suspect a trap immediately to the north of our objective. óThat would be most prudent.�
entries.translation: 我懷疑陷阱就設在我們目的地正北方。ó這樣安排最為謹慎。�

entries.source: I think I'd have to agree. Slipping in at night from the southeast would probably be the best way in...I'll at least keep it in mind as we travel.�
entries.translation: 我想我得同意這個看法。趁夜從東南方潛入，大概是最好的進城方式……趕路時我至少會把這點放在心上。�

entries.source:
Locklear was weary.
	When he had first left Krondor to study under Captain Moyiet for a while, he had thought it would be a simple matter of soldiering for a few months and then returning home to Land's End or back to Arutha's court. But for more months than it seemed he could count, he had been ambling around the Kingdom and the Northlands, accomplishing little that he felt would be of value to Prince Arutha. What was more, now he had Gorath and the squire from Tiburn in tow and a responsibility to get them all alive to Krondor.
	Feeling a tug at his sleeve, he revived from his woolgathering. Beside him, Owyn was pointing at an advancing figure...�
entries.translation:
洛克利爾疲憊不堪。
	當初他離開克朗多，去莫耶特隊長麾下受訓一段時日時，還以為不過是當幾個月兵、再回陸地盡頭老家或亞魯莎宮廷裡去，是件簡單的事。可如今，他已經在王國跟北境之間漫無目的地遊蕩了數不清多少個月，卻感覺不出自己完成了什麼對亞魯莎親王有價值的事。更何況，如今他身邊還多了戈拉斯跟這位提伯恩來的扈從，他得負責把他們三個活著帶回克朗多。
	感覺到袖子被拉了一下，他這才從恍神中回過神來。歐文正指著身邊一個逐漸靠近的身影……�

entries.source: So far from the Prince's court, I'm surprised any from your part of the world even knew Kenting Rush existed. Have you come for business or pleasure?�
entries.translation: 離親王宮廷這麼遠，我還挺意外你們那個地方居然有人知道肯廷拉什的存在。你們是為了生意還是純粹來遊玩的？�

entries.source: Chance has had a greater part in delivering us here than anything else. Actually, we are only travelling on our way from LaMut. We have a trading appointment in Romney...�
entries.translation: 老實說，會來到這裡，說是機緣巧合更貼切。其實我們只是路過，正從拉姆特一路趕來。我們在羅姆尼有筆生意約好了……�

entries.source:
óAhð, the city of guilds. I've heard that there is some difficulty there. Something to do with a dispute between the Riverpullers and the Glazer's Guilds. I've even heard rumors that the Guild of Assassins has had some involvement, but I could hardly credit it. Hopefully the affair will come to a peaceful resolution soon enough.
	You will excuse me for staring, but it has been some time since I have seen an óelf in these parts. It is even more passing uncommon I should meet one so heavily armored.�
entries.translation:
ó「啊ð」，公會之城。我聽說那邊出了些麻煩事，好像是縴夫公會跟玻璃匠公會之間有糾紛。我甚至聽過謠言說刺客公會也牽涉其中，不過我實在不太相信。希望這件事能盡快和平解決。
	恕我盯著看，只是我已經有段時間沒在這一帶見過ó精靈了。而且遇上一位全副武裝的精靈，就更是難得一見了。�

entries.source: Go...Thorgath is working with us to negotiate a new trading deal of elven goods in the Eastern Kingdom. He trades in armor, so it is easier to transport it this way rather than carrying it in a satchel.�
entries.translation: 戈……索爾加斯正跟我們合作，商談一筆精靈貨品在東部王國的新交易。他做的是盔甲生意，這樣運送起來，總比裝在袋子裡背著方便。�

entries.source: Ingenious, no doubt. Thorgath, you say. The name sounds...ófamiliar in a way. Perhaps we have met before...�
entries.translation: 這主意確實巧妙。索爾加斯，你說。這名字聽起來……有點ó耳熟。也許我們以前見過……�

entries.source: We have never met. You are mistaken.�
entries.translation: 我們從未見過面。您弄錯了。�

entries.source:
Of course, I will accept your word on the matter. I must have only met someone who óresembled you...
	To other matters. As you are all visitors to Kenting Rush, and visitors are also good óbusinessð, are there any things I may be of assistance with?�
entries.translation:
當然，這件事我就相信您的話了。想必我只是見過某個ó跟您長得相似的人……
	換個話題。既然幾位都是來肯廷拉什的訪客，而訪客也是門好ó生意ð，有什麼我能幫得上忙的嗎？�

entries.source: As we have appointments elsewhere, we should probably be on our way.�
entries.translation: 我們還有別的約要赴，大概該上路了。�

entries.source: Good travelling to you then. And if you ever have any need of anything and are in Kenting Rush, be sure to come and see me.�
entries.translation: 那祝各位一路順風。要是以後有任何需要，人又在肯廷拉什，務必來找我。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C1_Navon_Du_Sandau�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C1_Navon_Du_Sandau�

entries.source:
Someone called to them.
	Though the sun was in @4's eyes, he was fairly certain that the man approaching them was Navon Du Sandau, a merchant they had met in Kenting Rush before...�
entries.translation:
有人喊了他們一聲。
	雖然陽光刺得@4睜不開眼，他還是相當確定朝他們走來的人，是納馮．杜桑多——他們先前在肯廷拉什見過的一名商人……�

entries.source: I had not expected to see you three again for quite some time. How can Navon Du Sandau be of assistance to you?�
entries.translation: 沒想到這麼快又見到你們三位了。納馮．杜桑多能幫上什麼忙嗎？�

entries.source: As we have appointments elsewhere, we should probably be on our way.�
entries.translation: 我們還有別的約要赴，大概該上路了。�

entries.source: Good travelling to you then. And if you ever have any need of anything and are in Kenting Rush, be sure to come and see me.�
entries.translation: 那祝各位一路順風。要是以後有任何需要，人又在肯廷拉什，務必來找我。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C1_Navon_Du_Sandau�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C1_Navon_Du_Sandau�

entries.source:
James sniffed the air.
	While for the better part of the last hour he had been trying to piece together the details of the murder at the Black Sheep Tavern, something else had begun nagging at him, elusive as the names of all the Mockers he'd once known. It had only been after a few minutes of consideration that he'd realized what it was that was distracting him.
	"Do you smell anything odd?" he asked Gorath. Struck by the oddity of smelling jasmine in the open, he could spot no natural flora that could account for the scent. But while searching, he thought he spotted someone moving down the road towards them...�
entries.translation:
詹姆士嗅了嗅空氣。
	過去將近一個鐘頭，他一直在試圖拼湊黑羊酒館那樁謀殺案的細節，這時卻有另一件事開始揮之不去地纏著他，就跟他曾經認識的那些嘲弄幫成員的名字一樣，怎麼想都想不真切。過了幾分鐘他才意識到，是什麼在分散他的注意力。
	「你有沒有聞到什麼奇怪的味道？」他問戈拉斯。在露天環境裡聞到茉莉花香，實在透著古怪，他四下張望，卻找不到任何能解釋這股氣味的天然植物。可就在他搜尋的同時，他似乎瞥見有人正沿著大路朝他們走來……�

entries.source: There is little here to give event enough to warrant visitors from the Bitter Sea, and if that weren't enough, it seems we have guests as well from óElvandarð. Welcome to Kenting Rush.�
entries.translation: 這裡實在沒什麼大事，值得招來苦海那邊的訪客，而要是這樣還不夠稀奇，看來我們還有從ó艾爾凡達ð來的貴客呢。歡迎來到肯廷拉什。�

entries.source: This may sound a strange question, but a moment ago I thought I smelled spice...jasmine to be exact. Does it grow near here?�
entries.translation: 這問題聽起來可能有點奇怪，不過剛才我好像聞到一股香料味……確切地說是茉莉花香。這附近有種這種植物嗎？�

entries.source: You have a keen nose. Unfortunately it isn't local. I deal in spices as well as a number of other imported goods. I've just returned from a lengthy trip into Kesh and I am afraid the scent clings a bit to the clothes.�
entries.translation: 您鼻子真靈。可惜這不是本地的東西。我做的是香料生意，也經營一些其他的進口貨。我才剛從凱許跑完一趟長途行程回來，恐怕這氣味還沾在衣服上沒散去。�

entries.source: But you've only just come up the road. I've been smelling it for some while...�
entries.translation: 可您才剛從路那頭走過來。這味道我已經聞了好一陣子了……�

entries.source: I am told the scent carries. There óis a bit of a wind today. So...as you are travellers in the area and dealing with the natives can sometimes be difficult, is there any way I can be of some assistance to you?�
entries.translation: 我聽人說這味道傳得挺遠的。今天ó確實有點風。這麼說……幾位既是這一帶的旅人，跟本地人打交道有時候也不容易，有什麼我能幫得上忙的嗎？�

entries.source: As we have appointments elsewhere, we should probably be on our way.�
entries.translation: 我們還有別的約要赴，大概該上路了。�

entries.source: Good travelling to you then. And if you ever have any need of anything and are in Kenting Rush, be sure to come and see me.�
entries.translation: 那祝各位一路順風。要是以後有任何需要，人又在肯廷拉什，務必來找我。�

entries.source:
Someone called to them.
	Though the lighting was dim, @4 was fairly certain that the man approaching them was Navon Du Sandau, a merchant they had met in Kenting Rush before...�
entries.translation:
有人喊了他們一聲。
	雖然光線昏暗，@4還是相當確定朝他們走來的人，是納馮．杜桑多——他們先前在肯廷拉什見過的一名商人……�

entries.source:
A girl crossed the fields.
	Lacking the arrogant bearing of her father, she moved like a wisp of smoke, her tread so light it seemed she floated rather than walked through the rustling weeds. Flittering to Owyn's side, she kissed him lightly on the cheek.�
entries.translation:
一名女孩穿過田野走來。
	她沒有父親那種傲慢的氣派，行動起來就像一縷輕煙，腳步輕盈得彷彿是飄過那片沙沙作響的雜草，而不是走過去的。她翩然來到歐文身邊，在他臉頰上輕輕一吻。�

entries.source: You are so much taller than I remember! You've gone and grown up on me, haven't you?�
entries.translation: 你比我記憶中高多了！你這是趁我不注意就長大了，是吧？�

entries.source: I can't remain a little girl all my life, cousin. Father would have me married to some Vicompte somewhere spinning tapestries if he had his way but I'm a little too headstrong for the liking of most of my suitors. You know I've always hoped you would come up and sweep me off to some strange place.�
entries.translation: 我總不能一輩子當個小女孩吧，表哥。要是照父親的意思，他早把我嫁給哪個子爵，成天在家織掛毯了，可我這人太固執，大多數追求者都受不了我。你知道我一直希望有一天你會出現，把我帶去某個新奇的地方。�

entries.source: Third son of a very minor Count? I don't think your father would stand for it. Besides, I still can't conscience any girl that likes barrel ball tourneys.�
entries.translation: 一個微不足道的伯爵家排行老三的兒子？我看妳父親不會同意的。再說，我還是沒法接受一個喜歡看滾球錦標賽的女孩子。�

entries.source: Pig. Are you going to introduce me to your rather handsome friends here, or shall I perish of curiosity?�
entries.translation: 豬頭。你要不要把你這幾位相貌堂堂的朋友介紹給我，還是要讓我活活好奇死？�

entries.source: Perhaps later, if I'm feeling up to it.�
entries.translation: 也許等一下吧，如果我有這個心情的話。�

entries.source: I suggest you find a way to or I'll have father put you in irons, that you're a relative notwithstanding. So, what has you tromping all the way up to Cavall Keep?�
entries.translation: 我勸你最好有這個心情，不然就算是親戚，我也會叫父親把你上鐐銬。話說回來，是什麼風把你一路吹到卡瓦爾堡來的？�

entries.source: Well, cousin, as nice as its been seeing you again, we've got to be off. Things to do. Dragons to battle.�
entries.translation: 這個嘛，表妹，能再見到妳真好，不過我們得走了。還有事要辦，還得去打幾條龍呢。�

entries.source: Fine. Go off and abandon me here so I can expire of boredom here in this sheep herder's paradise! The most excitement I've seen in months is watching when the pigs got loose in Cavall Keep and were running through the streets!�
entries.translation: 好啊。你就這麼走了，把我一個人丟在這個牧羊人的天堂裡，讓我活活無聊死好了！我這幾個月見過最刺激的事，就是看著幾頭豬從圈裡逃出來，在卡瓦爾堡的街上到處亂竄！�

entries.source: You'll live. Take care of yourself, Ugyne. And tell your father hello if you see him before I do.�
entries.translation: 妳死不了的。烏格妮，照顧好自己。要是妳比我先見到妳父親，替我問候他一聲。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C2_Ugyne_Corvalis�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C2_Ugyne_Corvalis�

entries.source:
Ugyne shouted at them.
	Stationing herself before her cousin, she fixed him with her pale amber stare.�
entries.translation:
烏格妮朝他們喊了一聲。
	她站到表哥面前，用那雙淡琥珀色的眼睛直直盯著他。�

entries.source: Owyn! If I didn't know better, I would think you were trying to become a permanent guest.�
entries.translation: 歐文！要是我不了解你，還真會以為你打算長住不走了。�

entries.source: Not such a bad prospect. I've always liked this part of the country...�
entries.translation: 這也不算什麼壞主意。我一直挺喜歡這一帶的……�

entries.source: You would. Anything to get away from that tyrant of a father of yours. He never allowed us to have any fun at all. Always so serious about everything...�
entries.translation: 我猜也是。只要能離你那個暴君父親遠遠的，什麼都好。他從來不讓我們玩得開心，什麼事都嚴肅得要命……�

entries.source: And I suppose you think your father was any the better about rearing children?�
entries.translation: 那我猜妳覺得妳父親帶孩子的功夫就好到哪去了？�

entries.source: Hmm, well, so both our fathers are wretched bores. I suppose that's why we're so much alike---Now, why have you come a pestering a young girl out enjoying the afternoon?�
entries.translation: 嗯，這麼說，咱們倆的父親都是無趣得要命的老頑固。我看這就是我們倆這麼合得來的原因——好了，你幹嘛跑來打擾一個正享受下午時光的年輕姑娘？�

entries.source: Well, cousin, as nice as its been seeing you again, we've got to be off. Things to do. Dragons to battle.�
entries.translation: 這個嘛，表妹，能再見到妳真好，不過我們得走了。還有事要辦，還得去打幾條龍呢。�

entries.source: Fine. Go off and abandon me here so I can expire of boredom. It's perfectly all right with me.�
entries.translation: 好啊。你就這麼走了，把我一個人丟在這裡活活無聊死吧。我完全沒意見。�

entries.source: You'll live. Take care of yourself, Ugyne. And tell your father hello if you see him before I do.�
entries.translation: 妳死不了的。烏格妮，照顧好自己。要是妳比我先見到妳父親，替我問候他一聲。�

entries.source: Did I ever tell you that you show up at the strangest of times? It's nice to see you!�
entries.translation: 我有沒有跟你說過，你每次出現的時機都怪得很？不過見到你真好！�

entries.source: What are you doing wandering around unescorted? Honestly, you astonish me. By your age, most girls have the common sense to realize there are dangerous types wandering around in the open...�
entries.translation: 妳一個人在外頭閒晃是怎麼回事？老實說，妳真讓我吃驚。到了妳這個年紀，大部分女孩子都該懂得外頭四處遊蕩著危險人物的常識了……�

entries.source: How's that for an introduction?! You're only four years older than me, Owyn and I don't see that my age has anything to do with it. I just like to come out here to think when I have a problem that won't solve itself otherwise. It also gives me a safe harbor away from father when he's on one of his raging fits.�
entries.translation: 這開場白可真夠嗆的！歐文，你才比我大四歲，我看不出我的年紀跟這有什麼關係。我只是喜歡在遇到怎麼想都想不通的問題時，跑來這裡靜靜思考。這裡也是我父親發脾氣時，能讓我逃開他的一個安全避風港。�

entries.source: Is he on one at the moment?�
entries.translation: 他現在正在發脾氣嗎？�

entries.source: One of the worst I've ever seen. He's fired the entire kitchen staff, dismissed the guard, thrown out all five of my maids. He's been that way since about dinner time last evening. I tried to ask him what had him so upset, but he would only tell me that he had received some very bad news from a messenger regarding a financial arrangement which he had made.�
entries.translation: 我見過最嚴重的一次。他把整個廚房的人都開除了，解散了守衛，還把我五個侍女統統趕走。從昨晚晚餐時分開始，他就是這副樣子。我試著問他到底是什麼事讓他這麼心煩，他卻只告訴我，他收到一名信使帶來的壞消息，跟他安排的某項財務事宜有關。�

entries.source: Have any idea what the note said?�
entries.translation: 知道那張字條上寫了什麼嗎？�

entries.source:
Who knows? He's always on about conspiracy this, conspiracy that. It's like he's always afraid someone's about to find out some dire secret about the family when there's nothing to hide. It's getting terribly repetitive really.
	So...you have this frightful look on your face as if there's something you're afraid to speak to me about. What is it?�
entries.translation:
誰知道呢？他老是把陰謀掛在嘴邊，說東說西的。就好像他總是擔心有人會發現家族什麼見不得人的秘密，可明明就沒什麼好藏的。這種戲碼實在演得有點膩了。
	話說回來……你臉上這副驚恐的表情，好像有什麼事不敢跟我說似的。是什麼事？�

entries.source: As nice as it's been talking to you again, we have to be on our way. Promise me you'll find someone to look after you soon.�
entries.translation: 能再跟妳聊聊真好，不過我們得上路了。答應我，妳會盡快找個人來照顧妳。�

entries.source: I would appreciate it if you stopped fretting about me as if I were a child. But I'll take the promise only so long as óyou make the same promise.�
entries.translation: 要是你別再把我當小孩子一樣操心，我會很感激。不過這個承諾我可以答應，前提是ó你也得做出同樣的承諾。�

entries.source: Very well. You have my word as the son of the Count of Tiburn. Goodbye, Ugyne...�
entries.translation: 好吧。我以提伯恩伯爵之子的身分向妳保證。再見了，烏格妮……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C3_Ugyne_Corvalis�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C3_Ugyne_Corvalis�

entries.source:
Ugyne shouted at them.
	Stationing herself before her cousin, she fixed him with her pale amber stare.�
entries.translation:
烏格妮朝他們喊了一聲。
	她站到表哥面前，用那雙淡琥珀色的眼睛直直盯著他。�

entries.source: Back again so soon? I shall have to find out what young lady has caught your eye in Cavall Keep!�
entries.translation: 這麼快又回來了？看來我得查查是卡瓦爾堡哪位年輕姑娘勾走了你的心！�

entries.source: Actually, we are back to ask you a few questions. Do you have time for us?�
entries.translation: 其實我們是回來問妳幾個問題的。妳有空嗎？�

entries.source: Well, I suppose I could fit you in after the lancer's tourney and then the ball, because you óknow how busy Cavall Keep always is...�
entries.translation: 這個嘛，我看我可以在長槍騎兵比武大會跟舞會之後，勉強擠出點時間給你們，畢竟你們ó也知道卡瓦爾堡一向這麼忙……�

entries.source: You are absolutely incorrigible! Anyone ever tell you that?�
entries.translation: 妳簡直沒救了！有沒有人跟妳說過這句話？�

entries.source: Perhaps. Now what is it you three want? Some bit of gossip about my now óformer handmaidens? A story about old Peter the Grey?�
entries.translation: 也許有吧。好了，你們三個到底想幹嘛？想聽點關於我那些ó前任侍女的八卦？還是想聽聽老「灰袍」彼得的故事？�

entries.source: As nice as it's been talking to you again, we have to be on our way. Things to do.�
entries.translation: 能再跟妳聊聊真好，不過我們得上路了，還有事要辦。�

entries.source: Well, as it happens, I have a few things to do as well. I have to dust all the flowers so the bees don't sneeze. Nothing worse than sneezing bees. Then I have to rebuild the Keep with twigs...�
entries.translation: 這個嘛，剛好我也有些事要忙。我得把花全都撢一撢灰，免得蜜蜂打噴嚏。沒有什麼比蜜蜂打噴嚏更糟糕的事了。然後我還得用樹枝把堡壘重新蓋起來……�

entries.source: Goodóbye you silly goose. Take care of yourself. And make sure you get in before dark. I don't like the idea of you wandering around out here alone...�
entries.translation: 再ó見了，你這個傻鵝。照顧好自己。天黑之前一定要回去。我不喜歡妳一個人在外頭閒晃……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C3_Ugyne_Corvalis�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C3_Ugyne_Corvalis�

entries.source:
A figure turned the corner of the house.
	Happily, Owyn dropped his staff, opening up his arms to give the approaching girl a hug...�
entries.translation:
一個身影從屋子轉角處出現。
	歐文開心地放下法杖，張開雙臂迎向走來的女孩，給了她一個擁抱……�

entries.source: I don't know why you're here, Owyn, but I am so glad. I really needed to see a friendly face about now...�
entries.translation: 我不知道你為什麼會在這裡，歐文，不過我真的好高興。我現在真的很需要見到一張友善的面孔……�

entries.source: What are you doing out of Cavall Keep?�
entries.translation: 妳怎麼跑出卡瓦爾堡了？�

entries.source: We came up when some of Prince Arutha's men passed through Cavall Keep. They said there is a battle about to happen and there were going to be troops mustering here with the Lady Boswich. Is that true? Are we really going to war with the moredhel again?�
entries.translation: 亞魯莎親王手下的一些人路過卡瓦爾堡的時候，我們就跟著來了。他們說有場戰事即將爆發，會有軍隊在這裡跟波斯維奇夫人一起集結。這是真的嗎？我們真的要再次跟莫瑞德人開戰了？�

entries.source: I don't know how much I am allowed to say, but there is a very good possibility of it. Actually, Gorath and I are ósupposed to be looking for a magician named Pug from Stardock, but with the war going on here...I wanted to make sure that you and your father were all right.�
entries.translation: 我不知道能透露多少，不過這種可能性相當高。其實戈拉斯跟我ó應該是要去找一位星塢島來的法師，叫帕格，不過眼看這裡就要開戰了……我想先確認妳跟妳父親都平安無事。�

entries.source: Why wouldn't we be? It's not as if the fighting will get this far south...will it?�
entries.translation: 我們怎麼會不平安？戰火總不會一路打到這麼南邊來吧……會嗎？�

entries.source: No...it's just that...There are several things we will need to talk about when things have calmed down. I'm just glad that you're safe. I was concerned that something might have happened to you.�
entries.translation: 不會……只是……有幾件事，等局勢平靜下來之後我們得好好談談。我只是很高興妳平安無事。我一直擔心妳會出什麼事。�

entries.source: You're getting to be as silly as I am. So...what have you been eating? You're as thin as a bone. Is there anything I can do for you two?�
entries.translation: 你越來越傻里傻氣，跟我有得比了。話說回來……你都吃些什麼？瘦得跟骨頭似的。我能為你們倆做點什麼嗎？�

entries.source: Well, now that I know you are all right, I think we have to be going. I'm not sure how much longer we will be in the area. Do you need anything?�
entries.translation: 好了，既然知道妳平安無事，我看我們該走了。我也不確定我們還會在這一帶待多久。妳需要什麼嗎？�

entries.source: No, I'll be fine, I think. You take care of yourself, cousin.�
entries.translation: 不用，我想我會沒事的。表哥，你也照顧好自己。�

entries.source: You too, Ugyne. I promise, I'll come and visit as soon as I can.�
entries.translation: 妳也是，烏格妮。我保證，一有空就會來看妳。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C6_Ugyne_Corvalis�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C6_Ugyne_Corvalis�

entries.source:
Ugyne shouted at them.
	Stationing herself before her cousin, she fixed him with her pale amber stare.�
entries.translation:
烏格妮朝他們喊了一聲。
	她站到表哥面前，用那雙淡琥珀色的眼睛直直盯著他。�

entries.source: You've come back! What is it?�
entries.translation: 你又回來了！怎麼了？�

entries.source: Well, now that I know you are all right, I think we have to be going. I'm not sure how much longer we will be in the area. Do you need anything?�
entries.translation: 好了，既然知道妳平安無事，我看我們該走了。我也不確定我們還會在這一帶待多久。妳需要什麼嗎？�

entries.source: No, I'll be fine, I think. You take care of yourself, cousin.�
entries.translation: 不用，我想我會沒事的。表哥，你也照顧好自己。�

entries.source: You too, Ugyne. I promise, I'll come and visit as soon as I can.�
entries.translation: 妳也是，烏格妮。我保證，一有空就會來看妳。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C6_Ugyne_Corvalis�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C6_Ugyne_Corvalis�

entries.source: I have given express instruction that I was not to be disturbed today, but Miri seemed to think your visit might be of some importance.�
entries.translation: 我今天特地交代過不許有人打擾我，不過蜜莉似乎覺得你們來訪可能有些要緊事。�

entries.source: I don't know that it is óimportantð, but I would think you would be a bit more receptive to your own kin, óuncleð.�
entries.translation: 我不知道算不算得上ó要緊ð，不過我想您對自己的親人，多少該ó客氣ð一點吧，叔叔。�

entries.source: Don't presume to lecture me on manners, Owyn. If you were the proper squire your father dubbed you years ago, you would be in Tiburn at your brother Harold's side. Instead, you are allowed to roam wherever you like, without a whit of accountability to anyone. My ódaughter Ugyne has far more sense of responsibility...�
entries.translation: 別以為你有資格教訓我的禮數，歐文。你要是真如你父親多年前冊封的那樣，是個規規矩矩的扈從，此刻早該在提伯恩你哥哈羅德身邊了。可你倒好，愛去哪就去哪，對誰都不用負半點責任。我ó女兒烏格妮的責任感，可比你強得多了……�

entries.source: You have quite a few opinions for someone who hasn't seen me in three years. Have you always hated me this much?�
entries.translation: 三年沒見我了，您的意見倒是不少。您一直都這麼討厭我嗎？�

entries.source: It's not a question of óhatredð, Owyn. But your roaming about the world like you were a jongleur or a mercenary is an embarrassment to the family. How do you ever hope to gain the hand of a duke or an earl's daughter if you continue behaving as you are? How will you learn to rule?�
entries.translation: 這不是ó討厭ð不討厭的問題，歐文。可你這樣像個江湖藝人或傭兵一樣到處遊蕩，簡直是家族的恥辱。你再這麼下去，要怎麼指望娶到哪位公爵或伯爵的女兒？你又要怎麼學會治理領地？�

entries.source: What? Sit about all day long and tell quarrelling franklins who owns this bit of land and who owns that? I don't ówant that. I want to be a magician, like Pug of Stardock.�
entries.translation: 什麼？整天坐在那裡，聽兩個吵架的自耕農爭論這塊地是誰的、那塊地又是誰的？我可不ó想過那種日子。我想成為法師，像星塢島的帕格那樣。�

entries.source: And are you going to conjure up your living by doing parlor tricks for King Lyam? Going to make smoke pour out of your ears so you'll have a bit of something to eat in the evenings...�
entries.translation: 那你打算靠著替萊亞姆王表演客廳戲法混口飯吃？靠著讓耳朵冒煙來換一頓晚餐嗎……�

entries.source: I hate to disrupt your argument Count, but at the moment he is in my service as ómy squire. I am Seigneur Locklear of Krondor, adviser to Prince Arutha...�
entries.translation: 伯爵大人，很抱歉打斷您這場爭論，不過眼下他正是ó我的扈從，為我效力。在下克朗多的洛克利爾紳爵，亞魯莎親王麾下的顧問……�

entries.source: From Krondor? My forgiveness, I hadn't noticed your colors. And I have been standing here conducting a family spat! What can I do for you?�
entries.translation: 從克朗多來的？請恕我失禮，我沒注意到您的紋章。我居然就這麼站在這裡，跟家人吵起架來了！有什麼我能為您效勞的嗎？�

entries.source: You've been most helpful Count Corvalis, but it's time we returned to our business. Please give my regards to your daughter Ugyne.�
entries.translation: 科瓦利斯伯爵，您幫了大忙，不過我們也該回去忙正事了。請代我向令嬡烏格妮問好。�

entries.source: I shall, Seigneur. Good travelling and keep an óeye on my nephew.�
entries.translation: 我會的，紳爵大人。祝您一路順風，也請ó多看顧一下我這姪兒。�

entries.source: Oh I shall, believe me. Good bye.�
entries.translation: 噢，我一定會的，相信我。再會。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C1_Count_Corvalis�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C1_Count_Corvalis�

entries.source: I have a number of things to do today, so if you please make your business known quickly...�
entries.translation: 我今天還有不少事要忙，麻煩你們快點說明來意……�

entries.source: You've been most helpful Count Corvalis, but it's time we returned to our business. Please give my regards to your daughter Ugyne.�
entries.translation: 科瓦利斯伯爵，您幫了大忙，不過我們也該回去忙正事了。請代我向令嬡烏格妮問好。�

entries.source: I shall, Seigneur. Good travelling and keep an óeye on my nephew.�
entries.translation: 我會的，紳爵大人。祝您一路順風，也請ó多看顧一下我這姪兒。�

entries.source: Oh I shall, believe me. Good bye.�
entries.translation: 噢，我一定會的，相信我。再會。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C1_Count_Corvalis�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C1_Count_Corvalis�

entries.source: I haven't time to talk at the moment. Perhaps your father runs his affairs in a more lax manner down in Tiburn, but here in Cavall---we do things properly here. If I am to raise a daughter to be a future princess, then I must see to it that she is well accustomed to the manner of court life.�
entries.translation: 我現在沒空聊天。也許你父親在提伯恩那邊治家比較隨性，可在卡瓦爾——我們一切都得照規矩來。要是我打算把女兒栽培成未來的王妃，就得確保她從小熟悉宮廷生活的禮數。�

entries.source: óPrincess Ugyne? And how do you intend to arrange that? I thought she was engaged to the Baronet Ferone...�
entries.translation: ó王妃烏格妮？您打算怎麼安排這件事？我還以為她已經跟費隆準男爵訂婚了……�

entries.source: The operative word being ñwasð, nephew. I have decided that we should aim higher for her. The Prince of Krondor has two boys, both unmarried and more than eligible for the hand of my fair daughter. I think either would make a fine husband.�
entries.translation: 關鍵字是ñ『曾經』ð，姪兒。我已經決定，該替她找個更高的門第。克朗多親王有兩個兒子，都還未婚，配我這位嬌女綽綽有餘。我看無論哪一個，都是個好夫婿。�

entries.source: I agree, but with all due respect, Borric and Erland are only two very rambunctious óeleven year olds who still run away from girls. I think the pair of them would be horrified by a proposal at this point, though I imagine Prince Arutha might find the idea appealing.�
entries.translation: 我同意，不過恕我直言，博里克跟厄蘭不過是兩個活蹦亂跳、看見女生就跑的ó十一歲小男孩罷了。我看這時候跟他們提求婚的事，他們兩個大概都要嚇壞了，不過我倒是能想像亞魯莎親王會覺得這主意挺不錯。�

entries.source: I wouldn't suggest they marry as yet, of course. They will need a little time to grow naturally, say two years. Thirteen is a very marriageable age.�
entries.translation: 我當然不是建議他們現在就成婚。他們還需要點時間自然長大，就說兩年吧。十三歲正是適婚的好年紀。�

entries.source: Ahem. Once I return to Krondor, I'll mention it to Prince Arutha.�
entries.translation: 呃……等我回到克朗多，我會跟亞魯莎親王提一提這件事。�

entries.source: I would be forever in your debt Seigneur. Is there anything I can do for you in return?�
entries.translation: 紳爵大人，我將永遠感激不盡。有什麼我能回報您的嗎？�

entries.source: You've been most helpful Count Corvalis, but it's time we returned to our business. Please give my regards to your daughter Ugyne.�
entries.translation: 科瓦利斯伯爵，您幫了大忙，不過我們也該回去忙正事了。請代我向令嬡烏格妮問好。�

entries.source: I shall, Seigneur. Good travelling and keep an óeye on my nephew.�
entries.translation: 我會的，紳爵大人。祝您一路順風，也請ó多看顧一下我這姪兒。�

entries.source: Oh I shall, believe me. Good bye.�
entries.translation: 噢，我一定會的，相信我。再會。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C2_Count_Corvalis�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C2_Count_Corvalis�

entries.source: I have a number of things to do today, so if you please make your business known quickly...�
entries.translation: 我今天還有不少事要忙，麻煩你們快點說明來意……�

entries.source: You've been most helpful Count Corvalis, but it's time we returned to our business. Please give my regards to your daughter Ugyne.�
entries.translation: 科瓦利斯伯爵，您幫了大忙，不過我們也該回去忙正事了。請代我向令嬡烏格妮問好。�

entries.source: I shall, Seigneur. Good travelling and keep an óeye on my nephew.�
entries.translation: 我會的，紳爵大人。祝您一路順風，也請ó多看顧一下我這姪兒。�

entries.source: Oh I shall, believe me. Good bye.�
entries.translation: 噢，我一定會的，相信我。再會。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C2_Count_Corvalis�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C2_Count_Corvalis�

entries.source: Kindly tell me, sir, what it is I have done to make myself so attractive to the minuscule of the world? From the moment I first stepped from my bedchamber this morning, I have had servants swarming about me like nits and bothersome relations at my ankles. Will you kindly leave me in peace?!�
entries.translation: 勞煩您告訴我，先生，我到底做了什麼，才會對這世上這些微不足道的傢伙有這麼大的吸引力？從我今早踏出寢室那一刻起，僕人就像蝨子一樣圍著我團團轉，煩人的親戚也纏著我的腳踝不放。您能不能行行好，讓我清靜一下？！�

entries.source: We have very grave business to attend to and I must speak to you...�
entries.translation: 我們有件非常重要的事要處理，必須跟您談談……�

entries.source: Whatever you must do, I am quite certain does not involve me! I don't care what the nature of your business is about, Seigneur, I have other concerns...�
entries.translation: 不管你們要辦什麼事，我十分確定都跟我無關！紳爵大人，我才不管你們的事是什麼性質，我還有別的事要煩……�

entries.source: Is that so? Have you concerns above and beyond the Prince of Krondor? If so, I shall make most eager account of them before him when I return. Go on and spell them out so I may take them down. I'm sure Arutha will be fascinated.�
entries.translation: 是嗎？您的煩心事，難道比克朗多親王的事還要緊嗎？要是真是這樣，我回去之後一定樂意向他詳細稟報。您說吧，我這就記下來。我相信亞魯莎一定會很感興趣。�

entries.source: The Prince you say? Please understand that there are---things---going on that I am not entirely at liberty to discuss. Suffice to say that I have had something of a ódisagreement with the priests of the Temple of Kahooli in Kenting Rush over a private matter. So, if you may excuse my outburst, I would be happy to be of service to the Prince. What precisely can I do for you?�
entries.translation: 您說親王？請理解，眼下有些——事情——我不便完全公開討論。只能說，我跟肯廷拉什卡胡利神殿的祭司們，因為一件私事起了些ó爭執。所以，若您能原諒我方才的失態，我很樂意為親王效勞。您到底需要我做什麼？�

entries.source: You've been most helpful Count Corvalis, but it's time we returned to our business. Please give my regards to your daughter Ugyne.�
entries.translation: 科瓦利斯伯爵，您幫了大忙，不過我們也該回去忙正事了。請代我向令嬡烏格妮問好。�

entries.source: I shall, Seigneur. Good travelling and keep an óeye on my nephew.�
entries.translation: 我會的，紳爵大人。祝您一路順風，也請ó多看顧一下我這姪兒。�

entries.source: Oh I shall, believe me. Good bye.�
entries.translation: 噢，我一定會的，相信我。再會。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C3_Count_Corvalis�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C3_Count_Corvalis�

entries.source: Nephew, Seigneur, ah...elven sir. Is there any other way that I may help you?�
entries.translation: 姪兒，紳爵大人，啊……這位精靈先生。還有什麼我能幫上忙的嗎？�

entries.source: You've been most helpful Count Corvalis, but it's time we returned to our business. Please give my regards to your daughter Ugyne.�
entries.translation: 科瓦利斯伯爵，您幫了大忙，不過我們也該回去忙正事了。請代我向令嬡烏格妮問好。�

entries.translation: 我會的，紳爵大人。祝您一路順風，也請ó多看顧一下我這姪兒。�

entries.source: Oh I shall, believe me. Good bye.�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C3_Count_Corvalis�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C3_Count_Corvalis�

entries.source:
Locklear's stomach grumbled.
	Waiting until another patron had finished placing his order for hard rolls and a bottle of port, the seigneur beckoned the tavern keeper away from his other duties, hoping both for information and perhaps a bit to eat...�
entries.translation:
洛克利爾的肚子咕嚕作響。
	他等另一名客人點完硬麵包捲跟一瓶波特酒之後，才招呼這名酒館老闆暫時放下其他事務，希望既能打聽點消息，又能順便討點吃的……�

entries.source: I'm Peter, sometimes known as óPeter óthe óGrey. What can I get for you today?�
entries.translation: 我是彼得，有時候人稱ó「灰ó袍ó彼得」。今天想來點什麼？�

entries.source: If you'll excuse my abruptness, we have a few other things we need to be about and not much time to do them in. Perhaps we'll meet again.�
entries.translation: 恕我唐突，我們還有些別的事要辦，時間也不多了。也許改天再見。�

entries.source: I'll look forward to it! Good day to you!�
entries.translation: 我很期待！祝您愉快！�

entries.source: And to you as well. Luck to your business!�
entries.translation: 您也是。祝您生意興隆！�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C1_Peter_the_Grey�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C1_Peter_the_Grey�

entries.source:
Locklear beckoned the tavern keeper.
	Hesitating only long enough to wipe down a table on which a tankard of ale had been overturned, Peter the Grey hurried over to them.�
entries.translation:
洛克利爾朝酒館老闆招了招手。
	「灰袍」彼得只停下來把一張打翻了麥酒杯的桌子擦乾淨，隨即匆匆趕了過來。�

entries.source: Back for more! Ah, my luck is truly on the roll as late. So, what can old Peter the Grey do for you?�
entries.translation: 又回來光顧啦！啊，我最近手氣真是旺。老彼得能為你們做點什麼？�

entries.source: If you'll excuse my abruptness, we have a few other things we need to be about and not much time to do them in. Perhaps we'll meet again.�
entries.translation: 恕我唐突，我們還有些別的事要辦，時間也不多了。也許改天再見。�

entries.source: I'll look forward to it! Good day to you!�
entries.translation: 我很期待！祝您愉快！�

entries.source: And to you as well. Luck to your business!�
entries.translation: 您也是。祝您生意興隆！�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C1_Peter_the_Grey�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C1_Peter_the_Grey�

	Waiting until another patron had finished placing his order for a roast hen and a tankard of ale, the seigneur beckoned the tavern keeper away from his other duties, hoping both for information and perhaps a bit to eat...�
entries.translation:
詹姆士的肚子咕嚕作響。
	他等另一名客人點完烤雞跟一杯麥酒之後，才招呼這名酒館老闆暫時放下其他事務，希望既能打聽點消息，又能順便討點吃的……�

entries.source: I hope you haven't come looking for company tonight. The Duck's Head's a bit quiet this night. You'd think someone left a corpse a'laying in the middle of my floor during the dinner hour.�
entries.translation: 希望兩位今晚不是來找熱鬧的。『鴨頭』今晚有點冷清。安靜得就像晚餐時段有人在我地板正中央擺了具屍體似的。�

entries.source: They didn't did they?�
entries.translation: 該不會真有吧？�

entries.source: Ha, no! Except for the attempt to poison the Count's family a few months ago, things have been fairly sleepy around here in Cavall Keep. Farmer folk here tend to keep to themselves and worry about their crops, not each other.�
entries.translation: 哈，沒有啦！除了幾個月前有人企圖對伯爵一家下毒那件事，卡瓦爾堡這一帶大致上算是相當平靜。這裡的農家人大多各過各的，只操心自己的莊稼，不太管別人的閒事。�

entries.source: Who do you think tried to poison them?�
entries.translation: 你覺得是誰想毒害他們？�

entries.source: If you heard word from the Keep, you'd think no one did. They're a brave lot, all acting almost as if it didn't happen. Wouldn't matter to me if I hadn't of lost my best kitchen boy when he tasted the port. I've got a new boy that works for me, but I miss my old scully. He was a good lad...So...What can I get for you fellows, now that I've talked your ears off?�
entries.translation: 要是你聽堡壘那邊的說法，還真會以為根本沒這回事。他們都是些硬骨頭，一個個表現得跟什麼都沒發生過一樣。要不是我最好的廚房小廝在試喝那瓶波特酒時中毒喪命，這事對我來說也不打緊。我現在雇了個新的，可我還是懷念我那個老幫手。他是個好孩子……好了……我都嘮叨這麼久了，兩位想來點什麼？�

entries.source: If you'll excuse us, we have a few other things we need to be about and not much time to do them in.�
entries.translation: 恕我們失陪，還有些別的事要辦，時間也不多了。�

entries.source: Ah well, I suppose I'll live without the company. Good day to you!�
entries.translation: 啊，好吧，看來我還是得自己消磨時間了。祝兩位愉快！�

entries.source: And to you as well...�
entries.translation: 您也是……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C2_Peter_the_Grey�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C2_Peter_the_Grey�

	「灰袍」彼得只停下來把一張打翻了麥酒杯的桌子擦乾淨，隨即匆匆趕了過來。�

entries.source: Back already? Fine enough with me, I like the company. What can Peter do for you?�
entries.translation: 這麼快又回來啦？我倒是不介意，我喜歡有人陪。彼得能為兩位做點什麼？�

entries.source: If you'll excuse us, we have a few other things we need to be about and not much time to do them in.�

歐文的肚子咕嚕作響。
	他等另一名客人點完烤雞跟一杯麥酒之後，才招呼這名酒館老闆暫時放下其他事務，希望既能打聽點消息，又能順便討點吃的……�

entries.source: Evening gents. Just let me know if you need anything.�
entries.translation: 晚安，各位。需要什麼儘管吩咐。�

entries.source: The three of us are fine, but you sound as if you've had better days. Is something bothering you friend?�
entries.translation: 我們三個都挺好，不過聽你這語氣，日子過得不太順啊。朋友，有什麼煩心事嗎？�

entries.source: I don't suppose you would be interested in becoming a skully would you lad?�
entries.translation: 小夥子，你該不會有興趣來當個洗碗小廝吧？�

entries.source: I can't honestly say its on my list of ambitions at the moment, no. Having problems with the help?�
entries.translation: 老實說，這目前還真不在我的志向清單上。跟幫手處得不太順？�

entries.source: I wouldn't call it problems so much as disappointments. I don't know what to say to the lad. He's a good enough boy, kind, honest, hard-working. But all in all, he doesn't have the faintest idea which end of the pan's the handle. I've tried for weeks to teach him how to cook so the wife and I could take some time off, but when it comes to cooking he's as dense as the Thunderhell. I don't know what else to do. But enough about me. What can Peter do for you?�
entries.translation: 與其說是麻煩，不如說是失望吧。我都不知道該怎麼跟那孩子說了。他人是挺好的，善良、老實、又肯吃苦。可整體來說，他連鍋柄在哪頭都搞不清楚。我花了好幾週想教他做飯，好讓我跟老婆能偶爾歇口氣，可一說到做飯，他就跟雷獄草原一樣一片荒蕪。我實在不知道還能怎麼辦了。不過別光聽我發牢騷了。彼得能為你們做點什麼？�

entries.source: If you'll excuse us, we have a few other things we need to be about and not much time to do them in.�
entries.translation: 恕我們失陪，還有些別的事要辦，時間也不多了。�

entries.source: Ah well, I suppose I'll live without the company. Good day to you!�
entries.translation: 啊，好吧，看來我還是得自己消磨時間了。祝兩位愉快！�

entries.source: And to you as well...�
entries.translation: 您也是……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C3_Peter_the_Grey�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C3_Peter_the_Grey�

entries.translation:
歐文的肚子咕嚕作響。
	他等另一名客人點完烤雞跟一杯麥酒之後，才招呼這名酒館老闆暫時放下其他事務，希望既能打聽點消息，又能順便討點吃的……�

entries.source: Come on in, come on in. I suppose you heard about our new cook here at the Duck's Head, haven't you? Oh he can do marvels with a roast and his chicken is stupendous.�
entries.translation: 進來吧，進來吧。我猜你們聽說我們『鴨頭』新來的廚子了吧？哦，他做的烤肉簡直是一絕，雞肉更是了不得。�

entries.source: Sounds marvelous. Perhaps we will try some of it later.�
entries.translation: 聽起來太棒了。也許我們待會兒可以嚐嚐看。�

entries.source: Trust me, you won't regret it, not a bit! The prices are reasonable, of course. So, what will it be for you tonight?�
entries.translation: 相信我，你們絕對不會後悔的，一點都不會！價錢當然也很公道。那，今晚想來點什麼？�

entries.source: If you'll excuse us, we have a few other things we need to be about and not much time to do them in.�
entries.translation: 恕我們失陪，還有些別的事要辦，時間也不多了。�

entries.source: Ah well, I suppose I'll live without the company. Good day to you!�
entries.translation: 啊，好吧，看來我還是得自己消磨時間了。祝兩位愉快！�

entries.translation: 您也是……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C6_Peter_the_Grey�

entries.source: Just couldn't resist the smell from the Duck's Head, eh? That's a half score of chicken on the bake even as we speak! So, what would you like this evening?�
entries.translation: 就是抵擋不住『鴨頭』的香味吧，嗯？我們這會兒正烤著十來隻雞呢！那，今晚想來點什麼？�

entries.source: If you'll excuse us, we have a few other things we need to be about and not much time to do them in.�
entries.translation: 恕我們失陪，還有些別的事要辦，時間也不多了。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C6_Peter_the_Grey�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C6_Peter_the_Grey�

entries.source: Your husband has at last returned.�
entries.translation: 妳的丈夫終於回來了。�

entries.source: Husband? How so? Clan leader? By what right? Upon a time you held all those titles with dignity and honor. Around you, the Clan Ardanien was curled like a golden dragon, ready to rise up at your word and crush whatever lay in your path. Where is that dragon now? Why does it sleep?�
entries.translation: 丈夫？這話怎麼說？氏族領袖？憑什麼資格？曾幾何時，你光榮而有尊嚴地擔起這些頭銜。阿爾達尼恩氏族曾像一頭金龍般盤踞在你身邊，只待你一聲令下便會騰空而起，粉碎擋在你面前的一切。如今那頭龍在哪？牠為何沉睡不醒？�

entries.source: Cullich...is that all you dream of beneath your strange stars? A dead past? What value in all Murmandamus' speeches did we gain but to learn that we are weak? What spirit did we discover in defeat except that we corrupt from within? The time has come to blunt our blades and look to our own, to put down the monsters that we have become.�
entries.translation: 庫利奇……妳在那片奇異的星空下，夢見的就只有這些嗎？一段已死的過去？穆爾曼達穆斯那些演說，除了讓我們明白自己有多軟弱，我們還從中得到過什麼？我們在那場敗仗中領悟到的精神，除了發現自己正從內部腐爛之外，還有什麼？是時候放下屠刀、正視自己了，親手了結我們已經淪為的那頭怪物。�

entries.source: What destiny would you have of the moredhel, Gorath? Should we bend our heads to the earth once more, enslave ourselves to the will of the Eledhel who live in Elvandar much as we trembled beneath the Valheru in black centuries past? Their Queen Aglaranna will not accept us back into the fold as family, but instead as slaves. You've seen our brethren that have returned to them. What are they but gelded bulls in elven servitude?�
entries.translation: 戈拉斯，你希望莫瑞德人擁有什麼樣的命運？我們該再一次低頭伏地，把自己的意志交給住在艾爾凡達的伊列德人奴役嗎？就像我們在那段黑暗世紀裡，曾在瓦爾赫魯腳下瑟瑟發抖那樣？他們的亞葛拉蘭娜王后，不會把我們當作家人接納回去，只會把我們當成奴隸。你也見過我們那些回歸他們的同胞。他們如今除了在精靈麾下當一頭頭閹過的公牛，還算得上是什麼？�

entries.source: I know not whether they rejoice or weep under their midnight stars, but their children grow to great ages, they trade freely under the Kingdom sun. We must fight for so little as a loaf of bread and kill our cousins lest they steal our kits from their dreaming. It is time we became more than savages.�
entries.translation: 我不知道他們在那片深夜星空下，究竟是歡欣還是哀泣，可他們的孩子能活到高齡，能在王國的陽光下自由交易。而我們卻得為了區區一條麵包大打出手，得殺害自己的同族兄弟，只因深怕他們趁我們熟睡時偷走我們的幼崽。是時候讓我們超越野蠻人這個身分了。�

entries.source: Why have you come here, Gorath? Surely not to debate a love that between us is dead.�
entries.translation: 你來這裡做什麼，戈拉斯？該不會是為了爭論一段我們之間早已死去的愛情吧。�

entries.source: No...I need your help but for a short time longer and then I will be away and leave you to your own. So much I ask from my former wife. You then may be free to do as you see fit.�
entries.translation: 不……我還需要妳的幫忙，就一小段時間，之後我便會離去，讓妳過妳自己的日子。這是我對我這位前妻僅剩的請求。到那之後，妳便可以隨心所欲了。�

entries.source: In the name of one I loved once, I listen and I will do as I can. Speak, Gorath.�
entries.translation: 看在我曾深愛之人的份上，我聽你說，也會盡力而為。說吧，戈拉斯。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C4_Cullich�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C4_Cullich�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The woman nodded, then made her way across the wooden floor until she was standing before them.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名女子點點頭，穿過木地板走了過來，最後站到了他們面前。�

entries.source: Delekhan's Six are searching for you, but I cannot guarantee how much longer I can hold their searchers at bay. Speak quickly.�
entries.translation: 迪勒肯的六賢者正在搜尋你們，我沒辦法保證還能拖住他們派來的搜索隊多久。有話快說。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C4_Cullich�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C4_Cullich�

entries.source:
Gorath knocked on the wooden door.
	They were greeted by a uniformed moredhel who stared at Owyn for a moment before ushering them inside. After leading them into a back room, the guard presented them to Moraeulf.�
entries.translation:
戈拉斯敲了敲木門。
	一名穿著制服的莫瑞德人前來應門，盯著歐文看了片刻，才領他們進屋。守衛把他們帶進一間內室，將他們引見給莫萊伍夫。�

entries.source: What have you? Make it brief.�
entries.translation: 你們有什麼事？長話短說。�

entries.source: Sar-Sargoth has been besieged. Lord Narab and an unknown number of confidants freed dissidents trapped in the dungeons and fled north. Delekhan requests that you and the remaining members of the Six lend immediate assistance.�
entries.translation: 薩薩戈斯已遭圍困。納拉布大人與數目不明的心腹，放出了被囚在地牢裡的反叛分子，一同逃往北方。迪勒肯要求您跟六賢者剩下的成員立即支援。�

entries.source: Madness! I have my troops in position, ready to march and our target is only a week's expedition from here. If we leave now, we will not be in position when the time comes for the final strike! Surely Delekhan doesn't intend to divert us into the snowplains to chase a handful of cowards?!�
entries.translation: 瘋了！我的部隊已經就位，隨時準備出擊，我們的目標離這裡只有一週的行軍路程。要是現在離開，等最後總攻的時刻來臨，我們就沒法就位了！迪勒肯該不會真打算讓我們繞去雪原，追一小撮懦夫吧？！�

entries.source: The intentions of your father are unknown to me. I merely bring his message. Further, he requests progress reports on your activities.�
entries.translation: 令尊的用意我不得而知。我只是奉命傳話。此外，他還要求了解您這邊行動的進展。�

entries.source: If he were not my father, I would slit his impertinent throat! What does he wish to know?�
entries.translation: 要不是他是我父親，我早就割了他這副無禮的喉嚨了！他想知道什麼？�

entries.source: You have answered all we have been directed to discover.�
entries.translation: 您已經回答了我們奉命打探的一切。�

entries.source: Enthralling. Now take leave of me and send my father my ñgood ñwishes.�
entries.translation: 真是引人入勝。現在退下吧，替我向父親轉達ñ我的ñ問候。�

entries.source: Your will, Lord Moraeulf.�
entries.translation: 遵命，莫萊伍夫大人。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C4_Moraeulf�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C4_Moraeulf�

entries.source:
Gorath knocked on the wooden door.
	They were greeted by a uniformed moredhel who stared at Owyn for a moment before ushering them inside. After leading them into a back room, the guard presented them to Moraeulf.�
entries.translation:
戈拉斯敲了敲木門。
	一名穿著制服的莫瑞德人前來應門，盯著歐文看了片刻，才領他們進屋。守衛把他們帶進一間內室，將他們引見給莫萊伍夫。�

entries.source: Has my father sent you once more to find out if I have the competence to ñfeed myself or is there something you forgot?�
entries.translation: 我父親又派你們來確認我有沒有能力ñ自己餵飽自己，還是你們忘了帶什麼東西？�

entries.source: We shall take our leave of you...with your permission.�
entries.translation: 若您允許，我們這就告退……�

entries.source: I would advise you not to taunt me so, whoever you are. Once this battle is at an end...�
entries.translation: 不管你們是誰，我勸你們最好別這樣嘲弄我。等這場戰事結束之後……�

entries.source: ...we shall still be your father's servants and you know how protective he is of what he ñownsð. Farewell, Lord Moraeulf...�
entries.translation: ……我們終究還是令尊的僕從，您也知道他對自己ñ所擁有的ð東西向來護得緊。莫萊伍夫大人，告辭了……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C4_Moraeulf�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C4_Moraeulf�

entries.source:
They were not alone.
	@0's pulse quickened as he saw the lone figure approach; but when it became apparent they were not being attacked, he relaxed a bit, squinted slightly in an attempt to see who was about to join them.�
entries.translation:
他們並非孤身一人。
	@0看見一個孤零零的身影走近，脈搏頓時加快；但看出對方並無攻擊之意後，他才稍稍放鬆下來，瞇起眼想看清楚是誰要加入他們。�

entries.source: ñCrualla ñsholbah ñmoredhelan ñnordrannas ñbaktu?�
entries.translation: ñCrualla ñsholbah ñmoredhelan ñnordrannas ñbaktu?�

entries.source: Uh we're...ñQuegianð, warlord. If you could stay speaking in the Kingdom tongue, maybe we could understand one another better?�
entries.translation: 呃，我們是……ñ奎格ð人，大人。要是您能繼續用王國語交談，我們或許能更好地理解彼此？�

entries.source: ñSebah! How progresses the transfer from the Tsurani gate?�
entries.translation: ñSebah！圖蘭尼裂界之門那邊的移轉進度如何了？�

entries.source: We were ambushed, Lord Moraeulf! Several men, heavily armed were moving through the Dimwood. We were lucky to escape!�
entries.translation: 我們遭到伏擊了，莫萊伍夫大人！有好幾個全副武裝的人正穿越幽暗林。我們算是僥倖逃了出來！�

entries.source: Kingdom soldiers?�
entries.translation: 王國的士兵？�

entries.source: Perhaps...I know they weren't under our standards so they probably weren't mercenary. We heard sounds farther off from where they came from. It might be a whole army.�
entries.translation: 也許……我知道他們不是打著我們的旗號，所以應該不是傭兵。我們聽到他們來的方向，更遠處還有其他動靜。搞不好是整支軍隊。�

entries.source: Obkhar may have reached someone and raised the alarm. Damn! This will complicate the march to Sethanon. How close were they to the Six's rift-machine?�
entries.translation: 奧布卡可能已經聯繫上什麼人，拉響了警報。該死！這下賽瑟儂的行軍計畫要複雜了。他們離六賢者的裂界機有多近？�

entries.source: No idea. We got turned around during the attack...Our couriers were killed and we needed field reports. We hoped you could help us.�
entries.translation: 不清楚。我們在遭遇攻擊時被打散了……我們的傳令兵都死了，正需要戰報。希望您能幫我們一把。�

entries.source: What do you need to know?�
entries.translation: 你們想知道什麼？�

entries.source: We have our orders to attend to, with or without our squadron.�
entries.translation: 不管有沒有我們的小隊，我們都還有命令要執行。�

entries.source: To them then, with all haste. If any further complications arise, report to me immediately.�
entries.translation: 那就速速前去執行。若再有任何變故，立刻向我回報。�

entries.source: Your will, warlord...�
entries.translation: 遵命，大人……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C7_Moraeulf�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C7_Moraeulf�

entries.source: You again. I suppose by your reappearance that something else has happened which merits interrupting me?�
entries.translation: 又是你們。看你們又出現了，想必是發生了什麼值得打斷我的事吧？�

entries.source: We have our orders to attend to, with or without our squadron.�

entries.source:
A garden was nearby.
	Wrinkling his nose at the smell of fresh fertilizer, Owyn pointed out a small cloud of dust that rose off the road side. Within the cloud a mushroom shaped man was hard at work, his hoe rising and dipping over a row of budding pink potato eyes. Flashing his irrepressible smile, Locklear crept up behind the monk...�
entries.translation:
附近有座花園。
	歐文皺著鼻子聞著新鮮肥料的氣味，指了指路邊揚起的一小片塵霧。塵霧中，一個蘑菇般矮胖的男人正忙著幹活，鋤頭在一畦冒著粉紅嫩芽的馬鈴薯上起起落落。洛克利爾臉上掛著那抹難以壓抑的笑容，悄悄摸到了這名修士身後……�

entries.source: I half jumped from out of my robes! Hello there, strangers.�
entries.translation: 我差點嚇得跳出袍子外！你們好啊，陌生人。�

entries.source: I hope we aren't disturbing you.�
entries.translation: 希望我們沒打擾到您。�

entries.source: No, no. I was about to leave the garden anyway. Busy hands set the mind to work you know. On your way to Sarth?�
entries.translation: 不，不會。反正我也正要離開花園了。雙手忙碌，腦子才會轉得快嘛。你們是要去薩斯嗎？�

entries.source: Perhaps, brother...?�
entries.translation: 也許吧，修士……？�

entries.source: Brother Marc of Sarth. Glad to meet you. We don't get many ñillirati here. Books don't seem to interest the commoners as much as gold or wenching. But we have scholars enough, all going blind from reading worm eaten books and a dozen boys scribbling away their youth in our vaults. It is an unusual place.�
entries.translation: 薩斯的馬克修士。很高興認識你們。這裡不常有ñ識字之人上門。比起黃金或風流韻事，平民似乎對書本沒什麼興趣。不過我們的學者倒是不少，一個個都讀蟲蛀的舊書讀到眼睛快瞎了，還有十來個男孩把青春都耗在抄寫我們的典藏室裡。這裡真是個特別的地方。�

entries.source: I've a friend who visited here once. He told me that you worship the god of Knowledge.�
entries.translation: 我有個朋友曾經來過這裡。他告訴我，你們信奉的是知識之神。�

entries.source: They do say that, yes, and I suppose after a fashion it is true. If there is a question that can be answered in no other place, your best hope is to look in our vaults.�
entries.translation: 是有人這麼說沒錯，我想某種程度上也算是真的。要是有什麼問題在別處都找不到答案，你們最好的希望就是來我們的典藏室看看。�

entries.source: Seems we at least have a few things to think about. Thank you, Brother Marc.�
entries.translation: 看來我們至少有些東西可以好好想想了。謝謝您，馬克修士。�

entries.source: Always a pleasure to help. Come back and visit me again.�
entries.translation: 能幫上忙總是樂意之至。歡迎再來找我。�

entries.source: Perhaps we will. Goodbye!�
entries.translation: 也許我們會的。再見！�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C1_Brother_Marc�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C1_Brother_Marc�

entries.source: Brother Marc hove into view. Still wielding a hoe in his hammy fists, he gestured to Locklear with it.�
entries.translation: 馬克修士的身影映入眼簾。他那雙厚實的拳頭仍緊握著鋤頭，朝洛克利爾比劃了一下。�

entries.source: I see you didn't get your ear full last time! What brings you back to the Brothers of Sarth?�
entries.translation: 看來上次還沒把你的耳朵灌滿呢！是什麼風把你吹回薩斯兄弟會來的？�

entries.source: Seems we at least have a few things to think about. Thank you, Brother Marc.�
entries.translation: 看來我們至少有些東西可以好好想想了。謝謝您，馬克修士。�

entries.source: Always a pleasure to help. Come back and visit me again.�
entries.translation: 能幫上忙總是樂意之至。歡迎再來找我。�

entries.source: Perhaps we will. Goodbye!�
entries.translation: 也許我們會的。再見！�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C1_Brother_Marc�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C1_Brother_Marc�

entries.source: Brother Marc hove into view. Still wielding a hoe in his hammy fists, he gestured to James with it.�
entries.translation: 馬克修士的身影映入眼簾。他那雙厚實的拳頭仍緊握著鋤頭，朝詹姆士比劃了一下。�

entries.source: Discovered! I fear you will think me a farmer that only masquerades at being a monk rather than the other way around. How are you?�
entries.translation: 被逮個正著！恐怕你們會覺得我是個假扮修士的農夫，而不是相反。你們好嗎？�

entries.source: Once my young squire Owyn here forgets that he has feet, I believe we shall be well enough...�
entries.translation: 等我這位年輕的扈從歐文忘了自己還有腳這回事，我想我們就會過得不錯了……�

entries.source: If he has aches at his age then imagine what complaints he shall have at mine! He shall have to be carried everywhere he goes!�
entries.translation: 他這年紀就開始喊疼，真不敢想像到了我這把年紀他會抱怨成什麼樣！到時候大概走到哪都得讓人抬著了！�

entries.source: He practices to be the Emperor of Kesh, no doubt.�
entries.translation: 他這是在練習當凱許皇帝吧，肯定沒錯。�

entries.source: So what question will you now pose of Sarth, travelling friends?�
entries.translation: 那麼，旅途中的朋友們，這次想向薩斯請教什麼問題？�

entries.source: Seems we at least have a few things to think about. Thank you, Brother Marc.�
entries.translation: 看來我們至少有些東西可以好好想想了。謝謝您，馬克修士。�

entries.source: Always a pleasure to help. Come back and visit me again.�
entries.translation: 能幫上忙總是樂意之至。歡迎再來找我。�

entries.source: Perhaps we will. Goodbye!�
entries.translation: 也許我們會的。再見！�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C2_Brother_Marc�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C2_Brother_Marc�

entries.source: Brother Marc hove into view. Still wielding a hoe in his hammy fists, he gestured to James with it.�
entries.translation: 馬克修士的身影映入眼簾。他那雙厚實的拳頭仍緊握著鋤頭，朝詹姆士比劃了一下。�

entries.source: What is it that I can discover for you now? Kingdom history? Keshian law? Elven tradition? Ask and I shall do my best to find whatever you require.�
entries.translation: 這次我能替你們查些什麼？王國歷史？凱許律法？精靈傳統？儘管問吧，我會盡力找出你們需要的一切。�

entries.source: Seems we at least have a few things to think about. Thank you, Brother Marc.�
entries.translation: 看來我們至少有些東西可以好好想想了。謝謝您，馬克修士。�

entries.source: Always a pleasure to help. Come back and visit me again.�
entries.translation: 能幫上忙總是樂意之至。歡迎再來找我。�

entries.source: Perhaps we will. Goodbye!�
entries.translation: 也許我們會的。再見！�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C2_Brother_Marc�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C2_Brother_Marc�

entries.source: Brother Marc hove into view. Wielding a hoe in his hammy fists, he gestured to James with it.�
entries.translation: 馬克修士的身影映入眼簾。他那雙厚實的拳頭握著鋤頭，朝詹姆士比劃了一下。�

entries.source: Glad to see you, but I'd advise a bit of distance at the moment. There's been an outbreak of the Quegian Fever at Sarth and I'm not sure if I'm carrying it or not.�
entries.translation: 很高興見到你們，不過我建議你們現在還是保持點距離。薩斯這邊爆發了奎格熱，我也不確定自己身上有沒有帶著病。�

entries.source: How could you not know? Every five year old boy in Tiburn could recognize the warning signs.�
entries.translation: 您怎麼會不知道？提伯恩隨便一個五歲小男孩都認得出警訊。�

entries.source: In Tiburn perhaps they could, but as I might point out, this is not Tiburn.�
entries.translation: 在提伯恩或許是這樣，但容我指出，這裡並不是提伯恩。�

entries.source: I thought the Brothers of Ishap at Sarth were supposed to know everything.�
entries.translation: 我還以為薩斯的伊夏兄弟會應該無所不知呢。�

entries.source: Perhaps we will someday, Ishap willing, but let me tell you something. When I was about your age, I discovered a miraculous thing about planting. For years I had kept a journal about the things that I had learned as I had scratched in the dirt. One day--- shortly after my acceptance into the Brotherhood of Ishap--- I was going over some of my notes and I made a miraculous discovery. It would change the way that farmers grew crops forever! I was so excited that I decided I would share this great secret with the world and I padded off to the nearest town with my journal proudly stuck under my arm.�
entries.translation: 或許有朝一日會的，只要伊夏神保佑，不過讓我跟你說件事。我像你這麼大的時候，曾在種植上發現了一件不可思議的事。多年來，我把自己在田裡耕作時學到的東西都記在日記裡。有一天——就在我剛加入伊夏兄弟會不久之後——我翻閱著自己的一些筆記，竟有了個驚人的發現！這將永遠改變農夫種植作物的方式！我興奮極了，決定要把這個大祕密公諸於世，便把日記得意洋洋地夾在腋下，一路小跑到了最近的城鎮。�

entries.source: Did the farmers use your technique?�
entries.translation: 那些農夫用了您的技術嗎？�

entries.source: Oh, yes...and they had been using it for over three hundred years! My humble tricks were childish speculation next to what the farmers already knew. My point is this; if our brethren in Malac's Cross have something that they consider common knowledge, it might remain uncommon knowledge to the rest of us for years because they assume we should already know it. Like any other portable good, Knowledge must be collected and given out. That, my friends, is the primary reason that Sarth exists.�
entries.translation: 噢，用了……而且他們早就用了三百多年了！比起這些農夫早就知道的東西，我那點粗淺的小把戲不過是孩子氣的空想罷了。我想說的是：要是我們在馬拉克十字鎮的弟兄，把某些事當成理所當然的常識，對我們其他人來說，那可能會因為他們以為我們早就該知道，而多年來一直是不為人知的知識。知識就跟其他可攜帶的財貨一樣，必須被收集、被傳播出去。朋友們，這正是薩斯之所以存在的主要原因。�

entries.source: Seems we at least have a few things to think about. Thank you, Brother Marc.�
entries.translation: 看來我們至少有些東西可以好好想想了。謝謝您，馬克修士。�

entries.source: Always a pleasure to help. Come back and visit me again.�
entries.translation: 能幫上忙總是樂意之至。歡迎再來找我。�

entries.source: Perhaps we will. Goodbye!�
entries.translation: 也許我們會的。再見！�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C3_Brother_Marc�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C3_Brother_Marc�

entries.source: Brother Marc hove into view. Still wielding a hoe in his hammy fists, he gestured to James with it.�
entries.translation: 馬克修士的身影映入眼簾。他那雙厚實的拳頭仍緊握著鋤頭，朝詹姆士比劃了一下。�

entries.source: Don't get too close. As I said earlier, I may be carrying the fever and I don't want to make any of you ill. Perhaps you want me to look up something for you in Sarth's library?�
entries.translation: 別靠太近。就像我先前說的，我可能帶著熱病，不想害你們任何人生病。也許你們想請我到薩斯的圖書館替你們查點東西？�

entries.source: Seems we at least have a few things to think about. Thank you, Brother Marc.  And perhaps we can get a turnip from your garden next time we visit.�
entries.translation: 看來我們至少有些東西可以好好想想了。謝謝您，馬克修士。也許我們下次來訪時，還能跟您討顆蕪菁。�

entries.source: I will see to it! Good day!�
entries.translation: 我會留意的！祝您愉快！�

entries.source: Good day to you as well...�
entries.translation: 您也是……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C3_Brother_Marc�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C3_Brother_Marc�

entries.source: Brother Marc hove into view. Still wielding a hoe in his hammy fists, he gestured to Owyn with it.�
entries.translation: 馬克修士的身影映入眼簾。他那雙厚實的拳頭仍緊握著鋤頭，朝歐文比劃了一下。�

entries.source: I would advise you to stay well clear of Sarth. Our Brother Dominic has fallen ill with Quegian Fever.�
entries.translation: 我勸你們最好離薩斯遠一點。我們的多明尼克修士染上了奎格熱。�

entries.source: Why didn't anyone treat the fever before it became serious?�
entries.translation: 怎麼沒人在病情惡化之前就治療呢？�

entries.source: None of us knew he was infected until this morning. When he woke this morning he reported to the brotherhood's herbalist that he was experiencing dizziness.�
entries.translation: 我們誰也不知道他染病了，直到今天早上才發現。他今早醒來後，向兄弟會的藥草師報告說自己感到暈眩。�

entries.source: It's one of the early signs of the fever, but I wouldn't be overly concerned. Quegian Fever is rarely fatal to adults.�
entries.translation: 這是熱病的早期徵兆之一，不過我倒不會太過擔心。奎格熱對成年人來說很少致命。�

entries.source: It's not the fever's primary effects that concern me. As Keeper of the Gates, Brother Dominic is the greatest wielder of the magical arts among us. Should he begin to hallucinate, he may lose his capacity to discern between real and imagined threats. He might view other members of the brotherhood as enemies or perhaps he will see a threat in the outside world. We know from Pug of Stardock that things of this nature can occur when magicians fall ill.�
entries.translation: 讓我擔心的並不是熱病本身的主要影響。身為『守門者』，多明尼克修士是我們之中法術造詣最深的人。要是他開始出現幻覺，恐怕就會失去分辨真實威脅與想像威脅的能力。他可能會把兄弟會的其他成員當成敵人，又或者會在外界看見根本不存在的威脅。我們從星塢島的帕格那裡得知，法師生病時確實可能發生這類事情。�

entries.source: No one can break his fever?�
entries.translation: 沒有人能替他退燒嗎？�

entries.source: I am sure the herbalist will do what he can, but our best hope resides in Brother Dominic's iron will. Until such time his fever breaks, the Abbey of Ishap at Sarth will be a fearfully dangerous place and I would advise against going any closer. Was there something you needed from the Abbey?�
entries.translation: 我相信藥草師會盡他所能，不過我們最大的希望，還是寄託在多明尼克修士自己那股鋼鐵般的意志上。在他退燒之前，薩斯的伊夏神修道院會是個極其危險的地方，我勸你們最好別再靠近。你們是有什麼事需要修道院幫忙嗎？�

entries.source: We'll try our best to find a solution, but we have another important matter to attend to and very little time. What happens in the circumstance that this Brother Dominic begins to hallucinate?�
entries.translation: 我們會盡力想辦法解決，不過我們還有另一件要事要處理，時間也不多了。要是多明尼克修士真的開始產生幻覺，會發生什麼事？�

entries.source: I cannot say with any certitude. My assumption is that he will activate the mystic defenses. If that occurs, there may be no access to the Abbey at all...�
entries.translation: 我不敢十分肯定。我猜測他會啟動修道院的神祕防禦。要是真發生那種事，恐怕整座修道院都無法進入了……�

entries.source: At least it doesn't sound as if he will pose a life-threatening situation...If we come across anything that I think could be of help, I promise we will return as soon as we can. In exchange, do us a favor and stay out of Dominic's path until this problem is solved. Goodbye brother...�
entries.translation: 至少聽起來他不會對性命構成威脅……要是我們遇上什麼我覺得可能有幫助的東西，我保證會盡快回來。作為交換，請幫我們個忙，在這件事解決之前別擋到多明尼克的路。再見了，修士……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C6_Brother_Marc�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C6_Brother_Marc�

entries.source: Brother Marc hove into view. Still wielding a hoe in his hammy fists, he gestured to Owyn with it.�
entries.translation: 馬克修士的身影映入眼簾。他那雙厚實的拳頭仍緊握著鋤頭，朝歐文比劃了一下。�

entries.source: Like a moth to the candleflame? What about Sarth has you so quickly back here?�
entries.translation: 就像飛蛾撲火一樣？薩斯有什麼魔力，讓你們這麼快又回來了？�

entries.source: Thorgath and I still have things we need to attend to, so I guess I should bid you farewell.�
entries.translation: 索爾加斯跟我還有些事要處理，我想該向您道別了。�

entries.source: Travel under Ishap's blessings, young one.�
entries.translation: 願伊夏神保佑你們一路平安，年輕人。�

entries.source: We will try. Thank you. Goodbye, Brother Marc.�
entries.translation: 我們會盡力的。謝謝您。再見了，馬克修士。�

entries.source:
Sparks rocketed down the corridor.
	Slamming Owyn flat against the mineshaft walls, Locklear narrowly leapt for cover himself as something skidded along the rocky floor. Abruptly the glowing cone of fire winked out of existence as it collided with an unseen wall. After several long heartbeats, the Seigneur peeled himself away from the wall, just in time to meet the gaze of a short, tree stump of a man.�
entries.translation:
火花在走廊中竄射而過。
	洛克利爾將歐文猛地按在礦坑坑壁上，自己也險險躍身閃避，某樣東西正沿著石地滑掠而過。那團發光的火焰錐忽然撞上一道看不見的牆，瞬間消失無蹤。過了好幾個漫長的心跳，這位紳爵才緩緩從牆邊移開身子，正好與一個矮壯如樹樁的男人四目相對。�

entries.source: Bloddy awful hammer!...  You'd best 'ave a demon in your bones. You 'ave come to take a whack at killing the beastie 'ave you not?�
entries.translation: 這該死的破鎚子！……你這身子骨裡最好是藏了個惡魔。你們是來幫忙宰了那怪物的吧，是不是？�

entries.source: Beastie?�
entries.translation: 怪物？�

entries.source: Beastie, aye! 'alf a week ago we 'eard something fierce a'bayin' in the mine, terrible cold like. Of course a dwarf knows the sound instant whether he's heard it before or not---Brak Nurr. Curse of every hole delver since first dwarves took up hammers.�
entries.translation: 怪物，沒錯！半個禮拜前，我們聽見礦坑裡傳來一陣兇猛的咆哮聲，冷得嚇人。矮人一聽就知道，不管以前聽沒聽過——那是布拉克努爾。打從矮人第一次拿起鎚子挖洞開始，牠就是每個礦工的詛咒。�

entries.source: I've never heard of them...�
entries.translation: 我從沒聽說過牠們……�

entries.source: No one has in quite a while, laddie. There 'asn't been a Brak Nurr in the upper mines for well on since Delong the Great laid claim to the Kingdom of the Isles. We thought we'd laid low the lot o' them but the kobolds are stirring them up on their quest.�
entries.translation: 好一段時間沒人聽過了，小子。自從戴隆大帝奪下群島王國以來，上層礦坑就再也沒出現過布拉克努爾。我們原以為早就把牠們全都解決了，可科博德在他們的聖戰中把牠們給攪動起來了。�

entries.source: Kobolds?�
entries.translation: 科博德？�

entries.source: Your folk call them gnomes. They used to worship a dragon what lived down here, but when the dragon disappeared, they thought the dwarven folk 'id him away. Every now and again their leader Feydhir takes a notion to undertake a holy quest to find him. This time they must've woke up a clutch of Brak Nurr. Now the Nurr have collapsed the main passage an' kilt thirty of our kin. We've a reward to whomever can do it in---if you're of a mind and 'ave the spirit that is.�
entries.translation: 你們那邊的人管牠們叫地精。牠們以前信奉一頭住在這下面的龍，可那條龍消失以後，牠們就認定是矮人把牠給藏起來了。牠們的首領菲德希爾三不五時就會興起一股聖戰的念頭，想去把牠找出來。這回牠們肯定是驚動了一窩布拉克努爾。如今那些努爾把主通道給塌了，還害死了我們三十個同胞。誰要能宰了牠，我們有賞——當然，前提是你們有那個膽量跟本事。�

entries.source: Thank you for your time, Naddur. I hope you can get things straightened out down here.�
entries.translation: 謝謝你撥空，納杜爾。希望你們能把這裡的事情處理好。�

entries.source: We'll be fine, soon as we're through some o' this rock and the Brak Nurr is laid low. Ya canna keep us down.�
entries.translation: 我們會沒事的，等我們鑿穿這些岩石、把布拉克努爾解決掉就好了。你們可壓不垮我們矮人。�

entries.source: I didn't think so. Perhaps we'll meet again.�
entries.translation: 我也這麼想。也許我們還會再見。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C1_Naddur_Ban_Dok�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C1_Naddur_Ban_Dok�

entries.source: I don't know whether ya be comin' or goin' lads, but if yar lookin' for a way through the Mac to Elvandar, you're out of luck. Fault me if ya will for courage sake or call me a drunkard bull, but I've as fast a hammer hand as any under these mountains. I canna clear away several months of Brak Nurr burrowing in an eyeblink ya know! If Elvandar you musta see, then come back in a month or so and perhaps we may 'ave broke through! Or is there something else you were wanting?�
entries.translation: 我搞不清楚你們是要來還是要走，小子們，不過要是你們想找條路穿過麥克莫丹卡達爾通往艾爾凡達，那可就沒指望了。你們儘管說我沒種，或罵我是頭醉牛都成，可我這雙鎚子手，在這些山底下可沒人比得上快。布拉克努爾挖出來的爛攤子，可不是我一眨眼就能清乾淨的！要是你們非去艾爾凡達不可，那就過一個月左右再回來看看，說不定那時候我們已經打通了！還是說，你們是有別的事想問？�

entries.source: We should leave you to your work, I suppose. Thanks once more for talking with us.�
entries.translation: 我看我們該讓你回去做事了。再次謝謝你願意跟我們聊聊。�

entries.source: Aye, my pleasure as well, but if you'll excuse me...�
entries.translation: 是啊，我也很樂意，不過容我先失陪了……�

entries.source: Most certainly. We will be on our way as well...�
entries.translation: 當然。我們這就上路了……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C1_Naddur_Ban_Dok�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C1_Naddur_Ban_Dok�

After several long heartbeats, the Seigneur peeled himself away from the wall, just in time to meet the gaze of a short, tree stump of a man.�
entries.translation:
火花在走廊中竄射而過。
	詹姆士將歐文猛地按在礦坑坑壁上，自己也險險躍身閃避，某樣東西正沿著石地滑掠而過。那團發光的火焰錐忽然撞上一道看不見的牆，瞬間消失無蹤。過了好幾個漫長的心跳，這位紳爵才緩緩從牆邊移開身子，正好與一個矮壯如樹樁的男人四目相對。�

entries.source: I 'ope you've not come for passage through to Elvandar. We've gained some ground and cleared out a new section of about three miles or so, but we've a long way to go. After the Brak Nurr collapsed the passages, we've been a wee bit busy.�
entries.translation: 但願你們不是為了找路去艾爾凡達來的。我們是有點進展，新清出了大概三哩左右的坑道，不過還有很長的路要走。自從布拉克努爾把通道弄塌以後，我們可是忙得不可開交。�

entries.source: Any idea how long a delay we should expect?�
entries.translation: 你們估計還要拖多久？�

entries.source: Even with a 'undred dwarves flaying rock until they've bashed their bairns in, it'll take some while. The rock's festooned like a cheese rind and we 'ave to take it slow, else the lot of it'll come down on our 'eads and the whole of it gone to waste. We may get some 'elp though. We've been tapping messages back 'n forth through the rock and our cousins on the other side say that Aglaranna of the elves may be able to lend a hand.�
entries.translation: 就算派上一百個矮人拚了命地鑿石頭，也還是得花上一段時間。這岩層鬆得跟乳酪皮似的，我們得慢慢來，不然整片都會塌在我們頭上，全部白費工夫。不過我們或許能得到些幫助。我們一直隔著岩石敲敲打打互通消息，對面的同族說，精靈那邊的亞葛拉蘭娜或許能幫上一把。�

entries.source: We should leave you to your work, I suppose. Thanks once more for talking with us.�
entries.translation: 我看我們該讓你回去做事了。再次謝謝你願意跟我們聊聊。�

entries.source: Aye, my pleasure as well, but if you'll excuse me...�
entries.translation: 是啊，我也很樂意，不過容我先失陪了……�

entries.source: Most certainly. We will be on our way as well...�
entries.translation: 當然。我們這就上路了……�

entries.source: I've a section to clear through before the day's end and I canna be bothered aconstant. What can I do for ya?�
entries.translation: 我今天天黑前得清出一段坑道，可沒空一直被打擾。有什麼能為你們效勞的？�

entries.source:
A shadow approached.
	From a murky corner of the mine tunnel, the figure advanced towards them. @0's pulse quickened for a moment, but he relaxed slightly as he saw they were not about to be attacked.�
entries.translation:
一道陰影靠近。
	那身影從礦坑通道陰暗的角落中，朝他們走了過來。@0的脈搏頓時加快，但看出對方並無攻擊之意後，便稍稍放鬆下來。�

entries.source: We're at a deed 'alt at the moment. We 'ad a section of mine exposed, nearly the entire length to Elvandar when we found another blasted Brak Nurr hole! It was but a wee tyke and we were able to kill it, but that kept us bent in fits for weeks. Alone, 'e was able to collapse several hundred yards o' rock. We've got to make sure that the mine will 'old up to new 'ammering. Another few months and we should be through to Elvandar.�
entries.translation: 我們現在算是徹底停工了。原本都快把整段坑道打通到艾爾凡達了，結果又發現一個該死的布拉克努爾巢穴！雖然只是隻小的，我們也把牠給宰了，可這事就讓我們忙上了好幾個禮拜。牠一隻就塌了好幾百碼的岩石。我們得先確保這段坑道禁得起再度開鑿。再過幾個月，我們應該就能打通到艾爾凡達了。�

entries.source: Thank you for your time, Naddur. I hope you can get things straightened out down here.�
entries.translation: 謝謝你撥空，納杜爾。希望你們能把這裡的事情處理好。�
