entries.translation: 你們儘管說我沒種，或罵我是頭醉牛都成，可我這雙鎚子手，在這些山底下可沒人比得上快。布拉克努爾挖出來的爛攤子，可不是我一眨眼就能清乾淨的！要是你們非去艾爾凡達不可，那就過一個月左右再回來看看，說不定那時候我們已經打通了！�

entries.source: Thank you for your time, Naddur. I hope you can get things straightened out down here.�
entries.translation: 謝謝你撥空，納杜爾。希望你們能把這裡的事情處理好。�

entries.source: We'll be fine, soon as we're through some o' this rock and the Brak Nurr is laid low. Ya canna keep us down.�
entries.translation: 我們會沒事的，等我們鑿穿這些岩石、把布拉克努爾解決掉就好了。你們可壓不垮我們矮人。�

entries.source: I didn't think so. Perhaps we'll meet again.�
entries.translation: 我也這麼想。也許我們還會再見。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C3_Naddur_Ban_Dok�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C3_Naddur_Ban_Dok�

entries.source:
They were not alone.
	@0's pulse quickened as he saw the lone figure approach; but when it became apparent they were not being attacked, he relaxed a bit, squinted slightly in an attempt to see who was about to join them.�
entries.translation:
他們並非孤身一人。
	@0看見一個孤零零的身影走近，脈搏頓時加快；但看出對方並無攻擊之意後，他才稍稍放鬆下來，瞇起眼想看清楚是誰要加入他們。�

entries.source: A'heard you comin' down the passageway, and for a moment, I thought you might be another o' them beasties, come to rattle me bones. I suppose we're all a wee bit jumpy down here as yet.�
entries.translation: 我聽見你們沿著通道走過來，一時還以為又是哪隻怪物，想來嚇嚇我這把老骨頭。我看我們這裡的人現在都還有點神經兮兮的。�

entries.source: Hope we didn't startle you too badly. We were just looking around for a way to get to Elvandar. I think I'd heard once it was the other side of the Grey Towers...�
entries.translation: 希望我們沒把您嚇得太厲害。我們只是在找一條通往艾爾凡達的路。我記得曾聽說，那是在灰塔的另一頭……�

entries.source: You've ófound the way! These mines stretch all the way from one side o' the Grey Towers to the other. We had a collapse here, but we've broke through about an 'alf an 'our ago. I saw me brother McCannur for the first time in months! Oh, but there some tragic loss too. There was a falls in the caverns and the passages to it were terrible damaged. I don't know that we'll ever see it again. Terrible, terrible mess those Brak Nurr made...�
entries.translation: 你們可真是ó找對了路！這片礦坑一路從灰塔的一頭延伸到另一頭。我們這裡本來塌了，不過大概半小時前才剛打通。我這輩子頭一次好幾個月沒見著我兄弟麥卡努爾了！噢，不過也是有些慘痛的損失。洞穴裡出了場崩落，通往那裡的坑道被毀得很嚴重。我看我們大概是再也見不著那地方了。那些布拉克努爾搞出來的，真是一團糟……�

entries.source: But we can get through to Elvandar?�
entries.translation: 那我們可以通到艾爾凡達了嗎？�

entries.source: Aye! But I advise you to stick to the main passages as there's some windy bits that can cause some humans distress. As a common we wouldn't let you go alone as you'd get lost, but only the major passages 'ave been cleared. You'll do safe enow.�
entries.translation: 沒錯！不過我勸你們最好走主要坑道，有些彎彎繞繞的地方，人類走了容易受不了。照規矩我們是不會讓你們自己走的，免得迷路，不過現在也只清出了主要通道。你們這樣走應該夠安全了。�

entries.source: Before we go, could we ask you a few questions?�
entries.translation: 在我們離開之前，能向您請教幾個問題嗎？�

entries.source: I don't see why not. Whadda ya need to know, laddie?�
entries.translation: 沒理由不行啊。你想知道什麼，小子？�

entries.source: It's time we should be going, I suppose. Gorath and I both have quite a bit to attend to.�
entries.translation: 我看我們也該上路了。戈拉斯跟我都還有不少事要處理。�

entries.source: Don't we all! But a happier day I've not long had. If ya wish to be going on through to Elvandar, just keep following yar nose west until ya see daylight.�
entries.translation: 誰不是呢！不過我可有好一陣子沒這麼開心過了。你們要是想繼續往艾爾凡達走，就一路朝西走，直到看見天光為止。�

entries.source: How would you say `thank you' in your native tongue?�
entries.translation: 用你們的母語，「謝謝」該怎麼說？�

entries.source: I don't think ya could get your tongue around it, or I'd tell ya, but I appreciate it nonetheless. Good travelling to you.�
entries.translation: 我看你們的舌頭大概轉不過來，不然我早就告訴你們了，不過還是謝謝你們的心意。祝你們一路順風。�

entries.source: Thank you, then. Gorath, why don't you lead the way?�
entries.translation: 那就謝謝了。戈拉斯，不如你來帶路吧？�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C6_Naddur_Ban_Dok�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C6_Naddur_Ban_Dok�

entries.source:
They were not alone.
	@0's pulse quickened as he saw the lone figure approach; but when it became apparent they were not being attacked, he relaxed a bit, squinted slightly in an attempt to see who was about to join them.�
entries.translation:
他們並非孤身一人。
	@0看見一個孤零零的身影走近，脈搏頓時加快；但看出對方並無攻擊之意後，他才稍稍放鬆下來，瞇起眼想看清楚是誰要加入他們。�

entries.source: I'd not expected ta see you for some while. Did ya get lost in the Mac?�
entries.translation: 沒想到這麼快又見到你們了。是在麥克莫丹卡達爾裡迷路了嗎？�

entries.source: No, it just occurred to me that perhaps you could answer a few questions for me.�
entries.translation: 不是，我只是突然想到，或許您能替我解答幾個問題。�

entries.source: I canna guarantee I can tell ya what ya wish ta know, but I'll do me best. Ask your questions.�
entries.translation: 我不敢保證能告訴你們想知道的事，不過我會盡力而為。問吧。�

entries.source: Thanks once more for your patience. You've been a help.�
entries.translation: 再次謝謝您的耐心。您幫了我們大忙。�

entries.source: I 'ope so, for yar sake. If ya don't mind, I think I'll be back at my duties. Many things ta do as yet.�
entries.translation: 為了你們好，希望如此。要是你們不介意，我看我該回去做事了。還有很多事要忙呢。�

entries.source: Of course. Thanks once more for your patience. Gorath and I have a few things to do ourselves...�
entries.translation: 當然。再次謝謝您的耐心。戈拉斯跟我自己也還有些事要辦……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C6_Naddur_Ban_Dok�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C6_Naddur_Ban_Dok�

entries.source:
A figure moved in the tunnel.
	Seemingly having appeared from no where, a young boy halted them before they could move any further ahead.�
entries.translation:
通道裡有個身影在移動。
	一個少年彷彿憑空冒出，擋在他們面前，不讓他們再往前走。�

entries.source: Who be you and what would you in the Thieves' Highway?�
entries.translation: 你們是什麼人？來盜賊大道做什麼？�

entries.source: I be Seigneur Locklear and I do whatever I will in the Prince's sewers! If you're half as intelligent as you seem then I would advise you step out of our way.�
entries.translation: 我乃紳爵洛克利爾，在親王的下水道裡，我想做什麼就做什麼！要是你有你看起來一半聰明，我勸你還是讓開的好。�

entries.source: Fast with a blade I am. Step any further and I'll do you, I will!�
entries.translation: 我這把刀可不是擺著好看的。你再往前一步，我就宰了你，我說到做到！�

entries.source: The only thing you will do my young friend is die an unfortunate death on the point of my sword. I used to spar with Jimmy the Hand and I'm a faster blade than he. Do you still wish to cross me?�
entries.translation: 我這位年輕的朋友，你唯一能做的事，就是死在我劍下，死得挺不值。我以前可是跟神偷吉米對練過的，我的劍比他還快。你還想跟我過招嗎？�

entries.source: Jimmy the Hand? He's a ólegendð, sire. Next you'll be telling me you've lain with the Empress Lakeisha of Kesh...I'd advise you to be nice like, however cause I got five blokes waiting a little on down to make sure nothing happens to me, see. I don't suppose you've come on behalf of Seigneur James have you?�
entries.translation: 神偷吉米？他可是個ó傳說ð人物，大人。接下來你該不會要說你跟凱許的拉凱莎女皇睡過吧……不過我勸您還是客氣點好，因為我還有五個弟兄在不遠處候著，確保我不會有事，懂吧。您該不會是奉詹姆士紳爵之命來的吧？�

entries.source: Seigneur James? Then you don't...well, perhaps we have.�
entries.translation: 詹姆士紳爵？那你不是……嗯，或許我們是奉他之命來的。�

entries.source: Alright then, down to tacks. If he didn't send you, óyou'll be answering to the Upright Man and not me, so I wash my hands of it. Just watch your steps down here, as there's a bit of trouble going on down here. G'day.�
entries.translation: 好，那就打開天窗說亮話。要是他沒派你們來，ó你們就得去跟正直人交代，不干我的事，我可就撒手不管了。你們在這下面走路小心點，這兒最近不太平。告辭。�

entries.source: Wait...we don't know our way around down here.�
entries.translation: 等等……我們對這下面的路不熟。�

entries.source: I look like a bloody page to you? I've got affairs of me own whats I gots to do...�
entries.translation: 我看起來像哪家的跑腿小廝嗎？我自己也是有正事要辦的……�

entries.source: Just answer a few questions?�
entries.translation: 就回答幾個問題？�

entries.source: Right then, so long as you don't ask me anything what might get me in the hots with the Nightmaster. What you want to know?�
entries.translation: 好吧，只要你們別問些會讓我在守夜頭領那邊惹麻煩的事就成。你們想知道什麼？�

entries.source: I'll be off now as I've got business with the Upright Man. You'll have to come and tell me some more of your fables about Jimmy the Hand.�
entries.translation: 我這就得走了，我跟正直人還有事要辦。你們哪天再來，多說點神偷吉米的傳說故事給我聽聽。�

entries.source: Perhaps we will. Thanks for your help.�
entries.translation: 也許我們會的。謝謝你的幫忙。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C1_Limm�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C1_Limm�

entries.source:
A figure moved in the tunnel.
	Seemingly having appeared from no where, a young boy halted them before they could move any further ahead.�
entries.translation:
通道裡有個身影在移動。
	一個少年彷彿憑空冒出，擋在他們面前，不讓他們再往前走。�

entries.source: No further, you three. This be the Thieve's Highway and not a one among you looks a Mocker to me. Scatter off.�
entries.translation: 別再往前了，你們三個。這裡是盜賊大道，你們哪個看起來都不像嘲弄幫的人。滾開。�

entries.source: And what's to keep me from bringing the Krondorian Lancer Corps down here and crashing your gate?�
entries.translation: 那什麼能攔著我把克朗多的長槍騎兵團帶下來，踹爛你們的門？�

entries.source: Same thing as kept every Princes Krondor from doing that very thing. We'd know a week and a day before and have time for a nap in between. While they was tromping about down here, we'd be looting their houses and their barracks and be all the richer for the expedition.�
entries.translation: 攔著歷代克朗多親王的東西也一樣攔著你。我們早一週零一天就會得到消息，中間還有空睡個午覺。等他們在這下面咚咚踏踏的時候，我們早就把他們的房子跟軍營給洗劫一空，靠這趟遠征發了筆橫財。�

entries.source: Fourteen years away and the Mockers are just as I left them...I want you to send word to the Upright Man that Seigneur James needs access to the sewers, just for a few hours.�
entries.translation: 離開十四年了，嘲弄幫還是老樣子……我要你去給正直人捎個信，說詹姆士紳爵需要進出下水道，只要幾個鐘頭就好。�

entries.source: Seigneur James? Oh, well now that's different. You've been all the talk about Mocker's Rest for the better part of a two month! The Nightmaster has been right straight that we assist you in whatever manner we could.�
entries.translation: 詹姆士紳爵？噢，那可就不一樣了。這兩個月來，『嘲弄幫棲身處』上下都在談論您！守夜頭領已經明確交代，我們得盡一切可能協助您。�

entries.source: Why is that?�
entries.translation: 為什麼？�

entries.source: I'm sure I don't know. I just do as the Nightmaster says. He also said we were to answer any questions you might have.�
entries.translation: 我可不清楚。我只是照守夜頭領的話去做。他還說，我們得回答您可能提出的任何問題。�

entries.source: I've got to go and check on a few things on the other end of the tunnels, so I'll be off now. Mind you don't go pinching on my territory.�
entries.translation: 我還得去通道另一頭查點事情，先走一步了。你們可別在我地盤上順手牽羊。�

entries.source: Your territory is quite safe with us, be assured. Tell the Upright Man that James says hello.�
entries.translation: 放心，你的地盤在我們手上很安全。替我向正直人問聲好。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C2_Limm�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C2_Limm�

entries.source:
A figure moved in the tunnel.
	Seemingly having appeared from no where, a young boy halted them before they could move any further ahead.�
entries.translation:
通道裡有個身影在移動。
	一個少年彷彿憑空冒出，擋在他們面前，不讓他們再往前走。�

entries.source: Hello there, Seigneur. The Highway is yours, for the time being anyway. Keep a watch out though for the Crawler's men.�
entries.translation: 您好，紳爵。這條大道暫時是您的了。不過還是留意一下爬行者的手下。�

entries.source: We need to be moving on now, Limm. Thanks once again for your help.�
entries.translation: 我們該繼續上路了，林姆。再次謝謝你的幫忙。�

entries.source: If you were truly grateful, you'd tell me how it is to get into that palace of Arutha's so as I could get me a few shiny bits...�
entries.translation: 你要是真心感激，就該告訴我怎麼溜進亞魯莎那座王宮，好讓我撈點閃亮的小東西……�

entries.source: I'll pretend I didn't hear that and we'll call it óeven. Take care of yourself, Limm.�
entries.translation: 我就當沒聽見，咱們就算ó扯平了。保重，林姆。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C2_Limm�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C2_Limm�

entries.source:
A figure moved in the tunnel.
	Seemingly having appeared from no where, a young boy halted them before they could move any further ahead.�
entries.translation:
通道裡有個身影在移動。
	一個少年彷彿憑空冒出，擋在他們面前，不讓他們再往前走。�

entries.source: You'll have to be about your business elsewhere, blokes. I'm not to lets so much as a gnat past me tonight or any night soon or for any amount of money. The Thieve's Highway is closed.�
entries.translation: 你們得去別處辦事了，夥計們。今晚，還有接下來好一陣子，不管給多少錢我都不能放一隻蚊子過去。盜賊大道封了。�

entries.source: What, not even for a tax? Something fairly serious must have happened down here...�
entries.translation: 什麼，連買路錢都不收？看來這下面出了什麼相當嚴重的事……�

entries.source: If you're any friend of the Mockers, you'll understand what I mean when I tell you its a matter of family business. Meeting at Mocker's Rest.�
entries.translation: 你要是嘲弄幫的朋友，就該明白我說這是『家務事』是什麼意思。嘲弄幫棲身處在開會呢。�

entries.source: The Upright Man?�
entries.translation: 正直人的事？�

entries.source: You haven't heard it from my lips. I'm just a night watch and a stupid one at that.�
entries.translation: 這話不是從我嘴裡說出去的。我只是個守夜的，還是個蠢守夜的。�

entries.source: I understand. Who do you think was responsible?�
entries.translation: 我明白了。你覺得是誰幹的？�

entries.source: Same one as clapped hands on you a few months back. Whoever it was must have had a hand on the inside. The Upright Man was poisoned. In the Rest they're calling him The Crawler---still don't know what exactly he hopes to gain. We'd never submit to him after all he's done to us. Sooner see him dead than in charge of things.�
entries.translation: 跟幾個月前對你們下手的是同一夥人。不管是誰幹的，一定有內鬼幫忙。正直人是被下毒害死的。在棲身處那邊，他們都管他叫『爬行者』——到現在也還搞不清楚他到底想圖什麼。我們絕不會向他俯首稱臣，不管他過去對我們做過什麼好事。與其讓他當家作主，我們寧可看他死。�

entries.source: We need to be moving on now, Limm. Thanks for your help.�
entries.translation: 我們該繼續上路了，林姆。謝謝你的幫忙。�

entries.source: Such help as it was, but you're welcome to it. G'day, lords.�
entries.translation: 也算不上什麼幫忙，不過不客氣。告辭了，大人們。�

entries.source: And to you. Watch that the Crawler's men don't do you in as well.�
entries.translation: 你也是。小心別讓爬行者的手下也把你給做了。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C3_Limm�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C3_Limm�

entries.source:
A figure moved in the tunnel.
	Seemingly having appeared from no where, a young boy halted them before they could move any further ahead.�
entries.translation:
通道裡有個身影在移動。
	一個少年彷彿憑空冒出，擋在他們面前，不讓他們再往前走。�

entries.source: Until I receives word this gate can open again, you can't enter the sewers. Sorry, Seigneur. Now please be off with you.�
entries.translation: 在我接到消息說這道門可以重新開放之前，您沒法進下水道。抱歉了，紳爵。還請您先離開吧。�

entries.source: Presently, I'm not so much interested in the sewers as I am in what's between your óears. I'd like to ask you a few questions if I could..., pick your brain.�
entries.translation: 眼下我對下水道沒什麼興趣，倒是對您那對ó耳朵之間的東西比較感興趣。方便的話，我想問您幾個問題……，掏掏您的腦子。�

entries.source: Can't see any harm in it, so long as you're not trying to trick your way past. What you want to know?�
entries.translation: 那倒也無妨，只要您不是想耍花招矇混過去就行。您想知道什麼？�

entries.source: We need to be moving on now, Limm. Thanks once again for your help.�
entries.translation: 我們該繼續上路了，林姆。再次謝謝你的幫忙。�

entries.source: Such help as it was, but you're welcome to it. G'day, lords.�
entries.translation: 也算不上什麼幫忙，不過不客氣。告辭了，大人們。�

entries.source: And to you. Watch that the Crawler's men don't do you in as well.�
entries.translation: 你也是。小心別讓爬行者的手下也把你給做了。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C3_Limm�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C3_Limm�

entries.source:
A figure moved in the tunnel.
	Seemingly having appeared from no where, a young boy halted them before they could move any further ahead.�
entries.translation:
通道裡有個身影在移動。
	一個少年彷彿憑空冒出，擋在他們面前，不讓他們再往前走。�

entries.source: You're in Mocker territory. I'd advise you turn about and leave before I'm forced to do you a good bit of harm.�
entries.translation: 你們闖進嘲弄幫的地盤了。我勸你們趁我還沒被逼得對你們下重手之前，趕緊掉頭離開。�

entries.source: Please, if you could just answer a few questions for us then we will be out of here.�
entries.translation: 拜託，只要你回答我們幾個問題，我們馬上就走。�

entries.source: Questions?! Only thing as concerns me is getting the mess from the storm taken care of and getting us all back on our collective feet. Ordinarily we don't objects to a storm nows and then---cleans the smell out if you know what I mean. But this storm, it did us a piece all right. Water come in from the seas and washed a score of us into the ocean, destroyed our headquarters and ruined our plan to take care of a little local problem. And we almost had him...�
entries.translation: 問題？！我現在唯一在乎的，就是收拾這場暴風雨留下的爛攤子，讓我們大家重新站穩腳跟。平常我們對偶爾來場暴風雨倒也不介意——順便把臭味沖乾淨，您懂我的意思吧。可這場暴風雨，可真是把我們害慘了。海水灌了進來，沖走了我們二十來個弟兄，毀了我們的總部，還搞砸了我們原本要處理一個小小地頭問題的計畫。我們差一點就抓到他了……�

entries.source: Him? Who did you almost have?�
entries.translation: 他？你們差點抓到誰？�

entries.source: The Crawler, that's who, not that it concerns you anyway. Once he had the Upright Man out of his way, I guess he decided that it was time to come round and claim his prize. We had other ideas course. We had a handy little trap all baited for him, one such like he couldn't refuse. Would have had him scurrying back to the Sunset Isles or wherever else in the seven lower hells he came from. Unfortunately the weather didn't cooperate with our little plan.�
entries.translation: 爬行者，就是他，不過這跟你們也沒什麼關係。他一除掉正直人這個絆腳石，我猜他就打算回來領取他的獎賞了。我們可另有打算。我們給他布下了一個現成的小陷阱，誘餌他絕對拒絕不了。本來能讓他夾著尾巴逃回落日群島，或是他打哪個地獄爬出來的地方去的。可惜天公不作美，搞砸了我們的小計畫。�

entries.source: Are any of your Mockers magicians?�
entries.translation: 你們嘲弄幫裡有法師嗎？�

entries.source: No, at least none that admits it freely. Sooner cut a magician's throat than let him among us, but if truth be known we would have welcomed one this past few months. Some of the Crawler's men are magic types.�
entries.translation: 沒有，至少沒人願意大方承認。我們寧可割了法師的喉嚨，也不會讓他混進來，不過說實話，這幾個月我們倒是巴不得有一個。爬行者的手下裡，有幾個是玩法術的。�

entries.source: Are they? Any of them left down here?�
entries.translation: 是嗎？他們還有留在這下面的嗎？�

entries.source: Who's to say? We're still picking through our own dead, much less worried about which of them were still here. Large portions of the sewers are collapsed. There's even word that when a portion of the sea wall collapsed, it opened a new stairwell to a lower level of the sewers.�
entries.translation: 誰說得準？我們還在清點自己的死者，哪還顧得上他們有誰留在這下面。下水道有大片都塌了。甚至還有傳言說，海堤有一段崩塌時，打通了一道通往下水道更深層的新樓梯。�

entries.source: I think it is time we left, Owyn.�
entries.translation: 我看我們該走了，歐文。�

entries.source: Do what you like, pointy ears, just get out of the sewers afore someone decides to make a meat pie out of you.�
entries.translation: 你想幹嘛隨你，尖耳朵，只要趁還沒人把你剁成肉派之前滾出下水道就行。�

entries.source: Believe me, I have no burning desire to stay down here. I for one will be quite happy if I never see the underside of Krondor again. Goodbye, Limm, and good luck.�
entries.translation: 相信我，我一點都不想留在這下面。要是這輩子再也不用見到克朗多的地下世界，我會很高興的。再見了，林姆，祝你好運。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C6_Limm�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C6_Limm�

entries.source:
A figure moved in the tunnel.
	Seemingly having appeared from no where, a young boy halted them before they could move any further ahead.�
entries.translation:
通道裡有個身影在移動。
	一個少年彷彿憑空冒出，擋在他們面前，不讓他們再往前走。�

entries.source: Look, unless you're willing to help clean up this mess down here, I'd shag a behind to get out of here. I'm not the type as to kill people I don't know at the drop of a hat, but not so many of our Mocker brethren are so agreeably disposed. Get my meaning? Split before you get split.�
entries.translation: 聽著，除非你們願意幫忙收拾這下面的爛攤子，不然我勸你們最好趕緊滾。我不是那種一言不合就殺陌生人的人，可我們嘲弄幫的弟兄們可沒幾個這麼隨和。懂我意思嗎？趁還沒被劈成兩半之前，自己閃人。�

entries.source: Could we at least ask you a few questions?�
entries.translation: 我們至少能問你幾個問題嗎？�

entries.source: Sounds to me like you just did...What you want to know?�
entries.translation: 聽起來你剛剛已經問了……你想知道什麼？�

entries.source: I think we've learned enough for the time being.�
entries.translation: 我看我們現在打聽得也夠多了。�

entries.source: Surprised your head hasn't popped open, all the knowledge you've got up there. Have to be a right genius...�
entries.translation: 真奇怪你腦袋裡裝了這麼多東西居然沒炸開。肯定是個十足的天才……�

entries.source: Goodóbye, Limm. Try not to steal anything that you can't carry.�
entries.translation: 再ó見了，林姆。別偷些你扛不動的東西。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C6_Limm�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C6_Limm�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: What can I do for you today?�
entries.translation: 今天有什麼能為你們效勞的？�

entries.source: I do believe this is the loneliest tavern I've ever visited. Where ñis everyone?�
entries.translation: 我真心覺得這是我去過最冷清的酒館了。大家都ñ跑哪去了？�

entries.source: Everyone is elsewhere. With the exception of Rake, myself and a handful of boarders that have wandered in from off the road, there's not been another soul in town since the Festival.�
entries.translation: 大家都不在鎮上。除了雷克、我自己，還有幾個從路上晃進來投宿的旅客之外，自從那場慶典之後，鎮上就再沒別的人影了。�

entries.source: Everyone? Why? What happened here?�
entries.translation: 所有人？為什麼？這裡發生了什麼事？�

entries.source: Come the eighth hour of last evening, a cloaked gentlemen entered through that same door there and took a seat. He ordered a joint of beef, a loaf of bread and a mug of ale. I remembered these things because I had ordered the same. Soon as he had finished his meal he went to the tavernkeeper and tossed down fifty golden sovereigns, turned round and was gone by the door. Before the first of those coins stopped their spinning on the counter, the rest of the people in the tavern rushed out after him. The keeper didn't even latch the door.�
entries.translation: 昨晚第八個鐘頭，一位披著斗篷的先生從那扇門走了進來，找了個位子坐下。他點了一塊牛肉、一條麵包跟一杯麥酒。我會記得這些，是因為我點的也是一樣的東西。他一吃完，就走到酒館老闆那兒，扔下五十枚金幣，轉身就從門口出去了。那些錢幣還沒在櫃檯上轉停，酒館裡剩下的人就全都衝出去追他了。老闆連門都沒鎖上。�

entries.source: Some sort of deal?�
entries.translation: 是什麼交易嗎？�

entries.source: Nope. Some sort of damn local ritual. It seems I arrived in the middle of a ceremony that was called the Festival of the Stranger. Traditionally the elders of the town would gather in the tavern and draw lots and the one with the longest lot was dubbed The Stranger. On the first night of the festival, The Stranger comes around and offers the members of the town fake sovereigns---they called them nimptos---and then the citizens of the town leave to sleep in the fields. Of course, I wasn't aware of what was going on...�
entries.translation: 不是。是什麼該死的地方習俗。看樣子我來的時候，正好碰上一場叫『陌生人慶典』的儀式。按傳統，鎮上的長老們會聚在酒館裡抽籤，抽到最長那支籤的人就成了『陌生人』。慶典的第一晚，『陌生人』會挨家挨戶，發給鎮民假的金幣——他們管那叫『尼普托』——然後鎮民就都跑去田裡睡覺。當然，我當時完全不知道發生了什麼事……�

entries.source: And they're supposed to stay in the fields?�
entries.translation: 他們該一直待在田裡嗎？�

entries.source: Ah, no, no, no. The next morning, the elected Stranger is to circle the village three times while swinging a strand of hemp over his head. When he is done, he cuts the length of rope and sets it on the road to let the people know that they can come back. They then know that Killian is looking with good fortune on their township and that she won't strike their fields dead. If the strand is not placed, however, it means that she is displeased and any citizen that attempts to return to town will be struck dead.�
entries.translation: 啊，不，不，不是。隔天早上，被選中的『陌生人』得繞著村子走三圈，同時把一段麻繩甩在頭頂上轉。完事之後，他會把繩子剪斷，放在路上，讓鎮民知道他們可以回來了。這樣一來，大家就知道基利安對這座小鎮心懷善意，不會讓他們的田地枯死。可要是繩子沒放，那就表示她不高興了，任何試圖回鎮上的居民都會被擊斃。�

entries.source: Was The Stranger killed by Killian?�
entries.translation: 『陌生人』是被基利安殺死的嗎？�

entries.source: No, not Killian, but by a man named the Collector to whom he owed money who didn't know about the town's tradition. It didn't matter to the citizens of Eggley, though. They still chose to see it as a sign from Killian and they haven't returned since, think the place is cursed and won't return until the curse is lifted. They've relocated in Tanneurs, Hawk's Hollow, and a few in Malac's Cross. They all believe they've done the right thing and have given me permission to do whatever I wanted here. Out of respect for them, I've decided to keep the old town name of Eggley.�
entries.translation: 不，不是基利安殺的，而是一個叫『收帳人』的傢伙下的手，他不知道這座小鎮的傳統，只是來討他欠的債。不過對艾格利的鎮民來說，這無關緊要。他們仍然選擇把這件事當成基利安的示警，從此再也沒回來過，認定這地方遭了詛咒，除非詛咒解除，否則不會回去。他們搬去了坦紐爾、鷹谷，還有幾個搬去了馬拉克十字鎮。他們都相信自己做了對的事，還准我在這裡愛怎麼做就怎麼做。出於對他們的尊重，我決定沿用艾格利這個舊鎮名。�

entries.source: I don't know. It seems people would have to be pretty thick to believe all of that.�
entries.translation: 我說不準。感覺要相信這一整套，人得挺蠢才行。�

entries.source: Would they? Would you have the nerve to spit on a shrine of Ishap?�
entries.translation: 是嗎？那你敢對著伊夏神的神殿吐口水嗎？�

entries.source: No...but...I guess I can see your point.�
entries.translation: 不敢……不過……我想我明白你的意思了。�

entries.source: Everyone has their beliefs. Many people in these villages at one time were farmers, and it is difficult for them to simply turn their backs on the ñgoddess of nature. They require her blessing before they can go on to new lives. You should remember that before you judge something to be ignorant. So---as my new job as bartender of this tavern, I suppose it's my duty to see if you need anything? Can I set you up?�
entries.translation: 人人都有自己的信仰。這些村子裡許多人曾經是農夫，要他們就這麼背棄那位ñ自然女神，並不是件容易的事。他們需要她的祝福，才能展開新的生活。你在評斷什麼事愚昧無知之前，最好先記得這一點。好了——既然我現在的新差事是這間酒館的酒保，我想我有責任問問你們需要點什麼？我能替你們張羅點什麼嗎？�

entries.source: Thank you for your hospitality, Devon. It was a pleasant respite from travelling the roads�
entries.translation: 謝謝你的款待，戴文。這對長途跋涉來說，是一段令人愉快的歇息。�

entries.source: Remember that next time you talk to someone about Eggley. Time to start some ñnew rumors.�
entries.translation: 下次你跟人提起艾格利的時候，記得這件事。是時候該散布些ñ新的謠言了。�

entries.source: That we will. Goodbye, Devon.�
entries.translation: 我們會的。再見了，戴文。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : CX_HNM_Devon_Town_UNpopulated�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：CX_HNM_Devon_Town_UNpopulated�

entries.source:
Devon spat.
	Evidently less than pleased with the hand of solitaire ñpokiir that he'd dealt himself, he drummed his fingers on his leg.�
entries.translation:
戴文啐了一口。
	顯然對自己發的這手單人ñ波基爾牌不太滿意，他用手指敲著大腿。�

entries.source: Back for another night of Devon's hospitality, eh? Come on in. I need someone to cheat at ñpokiirð! What can I do for you?�
entries.translation: 又回來享受戴文的款待啦？進來吧。我正需要個人來陪我在ñ波基爾ð牌上作弊！有什麼我能為你們做的？�

entries.source: Thank you for your hospitality, Devon. It was a pleasant respite from travelling the roads�
entries.translation: 謝謝你的款待，戴文。這對長途跋涉來說，是一段令人愉快的歇息。�

entries.source: Remember that next time you talk to someone about Eggley. Time to start some ñnew rumors.�
entries.translation: 下次你跟人提起艾格利的時候，記得這件事。是時候該散布些ñ新的謠言了。�

entries.source: That we will. Goodbye, Devon.�
entries.translation: 我們會的。再見了，戴文。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : CX_HM_Devon_Town_UNpopulated�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：CX_HM_Devon_Town_UNpopulated�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: Come in and join the celebration! Welcome to The Stranger!�
entries.translation: 快進來一起慶祝！歡迎光臨陌生人酒館！�

entries.source: What are you celebrating?�
entries.translation: 你們在慶祝什麼？�

entries.source: A new life here in Eggley! You remember I told you that on the night I arrived something very peculiar happened? All the townspeople disappeared, vanished without a trace. When they didn't come back, I decided to stay here and see what happened, maybe take over the tavern...Damn me if they didn't all decide to come back!�
entries.translation: 慶祝在艾格利展開新生活！你們還記得吧，我跟你們說過，我抵達的那晚發生了件很奇怪的事？全鎮的人都消失了，無影無蹤。他們一直沒回來，我就決定留下來看看會發生什麼事，說不定還能接手這間酒館……結果沒想到他們居然全都決定回來了！�

entries.source: That's good news, isn't it?�
entries.translation: 這是好消息吧？�

entries.source: All taken, I think so, though I don't know what the ultimate fate of my tending this tavern will be. Still haven't heard what's become of the tavern keeper, but while I am still here, I suppose I ought to act like one. What can I get you?�
entries.translation: 整體來說，我想是的，雖然我還不知道自己經營這間酒館最後會是什麼結果。到現在還沒聽說原本的老闆怎麼樣了，不過既然我還在這裡，我想我也該做出老闆的樣子。想來點什麼？�

entries.source: Congratulations on Eggley's rebirth, Devon. I hope everything works out here so you can hold on to the tavern.�
entries.translation: 恭喜艾格利重生，戴文。希望這裡一切順利，讓你能保住這間酒館。�

entries.source: One way or the other, it's been fun, so I have no regrets however it turns out.�
entries.translation: 不管結果如何，這段日子都挺有意思的，所以不管怎樣我都不後悔。�

entries.source: That's good to hear. So long, barkeep!�
entries.translation: 很高興聽你這麼說。再會了，酒保！�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : CX_HNM_Devon_Town_Repopulated�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：CX_HNM_Devon_Town_Repopulated�

entries.source:
Devon spat.
	Evidently less than pleased with the hand of solitaire ñpokiir that he'd dealt himself, he glanced up at his new found patrons who were milling in the door. Seeing @4, he gave a halfhearted grin.�
entries.translation:
戴文啐了一口。
	顯然對自己發的這手單人ñ波基爾牌不太滿意，他抬眼瞥了瞥正擠在門口的新客人。看見@4，他勉強擠出一個笑容。�

entries.source: I'm not sure if I like this town any better now that the people are coming back. Now it's all I can do to find a minute to think. Price I guess you pay for your dreams. What can I get for you?�
entries.translation: 現在鎮民都回來了，我還真不確定自己是不是更喜歡這座小鎮。如今我連片刻靜下心思考的時間都難找。我想這就是追夢要付出的代價吧。想來點什麼？�

entries.source: We'll be off now I think. Things to do. Want us to keep spreading the word about Eggley?�
entries.translation: 我看我們該走了。還有事要辦。要我們繼續替艾格利散播消息嗎？�

entries.source: I think we have quite enough people at the moment. I'll be glad when we finally reach a level somewhere between a ghost town and a city.�
entries.translation: 我想現在人已經夠多了。等我們終於達到一個介於鬼鎮跟城市之間的規模，我會很高興的。�

entries.source: I'm sure you'll get your wish someday, Devon. Thanks once again.�
entries.translation: 我相信你總有一天會如願的，戴文。再次感謝。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : CX_HM_Devon_Town_Repopulated�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：CX_HM_Devon_Town_Repopulated�

entries.source: You should know that there are not many things that anger me. But as I feel, I never have been angry until this very moment!�
entries.translation: 你們該知道，能激怒我的事情不多。可就我現在的感受而言，我這輩子從沒像此刻這麼憤怒過！�

entries.source: If I have given you offense...�
entries.translation: 要是我冒犯了您……�

entries.source: Offense?! Every day my men ride to the border of the Northlands to hold back Delekhan's obscene dogs, every day they thrust their lives into the breech to buy another day of the Kingdom's freedom! These mountain tops are littered with the bodies of men who have given their lives in that cause and you spit on their graves by bringing a moredhel into my castle! I should hang you from the bailey!�
entries.translation: 冒犯？！我的部下每天都得騎馬前往北疆邊界，阻擋迪勒肯那群畜生；他們每天都得把性命豁出去，只為了替王國多爭取一天的自由！這些山頭上到處散落著為此犧牲性命的士兵屍骨，而你竟把一個莫瑞德人帶進我的城堡，簡直是在他們的墳頭上吐口水！我真該把你吊死在外堡牆上！�

entries.source: He has cause to be here. Prince Arutha believes this moredhel may have information that can lead us to the Nighthawks.�
entries.translation: 他來這裡是有正當理由的。亞魯莎親王認為這個莫瑞德人可能握有能帶我們找到夜鷹會的情報。�

entries.source: Damn, Prince Arutha! He has no conception of what the moredhel are like and the fact that he has taken this moredhel's word proves it. Seigneur Locklear told me the story about this moredhel and I no more believe in his virtue than I believe in Delekhan's strength!�
entries.translation: 該死的亞魯莎親王！他根本不了解莫瑞德人是什麼樣子，他居然採信這個莫瑞德人的話，正好證明了這一點。洛克利爾紳爵跟我說過這個莫瑞德人的來歷，可我對他的德行，就跟對迪勒肯的實力一樣毫無信心！�

entries.source: Baron, I have a duty to perform and if in the name of that duty I must offend a Baron then so be it! As I have had cause to come to this place, I need a few answers and I sincerely believe it would benefit the both of us to help one another. If you choose to block me, then I am sure that Prince Arutha would be more than happy to inform King Lyam that one of his subjects has deemed himself above imperial courtesy!�
entries.translation: 男爵，我身負職責在身，要是為了盡這份職責必須冒犯一位男爵，那也是不得已！既然我有正當理由來到此地，我需要一些答案，而我真心相信，彼此配合對我們雙方都有好處。要是您選擇阻撓我，那我相信亞魯莎親王一定會樂於向萊亞姆王稟報，說他的一位臣民自認可以凌駕於王室禮節之上！�

entries.source: Seigneur, as a border baron I owe fealty to King Lyam and he alone! What Prince Arutha may or may not do is his own affair. But if by answering your questions I may be shod of you all the more quickly, I am at your disposal! What do you want?�
entries.translation: 紳爵，身為邊境男爵，我只效忠萊亞姆王一人！亞魯莎親王要做什麼、不做什麼，是他自己的事。不過要是回答您的問題能讓我早點打發您走，那我聽候差遣！您想問什麼？�

entries.source: I think we know what we came here to find out. It would do me good to know that if we ever meet again, you will receive your royal guests with a little more courtesy.�
entries.translation: 我想我們已經打聽到來這裡想知道的事了。要是我知道下次再見面時，您能以更周到的禮節接待您的王室貴賓，我會很欣慰的。�

entries.source: I will take it under advisement. Please find your own way out.�
entries.translation: 我會列入考慮。請自行離開。�

entries.source: Very well. I thank you for your outstanding ñhospitalityð. We will be going now...�
entries.translation: 好吧。感謝您這番不同凡響的ñ盛情款待ð。我們這就告辭了……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C2_Baron_Gabot�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C2_Baron_Gabot�

entries.source: I am glad to see you once more. I am sorry about my earlier behavior. Just previous to your arrival, I was informed that a few of my men were killed and the issue was still on my mind. Please let me know however I may be of assistance...�
entries.translation: 很高興再次見到你們。我為先前的態度感到抱歉。就在你們抵達之前，我剛得知有幾名部下陣亡，這件事一直讓我心煩意亂。請儘管告訴我，我能幫上什麼忙……�

entries.source: Thanks once again for your help, baron. Your answers help clear a few things up for us at least...�
entries.translation: 再次感謝您的幫助，男爵。您的回答至少幫我們釐清了一些事……�

entries.source: Glad I could be of service. You'll forgive me if I don't have time to show you out.�
entries.translation: 很高興能幫上忙。恕我沒空送你們出去了。�

entries.source: Certainly. I don't imagine it will be too difficult to find our way...�
entries.translation: 當然。我想我們自己找路出去應該不難……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C2_Baron_Gabot�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C2_Baron_Gabot�

entries.source: Seigneur, I would talk with you but I am not entirely comfortable with the moredhel's presence. If he could step out of the room?�
entries.translation: 紳爵，我是想跟您談談，不過這個莫瑞德人在場讓我不太自在。能否請他先離開房間？�

entries.source: I will be waiting in the antechamber.�
entries.translation: 我會在前廳等候。�

entries.source:
This will take but a few moments.
	James, what do you know about the experimental projects that we have going on here at Northwarden?�
entries.translation:
這不會花太久時間。
	詹姆士，你對我們在北衛城進行的這些實驗計畫了解多少？�

entries.source: Very little. I believe the Prince mentioned you had discovered an explosive powder similar to naphtha but I don't know much beyond that.�
entries.translation: 不太清楚。我記得親王提過，您發現了一種類似那夫沙油的爆炸性粉末，不過除此之外我就不清楚了。�

entries.source: Our powder is similar to naphtha, yes, but many times stronger. With a portion that would scarcely fill my hand, we can rain two hundred pound iron balls onto enemy forces. It would destroy anything it hit. Unfortunately it takes a team of ten men a half hour to re-load the weapon and as yet its accuracy is not such that I would wish to count upon it in battle. In many years, it is possible it will be a weapon of monstrous power, but we will first have to learn how to master it.�
entries.translation: 我們這種粉末確實類似那夫沙油，沒錯，不過威力要強上許多倍。只要一小撮還不夠塞滿我手掌的分量，就能把兩百磅重的鐵球如雨點般砸向敵軍。凡是被擊中的東西，都會被摧毀殆盡。可惜這武器得靠十個人花上半小時才能重新裝填，而且準確度目前也還不足以讓我在戰場上倚重它。再過個幾年，它或許會成為一種威力驚人的武器，但我們得先學會如何駕馭它才行。�

entries.source: It will be a great contribution to the Kingdom's arsenal.�
entries.translation: 這將會是王國軍械庫的一大貢獻。�

entries.source: Yes, and it would be an even greater contribution to Delekhan. What I haven't told you is that thirty of Northwarden's pigs have been stolen over the past six months.�
entries.translation: 沒錯，而要是落到迪勒肯手裡，那貢獻可就更大了。有件事我還沒告訴你們：過去六個月裡，北衛城已經有三十頭豬被偷走了。�

entries.source: Pigs?...I don't understand, what do missing pigs have to do with anything?�
entries.translation: 豬？……我不明白，失蹤的豬跟這件事有什麼關係？�

entries.source: Pig urine is a principle component in the formulation of the powder and our swine can't survive the Northland cold. If someone in the castle has leaked the formula to them, they may well be attempting to build up stock for their own experiments.�
entries.translation: 豬尿是這種粉末配方裡的主要成分之一，而我們的豬又撐不過北疆的寒冬。要是城堡裡有人把配方洩漏給他們，他們很可能正試圖囤積存量，好進行自己的實驗。�

entries.source: Thanks once again for your help, Baron. Your answers help clear a few things up for us at least...�
entries.translation: 再次感謝您的幫助，男爵。您的回答至少幫我們釐清了一些事……�

entries.source: Glad I could be of service. You'll forgive me if I don't have time to show you out.�
entries.translation: 很高興能幫上忙。恕我沒空送你們出去了。�

entries.source: Certainly. I don't imagine it will be too difficult to find our way...�
entries.translation: 當然。我想我們自己找路出去應該不難……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C3_Baron_Gabot�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C3_Baron_Gabot�

entries.source: What can I do for you, James?�
entries.translation: 詹姆士，我能為你做什麼？�

entries.source: Thanks once again for your help, Baron. Your answers help clear a few things up for us at least...�
entries.translation: 再次感謝您的幫助，男爵。您的回答至少幫我們釐清了一些事……�

entries.source: Glad I could be of service. You'll forgive me if I don't have time to show you out.�
entries.translation: 很高興能幫上忙。恕我沒空送你們出去了。�

entries.source: Certainly. I don't imagine it will be too difficult to find our way...�
entries.translation: 當然。我想我們自己找路出去應該不難……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C3_Baron_Gabot�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C3_Baron_Gabot�

entries.source: It seems our time for preparations is at an end. Two of my field captains were found dead in areas through which a moredhel strike force would likely come. That leaves me with one garrison company and two field companies operating under green commanders. That does not make for an advantage in a siege.�
entries.translation: 看來我們備戰的時間已經到頭了。我有兩名野戰隊長，陳屍在莫瑞德突擊部隊很可能會經過的地區。這下我只剩一個駐防連，還有兩個由生手指揮官帶領的野戰連。這對守城可沒什麼優勢。�

entries.source: What of Duke Martin? I know he was visiting here...�
entries.translation: 那馬丁公爵呢？我知道他當時正在這裡作客……�

entries.source: He already is in the field with my rangers. I want you two to work with him to find ways to slow down or stop the oncoming enemy companies. Our scouts have estimated the moredhel have fielded about fifteen hundred men.�
entries.translation: 他已經跟我的遊騎兵一起在外野戰了。我要你們兩個跟他配合，想辦法拖延或阻擋敵軍逼近的部隊。我方斥候估計，莫瑞德人已經出動了大約一千五百名兵力。�

entries.source: You have three hundred men here and a castle! It's far more than you need to stop that many soldiers...�
entries.translation: 您這裡有三百名士兵，還有一座城堡！要擋下那麼多敵軍，這已經綽綽有餘了……�

entries.source: If there are Nighthawks that have infiltrated my troops, we will likely lose more than field captains before this is all over. We have to assume for the moment that the moredhel know something that we don't. If we can stop even half their number, I imagine we can diffuse whatever plan it is they have. So, any questions before you begin?�
entries.translation: 要是有夜鷹會的人滲透進我的部隊，等這一切結束時，我們損失的恐怕不只是幾名野戰隊長。眼下我們得假設，莫瑞德人知道些我們不知道的事。要是我們能擋下他們哪怕一半的兵力，我想就足以瓦解他們不管籌劃了什麼計畫。那麼，開始行動之前還有什麼問題嗎？�

entries.source: Well, with all that in mind, I think we can probably handle our assignments.�
entries.translation: 好，考慮到這一切，我想我們應該能勝任這次的任務。�

entries.source: Excellent. I shall be glad to see you and Locklear in action. Patrus, you stay with them and help them in any way you can. You are far more familiar with the area and as lucid at giving directions as any of the rest of my men.�
entries.translation: 很好。我很期待看到你跟洛克利爾大顯身手。派特魯斯，你留下來跟他們一起，盡你所能地協助他們。你對這一帶的地形比我手下任何人都熟，指路也講得比誰都清楚。�

entries.source: We're off then. We'll come back and report to you later if we find anything important or if Duke Martin sends us...�
entries.translation: 那我們這就出發了。要是發現什麼重要的事，或是馬丁公爵派我們回來，我們會再向您回報……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C5_Baron_Gabot�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C5_Baron_Gabot�

entries.source: We've found Tamney as you requested. He has told us he will be returning here as quickly as possible.�
entries.translation: 我們按您的要求找到了坦尼。他說他會盡快趕回這裡。�

entries.source: I appreciate your efforts, but I have other matters to concern me at the moment. I still do not like the look of this battle. Is there anything you need from me?�
entries.translation: 感謝你們的努力，不過我眼下還有別的事要操心。我還是不喜歡這場戰事的走向。你們還需要我幫什麼忙嗎？�

entries.source: I still do not like the look of this battle, Seigneur James. What do you need?�
entries.translation: 詹姆士紳爵，我還是不喜歡這場戰事的走向。你需要什麼？�

entries.source: We should probably get back and find Duke Martin. He's probably wondering where we've gotten off to.�
entries.translation: 我們大概該回去找馬丁公爵了。他大概正納悶我們跑哪去了。�

entries.source: Then go with my blessing, but mind where you are and what you are doing. I can't afford to lose a man at the moment.�
entries.translation: 那就帶著我的祝福去吧，不過要留意自己身在何處、正在做什麼。我現在可承擔不起再損失一個人。�

entries.source: We appreciate that. Health to you, Baron Gabot.�
entries.translation: 我們心領了。祝您健康，加博特男爵。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C5_Baron_Gabot�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C5_Baron_Gabot�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: Look here you ruffians...You're not students are you---of the Abbaye, I mean? I've had quite a lot of trouble from them.�
entries.translation: 聽著，你們這幾個小流氓……你們該不會是學生吧——我是說，修道院的學生？我可沒少被他們惹麻煩。�

entries.source: No, no. Just travellers on the way through.�
entries.translation: 不，不是。我們只是路過的旅人。�

entries.source: Mmhm. I've heard that line before, but you look honest enough. We gots a few rules here. Follow them and I'm sure we'll be fast friends. Break them and I'll have the three of you spitted and roasted.�
entries.translation: 嗯哼。這種話我聽多了，不過你們看起來還算老實。我們這裡有幾條規矩。守規矩，咱們保證能成為好朋友。壞規矩，我就把你們三個串起來烤了。�

entries.source: We're listening...�
entries.translation: 我們洗耳恭聽……�

entries.source: Swords, daggers and other such stay in their sheathes. I don't tolerates no kind o' killing in my establishment unless its called for. Two, I don't allows no animals, especially if they be bandicoots, badgers or sal-e-manders. They gets in soups and they upsets me dogs and I won't have a baying jag in the middle of the dinner hour. And lastly, under no circumstances whatsoever are you ever, ever to use an óen ópassah in this establishment.�
entries.translation: 劍啦、匕首啦，這些傢伙都給我收好在鞘裡。除非情非得已，不然我這店裡可不興什麼殺生。第二，不准帶動物進來，尤其是袋狸、獾，還是什麼火蜥蜴之類的。牠們會掉進湯裡，還會惹毛我家的狗，晚餐時間我可不想聽見一陣狂吠亂叫。最後，不管在什麼情況下，你們都絕對、絕對不准在我這店裡用什麼ó恩 ó帕薩。�

entries.source: A what? An óen ópassah?�
entries.translation: 用什麼？ó恩 ó帕薩？�

entries.source: Now if you don't even know what one is then I don't have to worry about it, now do I? So, what can I do for you?�
entries.translation: 既然你們連那是什麼都不知道，那我也不用擔心了，是吧？那，有什麼我能為你們做的？�

entries.source: It's been nice chatting with you. I think we may hang about a bit and chat with some of the students.�
entries.translation: 很高興跟你聊天。我想我們可能會在這兒待一會兒，跟幾個學生聊聊。�

entries.source: Whatever you like. Me, I've got dishes to tend to.�
entries.translation: 隨你們便。我還有一堆碗盤要洗呢。�

entries.source: Thanks again. Perhaps we'll chat later...�
entries.translation: 再次感謝。也許我們待會兒再聊……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C1_Ivan_Skaald�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C1_Ivan_Skaald�

entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: What's your pleasure gents? Anything I can do for you?�
entries.translation: 兩位想來點什麼？有什麼我能為你們做的？�

entries.source: It's been nice chatting with you. I think we may hang about a bit and chat with some of the students.�
entries.translation: 很高興跟你聊天。我想我們可能會在這兒待一會兒，跟幾個學生聊聊。�

entries.translation: 再次感謝。也許我們待會兒再聊……�

@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: I hope you haven't come for the match. It's already over!�
entries.translation: 希望你們不是為了那場比賽來的。已經結束了！�

entries.source: Match? What kind of match?�
entries.translation: 比賽？什麼比賽？�

entries.source: You're in the Queen's Row and you can ask that question? A chess match of course. It was wondrous. Jamie Tiller was defending his title against that snot nosed prat from the Abbaye, Kyle Fischer. Jamie opened, moved his queen's pawn to fourth rank. Fischer opened with Abbar's Gambit---arrogant cud---but Jamie actually maneuvered into it with his knight. I was thinking that he was going for the queen...�
entries.translation: 你人在王后街還問這種問題？當然是西洋棋賽啊。精彩極了。傑米．提勒正在衛冕頭銜，對手是修道院那個自以為是的黃毛小子，凱爾．費雪。傑米開局把后翼兵推到第四排。費雪則用阿巴爾棄兵局應戰——傲慢的臭小子——結果傑米居然用騎士順勢切入了那個棄兵局。我當時還以為他是衝著皇后去的……�

entries.source: But he sacrificed his King's rook and took the priest...It's a brilliant move, but it left his own queen vulnerable didn't it?�
entries.translation: 可是他犧牲了王翼城堡，吃掉了那個祭司……這步棋確實高明，可這樣不就讓他自己的皇后陷入險境了嗎？�

entries.source: You've got a good head for the game, Seigneur.�
entries.translation: 紳爵，您對這棋藝真有兩下子。�

entries.source: The Prince likes to play, but we don't always have a board handy. Once you learn to play in your head, a board almost becomes redundant. I have to admit it's tougher earlier into the game. More pieces to keep track of.�
entries.translation: 親王喜歡下棋，可我們並不總是有棋盤在手邊。一旦學會在腦子裡下棋，棋盤幾乎就變得多餘了。不過我得承認，開局階段比較吃力。要盯著的棋子比較多。�

entries.source: It's still fun to watch, though. That's why the Queen's Row is here. Perhaps I can relates the rest of the game over ale, assuming you gents are buying. What can I get you today?�
entries.translation: 不過看棋還是挺有意思的。這就是王后街存在的原因。也許我可以邊喝麥酒邊跟你們講完剩下的棋局，前提是兩位請客。今天想來點什麼？�

entries.source: It's been nice chatting with you. I think we may hang about a bit and chat with some of the students.�
entries.translation: 很高興跟你聊天。我想我們可能會在這兒待一會兒，跟幾個學生聊聊。�

entries.source: Whatever you like. Me, I've got dishes to tend to.�
entries.translation: 隨你們便。我還有一堆碗盤要洗呢。�

entries.source: Thanks again. Perhaps we'll chat later...�
entries.translation: 再次感謝。也許我們待會兒再聊……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C2_Ivan_Skaald�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C2_Ivan_Skaald�

	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: Jab me in the ribs when you wants to hear about the rest of the match. Invigorating sight that was. Now what is it I can gets for you?�
entries.translation: 你們想聽剩下的棋局，隨時捅捅我的肋骨提醒一聲。那場面真是振奮人心。那，有什麼我能給你們的？�

entries.translation: 很高興跟你聊天。我想我們可能會在這兒待一會兒，跟幾個學生聊聊。�

entries.translation: 再次感謝。也許我們待會兒再聊……�

@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: Tell me something. What is it that Malac's Cross has done to deserve the Abbaye Ishap? Have we done some grievous deed to the King that he should ditch a wagon load of disrespectful, annoying, self-centered little dung haulers into our midst? What is it now?�
entries.translation: 跟我說說看。馬拉克十字鎮到底做了什麼孽，才會攤上伊夏神修道院？我們是對國王犯了什麼滔天大罪，才害他把一車不知天高地厚、煩人又自我中心的小屎蛋全都倒進我們鎮上？這回又怎麼了？�

entries.source: I take it the students from the Abbaye Ishap are causing you grief.�
entries.translation: 我猜伊夏神修道院的學生又給你惹麻煩了。�

entries.source: No. The neighbor's dog digging up your begonias and piddling on your front step, that is grief. No, what the Abbaye and her blessed students have given me is a twinging ulcer and a head full of grey hair!�
entries.translation: 不。鄰居家的狗把你的秋海棠挖出來、還在你家門口撒尿，那才叫麻煩。不，修道院跟她那些寶貝學生給我的，是一個隱隱作痛的潰瘍，還有滿頭的白髮！�

entries.source: That's strange. I would think that students would be excellent customers.�
entries.translation: 真奇怪。我還以為學生應該是很不錯的顧客。�

entries.source: Oh well now, customers, yes. I can't stock ale fast enough to keep their eyeballs floating, but as someone that has to babysit their noble asses...that is another matter. I say lock the sorry prats in the basement until they'ze twenty or thereabouts.�
entries.translation: 噢，說到顧客，那倒是沒錯。我囤麥酒的速度都快趕不上他們灌到眼珠子發花的速度，可要我伺候他們那些高貴的屁股……那可就是另一回事了。我看不如把這群可憐的臭小子鎖進地窖，關到二十歲左右再放出來算了。�

entries.source: Are you sure that you haven't been speaking to the Prince? Sounds like something that he would say about his twins. Borric and Erland may be princes of the blood royal, but in Arutha's eyes they are nothing but a royal pain in the behind.�
entries.translation: 你確定沒跟親王聊過天嗎？這話聽起來就像他會說的，說他那對雙胞胎似的。博里克跟厄蘭雖然是王室血脈的親王，可在亞魯莎眼裡，他們不過是兩個道地的皇家屁股痛。�

entries.source: Kids are all the same, whether their blood's blue or not. What can I get for you today?�
entries.translation: 小孩都一個樣，不管血統高不高貴。今天想來點什麼？�

entries.source: It's been nice chatting with you. I think we may hang about a bit and chat with some of the students.�
entries.translation: 很高興跟你聊天。我想我們可能會在這兒待一會兒，跟幾個學生聊聊。�

entries.source: Whatever you like. Me, I've got dishes to tend to.�
entries.translation: 隨你們便。我還有一堆碗盤要洗呢。�

entries.source: Thanks again. Perhaps we'll chat later...�
entries.translation: 再次感謝。也許我們待會兒再聊……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C3_Ivan_Skaald�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C3_Ivan_Skaald�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: I need to clean up some pots in the back, but I might have a minute or two to chat. What can I do for you?�
entries.translation: 我得去後面洗幾個鍋子，不過應該還能抽個一兩分鐘聊聊。有什麼我能為你們做的？�

entries.source: It's been nice chatting with you. I think we may hang about a bit and chat with some of the students.�
entries.translation: 很高興跟你聊天。我想我們可能會在這兒待一會兒，跟幾個學生聊聊。�

entries.source: Whatever you like. Me, I've got dishes to tend to.�
entries.translation: 隨你們便。我還有一堆碗盤要洗呢。�

entries.source: Thanks again. Perhaps we'll chat later...�
entries.translation: 再次感謝。也許我們待會兒再聊……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C3_Ivan_Skaald�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C3_Ivan_Skaald�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: Brave customers tonight! And I thought I was going to tend the hearth with these puny lads.�
entries.translation: 今晚來的可是勇敢的客人啊！我還以為今晚只能陪著這幾個小毛頭顧顧爐火呢。�

entries.source: How have we merited bravery, barkeep?�
entries.translation: 酒保，我們是怎麼配得上『勇敢』這個稱號的？�

entries.source: Haven't you heard the stories? Why there's ósnake ópeople about, roaming the streets stealing babes from their mother's arms and giving sheep the blue heaves. Stole the gambols right off old nursemaid Finch's house and plugged up the gutters at the Abbaye Ishap.�
entries.translation: 你們沒聽說那些傳聞嗎？外頭到處都是ó蛇ó人，在街上到處遊蕩，從母親懷裡偷走嬰兒，還害綿羊得了藍喘病。牠們把老保姆芬奇家的小羊羔都給偷走了，還把伊夏神修道院的排水溝給堵死了。�

entries.source: You don't seem to have had any difficulties.�
entries.translation: 您看起來倒是沒遇上什麼麻煩。�

entries.source: Ah, no. I wouldn't! I lives here and don't have to tread the roads. Can't just close up shop when some pratting student elects to rumble the locals.�
entries.translation: 啊，是沒有！我住在這兒，不用上路趕道。總不能因為哪個討人厭的學生決定去騷擾鎮民，我就關門大吉吧。�

entries.source: So you think this is all part of a prank?�
entries.translation: 所以您覺得這一切都是惡作劇？�

entries.source: Come off it, lad! Snakes that looks like people and runnin' about stealing chickens? If it's not a joke then I'm a gwali's uncle! Course it's a prank! What 'ja take me for, an old buggering gaffer? Now, what can I do for you two?�
entries.translation: 少來了，小子！長得像人的蛇到處跑來偷雞？這要不是玩笑，我就是格瓦利獸的叔叔了！當然是惡作劇！你們把我當成什麼了，一個老糊塗的傻老頭嗎？好了，我能為你們兩位做點什麼？�

entries.source: It's been nice chatting with you. I think we may hang about a bit and chat with some of the students.�
entries.translation: 很高興跟你聊天。我想我們可能會在這兒待一會兒，跟幾個學生聊聊。�

entries.source: Whatever you like. Me, I've got dishes to tend to.�
entries.translation: 隨你們便。我還有一堆碗盤要洗呢。�

entries.source: Thanks again. Perhaps we'll chat later...�
entries.translation: 再次感謝。也許我們待會兒再聊……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C6_Ivan_Skaald�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C6_Ivan_Skaald�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: Killed any snake people on the way in? If so, pile up the bodies by the door and I'll skin 'em for a pair of new boots! What can I get for you?�
entries.translation: 進來的路上宰了幾個蛇人嗎？要是有，把屍體堆在門口，我好剝皮做雙新靴子！想來點什麼？�

entries.source: It's been nice chatting with you. I think we may hang about a bit and chat with some of the students.�
entries.translation: 很高興跟你聊天。我想我們可能會在這兒待一會兒，跟幾個學生聊聊。�

entries.source: Whatever you like. Me, I've got dishes to tend to.�
entries.translation: 隨你們便。我還有一堆碗盤要洗呢。�

entries.source: Thanks again. Perhaps we'll chat later...�
entries.translation: 再次感謝。也許我們待會兒再聊……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C6_Ivan_Skaald�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C6_Ivan_Skaald�

entries.source: Greetings, Owyn.�
entries.translation: 歐文，你好。�

entries.source: Wha?!... Where ñam I?�
entries.translation: 什……？！……我到底ñ在哪裡？�

entries.source:
While your body is lying, safe, still and silent in a cove near Malac's Cross, your mind has journeyed elsewhere... ñhereð...
	Your arrival has been expected. I am pleased to have you as my honored guest, Owyn Beleforte of Tiburn.�
entries.translation:
你的身體正安然無恙、靜止無聲地躺在馬拉克十字鎮附近的一處洞穴裡，而你的心靈卻已神遊他方……ñ來到這裡ð……
	你的到來，我早已預料到了。能招待提伯恩的歐文．貝勒佛特這位貴賓，我深感榮幸。�

entries.source: Me?�

At journey's end you shall not be as you are nor may you turn back the way you have come. The times ahead of you will be filled with hardship and many times you will believe yourself far less significant than you truly are. In the days to come, you may stand at a critical juncture between Rythar and Mythar and if that comes to pass you should know this: A time comes for all things to die.�
entries.translation: 待這段旅程走到盡頭，你將不再是如今的你，也再無法沿著來時的路走回去。前方等著你的日子將充滿艱辛，你也將多次認為自己遠不如實際那般重要。在未來的日子裡，你或許會站在萊薩與麥薩之間的關鍵交會點上，倘若那一刻真的到來，你該知道這件事：萬物終有一死之時。�

entries.source: What does that mean? Who are Rythar and Mythar?�
entries.translation: 那是什麼意思？萊薩跟麥薩是誰？�

entries.source: I can explain in no measure more as you yet understand your world. In years and in wisdom you will come to me again and a great destiny will be upon you by then. You will be ready for the fullness of truth on that distant day. Until such time, you may consult me on other matters.�
entries.translation: 憑你目前對這個世界的理解，我無法再多做解釋。等你年歲漸長、智慧漸增，你會再度前來見我，屆時一項偉大的命運將降臨在你身上。到了那遙遠的一天，你將準備好接受完整的真相。在那之前，你可以就其他事情向我請教。�

entries.source: Tales say that dragons know their own destinies, but I had not heard that they knew the destinies of others.�
entries.translation: 傳說中龍能知曉自己的命運，但我倒沒聽說過牠們也能知曉他人的命運。�

entries.source: I am no dragon though I wear a dragon's skin. I am the Oracle of the Aal and I am the last of my race. I am ancient, older than dwarf or elf, older than dragons and older than the Valheru who were their masters. Stars that at my birth flamed with violent power have long grown cold, expired. All these things I have seen and farther yet I see into the things that might be.�
entries.translation: 我並非真龍，儘管我披著龍皮。我是阿爾一族的神諭者，是我族最後的倖存者。我極為古老，比矮人、比精靈都要古老，比龍族還古老，甚至比曾是牠們主人的瓦爾赫魯都還要古老。在我誕生之時猛烈燃燒的星辰，如今早已冷卻、熄滅。這一切我都親眼見過，而我所能窺見的，還遠遠不止於此，更能看見那些可能發生的事。�

entries.source: You can see the future?�
entries.translation: 你能看見未來？�

entries.source: I can glimpse things that may be. Such was the gift given to all those of my race.�
entries.translation: 我能窺見一些可能發生的事。這是賦予我族所有成員的天賦。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_CX_Oracle_of_Aal�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_CX_Oracle_of_Aal�

entries.source: The Oracle awaits you. What question would you pose?�
entries.translation: 神諭者正等候著你。你想提出什麼問題？�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_CX_Oracle_of_Aal�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_CX_Oracle_of_Aal�

entries.source: I called for you but was unable to reach your mind. The magician wields an amulet which renders this body feeble and he is in the process of disabling the last of the defenses which ring the Lifestone.�
entries.translation: 我呼喚了你，卻無法觸及你的心靈。那名法師手持一件護符，能使這副身軀變得虛弱無力，而他正在解除環繞生命石的最後幾道防禦。�

entries.source: Makala is reckless, but I do not think he will have crippled you permanently. He must have unearthed some Valheru artifact, likely a product of Lyron-Baktos, the Master of Dragons. While he would be incapable of ruling your mind, he could still command your dragon's flesh.�
entries.translation: 馬卡拉行事魯莽，不過我不認為他會對你造成永久性的損害。他一定是挖出了某件瓦爾赫魯的遺物，很可能是「群龍之主」里隆-巴克托斯的作品。他雖然無法掌控你的心智，卻仍能號令你這副龍軀的血肉之驅。�

entries.source: My inability to know my own future blinded us to the possibility.�
entries.translation: 我無法預知自己的未來，這讓我們對這種可能性視而不見。�

entries.source:
It's something we will have to attend to later.
	Gorath, I wish you to stay here and guard the Oracle.�
entries.translation:
這件事我們得留到之後再處理。
	戈拉斯，我要你留在這裡，守護神諭者。�

entries.source: Thank-you. It pains me that protection is necessary.�
entries.translation: 謝謝你。需要有人保護，這讓我感到痛心。�

entries.source: Pug, you may require my strength when you reach the Tsurani magician...�
entries.translation: 帕格，等你面對那個圖蘭尼法師時，或許會需要我的力量……�

entries.source: You ñwill have a difficult time in the Lifestone chamber.�
entries.translation: 你ñ在生命石密室裡會遇上一番苦戰。�

entries.source: No Gorath. You have already given too much to this quest and seen what should have been seen by no one other than myself. You would never so much as scratch Makala's skin before he burned you to cinders. He will be more respectful in the presence of magicians and less likely to do anything rash. For now, you have a responsibility to guard the Oracle.�
entries.translation: 不，戈拉斯。你為這趟任務已經付出得夠多了，也看見了原本除了我以外不該有人看見的事物。你連馬卡拉的皮都還沒抓破，他就會先把你燒成灰燼。有法師在場，他會更有所顧忌，也比較不會輕舉妄動。眼下，你的職責是守護神諭者。�

entries.source:
Pug hurried Owyn under an archway.
	The corridor angled sharply downward, its rough earthen floor littered with a slippery ceramic material which cracked underfoot with each step taken. In places, the boy glimpsed ancient frescoes of a moredhel- looking race who stared back at him with eyes filled with enigmatic hate, the cause of which had been millions of years dead.
	Following a slow bend, they arrived at last at what looked to be a stone wall, but quickly Pug muttered a few words and the door shimmered away into nothingness. Beyond lay a vast chamber, and Makala was waiting for them...�
entries.translation:
帕格催促著歐文穿過一道拱門。
	通道陡然向下傾斜，粗糙的泥土地面上散落著滑溜的陶瓷碎片，每踩一步都會發出碎裂聲。有些地方，少年瞥見了古老的壁畫，畫中是一支貌似莫瑞德人的種族，那些畫像的眼睛裡充滿了難解的恨意，而引發那份恨意的緣由，早在數百萬年前就已消逝。
	沿著一道緩緩的彎道，他們終於來到一堵看似石牆的地方，但帕格很快低聲唸了幾個字，那道門便化為虛無、消失不見。門後是一間廣闊的密室，馬卡拉正在那裡等著他們……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C9_Oracle_of_Aal�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C9_Oracle_of_Aal�

entries.source:
They were not alone.
	@0's pulse quickened as he saw the lone figure approach; but when it became apparent they were not being attacked, he relaxed a bit, squinted slightly in an attempt to see who was about to join them.�
entries.translation:
他們並非孤身一人。
	@0看見一個孤零零的身影走近，脈搏頓時加快；但看出對方並無攻擊之意後，他才稍稍放鬆下來，瞇起眼想看清楚是誰要加入他們。�

entries.source: I knew when I saw Seigneur Locklear prowling about with Baron Gabot you couldn't be far behind. How's my princely brother Arutha?�
entries.translation: 我一看見洛克利爾紳爵跟加博特男爵鬼鬼祟祟地到處走動，就知道你不會離得太遠。我那親王哥哥亞魯莎還好嗎？�

entries.source: Fine, when I last saw him. He's outside of the Dimwood with a small force, waiting for my messengers to reach him. What are you doing so far from Crydee anyway? Briana have you hunting rabbits for the ducal stew?�
entries.translation: 我上次見到他時他還好。他帶著一小支部隊駐紮在幽暗林外，正等著我的信使送信過去。話說回來，你怎麼跑到離克萊迪這麼遠的地方來了？是布莉安娜叫你來獵兔子給公爵府燉湯的嗎？�

entries.source: No, but soon we four will be hunting far larger game than that. Seems this small wrinkle developing in the Northlands is about to become a Kingdom problem if what Locklear told me was correct. I'm just glad to have you two here to lend a hand.�
entries.translation: 不是，不過我們四個很快就要去獵更大的獵物了。要是洛克利爾跟我說的沒錯，北疆這場小小的風波看來很快就要變成整個王國的難題了。有你們兩個在這裡幫忙，我很高興。�

entries.source: Is King Lyam going to join the party?�
entries.translation: 萊亞姆王會加入這場戰事嗎？�

entries.source: Doubtful. This engagement isn't serious enough to warrant bringing the King into it and he's got his hands full enough with the Keshian Empire. Seems one of our Kingdom ships accidentally mistook one of her Empress' Imperial frigates as a pirate ship and sunk it with all hands on board. Naturally, Lord Hazra-Khan is having a conniption. We'll have to fight out Northwarden's battle on our own.�
entries.translation: 恐怕不會。這場交戰的規模還不足以驚動國王，況且他光是應付凱許帝國那邊，手頭已經夠忙的了。似乎是我們王國的一艘船，誤把她們皇帝麾下的一艘御用護衛艦當成海盜船，連人帶船一起擊沉了。哈茲拉-可汗大人自然是氣得暴跳如雷。北衛城這場仗，我們得靠自己打了。�

entries.source: What can Locklear and I do?�
entries.translation: 洛克利爾跟我能做些什麼？�

entries.source: I have most of Baron Gabot's rangers out checking up on the movements of the enemy, so I'll need you three to give me a hand with various missions. I hope you three are in the mood for a bit of running about.�
entries.translation: 我已經把加博特男爵手下大部分的遊騎兵都派去查探敵軍動向了，所以我需要你們三個幫我處理各項任務。希望你們三個有心情到處跑跑腿。�

entries.source: Well, that at least answers a few questions. We'd best be back at getting this battle in order. Is there anything else you need at the moment?�
entries.translation: 好，這至少解答了一些疑問。我們最好回去把這場戰事的部署安排好。您眼下還需要什麼嗎？�

entries.source: Just for you three to be ócareful. We can't afford to lose any more men.�
entries.translation: 只希望你們三個ó小心行事。我們可承擔不起再損失人手了。�

entries.source: I think we can handle that order. You stay out of harm's way as well, Duke. Arutha wouldn't forgive me if you somehow got arrow shot by some goblin archer! Farewell!�
entries.translation: 我想我們能遵守這道命令。公爵，您也要遠離危險。要是您不知怎麼被哪個哥布林弓箭手一箭射中，亞魯莎絕不會原諒我的！再會！�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C5_Duke_Martin�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C5_Duke_Martin�

entries.source:
They were not alone.
	@0's pulse quickened as he saw the lone figure approach; but when it became apparent they were not being attacked, he relaxed a bit, squinted slightly in an attempt to see who was about to join them.�
entries.translation:
他們並非孤身一人。
	@0看見一個孤零零的身影走近，脈搏頓時加快；但看出對方並無攻擊之意後，他才稍稍放鬆下來，瞇起眼想看清楚是誰要加入他們。�

entries.source: Things are not going well at all. I've started to get reports from some of our scouts and from the sound of things, this will not be an easy siege... So, what's brought you looking for me?�
entries.translation: 情況一點也不樂觀。我已經開始收到我方斥候的回報，從他們的說法聽來，這場圍城戰不會輕鬆……那，你們是為什麼事來找我的？�

entries.source: Well, that at least answers a few questions. We'd best be back at getting this battle in order. Is there anything else you need at the moment?�
entries.translation: 好，這至少解答了一些疑問。我們最好回去把這場戰事的部署安排好。您眼下還需要什麼嗎？�

entries.source: Just for you three to be ócareful. We can't afford to lose any more men.�
entries.translation: 只希望你們三個ó小心行事。我們可承擔不起再損失人手了。�

entries.source: I think we can handle that order. You stay out of harm's way as well, Duke. Arutha wouldn't forgive me if you somehow got arrow shot by some goblin archer! Farewell!�
entries.translation: 我想我們能遵守這道命令。公爵，您也要遠離危險。要是您不知怎麼被哪個哥布林弓箭手一箭射中，亞魯莎絕不會原諒我的！再會！�

	@0看見一個孤零零的身影走近，脈搏頓時加快；但看出對方並無攻擊之意後，他才稍稍放鬆下來，瞇起眼想看清楚是誰要加入他們。�

entries.source: James! Locklear! What are you doing here?�
entries.translation: 詹姆士！洛克利爾！你們怎麼會在這裡？�

entries.source: Prince Arutha told us that a Tsurani magician has given over a rift machine to the moredhel for use in this battle. We've come down here to locate and destroy it before Delekhan can get full use of it. How did you get here? We never saw you at the castle.�
entries.translation: 亞魯莎親王跟我們說，有個圖蘭尼法師把一台裂界機交給了莫瑞德人，供他們在這場戰事中使用。我們是來這裡找出並摧毀它的，趁迪勒肯還沒能徹底運用它之前。您怎麼會在這裡？我們在城堡裡完全沒見到您。�

entries.source: When a portion of the Southern Arrow company began to fall back from Northwarden, I decided to follow after them and make sure they weren't up to any mischief. As you might have guessed, they had that infernal machine of theirs set up a few miles to the north, but they spotted me and assumed that I was a human mercenary that was slacking behind...�
entries.translation: 當『南箭連』有一部分兵力開始從北衛城撤退時，我決定跟蹤他們，確保他們沒在搞什麼鬼。你們大概也猜到了，他們把那台該死的機器架設在北邊幾哩外，不過他們發現了我，還把我當成一個掉隊偷懶的人類傭兵……�

entries.source: ...so you played along and went through the gate and ended up here. How did you know you wouldn't end up in Sar-Sargoth?�
entries.translation: ……於是您就將計就計，穿過了裂界門，結果就到了這裡。您怎麼知道自己不會落到薩薩戈斯去？�

entries.source: I didn't, but I was surrounded by moredhel. I imagined that my best hope for survival lay on the other side of wherever that door led. Whenever we emerged here, I told the captain that I had to rejoin my unit and I was off. There were a few close moments along the way, but I won free at last.�
entries.translation: 我不知道，可我當時被莫瑞德人團團圍住。我猜想，不管那扇門通向哪裡，我最大的生機都在門的另一頭。等我們從這裡出來以後，我就跟那名隊長說我得回歸自己的部隊，然後便脫身離開了。路上有幾次差點露餡，不過我最終還是成功逃了出來。�

entries.source: Why didn't you try to destroy it?�
entries.translation: 您當時為什麼不試著摧毀它？�

entries.source: I thought about it, but the device was surrounded by moredhel at the time so I decided I'd try to gather some help. You three are the first humans I've seen in a week.�
entries.translation: 我考慮過，可那台裝置當時被莫瑞德人團團圍住，所以我決定設法找些人手幫忙。你們三個是我這一週以來見到的第一批人類。�

entries.source: Glad to see that Delekhan hasn't had you three for dinner. I was beginning to wonder the last time I saw you.�
entries.translation: 很高興看到迪勒肯還沒把你們三個給生吞活剝了。我上次見到你們時，還真開始有點擔心了。�

entries.source: If you had not slain that Wyvern...I am grateful, but I beg you go from this place cousin and take with you the evil you have brought. You may not take what will not have you, you cannot harm what will not be harmed. You and your people belong among your own.�
entries.translation: 要不是你殺了那頭雙足飛龍……我很感激，但我懇求你離開這個地方，同族兄弟，把你帶來的邪惡也一併帶走。你不能奪走不願被你奪走的東西，也傷不了不願被你傷害的事物。你跟你的族人，理應歸屬於自己的同胞之中。�

entries.source: I do not raid with my kin. Grant me passage, eledhel. I have come to look upon the face of the Shining Moon.�
entries.translation: 我不與我的族人一同劫掠。放我通行吧，伊列德人。我是為了瞻仰『明月』的容顏而來的。�

entries.source: The old tongue...I think then your coming will be well received in Elvandar. Tell my mother and Warleader Tomas I am well and I will continue on toward Moraelin to meet the moredhel there. Perhaps we can yet put a halt to their raids.�
entries.translation: 古語……我想，那麼你的到來會在艾爾凡達受到歡迎。告訴我母親跟托馬斯統帥，我一切安好，我會繼續前往莫拉埃林，跟那裡的莫瑞德人會面。或許我們還能設法阻止他們的劫掠。�

entries.source: What's the Shining Moon? Is it in Elvandar?�
entries.translation: 『明月』是什麼？是在艾爾凡達嗎？�

entries.source: ñSheð, not ñitð, young human friend. Your companion refers to our Queen Aglaranna. In your tongue it means something like Shining Moon.�
entries.translation: 是ñ她ð，不是ñ它ð，年輕的人類朋友。你的同伴指的是我們的亞葛拉蘭娜王后。用你們的語言來說，大概就是『明月』的意思。�

entries.source: Is the way to Elvandar passable?�
entries.translation: 通往艾爾凡達的路能通行嗎？�

entries.source: The attacks directed by the moredhel have made travel a difficulty. Fires are burning all across Elvandar and the Spellweavers are hard pressed to attend to them all. Most roads are impassable, but the western path was clear last I heard of it.�
entries.translation: 莫瑞德人發動的攻擊讓通行變得困難。艾爾凡達各處都燃著大火，織法者們忙得應接不暇。大部分道路都無法通行，不過就我最後得到的消息，西邊那條小路還是暢通的。�

entries.source: Delekhan has dealt us a great deal of grief this day and in some small way he must pay in measure. I hope that your journeys have done you greater good this day than mine have done me.�
entries.translation: 迪勒肯今日給我們帶來了極大的傷痛，他多少得為此付出代價。希望你們今天的旅途，比我今天的遭遇要順利得多。�

entries.source: I was beginning to believe Delekhan had slain you. He will be infuriated that you escaped.�
entries.translation: 我還一度以為迪勒肯已經把你殺了。他知道你逃脫了，肯定會勃然大怒。�

entries.source: You sound imminently pleased at that prospect. Why this charade, Liallan? You can't believe in Delekhan's activities any more than I, and yet you support his cause. You command a respectable tribe and have almost as much power...�
entries.translation: 聽你這語氣，對這個前景可是相當得意啊。莉艾蘭，妳這場戲究竟是為了什麼？妳心裡不會比我更相信迪勒肯的所作所為，可妳卻支持他的大業。妳統領著一個舉足輕重的部族，幾乎跟他一樣有權有勢……�

entries.source: Almost? Do you forget who engineered your escape from Sar-Sargoth all those months ago? Who do you think directed Delekhan's rats into the snowplains while Obkhar's family scrambled to safety. That was my doing. If not for my help, the Six would surely have crushed your tribes from the Green Heart.�
entries.translation: 幾乎？你忘了幾個月前是誰一手策劃了你從薩薩戈斯逃脫嗎？你以為當初是誰把迪勒肯那群鼠輩引去雪原，好讓奧布卡一家人趁機逃到安全的地方？那都是我的手筆。要不是我出手相助，六賢者早就把你們從綠心林逃出來的部族給徹底剿滅了。�

entries.source: Were you responsible for...�
entries.translation: 難道是妳一手促成了……�

entries.source: No, I had nothing to do with your escape this time. Whatever you may have done, you have achieved on your own. Your first escape served my purposes, but your continued survival is as nothing to me. It neither threatens or advances my cause.�
entries.translation: 不，這次我跟你的逃脫毫無關係。不管你做了什麼，都是你自己的本事。你第一次逃脫符合我的目的，可你之後能不能繼續活下去，對我來說根本無關緊要。這既不會威脅、也不會推進我的大業。�

entries.source: Then you will help me again?�
entries.translation: 那妳願意再幫我一次嗎？�

entries.source: I will consider my efforts an investment against the future of the Northlands, Gorath. They will gain me little now, but perhaps at a later day your help may be useful. I will alert my spies to whatever your needs may be. To be honest, I don't believe you will achieve much beyond your own survival, but even that may prove to be my boon.�
entries.translation: 戈拉斯，我會把我的付出當成是對北疆未來的一項投資。眼下這對我沒什麼好處，可將來某天，你的幫助或許會派上用場。我會通知我的眼線，配合你的任何需求。老實說，我不認為你除了保住自己一條命之外還能成就什麼，不過就算只是如此，對我來說或許也已經是種收穫了。�

entries.source: Why are you doddering here? You're only clear path to freedom lies through the Inclindel. Is there something else you need?�
entries.translation: 你在這兒磨蹭什麼？你唯一的自由之路，就是穿過因克林德爾山口。你還需要什麼嗎？�

entries.source:
Someone was calling.
	Recognizing the lilt of the young voice, Owyn turned and looked back down the road. A young squire that he had met at a party in Yabon was trudging behind them, a pack full of scrolls slung over his shoulder. The squire waved congenially and Owyn echoed the motion.
	"What do you think you're doing?! We are trying to remain unnoticed! Damn," Locklear muttered under his breath. "Try to behave as normally as possible. Since you know him, you handle him, Owyn. And remember Gorath's name is..."
	"Thorgath," Owyn finished, irritated. "I'm not a child you know."
	Locklear whispered. "That remains to be seen."�
entries.translation:
有人在呼喚。
	歐文認出了那年輕的聲音的抑揚頓挫，轉頭望向身後的道路。一名他曾在亞邦的一場宴會上見過的年輕扈從，正拖著腳步跟在他們後頭，肩上扛著一整袋卷軸。那名扈從友善地揮了揮手，歐文也照樣揮手回應。
	「你這是在做什麼？！我們正想避人耳目呢！該死，」洛克利爾低聲咕噥道。「盡量表現得正常一點。你認識他，歐文，你來應付他。還有，記得戈拉斯的名字是……」
	「索爾加斯，」歐文有點不耐煩地接了話。「我又不是小孩子。」
	洛克利爾低聲說道。「這可有待商榷。」�

entries.source: I didn't expect to see you again quite so soon. I would have thought you all the way to LaMut by now.�
entries.translation: 沒想到這麼快又見到你了。我還以為你這時候應該已經到拉姆特了呢。�

entries.source: Would have been if the Duchess hadn't insisted in introducing me to all of her daughters. Amelia was the prettiest I believe, though I think Katherine took quite a liking to you...�
entries.translation: 要不是公爵夫人堅持要把她所有的女兒都介紹給我認識，我早就到了。我覺得艾蜜莉亞是最漂亮的一個，不過我看凱瑟琳好像挺喜歡你的……�

entries.source: Katherine took a liking to everyone at the party. She's as fickle as her mother. She'll likely marry a conDoin if she can find one not tied in the marital knot.�
entries.translation: 凱瑟琳對宴會上每個人都挺有好感的。她跟她母親一樣善變。要是能找到一個還沒被婚姻套牢的康多因家族成員，她大概會嫁給那個人。�

entries.source: True enough. Say, I thought you said you were from Tiburn. Why are you taking this route home? Kind of a long way around isn't it?�
entries.translation: 這倒是真的。話說，我記得你說過你是提伯恩人。你怎麼會走這條路回家？這樣繞路是不是有點遠？�

entries.source: Well yes, but I had to meet up with my...uncle Locklear here. And my other friend here is an elf, Thorgath. They decided that it would be nice for me to take a tour with them down to Kron...�
entries.translation: 呃，是沒錯，不過我得先來見我的……這位洛克利爾叔叔。還有我這位朋友是精靈，叫索爾加斯。他們覺得帶我一起去克朗……�

entries.source: Hawk's Hollow...�
...down to Hawk's Hollow. I hear it's lovely at this time of year. What are you up to?�
entries.translation: ……去鷹谷玩玩挺不錯的。我聽說這個季節那裡很漂亮。你在忙什麼？�

entries.source: I'm looking to cash in a reward actually. When I was on my way up to Yabon last month, I found a chest in this area but I couldn't pick the lock on the thing. I figured it wasn't meant to be and I left off. Thing is, all through the Duchess' party I couldn't help but think about it. I had chest on the brain. I don't really care what's in it, but I have to pick that lock.�
entries.translation: 其實我是想來領一筆獎賞的。上個月我前往亞邦的路上，在這一帶發現了一個箱子，可我怎麼也撬不開那把鎖。我當時想大概是沒這個緣分，就作罷了。問題是，整場公爵夫人的宴會上，我腦子裡老是想著那個箱子，滿腦子都是它。我根本不在乎裡頭裝了什麼，但我非把那把鎖撬開不可。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C1_Squire_Phillip�

entries.source:
Owyn raised a finger to his lips.
	 Sensing that someone or something was nearby, he used the agreed upon sign that caution was called for. They steeled themselves for combat, their nerves wound tight like springs.
	 Abruptly, a figure emerged into the open before them.�
entries.translation:
歐文豎起一根手指抵在唇邊。
	察覺到附近有人或有什麼東西，他做出了先前說好、代表得小心行事的手勢。他們繃緊神經，做好戰鬥準備，一個個像上緊的發條。
	突然間，一道身影出現在他們面前的空地上。�

entries.source: Squire Phillip!�
entries.translation: 菲力普扈從！�

entries.source: Owyn?...What a...uh, surprise...�
entries.translation: 歐文？……真是……呃，真意外……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C1_Squire_Phillip�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C1_Squire_Phillip�

entries.source:
The crevasse was occupied.
	Standing away from a clutch of bushes, Squire Phillip impaled them with an flush faced glare while he refastened the cinches of his pants. Deciding that his dignity was not irretrievably beyond repair, he politely tucked in the tail of his shirt while he addressed Owyn.�
entries.translation:
這道裂隙已經有人在使用了。
	菲力普扈從站在一叢灌木旁，一邊繫緊褲子的束帶，一邊漲紅著臉狠狠瞪了他們一眼。他斷定自己的尊嚴還沒有徹底無可挽回，便一邊禮貌地把襯衫下擺塞好，一邊對歐文開口說話。�

entries.source: Not that I'm displeased to see you, Owyn, but you picked an odd moment to show up.�
entries.translation: 倒不是我不高興見到你，歐文，只是你出現的時機還真有點微妙。�

entries.source: Sorry about that. I didn't recognize you from behind and when we saw you duck into this cub hole here we became suspicious. We've had a few problems with bandits on the roads.�
entries.translation: 真是抱歉。我們從背後認不出是你，看你鑽進這個小洞裡，我們就起了疑心。這一帶的路上，我們遇過幾次強盜的麻煩。�

entries.source: I've narrowly avoided some myself. Fortunately they didn't pay much attention to me. I don't think father would have been too pleased if I'd ended up ransomed...�
entries.translation: 我自己也差點撞上。幸好他們沒太注意我。要是我最後淪落到被綁票勒贖，我看父親不會太高興的……�

entries.source: Did you ever find that chest you were looking for?�
entries.translation: 你後來找到你在找的那個箱子了嗎？�

entries.source: A bit of a disappointment. Soon as I had the lid up, I found it was empty. I should have expected that someone else would get there before me. Likely our bandit friends plundered it.�
entries.translation: 有點令人失望。我一打開蓋子，就發現裡頭空空如也。我早該料到會有人搶先我一步。大概是被我們那些強盜朋友給洗劫一空了吧。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C2_Squire_Phillip�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C2_Squire_Phillip�

entries.source:
They were not alone.
	@0's pulse quickened as he saw the lone figure approach; but when it became apparent they were not being attacked, he relaxed a bit, squinted slightly in an attempt to see who was about to join them.�
entries.translation:
他們並非孤身一人。
	@0看見一個孤零零的身影走近，脈搏頓時加快；但看出對方並無攻擊之意後，他才稍稍放鬆下來，瞇起眼想看清楚是誰要加入他們。�

entries.source: Hello again. What's on your mind?�
entries.translation: 又見面了。你在想什麼？�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C2_Squire_Phillip�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C2_Squire_Phillip�

entries.source:
They were not alone.
	@0's pulse quickened as he saw the lone figure approach; but when it became apparent they were not being attacked, he relaxed a bit, squinted slightly in an attempt to see who was about to join them.�
entries.translation:
他們並非孤身一人。
	@0看見一個孤零零的身影走近，脈搏頓時加快；但看出對方並無攻擊之意後，他才稍稍放鬆下來，瞇起眼想看清楚是誰要加入他們。�

entries.source: Are you sure you aren't following me around, Owyn? We seem to be bumping into one another fairly frequently.�
entries.translation: 歐文，你確定沒在跟蹤我嗎？我們碰面的次數也未免太頻繁了。�

entries.source: If seeing each other more than once a year can be called frequently. I guess that wedding party in Yabon turned the both of us into nomads.�
entries.translation: 要是一年碰面不只一次就能算頻繁的話。我看亞邦那場婚禮宴會，把我們倆都變成遊牧民族了。�

entries.source: I've about had my fill of it. If travel broadens the mind then I daresay my skull should be the size of a haywain by now. I'll be glad to get back home again and lay in my own bed for a time.�
entries.translation: 我可受夠了。要是說旅行能增廣見聞，那我敢說我的腦袋現在大概已經有一輛乾草車那麼大了。我真希望能早點回家，好好在自己的床上躺一陣子。�

entries.source: Why are you in the eastern part of the Kingdom? I thought you lived in LaMut.�
entries.translation: 你怎麼會在王國東部？我還以為你住在拉姆特。�

entries.source: On occasion, when my father will allow it, I sleep in LaMut, but I seem to spend most of my time running the Kingdom roads on family business. By my estimation, he must have his fingers in more pies than there are bakers in all of Midkemia! A trader has many things to keep track of and only so many sons to help him.�
entries.translation: 偶爾，要是我父親允許，我會在拉姆特過夜，不過我大部分時間似乎都在王國的道路上，為了家族生意四處奔波。依我估計，他插手的買賣，大概比全米德凱米亞的麵包師傅加起來還多！當商人的事情多如牛毛，能幫忙的兒子卻沒幾個。�

entries.source: Why doesn't he just hire a runner to do it for him?�
entries.translation: 他怎麼不乾脆雇個跑腿的替他辦事？�

entries.source: It's been suggested, most emphatically by those of us unfortunate enough to have been born to him, but he likes to quote a Quegian saying about marriage: Why pay for what you can get for free? Not to paint a poor picture of him though---he's just very practical about his money.�
entries.translation: 這建議提過，尤其是我們這些不幸生為他兒子的人強烈建議過，可他老愛引用一句關於婚姻的奎格諺語：能免費得到的東西，何必花錢買？不過我倒不是要把他說得多小氣——他只是對自己的錢非常務實而已。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C3_Squire_Phillip�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C3_Squire_Phillip�

	@0's pulse quickened as he saw the lone figure approach; but when it became apparent they were not being attacked, he relaxed a bit, squinted slightly in an attempt to see who was about to join them.�
