他們並非孤身一人。
	@0看見一個孤零零的身影走近，脈搏頓時加快；但看出對方並無攻擊之意後，他才稍稍放鬆下來，瞇起眼想看清楚是誰要加入他們。�

entries.source: Care to take me up on a foot race, Owyn? I'd beat you in the quarter mile with the legs I've developed!�
entries.translation: 歐文，要不要跟我來場賽跑？就憑我練出來的這雙腿，四分之一哩內我肯定能贏過你！�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C3_Squire_Phillip�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C3_Squire_Phillip�

entries.source:
A boy hurried from the house.
	Dressed in a squire's colors, he made haste as he closed the distance between them, his expression revealing he was more than a little happy to see them. Huffing out heavy breaths, he waved to them...�
entries.translation:
一個男孩從屋裡匆匆跑了出來。
	他身穿扈從的服色，一邊拉近彼此的距離，一邊加快腳步，神情看得出他見到他們相當高興。他喘著粗氣，朝他們揮了揮手……�

entries.source: Please, do not leave us yet. Seigneurs, in ordinary circumstances I wouldn't be empowered to ask for your aid, but our forces are spread rather thin at the moment. We need every body we can get to aid in this effort, whether you've sworn an oath to the secret garrison at Sethanon or not.�
entries.translation: 拜託，請先別走。紳爵們，換作平常，我沒有權力請求兩位相助，可我們眼下兵力實在吃緊。不管兩位是否曾向賽瑟儂那支祕密駐軍宣誓效忠，我們都需要每一分能用得上的人手來幫忙。�

entries.source: Sethanon Garrison? I've never heard Arutha mention anything about troops being stationed near Sethanon and you're far too young for senior duty...�
entries.translation: 賽瑟儂駐軍？我從沒聽亞魯莎提過賽瑟儂附近駐紮著什麼部隊，而且你年紀輕輕，也太嫩了些，擔不起資深職務……�

entries.source: How old do you think I am?�
entries.translation: 您猜我幾歲？�

entries.source: Eighteen, maybe nineteen summers. About the same age as a squire we know from Tiburn...�
entries.translation: 十八，也許十九歲。跟我們認識的一位來自提伯恩的扈從差不多年紀……�

entries.source: While Count Beleforte's son Owyn was taking his first baby steps, my wife and I had already had a son for three years. I'm thirty seven summers old and hold the rank of Captain in the Kingdom Army. When my commander noticed how young I looked, even as a veteran officer, he struck on the idea that I would make an ideal courier for the secret garrison.�
entries.translation: 貝勒佛特伯爵的兒子歐文還在學走路的時候，我跟我妻子已經有個三歲的兒子了。我今年三十七歲，在王國陸軍裡官拜上尉。我的指揮官注意到，即便身為一名資深軍官，我看起來卻依然十分年輕，便靈機一動，想到我很適合替那支祕密駐軍當信使。�

entries.source: Sink me! A spy for the Kingdom!�
entries.translation: 我的老天！是王國的間諜！�

entries.source: Even if the things you say about yourself are true the rest of your story's impossible. Arutha would have told me about a secret garrison...�
entries.translation: 就算你說的關於自己的事都是真的，你這故事其他部分也不可能。要是真有一支祕密駐軍，亞魯莎應該會告訴我……�

entries.source: Has he ever explained to you why there is an absolute ban on visitation to Sethanon? Can you recall any other occasion in which Prince Arutha or King Lyam have forbidden people to visit battle sites?�
entries.translation: 他有沒有跟您解釋過，為什麼賽瑟儂被完全禁止進入？您能想起還有哪一次，亞魯莎親王或萊亞姆王曾禁止人民造訪戰場遺址嗎？�

entries.source: No, but I always assumed he wished to keep it as a memorial to the battle there.�
entries.translation: 沒有，不過我一直以為他是想把那裡當作那場戰役的紀念地保留下來。�

entries.source: A memorial that cannot be visited by its veterans? You're trying to rationalize, Seigneur. Not even the members of the garrison are allowed near Sethanon unless an armed force approaches. Their orders are to destroy any who come against it. And now I must find a way to get word to them that the moredhel are advancing. Do you have any ideas on the subject?�
entries.translation: 一座連老兵都不能造訪的紀念地？紳爵，您這是在強詞奪理。就連駐軍成員本身，除非有武裝部隊逼近，否則也不准靠近賽瑟儂。他們奉命殲滅任何來犯之敵。現在我得想辦法把莫瑞德人正在逼近的消息傳給他們。您對這件事有什麼想法嗎？�

entries.source: We need to get back to our mission. Will you be able to hold things together here?�
entries.translation: 我們得回去繼續我們的任務了。你在這裡撐得住嗎？�

entries.source: Unless another band of goblins come round, I should be all right. I need to stay here and keep an eye on the supplies, but you'll be welcome if you need to come back.�
entries.translation: 除非又有一群哥布林過來，不然我應該沒問題。我得留在這裡看守補給，不過要是兩位需要回來，隨時歡迎。�

entries.source: That's appreciated. Farewell, ósquire...�
entries.translation: 感激不盡。再會了，ó扈從……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C7_Squire_Phillip�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C7_Squire_Phillip�

entries.source:
Phillip hailed them.
	A worried expression on his face, he moved out of the converted supply house to greet them...�
entries.translation:
菲力普朝他們打了招呼。
	他一臉憂心忡忡的神情，從那間改建成補給屋的房子裡走出來迎接他們……�

entries.source: I think that the moredhel may have picked up on my observations. I saw a band of them scouting near here, but they didn't approach the house for some strange reason. That doesn't mean they won't come back, however. What did you need?�
entries.translation: 我覺得莫瑞德人可能已經察覺我在監視他們了。我看見一小隊他們的人在這附近偵查，不過不知為何，他們並沒有靠近這棟屋子。不過這不代表他們不會回來。你們需要什麼？�

entries.source: There's still some bastardly machine out there and I don't think Delekhan will destroy it óhimself, so I suppose we should get back at it.�
entries.translation: 外頭還有那台該死的機器，我看迪勒肯是不會ó親自把它毀掉的，所以我想我們該回去處理它了。�

entries.source: Good luck to you, then. I don't envy you walking straight into their stronghold.�
entries.translation: 那就祝你們好運了。我可不羨慕你們得直接走進他們的據點。�

entries.source: I can't say I'm too enthused about it myself, but you do what needs to be done. Until we meet again, Phillip...�
entries.translation: 我自己也說不上有多興奮，不過該做的事還是得做。菲力普，後會有期……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C7_Squire_Phillip�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C7_Squire_Phillip�

entries.source:
Sumani clapped twice.
	Abruptly the festive mood of the room died, the clank of goblets and the scrape of plates falling silent as the bartender shuffled between benches to bow at Locklear's feet. Touching a gnarled fist to his forehead then to his heart, he spoke somberly.�
entries.translation:
蘇馬尼拍了兩下手。
	室內原本歡樂的氣氛頓時沉靜下來，酒杯的碰撞聲與盤子的刮擦聲一時止息，這名酒館老闆穿梭在長凳之間，來到洛克利爾腳邊躬身行禮。他用一隻布滿老繭的拳頭先觸額、再觸胸，神情肅穆地開口說道。�

entries.source: Be welcome to the Blue Wheel Inn. May you find the drinks to your liking and the company of our patrons pleasurable. If there is anything our servants or I may do, you need only ask Sumani.�
entries.translation: 歡迎光臨藍輪客棧。願您喜歡我們的酒水，也享受與我們這些客人相伴的時光。若有任何需要我或敝店僕從效勞之處，只需吩咐蘇馬尼一聲即可。�

entries.source: Ah...honors to your house as well...Sumani...Am I correct in believing this a drinking establishment?�
entries.translation: 啊……也向貴店致上敬意……蘇馬尼……我沒理解錯的話，這裡是間酒館吧？�

entries.source: So it is. We serve many of your Midkemian drinks as well as a few from the Tsuranuanni Empire as well. Perhaps I might interest you in a cup of chocha.�
entries.translation: 正是如此。我們供應許多位米德凱米亞的酒水，也有幾款來自圖蘭努安尼帝國的飲品。也許您會有興趣來一杯巧恰。�

entries.source: Thank you for your services, Sumani. You have a wonderful establishment. It's very Tsurani.�
entries.translation: 謝謝你的招待，蘇馬尼。你這店開得真好。很有圖蘭尼風味。�

entries.source: Your patronage honors us.�
entries.translation: 承蒙您光顧，是敝店的榮幸。�

entries.source: Goodbye. I promise if I'm ever in LaMut again, I'll be sure to drop in for a bit of something to eat.�
entries.translation: 再見了。我保證，要是我還會再來拉姆特，一定會進來吃點東西。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C1_Sumani�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C1_Sumani�

entries.source:
Sumani responded promptly.
	Shuffling closer, he pitched his voice so as not to disturb others that were drinking in the tavern.�
entries.translation:
蘇馬尼立刻回應。
	他挪步靠近，壓低了聲音，以免打擾到酒館裡其他正在飲酒的客人。�

entries.source: Your will, lord?�
entries.translation: 大人有何吩咐？�

entries.source: I'm afraid it's time we did something other than sit around soaking up the atmosphere. Things to do.�
entries.translation: 恐怕我們該去做點正事了，不能光坐在這兒享受氣氛。還有事要辦。�

entries.source: I am pleased you chose to visit the Blue Wheel Inn. It is my hope you will return again.�
entries.translation: 很高興您選擇光臨藍輪客棧。希望您能再度蒞臨。�

entries.source: I would say it is a definite possibility, assuming we're ever in LaMut again. Goodbye, Sumani.�
entries.translation: 要是我們還會再來拉姆特，我想這絕對有可能。再見了，蘇馬尼。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C1_Sumani�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C1_Sumani�

entries.source:
Sumani's responded promptly.
	Shuffling closer to James, he pitched his voice so as not to disturb others that were drinking in the tavern.�
entries.translation:
蘇馬尼立刻回應。
	他挪步靠近詹姆士，壓低了聲音，以免打擾到酒館裡其他正在飲酒的客人。�

entries.source: Your will, lord?�
entries.translation: 大人有何吩咐？�

entries.source: A minute of your time, keeper, if you have one to spare.�
entries.translation: 老闆，要是您抽得出時間，能耽誤您一分鐘嗎？�

entries.source: All the hours of the day if need be, honorable sire. How may I be of service?�
entries.translation: 要是有需要，一整天的時間我都奉陪，尊貴的大人。有什麼能為您效勞的？�

entries.source: I'm afraid it's time we did something other than sit around soaking up the atmosphere. Things to do.�
entries.translation: 恐怕我們該去做點正事了，不能光坐在這兒享受氣氛。還有事要辦。�

entries.source: I am pleased you chose to visit the Blue Wheel Inn. It is my hope you will return again.�
entries.translation: 很高興您選擇光臨藍輪客棧。希望您能再度蒞臨。�

entries.source: I would say it is a definite possibility, assuming we're ever in LaMut again. Goodbye, Sumani.�
entries.translation: 要是我們還會再來拉姆特，我想這絕對有可能。再見了，蘇馬尼。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C2_Sumani�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C2_Sumani�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: However the Blue Wheel Inn may be at your service, please do not hesitate to tell Sumani.�
entries.translation: 無論藍輪客棧能為您效勞什麼，請儘管告訴蘇馬尼，不必客氣。�

entries.source: Thank you for your services, Sumani. You have a wonderful establishment.�
entries.translation: 謝謝你的招待，蘇馬尼。你這店開得真好。�

entries.source: Your patronage honors us.�
entries.translation: 承蒙您光顧，是敝店的榮幸。�

entries.source: Goodbye. I promise if I'm ever in LaMut again, I'll be sure to drop in for a bit of something to eat.�
entries.translation: 再見了。我保證，要是我還會再來拉姆特，一定會進來吃點東西。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C2_Sumani�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C2_Sumani�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: We are always pleased to have guests of your imminence. How may the Blue Wheel Inn be of service to you?�
entries.translation: 能招待兩位如此尊貴的客人，我們一向深感榮幸。藍輪客棧能為您效勞什麼？�

entries.source: As much as I would enjoy staying, there are several dead men whose murderers we need to find. We appreciated your hospitality.�
entries.translation: 儘管我很想多留一會兒，可還有幾具屍體，我們得找出殺害他們的凶手。感謝你的款待。�

entries.source: It is my hope you may find those you seek. I should not like to see the Game of the Council become commonplace in your world.�
entries.translation: 希望您能找到您要找的人。我可不希望看到『議會之局』在您這個世界也變得司空見慣。�

entries.source: I'm not well versed in what this Game of the Council is, but from what little I have been told of it by other Tsurani, I think I would have to agree. Thank you again.�
entries.translation: 我不太清楚這個『議會之局』究竟是什麼，不過就我從其他圖蘭尼人那裡聽來的一點皮毛，我想我也不得不同意這一點。再次感謝。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C3_Sumani�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C3_Sumani�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: The Blue Wheel is honored to have such exalted guests. How may Sumani serve you?�
entries.translation: 藍輪客棧能招待如此尊貴的客人，深感榮幸。蘇馬尼能為您效勞什麼？�

entries.source: It's time we left. We still have men to find.�
entries.translation: 我們該走了。還有人要找。�

entries.source: May Chochoan watch over you.�
entries.translation: 願丘丘安神看顧您。�

entries.source: I'm assuming that must be a Tsurani god. I'm not sure if they have any influence here in Midkemia, but at this point, I'll take luck wherever I can get it from. Thank you, Sumani.�
entries.translation: 我猜那大概是位圖蘭尼神明。我不確定他們在米德凱米亞這裡有沒有什麼影響力，不過事到如今，能求到什麼好運我都不介意。謝謝你，蘇馬尼。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C3_Sumani�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C3_Sumani�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: I hope you will find your experience here at the Blue Wheel Inn a pleasurable one.�
entries.translation: 希望您在藍輪客棧的這段時光，能是一段愉快的體驗。�

entries.source: You're Tsurani aren't you? Did you belong to the garrison here in LaMut? I've heard that many of Earl Kasumi's troops were once from Tsuranuanni.�
entries.translation: 您是圖蘭尼人吧？您以前是拉姆特這裡駐軍的一員嗎？我聽說卡蘇米伯爵麾下有不少士兵，以前都來自圖蘭努安尼。�

entries.source: It is so...�
entries.translation: 正是如此……�

entries.source: Why did you leave the garrison to run a tavern? Surely you would have had more opportunities for advancement in the garrison. You might have one day gained land for yourself or even a title.�
entries.translation: 您怎麼會離開駐軍，跑來開酒館呢？留在駐軍裡，您想必會有更多晉升的機會。說不定哪天還能替自己掙得一塊土地，甚至一個頭銜。�

entries.source: Earl Kasumi was gracious enough to dismiss me from my post so that my dishonor would not taint the reputation of the LaMutian garrison.�
entries.translation: 卡蘇米伯爵寬宏大量，將我革職，免得我的不名譽玷污了拉姆特駐軍的名聲。�

entries.source: What did you do?�
entries.translation: 您做了什麼？�

entries.source: Forgive me, but I believe I hear my cook calling from the kitchen. I will attend you later.�
entries.translation: 恕我失陪，我想我聽見廚子在廚房裡喊我了。我稍後再來招呼您。�

entries.source: Very well...I hope I didn't...we shall speak again soon.�
entries.translation: 好吧……希望我沒有……我們回頭再聊。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C6_Sumani�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C6_Sumani�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: We are always pleased to have guests of your imminence. How may the Blue Wheel Inn be of service to you?�
entries.translation: 能招待兩位如此尊貴的客人，我們一向深感榮幸。藍輪客棧能為您效勞什麼？�

entries.source: Thank you for your services, Sumani. You have a wonderful establishment.�
entries.translation: 謝謝你的招待，蘇馬尼。你這店開得真好。�

entries.source: Your patronage honors us.�
entries.translation: 承蒙您光顧，是敝店的榮幸。�

entries.source: Goodbye. I promise if I'm ever in LaMut again, I'll be sure to drop in for a bit of something to eat.�
entries.translation: 再見了。我保證，要是我還會再來拉姆特，一定會進來吃點東西。�

entries.source:
They were not alone.
	@0's pulse quickened as he saw the lone figure approach; but when it became apparent they were not being attacked, he relaxed a bit, squinted slightly in an attempt to see who was about to join them.�
entries.translation:
他們並非孤身一人。
	@0看見一個孤零零的身影走近，脈搏頓時加快；但看出對方並無攻擊之意後，他才稍稍放鬆下來，瞇起眼想看清楚是誰要加入他們。�

entries.source: It's an awful mess from 'ere on out. Wyverns have come in from over the mountains and have singed things up a bit. If we'd 'adn't been beating back flames this past few weeks, we'd been through a month sooner! I doon't know 'ow many roads are passable at this stage. What kin o' yourn that come and 'elped us clear out the mess in the mine left as soon as word reached us that fires were approaching Elvandar.�
entries.translation: 從這裡再往前，情況糟糕透頂。雙足飛龍從山那頭飛了過來，把這一帶燒得亂七八糟。要不是這幾週我們一直在撲滅火勢，我們早一個月就能打通了！眼下我也搞不清楚還有多少路能通行。你們那位親戚，先前來幫我們清理礦坑裡的爛攤子，一聽到火勢逼近艾爾凡達的消息，就立刻離開了。�

entries.source: Where did the Wyverns come from?�
entries.translation: 那些雙足飛龍是打哪來的？�

entries.source: Whar else, lad? The Northlands! Some new bastard moredhel leader I hear harassing your kinfolk. I 'ope you 'aven't any kits in 'arms way.�
entries.translation: 還能打哪來，小子？北疆啊！聽說是哪個新冒出來的莫瑞德混帳頭領在騷擾你們的族人。希望你們沒有哪個小崽子正身陷險境。�

entries.source: No...What of the Moredhel?�
entries.translation: 沒有……那莫瑞德人那邊呢？�

entries.source: A few as what 'ad the nerve to cross over from the Moraelin 'ave already got themselves skewered, though I know that the Prince Calin has been on the frontier looking for others. The biggest concern as yet is to put out the flames and get 'elp to those as got trapped behind it all.�
entries.translation: 有幾個大膽從莫拉埃林越境過來的，已經被戳成串了，不過我知道卡林王子還在邊境上搜索其他人。眼下最要緊的，還是撲滅火勢，救援那些被困在火場後頭的人。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C6_McCannur_Ban_Dok�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C6_McCannur_Ban_Dok�

entries.source:
They were not alone.
	@0's pulse quickened as he saw the lone figure approach; but when it became apparent they were not being attacked, he relaxed a bit, squinted slightly in an attempt to see who was about to join them.�
entries.translation:
他們並非孤身一人。
	@0看見一個孤零零的身影走近，脈搏頓時加快；但看出對方並無攻擊之意後，他才稍稍放鬆下來，瞇起眼想看清楚是誰要加入他們。�

entries.source: Another pair of eyes and arms and 'opefully a brain betwixt! I'm glad to see the fires haven't burnt the two of ya to a crisp! We may need some 'elp with the folks up North. An elf sprinter came by 'ere not more than an few eyeblinks ago and said that Prince Calin and his escorts were set upon by Wyverns. As yet the young Prince may have survived, but three of the Warleader's men are struck dead and the Warleader Tomas 'as been poisoned by moredhel arrow!�
entries.translation: 又多兩雙眼睛跟手，但願中間還帶著顆腦子！很高興看到你們倆沒被大火燒成焦炭！我們北邊的人可能需要點幫忙。剛剛沒過多久，有個精靈快跑信使經過這裡，說卡林王子跟他的護衛遭到雙足飛龍襲擊。目前那位年輕王子似乎還活著，可統帥麾下有三名部下當場喪命，統帥托馬斯本人也中了莫瑞德人的毒箭！�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C6_McCannur_Ban_Dok�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C6_McCannur_Ban_Dok�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: Seigneur Locklear! Good to see you. Interesting news. Interesting news.�
entries.translation: 洛克利爾紳爵！見到您真高興。有意思的消息。有意思的消息。�

entries.source: Nivek, you old rascal. Got your ears to the grapevine again, eh? What is it this time?�
entries.translation: 尼維克，你這老滑頭。又豎起耳朵到處打聽小道消息了，是吧？這回又是什麼？�

entries.source: I've been to see Nia at the Six Toe near Sethanon. Ah... I can't really talk about it right now. Why don't you come back later and see me?�
entries.translation: 我最近去了趟賽瑟儂附近，見了六趾客棧的妮雅。啊……這事我現在還真不方便說。你何不待會兒再回來找我？�

entries.source: We will good friend! Take care.�
entries.translation: 我們會的，好朋友！保重。�

entries.source:
James grinned.
	Seated behind one of the benches was an old associate, Nivek, Lord Minister of Finances of the Western Realm. A loyal subject of Arutha, he had befriended both he and Seigneur Locklear during their scramblings about in Krondor's streets and had taught the both of them a good deal about the workings of the Kingdom's finances.
	Looking down the considerable length of his nose, he greeted them cheerily...�
entries.translation:
詹姆士咧嘴一笑。
	坐在一張長凳後方的，是一位老相識——尼維克，西境財政大臣。他是亞魯莎忠心耿耿的臣子，當年他跟洛克利爾紳爵倆人還在克朗多街頭闖蕩時，尼維克便與他們結為好友，並教了他們不少王國財政運作的門道。
	他順著那長長的鼻梁向下打量，愉快地向他們打了招呼……�

entries.source: Seigneur James! What a pleasure to see you!�
entries.translation: 詹姆士紳爵！見到您真是太高興了！�

entries.source: The pleasure is mutual. How are the ledgers of the Kingdom, Nivek? Think we shall have enough money to keep the Kingdom running for the year?�
entries.translation: 彼此彼此。尼維克，王國的帳本情況如何？你覺得我們今年的錢夠讓王國維持運轉嗎？�

entries.source: The ledgers are at a balance, but I daresay my thirst suffers a deficit of catastrophic proportions. Though I handle thousands of sovereigns a day, I fear I haven't the command of more than a handful for my own use at the moment. I don't suppose you might be in a position...�
entries.translation: 帳本倒是收支平衡，不過我敢說，我這口渴的赤字可就嚴重到災難等級了。雖然我每天經手成千上萬枚金幣，但眼下我自己能動用的，恐怕連一把都湊不齊。不知道您是否方便……�

entries.source:
Nivek squinted at them.
	Levering himself up from his table, he walked over to greet James...�
entries.translation:
尼維克瞇眼打量著他們。
	他撐著桌子站起身，走過來向詹姆士打招呼……�

entries.source: How nice it is to see you. What brings you into the Rainbow Parrot?�
entries.translation: 見到您真高興。是什麼風把您吹進彩虹鸚鵡酒館來的？�

entries.source: Ah, I see you're still in an upright position...�
entries.translation: 啊，看來你還站得挺直的嘛……�

entries.source: Just because you are counted among Arutha's favorites, James, do not be impertinent. I only on óoccasion drink a bit too much, but I have not indulged in that pleasure in quite some time. Would you perhaps be disposed to purchase me a drink?�
entries.translation: 詹姆士，別仗著自己是亞魯莎面前的紅人就這麼放肆。我只是ó偶爾喝得多了點，而且我也好一陣子沒放縱過這種享受了。您是否願意請我喝一杯？�

entries.source: What do you say, Owyn? Do we buy a drink for the honorable tax collector or do we allow him to expire of thirst?�
entries.translation: 歐文，你說呢？我們是該請這位尊貴的稅務官喝一杯，還是就讓他渴死算了？�

entries.source: Alas, our funds are tapped. All that I am in a position to offer you at the moment is a handful of lint. Unless the proprietor here has changed his medium of exchange, I believe that puts the both of us out of luck.�
entries.translation: 唉，我們的錢已經花光了。眼下我能給您的，大概就只有一把口袋裡的棉絮了。除非這裡的老闆改用棉絮當貨幣，不然我看咱們倆都沒指望了。�

entries.source: Hmph!�
Perhaps we may buy you something to drink next time. Good day to you.�
entries.translation: 也許下次我們再請您喝一杯。祝您愉快。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_Cx_Nivek_YES_DRINK1_NOT_ENOUGH_GOLD�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_Cx_Nivek_YES_DRINK1_NOT_ENOUGH_GOLD�

entries.source:
Bartender, a drink for the tax collector!
	Drink up friend and tell me what you know. You've always had a good ear for the happenings in and out of the Kingdom.�
entries.translation:
酒保，給這位稅務官來一杯！
	喝吧，朋友，告訴我你知道些什麼。你對王國內外的大小事，一向消息靈通。�

entries.source: Rumors? My goodness me, I'm not the kind to consort with the rumormongers. No sire, you should know that. Of course, I do occasionally hear a few facts that are of interest to people. Accounting is a...UHRUP...fascinating business you know, all the figures and such...�
entries.translation: 謠言？我的天啊，我可不是那種跟長舌婦廝混的人。不，大人，您該知道這一點的。當然，我偶爾也會聽到一些讓大家感興趣的事實。會計這行業啊……嗝……可有意思了，各種數字啦什麼的……�

entries.source: Something a little more lively if you please. Stolen cows, cheating wives, dishonest traders---that sort of thing.�
entries.translation: 拜託說點更有意思的。偷牛的、偷情的老婆、不老實的商人——那種事。�

entries.source: The prurient and the scatological, eh? Hmmm. Well, let me think on it. I believe I heard something last week---at least I believe it was last week. Maybe it was the week before that. Couldn't have been before that annexation in Malac's Cross---�
entries.translation: 香豔跟腌臢的那種，嗯？唔。好，讓我想想。我記得上禮拜聽說了什麼事——至少我覺得是上禮拜。也可能是前一禮拜。不可能是馬拉克十字鎮那次併入之前——�

entries.source: If you please, Nivek. We would like to get out of here before tomorrow.�
entries.translation: 拜託了，尼維克。我們可希望在天亮之前離開這裡。�

entries.source: I...AHHHP...would be most pleased to accommodate you, but it seems that my mouth has grown a bit dry. What do you say to buying me another drink?�
entries.translation: 我……呃……很樂意配合您，不過看來我這張嘴又有點乾了。您看再請我喝一杯如何？�

entries.source: Ahh now. That's much better. What was I saying? Oh yes, about this story. The-re was...UHRUP...this fellow that lives near Sethanon that has filed three new claims on land in the past year. Thr-ee, ya understand that?�
entries.translation: 啊，這下好多了。我剛才說到哪了？對了，說到這個故事。有——嗝——個住在賽瑟儂附近的傢伙，這一年裡申請了三塊新的土地。三——塊，聽懂了嗎？�

entries.source: Is there something suspect about his purchases?�
entries.translation: 他買地這件事有什麼可疑之處嗎？�

entries.source: Oh, his selections of land are nice enough. Prime pieces of land matter of fact, but he's without a...AAHHHP...ti-tle! How'z a person of ignoble birth manage to buy three prime estates? Tell me that!�
entries.translation: 噢，他挑的地段都挺不錯的。事實上都是上好的地皮，可他偏偏沒有……呃……爵位！一個出身卑微的人，怎麼買得起三塊上等地產？你倒是說說看！�

entries.source: What was this fellow's name? Perhaps we should look into it.�
entries.translation: 這傢伙叫什麼名字？也許我們該查一查。�

entries.source: What kind of ques---RUCHH---question is that now? Ya think I carry my ledger about in my head? I mean you might as well ass me the name of Prince Arufa's---Arutha's wife.�
entries.translation: 這算什麼問——嗝——問題啊？你以為我把帳本都背在腦子裡嗎？你這問題，還不如問我亞魯——亞魯莎親王的老婆叫什麼名字算了。�

entries.source: You mean to tell me that you can't remember Princess Anita's name?�
entries.translation: 你的意思是，你連安妮塔公主的名字都記不得了？�

entries.source: No---what is her name?�
entries.translation: 不——她叫什麼名字？�

entries.source: You were telling me about the man near Sethanon. What else do you know about him? Tell me about the man.�
entries.translation: 你剛才在跟我說賽瑟儂附近那個人的事。你還知道他什麼事？跟我說說那個人。�

entries.source: Ahhhh...I fink his name was Fibber...NAH, that's not right, not right at all...Fleeber...Monk's Finger...Map's Flipper...Fever...FEEBER! Maxie Feeber! Thatsss it! Ya know, I'm really, really getting tired now and maybe I should go home...�
entries.translation: 啊……我記得他叫費博……不，不對，完全不對……費利伯……修士的手指……地圖的鰭……發燒……費伯！麥克斯．費伯！就是他！你知道嗎，我現在真的真的累了，也許該回家了……�

entries.source: There's still a few things I need to know. Think you can hold out for a just a few more minutes?�
entries.translation: 我還有幾件事想知道。你覺得你還能再撐個幾分鐘嗎？�

entries.source: Sure...RUCCHH...I kin do it. Need something else ta drink though. You buy--- UHRUP--ing?�
entries.translation: 當然……嗝……我撐得住。不過還得再喝點什麼才行。你請——嗝——客嗎？�

entries.source: That hit the---the ahhh--- What?�
entries.translation: 這下真是——那個啊——什麼？�

entries.source: I suppose you mean that your drink hit the mark. Why don't you tell us a little more about this Max Feeber character?�
entries.translation: 我猜你是想說這杯酒正合你意吧。不如再多跟我們說說這個麥克斯．費伯的事？�

entries.source: NAHnahnahnahh...that's bori---UHRUP--ng...let's talk about the last year. Did ya know that for every cow in Midkemia, we get a golden sovereigns a year alone just for their manure...Did ya know that? BETCHA didn't! An for every duck...�
entries.translation: 不不不不……那個很無——嗝——聊……來聊聊過去這一年吧。你知道嗎，米德凱米亞每頭牛，光是牠的糞便，我們一年就能收一枚金幣……你知道嗎？我打賭你不知道！還有每隻鴨子……�

entries.source: Max Feeber. I want to know about Max Feeber.�
entries.translation: 麥克斯．費伯。我想知道麥克斯．費伯的事。�

entries.source: Dokay. Moxie Flipper. Ahm, I know that gee was tryging to buy up some of the propurtee left in Sethanon a few years back from Jared Lycrow but Jared wouldn't sell to no one, so Moxie co--AHRUP---cooked up this idea...Sure you don't want to hear about the ducks?�
entries.translation: 好——好吧。莫西．費利伯。呃，我知道他幾年前想跟賈瑞德．萊克羅買下賽瑟儂那邊留下來的一些地產，可賈瑞德誰都不肯賣，所以莫西就——嗝——想出了個點子……你們真的不想聽聽鴨子的事嗎？�

entries.source: No. Just tell us about Max. What did he do?�
entries.translation: 不用。快跟我們說麥克斯的事就好。他做了什麼？�

entries.source: Ee gots himselk a shovel and dug---ARRGHA---to try to skeer Jared. Corse Jared wasn't skeered of nuthin but it shore fri-teened---UHRUP---Nia.�
entries.translation: 他弄了把鏟子，挖啊——啊嗝——想嚇唬賈瑞德。當然賈瑞德什麼都不怕，不過倒是把——嗝——妮雅給嚇得不輕。�

entries.source: What was he digging up?�
entries.translation: 他在挖什麼東西？�

entries.source: Goin ta slep now...Gnite..�
entries.translation: 我要睡了……晚安……�

entries.source: Maybe I could buy you another drink?�
entries.translation: 也許我再請你喝一杯？�

entries.source: What, you haven run outta mon---mon---money yet? Oh, in that case I'll have nother...if you're buying?�
entries.translation: 什麼，你的錢——錢——還沒花完啊？噢，那樣的話我再來一杯……既然你請客？�

entries.source: Grabeyurd neer Sethnon. Dats whur he wusss diggin. Up---ERRRRUP---Frait o gosts n Jer-rud whatnt. Not at ull. Jes Nia. Littl o Nia.�
entries.translation: 賽——賽瑟儂附近的墓——墓地。那就是他挖——挖的地方。怕——嗝——怕鬼跟賈——賈瑞德什麼的。才不是呢。就只是妮雅。妮雅一個人怕。�

entries.source: Where do you think he got the funds to buy the land?�
entries.translation: 你覺得他買地的錢是從哪來的？�

entries.source: Ee sait that he gots it in na hole! Alz the monkeys...ARRAH...moneys in na hole! Jus got go...to get it...Ain't frait no gooset.�
entries.translation: 他說他在洞——洞裡找到的！所有的猴——嗝——銀子都在洞裡！只要去……拿就行了……才不怕什麼鵝呢。�

entries.source: What hole are you talking about? Where is he going?�
entries.translation: 你說的是什麼洞？他要去哪裡？�

entries.source: I tink I go home now...�
entries.translation: 我想我現在該回家了……�

entries.source: One more tankard of ale to keep him going?�
entries.translation: 再來一杯麥酒讓他繼續撐下去？�

entries.source: Ya nu...Zaa unturducktur key urdn skeywers...trite to sulit tome but...UHRUP...I no crumiminal...oh gles mr...AAAGH. O Ghats! Imna be sich! Ha- ho!�
entries.translation: 你知——知道……那個地——地下的鑰匙跟串——串子……想跟我說什麼來——嗝——著，可我不是罪——罪犯……噢天啊……啊嗄。噢老天！我要吐——吐了！哈——嘔！�

entries.source: The what? I don't understand.�
entries.translation: 什麼東西？我聽不懂。�

entries.source: I sait, mna be SICK!�
entries.translation: 我說，我要吐了！�

entries.source: Okay, okay. I think I've abused you enough for now. Sleep well, Nivek. I think we know all we need to know.�
entries.translation: 好啦，好啦。我看我這樣折騰你也夠了。睡個好覺吧，尼維克。我想我們該知道的都知道了。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH :GET_NIVEK_DRUNK�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：GET_NIVEK_DRUNK�

entries.source: Perhaps I'll buy something later. Right now, I believe my companions and I have to be off to attend to some business elsewhere. Thanks for your help Nivek!�
entries.translation: 也許我晚點再請你喝點什麼。眼下，我跟同伴恐怕得去別處辦點正事了。謝謝你的幫忙，尼維克！�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH :GET_NIVEK_DRUNK_STOP_BUYING�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：GET_NIVEK_DRUNK_STOP_BUYING�

entries.source:
The tax collector looked óill.
	Slumped on his bench, he gazed into open space, his monocle fogged and his features slackened. Seeing James, he seemed to pale somewhat...�
entries.translation:
這位稅務官看起來ó病懨懨的。
	他癱坐在長凳上，呆滯地望著虛空，單片眼鏡蒙上了一層霧氣，面容也鬆垮無力。看見詹姆士，他似乎又白了幾分臉色……�

entries.source: GRRNNMPH!...Just let me die, gods!�
entries.translation: 嗚嗯……讓我死了吧，諸神啊！�

entries.source: Still hung over, Nivek?�
entries.translation: 尼維克，還在宿醉啊？�

entries.source: ...not so loud...ooh...please, just leave a poor old soul to die...�
entries.translation: ……別這麼大聲……噢……拜託，就讓我這可憐的老頭子安靜等死吧……�

entries.source: Sure you don't want a drink?�
entries.translation: 你確定不想喝一杯嗎？�

entries.source: ...I want you to know that I hate you to the depths of my being right now...the Bitter Sea isn't as deep as my loathing for you...�
entries.translation: ……我要你知道，我現在打從心底恨你……苦海都沒我對你的厭惡來得深……�

entries.source: So I take it you're not in the mood for a talk.�
entries.translation: 那我猜你現在沒心情聊天了。�

entries.source: ...go fall off the edge of the world...quietly...just so long as you don't make any sound doing it. Goodbye, James.�
entries.translation: ……去跳下世界的邊緣吧……悄悄地……只要別發出任何聲音就好。再見了，詹姆士。�

entries.source: Take care of yourself, old friend.�
entries.translation: 保重，老朋友。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_Cx_Nivek_COMPLETED�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_Cx_Nivek_COMPLETED�

entries.source:
The tax collector looked óill.
	Slumped on his bench, he gazed into open space, his monocle fogged and his features slackened. Seeing Owyn, he seemed to pale somewhat...�
entries.translation:
這位稅務官看起來ó病懨懨的。
	他癱坐在長凳上，呆滯地望著虛空，單片眼鏡蒙上了一層霧氣，面容也鬆垮無力。看見歐文，他似乎又白了幾分臉色……�

entries.source: Please state your business quickly and quietly. I'm...incapacitated...just now.�
entries.translation: 請快點小聲說明來意。我現在……行動不便……�

entries.source: I'm sorry to interrupt your hangover, sir, but it's very important that we speak to you. Have you seen or spoken to Pug of Stardock in the past few days? He's disappeared from the palace and we're trying to find out where he might have gone or done before he left.�
entries.translation: 很抱歉打擾您宿醉，大人，不過我們有非常重要的事得跟您談談。您這幾天有見過或跟星塢島的帕格說過話嗎？他從王宮裡失蹤了，我們正試著查出他離開前去了哪裡、做了什麼。�

entries.source: It could be that he and I dressed in the Princess Anita's finest gowns and danced with skeletons on the docks, but I don't remember a single detail of this last evening. I had a bit too much drink, I believe...and I'm regretting it with great acuity at this moment.�
entries.translation: 也許他跟我穿上安妮塔公主最華麗的禮服，在碼頭上跟骷髏跳了支舞，可我對昨晚的事一個細節都想不起來。我想我是喝多了……而且此刻我正深切地後悔著這件事。�

entries.source: Surely you might remember the events when you entered the bar?�
entries.translation: 您總該記得自己進酒館時的情形吧？�

entries.source: Nothing. Not a moment...mind's as blank as a slate...I don't even remember where it is I mislaid my keys...�
entries.translation: 什麼都不記得。一刻都想不起來……腦子裡一片空白……我甚至不記得自己把鑰匙掉在哪了……�

entries.source: Maybe if you found your keys, you'll recall last night's events.�
entries.translation: 也許找到您的鑰匙，您就會想起昨晚的事了。�

entries.source: That is a respectable theory, young friend, but as I am in no condition to move I cannot test your hypothesis.�
entries.translation: 這是個值得敬重的理論，年輕的朋友，可我現在根本沒法動彈，沒辦法替您驗證這個假說。�

entries.source: Tell me what they look like. If we run across them, we will bring them back to you and maybe then you'll remember.�
entries.translation: 告訴我鑰匙長什麼樣子。要是我們碰巧找到，會幫您帶回來，說不定那時候您就會想起來了。�

entries.source:
Not much to distinguish it from other keys...It has my name etched upon it...that is all.
	Good luck.�
entries.translation:
跟其他鑰匙比起來也沒什麼特別的……上頭刻著我的名字……就這樣而已。
	祝你們好運。�

entries.source: Take care of yourself, old friend.�
entries.translation: 保重，老朋友。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C6_Nivek�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C6_Nivek�

entries.source:
The tax collector looked óill.
	Slumped on his bench, he gazed into open space, his monocle fogged and his features slackened. Seeing Owyn, he seemed to pale somewhat...�
entries.translation:
這位稅務官看起來ó病懨懨的。
	他癱坐在長凳上，呆滯地望著虛空，單片眼鏡蒙上了一層霧氣，面容也鬆垮無力。看見歐文，他似乎又白了幾分臉色……�

entries.source: I don't suppose you've found my keys have you? Fortunately the locksmith came by and gave me a new one so that I can again enter my dwelling, but I would still like to know where I went during my bender.�
entries.translation: 我猜你們沒找到我的鑰匙吧？幸好鎖匠來過，給了我一把新的，讓我能重新進屋。不過我還是想知道，我那次縱酒狂歡到底跑到哪去了。�

entries.source: You still don't remember?�
entries.translation: 您還是想不起來嗎？�

entries.source: Nothing. I know only that I've discovered a twig in my shoe and a leaf in my pocket. Perhaps I wandered into the woods.�
entries.translation: 什麼都想不起來。我只知道我鞋子裡發現了一根小樹枝，口袋裡還有片葉子。也許我曾在林子裡遊蕩過。�

entries.source: At least that gives Gor...Thorgath and I something to go on. Thank you, Nivek.�
entries.translation: 至少這給了戈……索爾加斯跟我一點線索。謝謝你，尼維克。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C6_Nivek_NO_KEY�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C6_Nivek_NO_KEY�

entries.source:
The tax collector looked óill.
	Slumped on his bench, he gazed into open space, his monocle fogged and his features slackened. Seeing Owyn, he seemed to pale somewhat...�
entries.translation:
這位稅務官看起來ó病懨懨的。
	他癱坐在長凳上，呆滯地望著虛空，單片眼鏡蒙上了一層霧氣，面容也鬆垮無力。看見歐文，他似乎又白了幾分臉色……�

entries.source: So, have you found the key that will unlock my past?�
entries.translation: 那麼，你們找到能解開我過去那把鑰匙了嗎？�

entries.source: If you mean, have we found your key, the answer is yes. I have it here in my pack, but...it might be advisable for you to consult a solicitor for advice.�
entries.translation: 如果您是問我們有沒有找到您的鑰匙，答案是有。就在我包裡，不過……我建議您最好去找位律師諮詢一下。�

entries.source: A solicitor? Why? Where were my keys?�
entries.translation: 律師？為什麼？我的鑰匙在哪找到的？�

entries.source: We found them on a dead man. He was just outside of Krondor. It looked as though the side of his head had been bashed in with a large, blunt weapon. Was he an enemy of yours?�
entries.translation: 我們是在一具屍體身上找到的。就在克朗多城外不遠處。看起來他的頭側被某種大型鈍器狠狠砸過。他是您的仇家嗎？�

entries.source: If you're suggesting that in my stupor I killed someone, you've lost your senses. I'm not violent when I'm drunk, and in fact I tend to fall unconscious after even a few tankards of ale...I am starting to recall a few things about my...episode...shall we call it? I remember a man who came into the Rainbow Parrot and offered me a drink and then it seems I followed him somewhere...outside of town, perhaps?�
entries.translation: 要是您是在暗示我醉醺醺的時候殺了人，那您可真是失心瘋了。我喝醉了並不會動粗，事實上，我通常喝個幾杯麥酒就會不省人事……我開始想起一些關於我那次……姑且稱之為『插曲』吧……的片段了。我記得有個男人走進彩虹鸚鵡酒館，請我喝了一杯，然後我似乎就跟著他去了某個地方……也許是城外？�

entries.source: Where you killed him.�
entries.translation: 就是您殺了他的地方。�

entries.source: No, where he...he offered me more to drink...and then he took me someplace else, or did his friend take me there? And then...after that, everything's still a blank.�
entries.translation: 不，是他……他又請我喝了幾杯……然後他帶我去了別的地方，還是他朋友帶我去的？然後……在那之後，一切又是一片空白了。�

entries.source: So these strangers got you drunk and stole your key. Does your house key open any other locks other than your house?�
entries.translation: 這麼說，是這些陌生人把您灌醉，偷走了您的鑰匙。您這把家門鑰匙，除了您家之外，還能開別的鎖嗎？�

entries.source: Yes, it opens the locks to my correspondent's office in Eggley. The Prince had my keys made especially so I could have access to any of the Kingdom treasury offices.�
entries.translation: 是的，它還能打開我在艾格利那間通訊處的鎖。親王特地為我打造了這把鑰匙，好讓我能出入王國財政部的任何一間辦事處。�

entries.source: Mind if we borrow this key for a while? I want to test a theory.�
entries.translation: 介意我們暫時借用一下這把鑰匙嗎？我想驗證一個推論。�

entries.source: Be my guest. Anything to help my own cause. I'd really like to get this cleared up.�
entries.translation: 請便。只要能幫上自己的忙，什麼都行。我真的很想把這件事查清楚。�

entries.source: We'll do what we can. Thanks.�
entries.translation: 我們會盡力而為的。謝謝。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C6_Nivek_YES_KEY�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C6_Nivek_YES_KEY�

entries.source:
The tax collector snored.
	Despite @4's repeated attempts to revive him from his drunken stupor, his efforts proved to be fruitless. "Seems someone else has come along and softened him up," Owyn sighed. "We'll just have to find out the significance of his key on our own."�
entries.translation:
這位稅務官打起了呼嚕。
	儘管@4一再嘗試把他從醉醺醺的昏睡中喚醒，卻始終徒勞無功。「看來已經有人先來把他灌醉了，」歐文嘆了口氣。「我們只能靠自己查出這把鑰匙的意義了。」�

entries.source: We...We could be...�
entries.translation: 我們……我們可能是……�

entries.source: ...Twins, yes, so it seems. Seeing you, a great number of things suddenly seem crystal clear to me. What is your association with the Mockers in Krondor?�
entries.translation: ……雙胞胎，對，看起來是這樣沒錯。見到你，突然間有好多事在我心裡都清楚了起來。你跟克朗多的嘲弄幫是什麼關係？�

entries.source: What do you mean? I don't...�
entries.translation: 你這話什麼意思？我沒有……�

entries.source: Stop the idiot act, Lysle. I know you have something to do with the Mockers in Krondor. A few months ago, I was abducted by a band of cutthroats dressed as Nighthawks while I was investigating a rumor in the sewers. At the time I thought they had abducted me because I was close to Arutha, but that wasn't the case at all, was it?�
entries.translation: 萊斯爾，別再裝傻了。我知道你跟克朗多的嘲弄幫脫不了關係。幾個月前，我在下水道調查一則傳聞時，被一夥打扮成夜鷹會的殺手綁架了。當時我以為他們綁架我，是因為我跟亞魯莎關係親近，可事實根本不是那樣，對吧？�

entries.source: That must mean things have gotten even worse than the Upright Man imagined. When he sent word for me in Kesh...�
entries.translation: 那想必表示情況已經比正直人預想的還要糟了。他當初派人到凱許找我的時候……�

entries.source: Excuse me...did you say Kesh, as in the Great Empire Of?�
entries.translation: 抱歉……你剛才是說凱許，就是大凱許帝國那個凱許嗎？�

entries.source: You of all people should know that the Upright Man has contacts everywhere, including under the Empress' nose. He couldn't very well operate the single most powerful guild in Midkemia without them. But as I was saying---he sent for me in Kesh and asked for me to take a boat into Silden and check on a group of thieves who operated there. I can't really say more, but I confirmed the Upright Man's suspicions. If you should get to Krondor before I do, tell one of the thieves---a boy named Limm---that I think the Upright Man's right, though I am quite positive now that the Crawler is ñnot Jocko Radburn. He should give you a reward for the information...�
entries.translation: 你比誰都該清楚，正直人的眼線無所不在，就連皇帝的眼皮子底下也不例外。要不然他也沒法在沒有這些眼線的情況下，經營米德凱米亞最強大的公會。不過我剛才說到——他派人到凱許找我，要我搭船去錫爾登，查探當地活動的一群竊賊。詳情我不方便多說，但我證實了正直人的懷疑。要是你比我先到克朗多，告訴其中一個竊賊——一個叫林姆的男孩——就說我認為正直人是對的，不過我現在相當確定，爬行者ñ絕不是喬科．瑞德本。他應該會拿點好處酬謝你這個消息……�

entries.source: If there is something in the offing that threatens the Prince...�
entries.translation: 要是有什麼陰謀正威脅著親王……�

entries.source: Don't worry your head. The Nighthawks in Krondor were likely sent into Krondor to kill the Upright Man after I fumbled up matters investigating in Silden, not go after Arutha. This Crawler fellow that's running the new thieve's guild is determined to expand his empire, but he's been busy infiltrating other guilds. He's the shadow prince behind half a dozen, most notably the new Guild of the Romney. He's also training his men in magic...�
entries.translation: 別費心了。克朗多的夜鷹會多半是在我在錫爾登搞砸調查之後，被派去殺正直人的，不是衝著亞魯莎去的。這個掌管新竊賊公會的爬行者，一心想擴張他的地盤，一直忙著滲透其他公會。他是至少半打公會背後的影子親王，其中最引人注目的，就是那個新成立的羅姆尼公會。他還在訓練他的手下學習法術……�

entries.source: A whole band of thieves trained as magicians? I don't like the sound of it at all.�
entries.translation: 一整幫竊賊都被訓練成法師？這聽起來一點都不妙。�

entries.source: Neither do I, though for much different reasons. I'm still working on finding out who's training them. Last trail I followed, I heard word that someone in Lyton wished to buy glory hands---magic artifacts I had heard something about. I found this skeletal hand near Sethanon and I sold it to a fellow in Lyton named Glover. I figured if they were magicians, they'd spot the substitution and perhaps I would have a lead...�
entries.translation: 我也不喜歡，不過原因跟你不太一樣。我還在設法查出是誰在訓練他們。我追查的最後一條線索，聽說萊頓有人想買『榮光之手』——我聽過一些關於這種魔法器物的傳聞。我在賽瑟儂附近找到了這隻骸骨手，便賣給了萊頓一個叫格洛佛的傢伙。我猜想，要是他們真是法師，應該會看穿這是贗品，說不定就能讓我摸出點線索……�

entries.source: But they bought it from you and killed your lead. How did you find the skeletal hand?�
entries.translation: 可他們跟你買了，卻毀了你的線索。你是怎麼找到那隻骸骨手的？�

entries.source: You'll probably find this a bit distasteful, but...I was going to dig up somebody from the Sethanon graveyard and just borrow a hand. Since that part of the world has been deserted for quite some time, I thought it would be my best bet to find what I needed without getting caught. Fortunately, some old ghoul saved me the trouble. I have no idea what this fellow was up to with the corpse, but he was dragging it through this field like he was headed to the graveyard. At one point he apparently got tired or thirsty and left the body for a bit and I went over to ñliberate this dead man of his hand, but before I could finish, the old man came back. Since I nearly had the hand off, I came back the next day to see if it had wiggled loose in the transport...�
entries.translation: 你大概會覺得這事有點噁心，不過……我原本打算去賽瑟儂的墓地挖個人出來，借用一隻手。既然那一帶已經荒廢好一陣子了，我想這是我不被發現、找到所需之物的最佳機會。幸好，有個老怪物幫我省了這番功夫。我不知道這傢伙拖著那具屍體想做什麼，不過他當時正把屍體拖過一片田野，像是要往墓地去。中途他似乎是累了或渴了，便把屍體暫時擱下，我就過去想ñ順手把這死人的手取走，可還沒完成，那老人就回來了。因為我當時差不多快把手弄下來了，隔天我又回去看看，那隻手在搬運過程中會不會已經鬆脫……�

entries.source: And so you found it and sold it to Glover in Lyton.�
entries.translation: 於是你找到了它，賣給了萊頓的格洛佛。�

entries.source: Just so, but my troubles didn't end there. There were a few men in Lyton who recognized me, apparently men working for the Crawler. Seems that he's issued a death token on my head after I was spotted in Silden. So, since then, I've been lying low.�
entries.translation: 正是如此，不過我的麻煩並沒有就此結束。萊頓有幾個人認出了我，顯然是爬行者手下的人。看樣子我在錫爾登被發現之後，他就對我發出了追殺令。所以從那以後，我就一直在低調行事。�

entries.source: Understandable...Someday, if we should meet again, I would like to talk to you some more. Find out more about where you came from.�
entries.translation: 可以理解……要是哪天我們還能再見面，我想再跟你多聊聊。多了解一下你的出身背景。�

entries.source: You mean, find out if we're brothers? It's not likely. I was born in Tulan and only came to Krondor about three years ago when the Upright Man sent for me. I was never sure ñwhy he sent for me, but apparently he had heard of me. But, he is odd that way. I doubt I'll ever understand the way his mind works.�
entries.translation: 你是說，想查出我們是不是兄弟？這不太可能。我出生在圖藍，大概三年前才因為正直人召見而來到克朗多。我一直不確定他ñ為什麼要召見我，只知道他顯然聽說過我。不過他這人就是有點古怪。我看我這輩子大概都搞不懂他腦子裡在想什麼。�

entries.source: That makes two of us. Thank you for this talk at least, Lysle. You've been quite a help to us and it's been interesting seeing how others see me. I hope we can meet again.�
entries.translation: 我也是。至少謝謝你跟我聊了這麼多，萊斯爾。你幫了我們大忙，而且看看別人怎麼看待我，也挺有意思的。希望我們還能再見面。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_CX_Lysle_Rigger�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_CX_Lysle_Rigger�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: Hello, Seigneur James. What brings you back here?�
entries.translation: 您好，詹姆士紳爵。是什麼風把您又吹回來了？�

entries.source: We came back to check on where you sold the skeletal hand that you found near Sethanon. Did you say you sold it to someone named Glover in Lyton?�
entries.translation: 我們回來是想確認一下，你把在賽瑟儂附近找到的那隻骸骨手賣去了哪。你說你賣給了萊頓一個叫格洛佛的人？�

entries.source: That I did.�
entries.translation: 是的，沒錯。�

entries.source: I just wanted to check again before I went and made a fool of myself. Thanks again, Lysle...�
entries.translation: 我只是想在自己出糗之前再確認一次。再次謝謝你，萊斯爾……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_CX_Lysle_Rigger�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_CX_Lysle_Rigger�

entries.source:
A figure lurched from the mines.
	Startled, Owyn drew in a breath, but next to him Gorath remained unfazed, his gaze filled with sharp defiance at the mercenary's sudden appearance, as if he had anticipated the arrival.
	The man had black hair, cropped short over his expansive forehead, revealing a dark birthmark which curled from his hairline to just below his left eye. Looking them over, he nodded to Gorath...�
entries.translation:
一道身影從礦坑裡踉蹌走出。
	歐文嚇得倒抽一口氣，但一旁的戈拉斯卻不為所動，面對這名傭兵的突然現身，他眼中滿是銳利的挑釁之色，彷彿早已料到他會出現。
	這名男子留著一頭黑色短髮，緊貼在他寬闊的額頭上，露出一塊從髮際線一路蜿蜒到左眼下方的深色胎記。他打量了他們一番，朝戈拉斯點了點頭……�

entries.source: What business do you have here, moredhel? This is my private stake...�
entries.translation: 莫瑞德人，你來這裡做什麼？這是我的私人礦區……�

entries.source: Your claim was unknown to us. We saw the cave and assumed it might be a good place to bed down for the night.�
entries.translation: 我們不知道這是你的地盤。我們看見這個洞穴，以為可能是個過夜的好地方。�

entries.source: You know of the claim ónow and I'd advise you not to forget that Venutrier of Lan runs things here. Now push off...�
entries.translation: 你現在ó知道了，我勸你別忘了，這裡是蘭恩的維努特里爾說了算。現在，滾吧……�

entries.source: Of course. Good day to you.�
entries.translation: 當然。祝你愉快。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C4_Venutrier_of_Lan_BeforeQuest�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C4_Venutrier_of_Lan_BeforeQuest�

entries.source:
A figure lurched from the mines.
	The man had black hair, cropped short over his expansive forehead, revealing a dark birthmark which curled from his hairline to just below his left eye. Looking them over, he nodded to Gorath...�
entries.translation:
一道身影從礦坑裡踉蹌走出。
	這名男子留著一頭黑色短髮，緊貼在他寬闊的額頭上，露出一塊從髮際線一路蜿蜒到左眼下方的深色胎記。他打量了他們一番，朝戈拉斯點了點頭……�

entries.source: You're trespassing on private property moredhel. This area is restricted for commerce, not loitering...�
entries.translation: 莫瑞德人，你這是擅闖私人領地。這一帶是商業管制區，不是給人閒晃的地方……�

entries.source: But I am very interested in your commerce sir and that is the very reason I sought you out. I wish to sell you the boy...�
entries.translation: 可我對你的生意可感興趣得很，先生，這正是我找你的原因。我想把這男孩賣給你……�

entries.source: What?!!�
entries.translation: 什麼？！�

entries.source: Pah, pitiful! He bawls like a calf! We'd have to feed him a herd to get enough meat on his bones. He's weak, probably diseased. Doesn't look as if he's eaten in weeks...�
entries.translation: 哼，真可憐！他哭得跟頭小牛似的！得餵他一整群牲畜的量，才能讓他長點肉。他這麼虛弱，搞不好還帶著病。看起來好幾週沒吃過東西了……�

entries.source: His looks are deceptive. Single handedly he slew my partner with a kitchen knife and he broke my mate's arm. He will grow into an even stronger man.�
entries.translation: 他的外表會騙人。他單槍匹馬用一把廚刀殺了我的夥伴，還打斷了我另一個同伴的手臂。他會長成一個更強壯的男人。�

entries.source: Impressive, but he sounds like trouble. We'd have to fight him every day to keep him from escaping.�
entries.translation: 令人佩服，不過聽起來是個麻煩。我們得天天跟他搏鬥，才能防止他逃跑。�

entries.source: I'm not getting sold to anybody!�
entries.translation: 我才不會被賣給任何人！�

entries.source: A mercenary is of little good if he is easily overcome, don't you think? Break his will and he will be invaluable to you.�
entries.translation: 一個輕易就能被制伏的傭兵沒什麼用處，你說是吧？磨掉他的意志，他就會成為你手裡的無價之寶。�

entries.source: He looks noble and I don't want bounty hunters sent from the Kingdom in my business...�
entries.translation: 他看起來出身高貴，我可不想招惹王國那邊派來的賞金獵人來煩我的生意……�

entries.source: He was a chamber boy of no importance. You'll have no trouble with him.�
entries.translation: 他不過是個無足輕重的侍寢小廝。你不會惹上什麼麻煩的。�

entries.source: Of no importance?!�
entries.translation: 無足輕重？！�

entries.source: A hundred fifty sovereigns, take it or leave it. But before we clap hands on this, would you care to view our operations here?�
entries.translation: 一百五十枚金幣，要就要，不要拉倒。不過在我們成交之前，你要不要先來看看我們這裡的營運情況？�

entries.source: An intriguing notion...If it would not trouble you?�
entries.translation: 這主意倒挺有意思的……要是不麻煩你的話？�

entries.source: No trouble at all. My guards will escort you...�
entries.translation: 一點也不麻煩。我的守衛會護送你……�

entries.source:
Moredhel surrounded them.
	Chuckling to himself, Venutrier looked the pair of them over as if they were oxen bought at the market, examining first Owyn and then Gorath with greater interest. "Too easy," he said with a sigh. "What kind of fool do you take me for? The boy is of no use, Gorath, but óyou are a prime slave indeed. You will enjoy your new life below."
	Seized by a myriad of hands, they were dragged to the mouth of the cavern and thrown in. For an eternity it seemed they stumbled down steps...�
entries.translation:
莫瑞德人將他們團團圍住。
	維努特里爾自顧自地笑了起來，像打量市場上買來的牛似的把兩人上下端詳了一番，先是歐文，接著又饒富興味地打量起戈拉斯。「太容易了，」他嘆了口氣說道。「你當我是什麼傻瓜？這男孩沒什麼用，戈拉斯，可ó你倒真是個上等的奴隸。你會喜歡你在下面的新生活的。」
	無數雙手抓住了他們，將他們拖到洞口丟了進去。他們彷彿踉踉蹌蹌走了一段沒有盡頭的階梯……�

entries.source:
Venutrier emerged from the mines.
	An astonished look fixed on his features, he looked to Gorath and Owyn, shaking his head...�
entries.translation:
維努特里爾從礦坑裡走了出來。
	他臉上帶著震驚的神情，望向戈拉斯跟歐文，搖了搖頭……�

entries.source: I have looked over your caves, Venutrier, and I am appalled they are run so poorly. Delekhan will be sorely disappointed you have done ill with your stake.�
entries.translation: 維努特里爾，我巡視過你的洞穴了，對這裡經營得如此不善感到震驚。迪勒肯要是知道你把自己的地盤搞成這樣，肯定會大失所望。�

entries.source: What has óhe to do with this? I see only a renegade moredhel and a sapling of a boy! How does your leader enter into this?�
entries.translation: 這事跟ó他有什麼關係？我只看見一個叛徒莫瑞德人跟一個乳臭未乾的小子！你們的頭領怎麼會扯上這件事？�

entries.source: His son Moraeulf has sent him word you harbor traitors and has plans to send his assistants to come and óattend to you. I have come and found no such traitors, but detain me and I guarantee he shall be on you...�
entries.translation: 他的兒子莫萊伍夫已經傳話給他，說你窩藏叛徒，並打算派他的手下前來ó好好『照顧』你。我來這裡查過，並沒有發現什麼叛徒，不過你要是敢扣留我，我保證他一定會找上你……�

entries.source: And why should I believe you? He has called for your óhead.�
entries.translation: 我憑什麼相信你？他已經下令要取你的ó人頭了。�

entries.source: Rumor. I have also heard word that Murmandamus sleeps yet in Sar-Sargoth, but as you like---if enjoy taking risks.�
entries.translation: 那不過是謠言。我還聽說穆爾曼達穆斯依然沉睡在薩薩戈斯呢，不過隨你怎麼想吧——要是你喜歡冒險的話。�

entries.source: Bah! Be off with you then. I have no use for either of you! Stay clear of these caves.�
entries.translation: 呸！那就滾吧。你們兩個對我都沒用！離這些洞穴遠一點。�

entries.source: We will leave you conduct your business undisturbed.�
entries.translation: 我們會讓你不受打擾地做生意。�

entries.source:
Venutrier emerged from the mines.
	An astonished look fixed on his features, he looked to Gorath and Owyn, shaking his head...�
entries.translation:
維努特里爾從礦坑裡走了出來。
	他臉上帶著震驚的神情，望向戈拉斯跟歐文，搖了搖頭……�

entries.source: I told you before, I don't want to see you around here anymore moredhel.�
entries.translation: 我早跟你說過，莫瑞德人，我不想再在這附近看見你。�

entries.source: My mistake, Venutrier. We will leave you conduct your business undisturbed.�
entries.translation: 我的錯，維努特里爾。我們會讓你不受打擾地做生意。�

entries.source: A pleasure to see you again, James.�
entries.translation: 又見到你了，詹姆士，真高興。�

entries.source: Mine is the greater pleasure, my lady. Is Pug about?�
entries.translation: 我才更是榮幸，夫人。帕格在嗎？�

entries.source: You've just missed him. He and Makala went off to discuss magic someplace and if I know my husband, that means I won't see him for a few days. Even on holiday, he can't seem to take his mind away from the art for long.�
entries.translation: 你剛好錯過他了。他跟馬卡拉跑去某個地方討論法術了，要是我了解自己的丈夫，那就表示我這幾天都見不到他了。就算是在放假，他似乎也沒法讓心思長時間離開法術這門技藝。�

entries.source: In many ways, he and the Prince are much alike. Where is Arutha anyway?�
entries.translation: 在很多方面，他跟親王還真像。話說回來，亞魯莎人在哪？�

entries.source: Out with his twins and the Princess Anita. It seems your famed luck is running thin today.�
entries.translation: 帶著他那對雙胞胎跟安妮塔公主出去了。看來你那出了名的好運，今天似乎有點薄弱啊。�

entries.source: Quite the contrary, for I still have your company. If I may have a moment...�
entries.translation: 恰恰相反，因為我還有夫人您相伴。方便耽誤您一點時間嗎……�

entries.source: As much time as you need. What may I do for you?�
entries.translation: 您需要多少時間都行。我能為您做什麼？�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C2_Katala�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C2_Katala�

entries.source: Perhaps Pug's abilities are rubbing off on me. After our last meeting, I had a---a feeling, I suppose you would call it, that you would be back fairly soon. What can I do for you?�
entries.translation: 也許帕格的能力，多少也感染了我一些。上次我們見面之後，我有種——你大概會稱之為『預感』的東西吧——覺得你很快就會回來。我能為你做什麼？�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C2_Katala�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C2_Katala�

entries.source: James!�
entries.translation: 詹姆士！�

entries.source: Seigneur James at your disposal, Lady. I'm sorry if I have interrupted you...�
entries.translation: 詹姆士紳爵聽候差遣，夫人。抱歉打擾您了……�

entries.source: No, no. Actually I am quite pleased to have you here, James. Things around the palace have become very peculiar. Prince Arutha hasn't held court in weeks and Pug has been locking himself up with Makala and our daughter Gamina discussing who knows what.�
entries.translation: 不，不會。其實我很高興你能來，詹姆士。王宮裡最近變得非常古怪。亞魯莎親王已經好幾週沒有臨朝了，帕格則把自己跟馬卡拉、還有我們的女兒蓋米娜關在一起，天曉得在討論些什麼。�

entries.source: And you feel left out of the circle, is that it?�
entries.translation: 這麼說，您覺得自己被排除在外了，是嗎？�

entries.source: I suppose I have been privileged---spoiled even---in the past because he has entrusted me with whatever he was thinking. He's shown me things that I could never have imagined and yet now he's hiding something from me. At some level, I'm almost inclined to think that something is frightening him.�
entries.translation: 我想過去我一直很榮幸——甚至可以說是被寵壞了——因為他總會把心裡的想法都告訴我。他讓我見識過我從未能想像的事物，可如今他卻對我有所隱瞞。某種程度上，我幾乎忍不住覺得，有什麼事讓他感到害怕了。�

entries.source: Frightening Pug? Gods, I don't like the sound of that! May I speak to him?�
entries.translation: 讓帕格感到害怕？老天，這聽起來可不妙！我能跟他談談嗎？�

entries.source: I wish you could, but he has gone to our Academy at Stardock. I don't know when he plans to return. To make matters worse, when I went to see Prince Arutha he sent word that he couldn't speak to me because he was busy with matters of state. That's not at all like him.�
entries.translation: 我也希望你能，可他已經去了我們星塢島的學院。我不知道他打算什麼時候回來。更糟的是，我去見亞魯莎親王的時候，他傳話說自己忙於國事，沒空見我。這一點都不像他的作風。�

entries.source: No, it isn't, but I have a few suspicions about what this may all mean. First, there are a few things I need to know...�
entries.translation: 是不像，不過我對這一切可能代表什麼，有一些懷疑。首先，我有幾件事需要了解……�

entries.source: I am at your service.�
entries.translation: 我聽候你差遣。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C3_Katala�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C3_Katala�

entries.source: Nothing has changed here for the better, but thankfully the situation hasn't worsened. Good to see you again, Seigneur.�
entries.translation: 這裡的情況沒有任何好轉，不過謝天謝地，也沒有惡化。紳爵，很高興再見到你。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C3_Katala�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C3_Katala�

entries.source: ...the meditation tower being one of the first places I suspected of looking. I went there as soon as I discovered that neither he nor my daughter appeared for breakfast that morning. There I found the message that he had burnt into the wall.�
entries.translation: ……冥想塔是我最先想到要去找的地方之一。我一發現他跟女兒那天早上都沒來吃早餐，就立刻趕了過去。我在那裡找到了他用火燒在牆上的訊息。�

entries.source: The Book of Macros...What do you think the message means?�
entries.translation: 馬克羅斯之書……您覺得這則訊息是什麼意思？�

entries.source: I thought for a while that he intended for us to contact the magician named Macros, but it would be a feat impossible for even Pug to accomplish. Macros left Midkemia long ago and all he left behind were his writings.�
entries.translation: 我一度以為他是想要我們去聯繫一位名叫馬克羅斯的法師，不過就算是帕格，也不可能辦到這種事。馬克羅斯早在很久以前就已經離開了米德凱米亞，只留下了他的著作。�

entries.source: And presumably this Book of Macros would be among the books he left behind.�
entries.translation: 那麼，這本『馬克羅斯之書』想必就在他留下的著作之中了。�

entries.source: Perhaps, but I cannot be certain. The library that Macros left on Sorcerer's Isle was vast and it took us the better part of a year to move the bulk of it to the Academy at Stardock. Since that time, some of the volumes have been lent out to various scribes so that they can be cataloged and transcribed.�
entries.translation: 也許吧，不過我不能肯定。馬克羅斯留在法師之島上的藏書浩如煙海，我們花了將近一年的時間，才把大部分搬到星塢島的學院。從那之後，有些卷冊也被外借給各地的抄寫員，以便編目跟謄抄。�

entries.source: Then the book could be anywhere---a new approach. Before he disappeared, did you note anything unusual that he may have said or done?�
entries.translation: 那這本書可能在任何地方——得換個方向找了。他失蹤之前，您有沒有注意到他說過或做過什麼不尋常的事？�

entries.source: As I said earlier he had seemed agitated for some long time, but yes, there was something. About a month ago we were walking in the gardens outside of the palace, just the two of us enjoying the day when he suddenly halted us near a sewer grate. When I asked him what was wrong, he said, "Not all of the sheep are in our fold."�
entries.translation: 就像我先前說的，他已經焦躁不安好一段時間了，不過，對，是有件事。大概一個月前，我們倆在王宮外的花園裡散步，就我們兩個人享受著那天的陽光，他卻突然在一道下水道柵欄旁停下腳步。我問他怎麼了，他說：『不是所有的羊都在我們的羊圈裡。』�

entries.source: Sheep? Forgive me, Lady, but your husband seems to have an infuriating penchant for the cryptic.�
entries.translation: 羊？恕我直言，夫人，令夫似乎特別偏好讓人抓狂的隱晦說法。�

entries.source: Not ordinarily, no, only when things are on his mind. But come, I must head towards Stardock and look for evidence of this Book of Macros there. Where shall you two go?�
entries.translation: 平常倒不會，只有心事重重的時候才這樣。好了，我得動身前往星塢島，去那裡找找這本馬克羅斯之書的線索了。你們兩個要去哪？�

entries.source: We go below into the sewers under Krondor, Owyn, good Lady. I believe we shepherds have an errant flock of sheep to find.�
entries.translation: 夫人，我們要下到克朗多下方的下水道去，歐文。我想，我們這些牧羊人，有一群走失的羊要找。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C6_Katala�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C6_Katala�

entries.source:
The way ahead was blocked.
	From among the men who were guarding the bridge, a man stepped forward to confront them...�
entries.translation:
前方的路被擋住了。
	看守橋樑的人群之中，一名男子上前攔住了他們……�

entries.source: I wouldn't advise venturing any closer to Romney. She's a city besieged.�
entries.translation: 我勸你們別再靠近羅姆尼了。那座城正遭到圍困。�

entries.source: What's happened here?�
entries.translation: 這裡發生了什麼事？�

entries.source: Guild war, uprising, chaos, the whole of Romney's lost its senses. I'm surprised you haven't heard, but then again, a child scraping his knee in Romney seems more important here than does a coronation in Rillanon. It all started when the Guild of the River puller was pushed out of Silden by a splinter guild, the Guild of the Romney. When the Riverpullers tried to recoup their losses by raising fees in Romney, the Glazer's and Dyer's Guilds refused to take the brunt and we contracted the splinter guild to bring in goods. Unfortunately the Riverpullers asserted they had royal grant of exclusivity to the river and burned two Romney Guild rafts. Three members of the Glazer's Guild were killed in the fire as was the chief reeve of the Dyer's Guild. We've been fighting for access to Romney ever since.�
entries.translation: 公會戰爭、暴動、一片混亂，整個羅姆尼都失去理智了。我很意外你們居然沒聽說過，不過話說回來，在這一帶，羅姆尼一個小孩擦破膝蓋，大概都比里蘭儂的加冕典禮還重要。這一切，是從縴夫公會被一個分裂出去的公會——羅姆尼公會——擠出錫爾登開始的。縴夫公會想靠在羅姆尼提高運費來彌補損失，玻璃匠公會跟染工公會不肯承受這個負擔，便轉而跟那個分裂公會簽約運貨。不料縴夫公會宣稱他們握有王室授予的河運獨佔權，燒了兩艘羅姆尼公會的木筏。玻璃匠公會有三名成員葬身火場，染工公會的總管事也不幸罹難。從那之後，我們就一直在為了進出羅姆尼而奮戰。�

entries.source: Who seems to have the upper hand at the moment?�
entries.translation: 目前看來哪一方占上風？�

entries.source: Neither side. It's a stalemate with the labor guilds occupying the North bank of the Ursine Ford and the crafters on the South. I was trapped on this side before the Riverpullers ordered the blockade. Oh, and by the way, I'm Mitchel Waylander, Local Chief Reeve of the Glazer's Guild.�
entries.translation: 哪一方都沒有。這是場僵局，勞工公會占據著烏爾辛渡口的北岸，工匠公會則占著南岸。縴夫公會下令封鎖之前，我剛好被困在這一邊。噢，對了，我叫米契爾．韋蘭德，是玻璃匠公會的地方總管事。�

entries.source: Nice to meet you. What do you think it's going to take to bring this fight to an end?�
entries.translation: 幸會。你覺得要怎樣才能結束這場紛爭？�

entries.source: We've sat down to negotiate with them, but the Riverpullers' leader is a hard old crat and frankly, I don't think he wants to end it. They've laid claim to all the goods that weren't shipped as duty for breech of agreement. The local solicitor informed him that it went outside of Kingdom custom, but the Riverpullers asserted it was also part of their royal charter. We still don't even know if such a document exists.�
entries.translation: 我們是坐下來跟他們談過，可縴夫公會的頭頭是個老頑固，坦白說，我不認為他真想結束這件事。他們宣稱，凡是違約沒能運送出去的貨物，全都歸他們所有，算是違約金。當地的律師告訴他，這已經超出王國慣例了，可縴夫公會卻堅稱，這也是他們王室特許狀裡的內容。我們到現在都還不知道這份文件到底存不存在。�

entries.source: Is there any other way into Romney?�
entries.translation: 還有別的路能進羅姆尼嗎？�

entries.source: There was a time when you could have hired someone to boat you in, but there's not a soul on the river who'd be fool enough to try to run the river blockade. River's nearly deserted because of it. Only people who are still around are the one's who can talk a blue streak.�
entries.translation: 曾經有段時間，你還能雇條船載你進去，可現在河上沒人傻到敢去闖那道封鎖線。因為這樣，河上幾乎沒什麼人了。還留在這一帶的人，都是些能說會道、討價還價一流的人。�

entries.source: Really? And why is that?�
entries.translation: 真的嗎？為什麼會這樣？�

entries.source: Unless you can haggle with the best of them, you'll not get even a fair price on any of the goods here on the river. Might as well try to buy King Lyam's crown as a packet of rations around here.�
entries.translation: 除非你討價還價的本事跟他們一樣厲害，不然這河上什麼貨你都買不到公道的價錢。在這一帶想買一包口糧，大概跟想買萊亞姆王的王冠一樣難。�

entries.source: Perhaps you could give us a few of the finer points of haggling since you're in the trade...�
entries.translation: 既然你也是幹這行的，也許能教我們幾招討價還價的訣竅……�

entries.source: Perhaps I could, but...I really have to get to some of my associates in Sloop. I stand to lose quite a bit of money the longer I wait.�
entries.translation: 也許可以，不過……我真的得去斯魯普找我的一些同僚。我拖得越久，損失的錢就越多。�

entries.source: We might be prepared to renumerate you for lost time if you could help.�
entries.translation: 要是你能幫忙，我們或許願意補償你耽誤的時間。�

entries.source: Really? Well, I suppose I might be persuaded to give you a hand for oh, fifty sovereigns. That's my proposal. What do you say?�
entries.translation: 真的嗎？這樣的話，我想……五十枚金幣，或許能說服我幫你們一把。這是我的條件。你們覺得如何？�

entries.source: I think we'll pass for the moment. I'm always interested in a bargain, but not at the cost you're asking.�
entries.translation: 我看我們暫時算了。我一向對划算的交易感興趣，可不是你開的這個價。�

entries.source: Suit yourself, but beware. Most of the guilds in this region take this no less lightly than if the dog soldiers of Greater Kesh were poling up the Romney. This is ówar to most of us.�
entries.translation: 隨你們便，不過小心點。這一帶大部分的公會，把這件事看得就跟大凱許的走狗部隊撐船殺上羅姆尼一樣嚴重。對我們大多數人來說，這就是ó戰爭。�

entries.source: They aren't far from wrong. Romney is a Kingdom village and as such, it is a free town. Any faction that has determined the city is to be closed against its will deserves to be warred with, Kingdom writ or no. I am sure your Duke has something to say about it.�
entries.translation: 他們這話八九不離十。羅姆尼是王國的一個村鎮，因此也是座自由城鎮。任何硬要把這座城市違反其意願封鎖起來的派系，都活該被開戰對付，不管有沒有王國詔令都一樣。我相信你們的公爵對這件事一定有話要說。�

entries.source: He's none too pleased, that's for certain, but there's not much he can do about the matter until he can get the head of the Ironmonger's Guild to come to negotiations. That's neither here nor there. I've got a bridge to watch and later, business to attend to in Sloop. I bid you gentlemen farewell.�
entries.translation: 他當然不太高興，這是肯定的，不過在他能請動五金匠公會的會長出面談判之前，他也做不了什麼。這些都不重要了。我還得看守這座橋，之後還得去斯魯普處理點事情。兩位，先告辭了。�

entries.source: Good day to you. We shall speak again.�
entries.translation: 祝你愉快。我們回頭再聊。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C1_Mitchel_Waylander_PAY_FOR_IT_NO�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C1_Mitchel_Waylander_PAY_FOR_IT_NO�

entries.source:
The way ahead was blocked.
	From among the men who were guarding the bridge, a man stepped forward to confront them...�
entries.translation:
前方的路被擋住了。
	看守橋樑的人群之中，一名男子上前攔住了他們……�

entries.source: You'll pardon me if I seem a little startled, but I half expected you to be dead men. I'm glad to see the Riverpullers haven't sent you to your graves.�
entries.translation: 恕我有點吃驚，我還一度以為你們已經死了呢。很高興看到縴夫公會沒把你們送進墳墓。�

entries.source: We held our own. Did you attend to your affairs in Sloop?�
entries.translation: 我們挺過來了。你在斯魯普的事情辦好了嗎？�

entries.source: The Glazers there said they would send in a few men for support but they weren't sure how many or how soon. I'll have to take their word for it and hope their help doesn't become necessary. Now, how about that lesson on haggling? I could still use the funding. Interested?�
entries.translation: 那邊的玻璃匠說他們會派幾個人來支援，不過不確定會派多少人、什麼時候到。我只能相信他們的話，希望到頭來用不上這些援手。那，討價還價那堂課怎麼樣？我還是需要那筆資金。有興趣嗎？�

entries.source: Sorry, but as we told you before, the price is too high for us.�
entries.translation: 抱歉，就像我們之前說的，這個價錢對我們來說太高了。�

entries.source: In the end, you'll end up paying the more for it, but that is your choice. Good day to you.�
entries.translation: 到頭來你們還是得付出更多代價，不過那是你們的選擇。祝你們愉快。�

entries.source: To you as well.�
entries.translation: 你也是。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C1_Mitchel_Waylander_PAY_FOR_IT_NO�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C1_Mitchel_Waylander_PAY_FOR_IT_NO�

entries.source: I say you're mad as old King Rodric, but I can't blame you for wanting to make an honest sovereign. You have your deal.�
entries.translation: 我說你們瘋得跟老羅德里克王有得比，不過我也不能怪你們想正正當當賺點錢。成交。�

entries.source: First thing, don't cross your arms when you talk. I know as a noble you have been taught to look as imposing as possible, but that won't wash when you're trying to buy a bolt of cloth. Look vulnerable or at the very least unimposing. Once you're human, it's a lot easier to believe that you're in need of a break.�
entries.translation: 第一件事，說話的時候別抱著胳膊。我知道身為貴族，你們從小被教導要盡量擺出威嚴的架勢，可那一套買一匹布的時候可行不通。要表現得脆弱一點，至少也別擺出一副高高在上的樣子。一旦你顯得跟凡人沒兩樣，對方就更容易相信你是真的需要通融。�

entries.source: Sounds reasonable. What else?�
entries.translation: 聽起來挺有道理。還有呢？�

entries.source: Look a man in the eye when he's talking to you. It makes him believe that you share interests with him and will usually lull him into a charitable mood. He's much more malleable when he believes he's the authority on the matter...�
entries.translation: 跟你說話的時候，要直視他的眼睛。這會讓他相信你跟他有共同的利益，通常也會讓他心軟、慷慨起來。要是他覺得自己在這件事上握有話語權，他就會更好說話……�

entries.source: But what if he isn't?�
entries.translation: 那要是他其實沒有話語權呢？�

entries.source: ...Lesson three, never interrupt the man whom you're trying to buy from. Lesson four, right and wrong lose their meaning in a bargaining atmosphere. It doesn't really matter if the sword that the shopkeeper presents to you isn't the finest blade in the land. You are either interested in the blade at the price he quotes or you aren't. Insulting the integrity of his good will only earn you his scorn. Disinterest will more often lead you to better bargains.�
entries.translation: ……第三課，絕不要打斷你想跟他買東西的那個人說話。第四課，在討價還價的氣氛裡，對錯是沒有意義的。店家拿給你看的劍，是不是全國最好的一把劍，其實根本不重要。你要嘛對他開的價錢感興趣，要嘛不感興趣。質疑他的誠信，只會換來他的輕蔑。表現出不感興趣，往往更能讓你談到更好的價錢。�

entries.source: Hmmm. A few things to think about and I daresay we may find uses for your wisdom elsewhere.�
entries.translation: 唔。有些東西值得好好想想，我敢說我們以後在別處也用得上你這番智慧。�

entries.source: My pleasure. I'd love to stay and chat some more, but I have finances to attend to. Farewell.�
entries.translation: 這是我的榮幸。我很想多留下來聊聊，不過我還有財務上的事要處理。告辭了。�

entries.source: Thank-you, Mitchel. Farewell.�
entries.translation: 謝謝你，米契爾。告辭。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH :WANT_LESSON_FROM_Mitchel_Waylander_ENOUGH_MONEY�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：WANT_LESSON_FROM_Mitchel_Waylander_ENOUGH_MONEY�

entries.source: As usual, I have allowed my tongue to engage in a bargain that my pouch could not fulfill. I haven't the money to reimburse you with.�
entries.translation: 老毛病又犯了，我這張嘴又答應了我這荷包負擔不起的交易。我沒有錢能付給你。�

entries.source: I'm sorry then, I haven't the money to dally here. I'm sorry Seigneur, but perhaps I could see you again once I have concluded my business elsewhere. Farewell.�
entries.translation: 那我很抱歉，我沒空在這裡耗著。抱歉了，紳爵，不過也許等我在別處把事情辦完，我們可以再見一面。告辭。�

entries.source: Farewell, Mitchel.�
entries.translation: 再見了，米契爾。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH :WANT_LESSON_FROM_Mitchel_Waylander_NOT_ENOUGH_MONEY // END: WANT_LESSON_FROM_Mitchel_Waylander�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：WANT_LESSON_FROM_Mitchel_Waylander_NOT_ENOUGH_MONEY // END: WANT_LESSON_FROM_Mitchel_Waylander�

entries.source:
The way ahead was blocked.
	From among the men who were guarding the bridge, a man stepped forward to confront them...�
entries.translation:
前方的路被擋住了。
	看守橋樑的人群之中，一名男子上前攔住了他們……�

entries.source: Do you have a Glazer's Guild Seal? I'll have to see one before I can let you across the bridge. We're trying to prevent a full scale guild war here and we have to make sure that no unfavorables show up. It's just a formality until we can get things settled down here again.�
entries.translation: 你們有玻璃匠公會的印信嗎？我得先看過才能讓你們過橋。我們正試著阻止這裡爆發全面的公會戰爭，得確保不會有不受歡迎的人物出現。這只是個手續，等我們這裡的情況再度穩定下來就好。�

entries.source: Guild war? What do you mean?�
entries.translation: 公會戰爭？你這話什麼意思？�

entries.source: There was an uprising here. Lasted for several months. The Riverpullers Guild took charge of the other labor guilds and surrounded Romney. The crafts guilds tried to fight their way out and it seemed a losing battle until the King's men came up from Bas-Tyra. They managed to pacify the Riverpullers' leader. The Duke of Romney's kept it from getting worse, but I can't guarantee how much longer he'll be able. It will probably be a while though before we open up the roads to the general populace.�
entries.translation: 這裡發生過一場暴動，持續了好幾個月。縴夫公會掌控了其他勞工公會，把羅姆尼團團圍住。工匠公會試圖突圍，眼看就要打輸了，幸好國王的人馬從巴斯泰拉趕來支援，才總算安撫住了縴夫公會的頭頭。羅姆尼公爵一直設法防止情勢惡化，不過我沒法保證他還能撐多久。恐怕還得再過一陣子，我們才能對一般民眾重新開放道路。�

entries.source: Can the townspeople come and go at will?�
entries.translation: 鎮民能自由進出嗎？�

entries.source: We've restricted visitors from the outside, not imprisoned the citizens. Any townsperson can come and go at their leisure.�
entries.translation: 我們限制的是外來的訪客，不是把居民關起來。任何鎮民都能隨意進出。�

entries.source: I assume the same may be said of your guests? May the men of the King's company come out and play? We have business with them.�
entries.translation: 我猜這對你們的客人也一樣適用吧？國王部隊的人能出來走動嗎？我們跟他們有事要談。�

entries.source: I would be happy to help you but I'm not entirely certain I would know how to contact them. They are hard to get into one place and I'm not sure that I've met their leader. They are a rather untrusting pack of men.�
entries.translation: 我很樂意幫忙，不過我不太確定該怎麼聯絡上他們。他們很難聚在一起，而且我也不確定自己見過他們的頭領。他們是一群相當不輕易信任人的傢伙。�

entries.source:
They would have to be. When you're tracking assassins, you have to be craftier and a little less moral than your prey.
	So, where would I go to get one of these seals?�
entries.translation:
他們也只能如此。要追蹤刺客，你得比獵物更狡猾、道德底線也要低上一些才行。
	那，我該去哪弄一枚這種印信？�

entries.source: It's not that easy. There's a group near Silden that have been petitioning for membership for some time now. But they're an unruly bunch and can't find anyone to sponsor them.�
entries.translation: 沒那麼簡單。錫爾登附近有一群人，已經申請入會好一陣子了，可他們是群不服管教的傢伙，一直找不到人願意替他們擔保。�

entries.source: But if I present a seal you will step aside with no questions asked?�
entries.translation: 那要是我出示印信，你就會二話不說讓路？�

entries.source: Well, not with no questions asked, but it would show that someone from the guild was vouching for you.�
entries.translation: 這個嘛，倒也不是二話不說，不過那至少能證明公會裡有人替你擔保。�

entries.source: Enough, reeve. We will come back. In the interim, please deliver a message to the King's men from Bas-Tyra that three men will be here soon to visit with them concerning a nocturnal bird that kills at night. They will understand what the message means.�
entries.translation: 夠了，總管事。我們會再回來的。這段期間，請替我們帶個口信給巴斯泰拉來的國王部隊，就說很快會有三個人來拜訪他們，是為了一隻在夜裡獵殺的夜行猛禽的事。他們會明白這則訊息的意思。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C2_Mitchel_Waylander_HAS_NO_SEAL�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C2_Mitchel_Waylander_HAS_NO_SEAL�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C2_Mitchel_Waylander_HAS_SEAL�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C2_Mitchel_Waylander_HAS_SEAL�

entries.source:
The way ahead was blocked.
	From among the men who were guarding the bridge, a man stepped forward to confront them...�
entries.translation:
前方的路被擋住了。
	看守橋樑的人群之中，一名男子上前攔住了他們……�

entries.source: Halt. I can't let you across without a Glazer's...�
entries.translation: 站住。沒有玻璃匠公會的……我不能讓你們過去。�

entries.source: ...Guild Seal, yes, you've told us before. The business I have with the King's men is very important and I can't tolerate further impedance by a group of self-important cattle! Let us pass!�
entries.translation: ……印信，是的，你之前說過了。我跟國王部隊有非常重要的事，不能再容忍被一群自以為是的蠢牛耽擱下去！讓我們過去！�

entries.source: Present the seal and the town is yours. Until then, sleep in the mud, Seigneur. It suits your manners.�
entries.translation: 拿出印信，這座城就是你的了。在那之前，紳爵，你就睡泥地裡吧。這正配得上你的禮數。�

entries.source: Right now, my "manners" are the only thing separating your skull from my boot. We'll be back.�
entries.translation: 眼下，我這份『禮數』，是唯一能讓你的腦袋跟我的靴子保持距離的東西。我們會再回來的。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C2_Mitchel_Waylander_HAS_NO_SEAL�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C2_Mitchel_Waylander_HAS_NO_SEAL�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C2_Mitchel_Waylander_HAS_SEAL�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C2_Mitchel_Waylander_HAS_SEAL�

entries.source:
The way ahead was blocked.
	From among the men who were guarding the bridge, a man stepped forward to confront them...�
entries.translation:
前方的路被擋住了。
	看守橋樑的人群之中，一名男子上前攔住了他們……�

entries.source: The city of Romney is sealed at the moment to all but the citizens and those who are members of the Glazer's Guild. Do you have one of our seals?�
entries.translation: 目前羅姆尼城是封閉的，只有居民跟玻璃匠公會的成員能進出。你們有我們公會的印信嗎？�

entries.source: Yes. Why is a guild in charge of the city?�
entries.translation: 有。為什麼是一個公會在掌管這座城市？�

entries.source: The constabulary were all killed in the uprising by the Riverpullers Guild and no one else in any authority was left alive to administrate. When I was approached to take command, I decided that I would use my men in the Guild to help maintain order until such a time the Duke was able to arrive from his estates.�
entries.translation: 治安隊在縴夫公會發動的暴動中全數喪命，沒有其他任何有權責的人存活下來主持大局。當有人請我出面接管的時候，我決定動用公會裡的人手維持秩序，直到公爵能從他的領地趕來為止。�

entries.source: Makes some sort of sense. Where can we find the King's men from Bas-Tyra?�
entries.translation: 這倒也說得過去。我們能在哪找到巴斯泰拉來的國王部隊？�

entries.source: They'll be holding up in the Black Sheep Tavern for a celebration of some kind. I believe I heard one of them say they've found something they were looking for. I'm not sure what it's all about.�
entries.translation: 他們正待在黑羊酒館，好像在慶祝什麼。我記得聽見他們其中一人說，他們找到了一直在找的東西。詳細情況我就不清楚了。�

entries.source: I think that may mean good news for us as well. Good night, reeve. We're on into Romney.�
entries.translation: 我想這對我們來說，或許也是個好消息。晚安，總管事。我們這就進羅姆尼去。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH :SHOW_Mitchel_Waylander_THE_SEAL�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：SHOW_Mitchel_Waylander_THE_SEAL�

entries.source:
@4 knocked cautiously on the door.
	A few tense moments later the wood began to creak and the door swung open. From the darkened room a figure emerged and @4 gripped his sword tighter, prepared for any eventuality. Though Mitchel Waylander wasn't one of his favorite people, he was a bit relieved to see his familiar face...and Mitchel seemed a bit relieved to see óthemð.�
entries.translation:
@4小心翼翼地敲了敲門。
	幾個緊繃的片刻過後，木門開始嘎吱作響，隨即敞開。一道身影從黑暗的房間裡走了出來，@4握緊了劍柄，準備應付任何突發狀況。儘管米契爾．韋蘭德並不是他特別中意的人物，看見這張熟悉的面孔，他還是稍稍鬆了口氣……而米契爾看見ó他們ð，似乎也鬆了一口氣。�

entries.source: I don't know who sent you, but I'm very thankful for your help!�
entries.translation: 我不知道是誰派你們來的，但我真的非常感激你們的幫忙！�

entries.source: Let's just say that anyone on the business end of a Nighthawk sword is of interest to me these days. It's not like them to send multiple assassins unless the target is considered a danger to the guild.�
entries.translation: 這麼說吧，最近凡是被夜鷹會的劍指著的人，我都很感興趣。除非目標被視為對公會構成威脅，不然他們一般不會派出這麼多刺客。�

entries.source: But I'm a merchant! I don't know anything about the Guild of Assassins!�
entries.translation: 可我只是個商人！我對刺客公會一無所知！�

entries.source: You wouldn't necessarily have to know anything about them. You might have witnessed something they preferred unseen, perhaps they think you've wronged them in some way. Where were you the night the King's men from Bas-Tyra regiment were assassinated?�
entries.translation: 你未必需要對他們有所了解。也許你目睹了什麼他們不想被人看見的事，又或者他們認為你在某方面得罪了他們。巴斯泰拉那支國王部隊遇刺的那晚，你人在哪裡？�

entries.source: What?! I hadn't heard...Gods, they were good men! If it hadn't been for them, we never would have broken the Riverpullers' siege at Romney. How did they die?�
entries.translation: 什麼？！我都還沒聽說……老天，他們都是好人啊！要不是有他們，我們根本沒法打破縴夫公會對羅姆尼的圍困。他們是怎麼死的？�

entries.source: Nighthawks set upon them in the Black Sheep Tavern. Killed every last man. The only thing I found strange was the fact there were few signs of resistance. I was told by the boy who tends the bar that a few casks of Keshian Ale were delivered the night before, but the Bas-Tyra men are very disciplined men. I doubt they would get drunk while trailing Nighthawks. I suspect that the ale was tainted somehow to make certain the assassins had as little difficulty as possible. We also found a silver spider and a brass spyglass on the bodies.�
entries.translation: 夜鷹會的人在黑羊酒館襲擊了他們，把每個人都殺光了。唯一讓我覺得奇怪的是，幾乎沒有任何反抗的跡象。看店的男孩告訴我，前一晚有人送來了幾桶凱許麥酒，可巴斯泰拉的人紀律極為嚴明。我很懷疑他們在追蹤夜鷹會的時候，還會喝到爛醉。我懷疑那批麥酒被人動了手腳，好確保刺客們能盡量輕鬆得手。我們還在屍體上找到了一隻銀蜘蛛跟一支黃銅望遠鏡。�

entries.source: A brass spyglass? I agree, that's very strange, very strange indeed. I wonder what they were doing with it? The silver spider though, that's definitely a sign. That's an assassin's tool...�
entries.translation: 黃銅望遠鏡？我同意，這確實很奇怪，非常奇怪。我很好奇他們拿那東西做什麼？不過那隻銀蜘蛛，那絕對是個徵兆。那是刺客的工具……�

entries.source: Really? How is it used?�
entries.translation: 真的嗎？那東西怎麼用？�

entries.source: I'm clueless. I've just heard that Nighthawks carry them sometimes. Maybe they dropped it on the bodies when they were fighting.�
entries.translation: 我也不清楚。我只聽說夜鷹會的人有時候會帶著這東西。也許是他們打鬥的時候掉在屍體上的。�

entries.source: It's a lead at the least. Thank you, Mitchel. Where will you be if we need you again?�
entries.translation: 這至少算是條線索。謝謝你，米契爾。要是我們還需要你，能去哪找你？�

entries.source: I have a few debts to pay off for the Glazer's Guild in Sloop, so if you should need me I will be here. Goodbye.�
entries.translation: 我還有幾筆帳要替玻璃匠公會在斯魯普那邊還清，要是你們需要我，我會在這裡。再見。�

Though Mitchel Waylander wasn't one of his favorite people, he was a bit relieved to see his familiar face...and Mitchel seemed a bit relieved to see óthemð.�
