entries.source: Nighthawks set upon them in the Black Sheep Tavern. Killed every last man. The only thing I found strange was the fact there were few signs of resistance. I was told by the boy who tends the bar a few casks of Keshian Ale were delivered the night before, but the Bas-Tyra men are very disciplined men. Does it seem reasonable to you a detachment of men trailing the Nighthawks would get drunk in the town where they suspect the Guild of Assassins have their headquarters?�
entries.translation: 夜鷹會的人在黑羊酒館襲擊了他們，把每個人都殺光了。唯一讓我覺得奇怪的是，幾乎沒有任何反抗的跡象。看店的男孩告訴我，前一晚有人送來了幾桶凱許麥酒，可巴斯泰拉的人紀律極為嚴明。你覺得合理嗎？一支正在追蹤夜鷹會的分隊，會在他們懷疑刺客公會設有總部的城鎮裡喝得爛醉？�

entries.source: It does sound a bit odd...�
entries.translation: 這聽起來是有點奇怪……�

entries.source: It sounded odd to me as well, so I decided the ale had been tainted in some way. I thought if I found the man who sent the ale, I might be on the trail of the Nighthawks. Then I visited the tavern here in town and I discovered something very disturbing. The arrangements for the ale delivery were made here and the keeper was instructed to add a significant amount of tarweed to the mixture, a mixture that while not poisonous, induces the drinker to become excessively thirsty, ensuring that he will continue to drink until quite drunk. But that was not the shocking information. You see, it seems the local chief reeve of a prestigious guild arranged for the delivery of the Ale...Mitchel Waylander.�
entries.translation: 我也覺得奇怪，所以我判斷那批麥酒一定被動了手腳。我想，要是能找到送酒的人，或許就能循線找到夜鷹會。於是我造訪了鎮上這間酒館，發現了一件非常令人不安的事。這批送酒的安排就是在這裡談成的，酒館老闆被交代要在酒裡加入大量的焦渴草，這種東西雖然沒有毒，卻會讓喝的人變得異常口渴，確保他會不停地喝下去，直到爛醉如泥。不過真正令人震驚的消息還在後頭。原來，安排這批麥酒送貨的，正是本地一個聲望顯赫的公會的總管事……米契爾．韋蘭德。�

entries.source: I never made that order! I would have been in Romney when the arrangement was made. I couldn't have made that order!�
entries.translation: 我從沒下過那筆訂單！那筆交易談成的時候，我人應該在羅姆尼。我不可能下那個訂單的！�

entries.source: I realize that as well. The Nighthawks have gone to extreme trouble to implicate you and that tells me they want revenge for something. The men that were sent here to kill you would undoubtedly have planted the final evidence on your corpse. So, what could you have done to them?�
entries.translation: 這我也知道。夜鷹會費了這麼大的功夫想嫁禍給你，這說明他們是想為了什麼事報仇。派來殺你的人，無疑會在你的屍體上留下最後的『證據』。那麼，你到底對他們做了什麼？�

entries.source: Truly, I don't know...�
entries.translation: 我真的不知道……�

entries.source: Do you know anything about a silver spider or a brass spyglass?�
entries.translation: 你對銀蜘蛛或黃銅望遠鏡有任何了解嗎？�

entries.source: A brass spyglass? Oh dear gods! But that man couldn't have been a Nighthawk...He was so, so regal looking...�
entries.translation: 黃銅望遠鏡？噢，天啊！可那個人不可能是夜鷹會的人啊……他看起來那麼、那麼氣派……�

entries.source: What did you do to this man? Is the spyglass involved?�
entries.translation: 你對這個人做了什麼？跟那支望遠鏡有關嗎？�

entries.source: There is a place north of Romney known as Prank's Stone. When people approach it, they often discover that items on their person disappear. A business partner and I discovered where the disappeared items go to and we sell the items we find. Anyway, one night I was drinking in the town of the same name and I saw this man who had a very marvelous brass spyglass. My guild was having difficulties at the time and I was low on cash so I conspired to achieve the spyglass for my own. I had noticed the attention he was paying to a rather fetching barmaid and I arranged that a note was sent to his table telling him to meet her near the Prank's Stone. The spyglass became ours.�
entries.translation: 羅姆尼北邊有個地方叫『惡作劇石』。人一靠近那裡，身上的物品就常常會不翼而飛。我跟一個生意夥伴發現了這些消失的物品都跑去了哪裡，便把找到的東西拿去變賣。總之，有天晚上，我在同名的那座小鎮喝酒，看見一個男人帶著一支非常精美的黃銅望遠鏡。我當時公會的處境很艱難，手頭又缺錢，便起了心思想把那支望遠鏡弄到手。我注意到他一直在留意一個相當標緻的酒館女侍，便安排人送了張字條到他桌上，說要他到惡作劇石附近跟她碰面。那支望遠鏡就這樣到了我們手上。�

entries.source: If the man you snatched the spyglass from learned what happened, I could see how he would want revenge. Where did you sell it?�
entries.translation: 要是被你偷走望遠鏡的那個人查出真相，我能理解他為什麼會想報仇。你把它賣去哪了？�

entries.source: I don't sell the items. My partner does and we split the profits. I don't know anything about him other than the fact that he is a native of Silden. We decided early on that we would share only our booty so that if one of us was caught, the other would be safe.�
entries.translation: 我不負責賣東西。是我的夥伴在賣，我們平分利潤。除了他是錫爾登本地人這件事以外，我對他一無所知。我們一開始就講好只分贓不通消息，這樣一個人要是被抓，另一個還能安然無恙。�

entries.source: Then it seems we have business in Silden. Lay low. It may be the only thing that keeps you alive, Mitchel. The Nighthawks are not men that should be angered.�
entries.translation: 那看來我們在錫爾登還有事要辦了。低調行事吧。這或許是唯一能保住你性命的辦法了，米契爾。夜鷹會可不是能隨便招惹的人。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C3_Mitchel_Waylander�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C3_Mitchel_Waylander�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: Have you found anything new out about the murder?�
entries.translation: 你查出這樁謀殺案的新線索了嗎？�

entries.source: Not yet. We were hoping you might have some extra insights into the matter.�
entries.translation: 還沒有。我們原本希望你可能對這件事有些額外的見解。�

entries.source: You've come to the wrong man. I'm still getting over the shakes after those Nighthawks came after me...�
entries.translation: 你們找錯人了。自從那些夜鷹會的人來找過我之後，我到現在都還在發抖……�

entries.source: I'd be an unreasonable man not to grant you that. We will leave you to recover your wits then. Good day, Mitchel.�
entries.translation: 要是連這點都不能體諒，那我未免太不通情理了。那我們就先讓你好好定定神吧。祝你愉快，米契爾。�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: I don't have time to chat right now. I've got Glazer's Guild business I need to attend to and far too many pots to glaze before the sun goes down this evening...�
entries.translation: 我現在沒空聊天。我還有玻璃匠公會的事要處理，今晚天黑之前還有一大堆罐子要上釉……�

entries.source: We've come from Malac's Cross. Abbot Graves sent us.�
entries.translation: 我們是從馬拉克十字鎮來的。是葛雷夫斯院長派我們來的。�

entries.source: What about?�
entries.translation: 為了什麼事？�

entries.source: The townspeople in Malac's Cross are calling for his head. He said that we should come and ask you for help.�
entries.translation: 馬拉克十字鎮的鎮民正在要求處死他。他說我們該來找你幫忙。�

entries.source: He's gambling quite a bit that I would help him, of all people. If I hadn't accepted his connections to the Crawler and the Guild of the Romney, the guild war might never have started...blast him. Deep down I know he was trying to help us, but the trouble he caused...Do you think they will truly attempt to kill him?�
entries.translation: 他這是在賭一把，賭偏偏是我會出手幫他。要不是我當初接受了他跟爬行者、還有羅姆尼公會的關係，這場公會戰爭說不定根本就不會爆發……真該死。我心底知道他當初是想幫我們，可他惹出來的這些麻煩……你們覺得他們真的會想殺他嗎？�

entries.source: I can't be convinced, but the Abbot seemed convinced.�
entries.translation: 我沒法確定，不過院長本人看起來相當確信。�

entries.source: He's wise enough to know...All right, then. I will give you a note to give to the Abbot. There is a Glazer's Guild office in Malac's Cross and they should be able to help him out, but I'm calling in the last of my favors. I'll probably lose the guild, but this is for a friend.�
entries.translation: 他也不是不懂事理的人……好吧。我會寫張字條讓你們帶給院長。馬拉克十字鎮有間玻璃匠公會的辦事處，他們應該能幫上他的忙，不過我這是在動用我最後的人情了。我大概會因此丟了公會，不過這是為了一個朋友。�

entries.source: I'm sure he will appreciate it. Thank you, Mitchel.�
entries.translation: 我相信他會心存感激的。謝謝你，米契爾。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C6_Mitchel_Waylander_HASMET_Abbot_Graves�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C6_Mitchel_Waylander_HASMET_Abbot_Graves�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: I really don't have time to talk right now. I've got Glazer's Guild business that I need to attend to and far too many pots to glaze before the sun goes down this evening. Goodbye.�
entries.translation: 我現在真的沒空說話。我還有玻璃匠公會的事要處理，今晚天黑之前還有一大堆罐子要上釉。再見。�

entries.source: Good day to you then.�
entries.translation: 那祝你愉快。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C6_Mitchel_Waylander_HASNOTMET_Abbot_Graves�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C6_Mitchel_Waylander_HASNOTMET_Abbot_Graves�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The boy walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyes downcast.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那個男孩走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，垂著眼低下頭。�

entries.source: Are you...the Collectors?�
entries.translation: 你們是……收容人嗎？�

entries.source: The Collectors? What do you know about them?�
entries.translation: 收容人？你對他們了解多少？�

entries.source: Only what master Carolus said. Before he went away he says to me that one day the Collectors would come and take me away to a pretty place where every boy would be like me and I wouldn't have to worry and that I shouldn't be upset he had to go cause he was going to a real nice place where people were like him. I tried to not be scared but it was real hard and after the master left I cried real hard for days until my head hurt. Then one day the Black Sheep man found me and said I could scrub his pots until the Collectors take me.�
entries.translation: 我只知道卡羅魯斯師傅說過的話。他離開之前跟我說，總有一天收容人會來，把我帶去一個漂亮的地方，那裡的每個男孩都會跟我一樣，我就不用再擔心了，還說他得離開這件事我不該難過，因為他是要去一個很美好的地方，那裡的人也都跟他一樣。我試著不要害怕，可真的好難，師傅走了以後，我哭了好幾天，哭到頭都痛了。後來有一天，黑羊酒館那個人找到了我，說我可以幫他刷鍋子，直到收容人來帶我走為止。�

entries.source: And how much does your current master pay you?�
entries.translation: 那你現在這位師傅，付你多少工錢？�

entries.source: Pay me?�
entries.translation: 付我工錢？�

entries.source: Yes, your wages---What does the Black Sheep man give you for helping clean up around here, for sweeping the floor and scrubbing pots?�
entries.translation: 對，你的薪水——黑羊酒館那個人，給了你什麼作為報酬，讓你幫忙打掃、掃地、刷鍋子？�

entries.source: Oh, well he's very good to me, Lord. He lets me sleep in the coup with the chickens so I don't catch the shakes and I get the bread that hasn't greened yet.�
entries.translation: 噢，他對我很好的，大人。他讓我跟雞一起睡在雞舍裡，這樣我就不會發抖著涼，還會給我還沒發霉的麵包吃。�

entries.source: That's...very kind of him. Is he here?�
entries.translation: 這……真是太仁慈了。他在這裡嗎？�

entries.source: No. He left a week ago on business to Silden. He said he would be back very soon and that I could sleep here in the shop. I forgot to lock the door.�
entries.translation: 不在。他一週前出門去錫爾登辦事了。他說他很快就會回來，還說我可以睡在這間店裡。我忘了鎖門。�

entries.source: Well, we'll leave you then. I want you to lock up the shop behind us and I want you to stay here until your master comes back. When he does, I want you to tell him that the Collectors are coming for óhim very soon and that Seigneur Locklear of Prince Arutha's court says so.�
entries.translation: 好，那我們這就離開了。我要你在我們走後把店門鎖好，一直待在這裡，直到你師傅回來為止。等他回來，我要你告訴他，收容人很快就要來找ó他了，這是亞魯莎親王宮廷的洛克利爾紳爵說的。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C1_Jason�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C1_Jason�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The boy walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyes downcast.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那個男孩走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，垂著眼低下頭。�

entries.source: Are...are you going to take me away?�
entries.translation: 你們……你們是要帶我走嗎？�

entries.source: Why should we want to do that?�
entries.translation: 我們為什麼要那麼做？�

entries.source: Because when I broke things, master always told me that someone would come and take me away someplace bad and someplace dark where they would never feed me and I'd never see the light of day. I knew when all those people got killed in here that someone would come for me and take me to the bad place.�
entries.translation: 因為每次我打破東西，師傅都會說，會有人來把我帶去一個又壞又暗的地方，他們永遠不會給我東西吃，我也永遠見不到天日。我知道這裡所有人都被殺了以後，一定會有人來找我，把我帶去那個壞地方。�

entries.source: You don't have anything to be afraid of, Jason. You didn't kill those men. It's not your fault.�
entries.translation: 傑森，你沒什麼好害怕的。不是你殺了那些人。這不是你的錯。�

entries.source: Master says anybody that stays under our roof is our respont...respono...responsibility and I was here when they were killed! That means it was my fault.�
entries.translation: 師傅說，住在咱們屋簷下的人，都是咱們的責——責——責任，他們被殺的時候我就在這裡！這就表示是我的錯。�

entries.source: Then you saw the murders?�
entries.translation: 那麼，你看見兇殺過程了嗎？�

entries.source: No, but they come in and told me to leave or they'd hurt me real bad. They didn't tell me what they were going to do.�
entries.translation: 沒有，可他們進來叫我離開，不然就要狠狠傷害我。他們沒告訴我他們要做什麼。�

entries.source: What did the men who told you to leave look like?�
entries.translation: 那些叫你離開的人長什麼樣子？�

entries.source: They were big and they had birds on their chests, like eagles. And they smelled funny, like sometimes the sailors from Kesh smell like. Like flowers...�
entries.translation: 他們個子很大，胸口上有鳥的圖案，像老鷹那樣。而且他們身上的味道很奇怪，有點像凱許來的水手身上有時候會有的那種味道。像花的味道……�

entries.source: Hawks on their chests. That at least confirms the Nighthawks' involvement...Do you know anything about a spider made of silver or a brass spyglass that one of the men that were killed might have carried? It's very important. Think hard.�
entries.translation: 胸口上有鷹的圖案。這至少證實了夜鷹會牽涉其中……你知不知道一隻銀做的蜘蛛，或是被殺的其中一人可能帶著的黃銅望遠鏡？這非常重要。仔細想想。�

entries.source: I...I don't know anything about the spider, but I remember that one of the King's Men had a brass tube with little pieces of glass in the ends of it and I could see things that were far away with it. He said that he and one of the other men had brought it back from Silden.�
entries.translation: 我……我對那隻蜘蛛一無所知，不過我記得國王部隊裡有一個人有一根黃銅管子，兩端都嵌著小玻璃片，透過它我能看見很遠的東西。他說他跟另一個人是從錫爾登把它帶回來的。�

entries.source: Did he say where in Silden he got it?�
entries.translation: 他有說是在錫爾登哪裡弄到的嗎？�

entries.source: No...just in Silden.�
entries.translation: 沒有……只說是在錫爾登。�

entries.source: Can you think of anything else? Did anyone else come into the Black Sheep before the murderers?�
entries.translation: 你還能想起別的事嗎？在兇手出現之前，有沒有別人進來過黑羊酒館？�

entries.source: A carrying man brought in some wine from the Upside Down Keg for the soldiers. Told me it was sent special, but besides that, I can't think of anything...�
entries.translation: 有個搬運工從『倒扣酒桶』給那些士兵送了些酒來。他跟我說這是特別送來的，除此之外，我想不起別的了……�

entries.source: Thanks, Jason. We may be back later to ask you more questions, so don't go anywhere.�
entries.translation: 謝謝你，傑森。我們晚點可能還會回來問你更多問題，所以別跑遠了。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C3_Jason�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C3_Jason�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The boy walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyes downcast.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那個男孩走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，垂著眼低下頭。�

entries.source: Hello. Are you going to ask me more questions now?�
entries.translation: 你好。你們現在是要再問我更多問題嗎？�

entries.source: Have you heard anything more about the murder?�
entries.translation: 你有沒有聽說更多關於這樁謀殺案的事？�

entries.source: Only that my master says that it will be bad for business and we have to bump bunnies to bring the people back in.�
entries.translation: 我只知道我師傅說這對生意不好，我們得『撞兔子』才能把客人找回來。�

entries.source: Bump bunnies? That's a new expression for the books. Well, we are here and I suppose we ought to do what we can for the locals. Have anything to eat around here?�
entries.translation: 撞兔子？這可是個新鮮的說法。好了，既然我們人都在這兒了，我想也該幫幫當地人。這裡有什麼吃的嗎？�

entries.source: Nothing fresh, but we have standard rations if you have the money.�
entries.translation: 沒有新鮮的東西，不過要是你們有錢，我們有一般的口糧。�

entries.source: I think we'll pass on the rations. Maybe another time.�
entries.translation: 我看我們口糧就不用了。也許下次吧。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C3_Jason_DONT_BUY�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C3_Jason_DONT_BUY�

entries.source: We'll take some. We have quite a bit of travelling to do.�
entries.translation: 我們要買一些。我們還有不少路要趕。�

entries.source: I'll get them out of the back.�
entries.translation: 我去後面拿。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C3_Jason_ENOUGH_GOLD�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C3_Jason_ENOUGH_GOLD�

entries.source: Seems I may have spoken too soon. I'm short on funds. Perhaps next time.�
entries.translation: 看來我話說得太早了。我手頭有點緊。也許下次吧。�

entries.source: Next time. Ok. Goodbye.�
entries.translation: 下次吧。好。再見。�

entries.source: Goodbye, Jason. Take care of yourself.�
entries.translation: 再見了，傑森。保重。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C3_Jason_NOT_ENOUGH_GOLD�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C3_Jason_NOT_ENOUGH_GOLD�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The boy walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyes downcast.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那個男孩走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，垂著眼低下頭。�

entries.source: Is there something I can get for you?�
entries.translation: 有什麼我能幫你們拿的嗎？�

entries.source: Hello, Jason. How's your business been doing? I know you were concerned about customers coming back the last time I saw you.�
entries.translation: 你好，傑森。生意最近怎麼樣？我記得上次見面時，你還在擔心客人回不回得來。�

entries.source: Master is mad and says he will have to close up the shop and get rid of me because everybody is scared in Romney. No business.�
entries.translation: 師傅很生氣，說他得把店關了，還要把我攆走，因為羅姆尼的人都嚇壞了。沒生意了。�

entries.source: What are they scared of?�
entries.translation: 他們在怕什麼？�

entries.source: I don't know, but master says they are scared and he's got no use for a stupid boy when he can't pay his debts. I guess he's right though, cause I am stupid and I'm costing him money...�
entries.translation: 我不知道，不過師傅說他們在害怕，而且他還不起債的時候，養不起一個蠢男孩。不過我猜他是對的，因為我確實很蠢，還一直花他的錢……�

entries.source: I'm...really sorry to hear about that Jason. I wish there was something we could do.�
entries.translation: 傑森，聽到這件事我……真的很遺憾。真希望我們能幫上點忙。�

entries.source: Maybe if you bought some food it would help.�
entries.translation: 也許你們要是買點吃的，會有幫助。�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The boy walked over to join them...�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那個男孩走了過來，加入他們……�

entries.source: We still have a few packs of rations left in the storeroom if you want them. Want me to get them for you?�
entries.translation: 儲藏室裡還剩幾包口糧，你們要的話還有。要我去幫你們拿嗎？�

entries.source: I wish we could help, but I think we'll pass on the rations. I'm sorry Jason.�
entries.translation: 真希望我們能幫上忙，不過我看我們口糧就不用了。抱歉了，傑森。�

entries.source: That's Ok. Maybe you can buy some next time.�
entries.translation: 沒關係。也許你們下次可以買一些。�

entries.source: Goodbye, Jason. Take care.�
entries.translation: 再見了，傑森。保重。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C6_Jason_DONT_BUY�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C6_Jason_DONT_BUY�

entries.source: Whatever we can do. We'll take some.�
entries.translation: 只要我們幫得上忙。我們要買一些。�

entries.source: I'll get them from the stock room.�
entries.translation: 我去儲藏室拿。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C6_Jason_ENOUGH_GOLD�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C6_Jason_ENOUGH_GOLD�

entries.source: I wish we could help, but we're short on funds. I'm sorry Jason.�
entries.translation: 真希望我們能幫上忙，不過我們手頭有點緊。抱歉了，傑森。�

entries.source: That's Ok. Maybe you can buy some next time.�
entries.translation: 沒關係。也許你們下次可以買一些。�

entries.source: Take care of yourself, Jason.�
entries.translation: 保重，傑森。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C6_Jason_NOT_ENOUGH_GOLD�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C6_Jason_NOT_ENOUGH_GOLD�

entries.source: Without looking away from the stranger on the road, Locklear whispered under his breath. "He's dressed in a Keshian manner---this may be trouble. Be ready to move at an instant should I say the word."�
entries.translation: 洛克利爾目光沒有離開路上那名陌生人，低聲喃喃道。「他穿著凱許人的服飾——這可能有點麻煩。要是我一聲令下，做好隨時行動的準備。」�

entries.source: It's a hot day to be idling under the sun without shade. Can I assume you're waiting for someone?�
entries.translation: 這麼熱的天，站在太陽底下無遮無蔽地閒晃。我能猜你是在等人嗎？�

entries.source: So I do. A spice trader come from Malac's Cross bound for Silden. I must assume his journey is delayed for a time. We shall drink full a fortnight or two in the Empress Inn.�
entries.translation: 正是如此。一位從馬拉克十字鎮來、要前往錫爾登的香料商人。我猜他的旅程想必是耽擱了。我們該在女皇客棧裡痛飲個一兩週才是。�

entries.source: Do you fear that this trader will be harmed in Silden?�
entries.translation: 你是擔心這位商人會在錫爾登遇害嗎？�

entries.source: Ah! With an eagle's eye you see the problem---The danger that awaits there is not intended for him, nor for any man alone. Strangers live short lives that cross into Silden when the Crawler has convened a secret session of his assistants.�
entries.translation: 啊！你這雙眼睛敏銳如鷹，一眼便看穿了問題所在——在那裡等著他的危險，並非專為他一人而設，也非針對任何單獨一人。每當爬行者召開他那些手下的祕密會議時，踏入錫爾登的陌生人，壽命都不長久。�

entries.source: And this Crawler has called such a meeting?�
entries.translation: 那這個爬行者已經召開了這樣的會議？�

entries.source: Even so. At dusk two nights ago a raven was nailed to the doorpost of the Anchorhead Tavern, the sign any that hadn't business in Silden should quit the town and quickly. Such it has been for several years.�
entries.translation: 正是如此。兩晚前的黃昏，有人把一隻渡鴉釘在了錨首酒館的門柱上，這是個信號，告訴任何在錫爾登沒有正事要辦的人，該盡快離開這座城鎮。這樣的規矩，已經行之有年了。�

entries.source: What of the town constable? He does nothing about this criminal?�
entries.translation: 那鎮上的治安官呢？他對這個罪犯就什麼都不做嗎？�

entries.source: In Kesh it is said that a man cannot see that has gold in his eyes, a man will not look that has sin in his heart.�
entries.translation: 在凱許有句話是這麼說的：眼中裝滿黃金的人看不見真相，心中藏著罪孽的人不願正視真相。�

entries.source:
I believe I understand.
	I think we shall be on our way then and thanks for your news of Silden.�
entries.translation:
我想我明白了。
	那我們這就繼續上路了，謝謝你告訴我們錫爾登的消息。�

entries.source: Remember, heed the roadsigns. Wander no closer to Silden than you must for the Crawler's assistants have great cajunlo---great power.�
entries.translation: 記住，留意路上的標誌。除非必要，別再靠近錫爾登了，因為爬行者的手下擁有強大的『卡尊洛』——強大的力量。�

entries.source: Thank-you, Abuk. We will remember your warning.�
entries.translation: 謝謝你，阿布克。我們會記住你的警告。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C1_Abuk�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C1_Abuk�

entries.source:
They were not alone.
	@0's pulse quickened as he saw the lone figure approach; but when it became apparent they were not being attacked, he relaxed a bit, squinted slightly in an attempt to see who was about to join them.�
entries.translation:
他們並非孤身一人。
	@0看見一個孤零零的身影走近，脈搏頓時加快；但看出對方並無攻擊之意後，他才稍稍放鬆下來，瞇起眼想看清楚是誰要加入他們。�

entries.source: Are you still waiting for your friend?�
entries.translation: 你還在等你的朋友嗎？�

entries.source: Even so. Though I have blisters on my tongue and boils on my feet, I shall wait until the sun boils away my flesh and maggots chew my brain and even then shall I wait until I have word of him.�
entries.translation: 正是如此。儘管我舌頭上起了水泡，腳上也長了膿瘡，我仍會等下去，直到太陽把我的血肉都曬乾，蛆蟲啃食我的腦子，即使到了那時，我也要等到有他的消息為止。�

entries.source: Maybe something has happened to him.�
entries.translation: 也許他出了什麼事。�

entries.source: I will wait! My thanks for your concern, but I cannot quit my duty to a friend. Travel fairly, sir.�
entries.translation: 我會等下去！謝謝你的關心，不過我不能就此放棄我對朋友的責任。一路順風，先生。�

entries.source: I will. Good luck to you.�
entries.translation: 我會的。祝你好運。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C1_Abuk�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C1_Abuk�

entries.source:
They were not alone.
	@0's pulse quickened as he saw the lone figure approach; but when it became apparent they were not being attacked, he relaxed a bit, squinted slightly in an attempt to see who was about to join them.�
entries.translation:
他們並非孤身一人。
	@0看見一個孤零零的身影走近，脈搏頓時加快；但看出對方並無攻擊之意後，他才稍稍放鬆下來，瞇起眼想看清楚是誰要加入他們。�

entries.source: Excuse me, sirs. I will detain you only a few moments. Can you show me the way to Lyton? I am told that there is someone there who requires my services to pick a Webber lock. The letter I received from there sounded most urgent...�
entries.translation: 打擾了，兩位先生。我只耽誤你們一點時間。能指引我去萊頓的路嗎？我聽說那裡有人需要我的服務，去開一把韋伯鎖。我收到的那封信，聽起來十萬火急……�

entries.source: Impossible. A Webber lock cannot be picked.�
entries.translation: 不可能。韋伯鎖是撬不開的。�

entries.source: Perhaps not by you, but one skilled in the arts of subtlety, he may know how to penetrate even the most difficult of locks. It is a matter of patience.�
entries.translation: 或許你辦不到，不過精通這門精細技藝的人，或許知道該如何攻破再困難的鎖。這只是耐心的問題。�

entries.source: I don't care how patient you are, a Webber lock cannot be picked. You're making idle boasts.�
entries.translation: 我才不管你有多少耐心，韋伯鎖是撬不開的。你這是在說大話。�

entries.source: And what would Abuk gain telling strangers a fact that was not true, eh? I merely say these things so I may advertise my services and you might make use of them one day. I state simple fact. There is no lock in this Kingdom of yours that Abuk cannot pick. None.�
entries.translation: 那阿布克跟陌生人說謊話，又能得到什麼好處呢，嗯？我說這些，只是想替自己打個廣告，好讓你們有朝一日能用得上我的服務。我陳述的不過是簡單的事實。在你們這個王國裡，沒有一把鎖是阿布克開不了的。一把都沒有。�

entries.source: Is that so? Perhaps you could teach us how to pick Webber locks.�
entries.translation: 是嗎？也許你能教我們怎麼撬開韋伯鎖。�

entries.source: It would take more time than I think you would care to spend. I spent five years at the foot of my master Caliphad in the shadow of mount Ashunta learning the art. But I could perhaps improve whatever skill you may already possess. A small fee of seventy gold sovereigns should pay for my time.�
entries.translation: 這得花上比你們願意花的時間更多。我花了整整五年，在阿舜塔山的山蔭下，跟隨我的師傅卡里法德學習這門技藝。不過或許我能改善你們已經具備的技巧。區區七十枚金幣，應該就足以支付我的時間。�

entries.source: Seventy gold pieces for a lesson in lockpicking? That's nothing short of robbery.�
entries.translation: 七十枚金幣上一堂開鎖課？這根本跟搶劫沒兩樣。�

entries.source: You are wise. I should not cheat myself in this fashion. Eighty sovereigns, but I cannot raise my price any higher, despite the great deference you show to my person. Is the arrangement to be sealed?�
entries.translation: 你真是精明。我不該這樣虧待自己。八十枚金幣，不過儘管你們對我如此敬重，我也不能再往上加價了。這樁交易，要成交嗎？�

entries.source: There are many things I enjoy in life, but wasting hard earned money is not one of them. Any man that claims to be able to pick a Webber lock is undoubtedly a fraud.�
entries.translation: 人生中我喜歡的事情有很多，可浪費辛苦賺來的錢不在其中。任何自稱能撬開韋伯鎖的人，肯定都是騙子。�

entries.source: Perhaps you are right. I shall consider these things while I unlock one in Lyton. If you should change your mind and we should meet again, however, I would be willing to teach you the things that are impossible for me to know. Travel well.�
entries.translation: 也許你說得對。我會一邊在萊頓開一把鎖，一邊好好想想這些事。不過要是你改變主意，我們又剛好再相遇，我會樂意教你們一些我不可能知道的事。一路順風。�

entries.source: That we will. Good day.�
entries.translation: 我們會的。祝你愉快。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C2_Abuk_LESSON_NO�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C2_Abuk_LESSON_NO�

entries.source:
They were not alone.
	@0's pulse quickened as he saw the lone figure approach; but when it became apparent they were not being attacked, he relaxed a bit, squinted slightly in an attempt to see who was about to join them.�
entries.translation:
他們並非孤身一人。
	@0看見一個孤零零的身影走近，脈搏頓時加快；但看出對方並無攻擊之意後，他才稍稍放鬆下來，瞇起眼想看清楚是誰要加入他們。�

entries.source: Dear friends! Come, Abuk will teach you how to pick locks. I believe we fixed my price at eighty sovereigns on my last meeting. Shall I give you a lesson now?�
entries.translation: 親愛的朋友們！來吧，阿布克會教你們怎麼開鎖。我記得我們上次談定的價錢是八十枚金幣。現在要我教你們一課嗎？�

entries.source: As I told you last time, any man that claims to be able to pick a Webber lock is a fraud. I'm not going to throw my money away.�
entries.translation: 就像我上次跟你說的，任何自稱能撬開韋伯鎖的人都是騙子。我才不會把錢白白扔掉。�

entries.source: If you should change your mind and we should meet again, I shall attempt once more to prove you wrong. Travel well.�
entries.translation: 要是你改變主意，我們又再相遇，我會再試著證明你是錯的。一路順風。�

entries.source: That we will. Good day.�
entries.translation: 我們會的。祝你愉快。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C2_Abuk_LESSON_NO�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C2_Abuk_LESSON_NO�

entries.source: All right, Keshian. Eighty sovereigns, but I am warning you...I doubt there's anything you can teach me.�
entries.translation: 好吧，凱許人。八十枚金幣，不過我警告你……我很懷疑你有什麼東西能教我。�

entries.source: You must open yourself to new things. This is the first learning. Without this opening you will not be complete. Opening yourself is like opening a lock. If you cannot open, then the lock may not open. You should understand that there is no difference between yourself and the lock that you pick. All these things I will demonstrate with a test lock that I carry with me. Now I want you to observe...�
entries.translation: 你必須向新事物敞開自己。這是第一課。不敞開自己，你就不完整。敞開自己，就像打開一把鎖。要是你打不開自己，那把鎖也可能打不開。你該明白，你自己跟你要開的那把鎖之間，並沒有差別。這一切，我會用隨身攜帶的一把試驗用鎖來示範給你看。現在，我要你仔細觀察……�

entries.source: Keshian double...talk . Wait a minute...how did you do that? I couldn't see...Do that again.�
entries.translation: 凱許人的……模稜兩可的鬼話。等等……你剛才是怎麼辦到的？我沒看清楚……再做一次。�

entries.source: That is it. You have received your first lesson, dark eyes.�
entries.translation: 就是這樣。你已經上完了你的第一課，黑眼睛的孩子。�

entries.source: That was too fast. I couldn't catch what you were doing.�
entries.translation: 太快了。我沒能看清楚你在做什麼。�

entries.source: In time you shall realize what was done. In your mind, the events will unlock and thus your hands will unlock as well. I must go now. Goodbye.�
entries.translation: 時候到了，你自然會明白發生了什麼事。在你心中，這段經歷終將解鎖，而你的雙手也會隨之解鎖。我該走了。再見。�

entries.source: Wait...�
entries.translation: 等等……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH :LESSON1_FROM_Abuk_ENOUGH_GOLD�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：LESSON1_FROM_Abuk_ENOUGH_GOLD�

entries.source: If I had the money, I would embarrass you Keshian, but unfortunately it seems that I hadn't as many sovereigns as I thought.�
entries.translation: 要是我有錢，我肯定會讓你這個凱許人出出糗，可不巧的是，看來我手頭的金幣沒有我想得那麼多。�

entries.source: Indeed it is unfortunate, for I wish to one day be embarrassed. Perhaps when you have more money, you can come and we shall test one another. Until that time, I bid you fair travelling.�
entries.translation: 這確實很可惜，因為我倒是很希望有朝一日能被人比下去。也許等你手頭寬裕些，你可以再來，咱們互相較量一下。在那之前，祝你一路順風。�

entries.source: I look forward to the day we meet again. Goodbye.�
entries.translation: 我很期待我們再見面的那一天。再見。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH :LESSON1_FROM_Abuk_NOT_ENOUGH_GOLD�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：LESSON1_FROM_Abuk_NOT_ENOUGH_GOLD�

entries.source:
They were not alone.
	@0's pulse quickened as he saw the lone figure approach; but when it became apparent they were not being attacked, he relaxed a bit, squinted slightly in an attempt to see who was about to join them.�
entries.translation:
他們並非孤身一人。
	@0看見一個孤零零的身影走近，脈搏頓時加快；但看出對方並無攻擊之意後，他才稍稍放鬆下來，瞇起眼想看清楚是誰要加入他們。�

entries.source: Abuk, master of locks at your service. How may I be of assistance?�
entries.translation: 阿布克，開鎖大師，聽候差遣。有什麼我能幫上忙的？�

entries.source: It appears that you are master of more than locks. What do you know of the Prank's Stone north of Romney?�
entries.translation: 看來你不只精通開鎖而已。你對羅姆尼北邊的惡作劇石了解多少？�

entries.source: A tongue wags loose in Silden. I see my enterprises may be silenced.�
entries.translation: 錫爾登有張嘴巴不夠嚴實啊。看來我的生意恐怕保不住了。�

entries.source: I am interested only in a brass spyglass that you sold to Joftaz in Silden. Tell me about it and I will choose to forget about any other thefts you may have participated in. How did you come by it?�
entries.translation: 我只對你賣給錫爾登喬夫塔茲的那支黃銅望遠鏡感興趣。跟我說說吧，我會選擇忘掉你可能參與過的其他偷竊勾當。你是怎麼弄到那支望遠鏡的？�

entries.source: A year and twenty ago, I bought a box in Silden from a trader. He told me it would bring me great fortune, but I wished only for a strong chest to hold my things and I told him that he would be a fool to sell such a box. We haggled and at last I purchased it for ten sovereigns, a price that the seller seemed positively glad to receive. I too was pleased with the exchange, but began to wonder at the nature of what I had purchased. The chest was possessed of ócajunlo.�
entries.translation: 二十年前，我在錫爾登跟一個商人買了個箱子。他告訴我這箱子會帶給我大好運，可我只是想要個堅固的箱子來放我的東西，還跟他說，他要是賣掉這種箱子那才叫傻。我們討價還價了一番，最後我用十枚金幣買下了它，賣家對這個價錢似乎相當滿意。這筆交易我自己也很滿意，不過後來我開始納悶，自己到底買了個什麼樣的東西。這箱子帶著ó卡尊洛。�

entries.source: óCajunlo? What does that mean?�
entries.translation: ó卡尊洛？那是什麼意思？�

entries.source: It was box of trickery, of magic. Objects would appear in the box, things that I had not placed there. Then one day I met a man from Romney and he told me of the true nature of my chest. When things were lost in a certain place, they came to my box and we could sell those items. We decided of course that we would never tell each other more about ourselves so our business would be safe should one of us fall into harm.�
entries.translation: 那是個充滿詭計、充滿魔法的箱子。箱子裡會出現一些東西，是我根本沒放進去的東西。後來有一天，我遇見一個羅姆尼來的人，他告訴了我這個箱子的真正本質。某個特定地點遺失的東西，會出現在我的箱子裡，我們便能把這些物品賣掉。我們當然也講好，絕不透露更多彼此的底細，這樣一來，要是我們其中一人出了事，這門生意還能安然無恙。�

entries.source: And you two would split the profits of whatever appeared in the box. I take it that the brass spyglass was one of the items he arranged for you to find?�
entries.translation: 你們倆會平分箱子裡出現的東西賣得的利潤。我猜這支黃銅望遠鏡，就是他安排讓你找到的其中一樣東西吧？�

entries.source: It was one of many things.�
entries.translation: 那是眾多東西之一。�

entries.source: The day you got the spyglass, did anything else appear in your box?�
entries.translation: 你拿到那支望遠鏡的那天，箱子裡還出現了別的東西嗎？�

entries.source: A few things. I keep the things whose value I do not know, so those items which arrived with the spyglass are still there as well. I believe there was a note whose contents I do not remember.�
entries.translation: 有幾樣東西。我不知道價值的東西都會留著，所以跟望遠鏡一起出現的那些物品，現在應該也還在。我記得好像有張字條，不過內容我不記得了。�

entries.source: Where was this box? Is it close-by?�
entries.translation: 這個箱子在哪？離這裡近嗎？�

entries.source: It lies behind a mountain with two other boxes near Silden and is locked with a special lock. You will have to spell out Thorn so that it may be opened. If you do not understand of what I speak, you shall when you find the box.�
entries.translation: 它就放在錫爾登附近一座山後面，跟另外兩個箱子放在一起，鎖著一把特殊的鎖。你得拼出Thorn這個字，才能把它打開。要是你聽不懂我在說什麼，等你找到箱子就會明白了。�

entries.source: Thorn? We will remember your kindness. Thank-you.�
entries.translation: Thorn？我們會記住你的好意的。謝謝你。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C3_Abuk_HASMET_JOFTAZ�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C3_Abuk_HASMET_JOFTAZ�

entries.source:
They were not alone.
	@0's pulse quickened as he saw the lone figure approach; but when it became apparent they were not being attacked, he relaxed a bit, squinted slightly in an attempt to see who was about to join them.�
entries.translation:
他們並非孤身一人。
	@0看見一個孤零零的身影走近，脈搏頓時加快；但看出對方並無攻擊之意後，他才稍稍放鬆下來，瞇起眼想看清楚是誰要加入他們。�

entries.source: The sun shines favorably on you traveller. I am Abuk of Silden, master of locks, son of Kardeji and student of Caliphad, master among masters of locks...�
entries.translation: 旅人，願陽光眷顧著你。我是錫爾登的阿布克，開鎖大師，卡爾德吉之子，卡里法德的學生，鎖匠中的鎖匠大師……�

entries.source: Save your breath. I haven't the need for a locksmith at the moment. I need information about a company of Kingdom soldiers that may have visited Silden recently.�
entries.translation: 省省吧。我目前不需要鎖匠。我需要打聽一支最近可能造訪過錫爾登的王國士兵部隊的消息。�

entries.source: Many soldiers visit Silden. Some come from the boats that dock there, some come from Lyton or places further away. What would distinguish the men you seek from any other men?�
entries.translation: 造訪錫爾登的士兵可多了。有些是從停靠的船上下來的，有些是從萊頓或更遠的地方來的。你要找的這些人，有什麼特徵能跟其他人區分開來？�

entries.source: If you noticed them at all, they should have seemed conspicuously inconspicuous. They would have drank little and paid whatever shopkeepers asked, no matter how outrageous the price. They would have avoided fighting unless it was forced upon them and then it would have been very evident they were skilled fighters...�
entries.translation: 要是你注意到他們，他們應該會顯得『刻意不起眼』。他們喝酒喝得不多，不管店家開價多離譜都會照付。他們會避免打鬥，除非被逼上梁山，而一旦動起手來，就會很明顯看出他們是身手不凡的戰士……�

entries.source: I know of these men. They came to Silden to hire assassins, but Abuk told them they do not need assassins.�
entries.translation: 我認識這些人。他們來錫爾登是想雇刺客，不過阿布克告訴他們，他們用不著刺客。�

entries.source: Hire Nighthawks? No. These men would have been looking for the Nighthawks, but they didn't wish to hire them. If anything, they wanted to trick them into the open...�
entries.translation: 雇夜鷹會的人？不對。這些人應該是在找夜鷹會，可他們並不是想雇用他們。要說有什麼目的，他們反而是想把他們引出來……�

entries.source: They asked Abuk to hire assassins, but I told them about my spider and they did not wish to hire assassins anymore. They bought the spider and went away to Romney.�
entries.translation: 他們要阿布克幫忙雇刺客，可我跟他們說了我那隻蜘蛛的事，他們就不想雇刺客了。他們買下了那隻蜘蛛，然後就去羅姆尼了。�

entries.source: You sold them the silver spider? Why did they wish to buy it?�
entries.translation: 你把那隻銀蜘蛛賣給他們了？他們為什麼想買？�

entries.source: They did not tell Abuk and I did not ask. I am only a master of locks and the business of the King's men is their own.�
entries.translation: 他們沒告訴阿布克，我也沒問。我只是個開鎖大師，國王部隊的事是他們自己的事。�

entries.source: No one is accusing you of anything. Where did you get the silver spider from? Did you buy it from someone?�
entries.translation: 沒人在指控你什麼。你這隻銀蜘蛛是打哪弄來的？是跟誰買的嗎？�

entries.source: A man of the Guild of Assassins learned where I keep my modest treasures and wished to open it. Having considerable skills, he opened its strange lock but he was struck dead by the trap which he had thoughtlessly triggered. When I found the silver spider on his person, I kept it until the day I sold it to the King's soldiers.�
entries.translation: 有個刺客公會的人打聽到我收藏小小珍寶的地方，想打開它。他手藝相當高明，打開了那把奇特的鎖，卻被他不小心觸發的機關給當場擊斃。我在他身上找到那隻銀蜘蛛，便留了下來，直到後來賣給國王的士兵為止。�

entries.source: They may have believed they could use it to track down the Nighthawks. Was there anything else on the dead Nighthawk that could have told you anything about him?�
entries.translation: 他們可能以為能用這東西追蹤夜鷹會。那個死掉的夜鷹會成員身上，還有沒有別的東西能透露他的身分？�

entries.source: He had a ticket for passage to Krondor on the Night Crawler, a boat that sometimes harbors in Silden. I had no need for it so I threw it away.�
entries.translation: 他身上有一張搭乘『夜爬行者號』前往克朗多的船票，那是艘偶爾會在錫爾登靠港的船。我用不著，就把它扔了。�

entries.source: I think we have all we need for now, Abuk, but please stay here. We may need to speak to you again.�
entries.translation: 我想我們目前該問的都問完了，阿布克，不過請你留在這裡。我們可能還需要再找你談談。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C3_Abuk_HASNOTMET_JOFTAZ�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C3_Abuk_HASNOTMET_JOFTAZ�

entries.source:
They were not alone.
	@0's pulse quickened as he saw the lone figure approach; but when it became apparent they were not being attacked, he relaxed a bit, squinted slightly in an attempt to see who was about to join them.�
entries.translation:
他們並非孤身一人。
	@0看見一個孤零零的身影走近，脈搏頓時加快；但看出對方並無攻擊之意後，他才稍稍放鬆下來，瞇起眼想看清楚是誰要加入他們。�

entries.source: Greetings, traveller. I am Abuk, picker of locks and teacher of souls. How might I serve you?�
entries.translation: 旅人，你好。我是阿布克，開鎖之人，靈魂的導師。我能為你效勞什麼？�

entries.source: You said you were a teacher. Would you be interested in teaching us how to pick locks?�
entries.translation: 你說你是位老師。你有興趣教我們怎麼開鎖嗎？�

entries.source: Abuk is always interested in making money. I propose a price of seventy sovereigns. Is this offer acceptable to you?�
entries.translation: 阿布克永遠對賺錢感興趣。我開價七十枚金幣。這個價錢你能接受嗎？�

entries.source: I will have to consider your offer for a while. Let me think on it.�
entries.translation: 我得考慮一下你的提議。讓我想想。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C6_Abuk_LESSON_NO�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C6_Abuk_LESSON_NO�

entries.source:
They were not alone.
	@0's pulse quickened as he saw the lone figure approach; but when it became apparent they were not being attacked, he relaxed a bit, squinted slightly in an attempt to see who was about to join them.�
entries.translation:
他們並非孤身一人。
	@0看見一個孤零零的身影走近，脈搏頓時加快；但看出對方並無攻擊之意後，他才稍稍放鬆下來，瞇起眼想看清楚是誰要加入他們。�

entries.source: I still may improve your knowledge of locks, young one. If you are still interested, my price is still seventy sovereigns. Shall I instruct you?�
entries.translation: 年輕人，我仍然能增進你對鎖的了解。要是你還有興趣，我的價錢依然是七十枚金幣。要我教你嗎？�

entries.source: Sorry, I've got better things to waste my gold on. Perhaps you will find someone else to teach.�
entries.translation: 抱歉，我的金子還有更值得花的地方。也許你能找到別人來教。�

entries.source: An unfortunate choice for you, but one I shall respect. Travel well.�
entries.translation: 這對你來說是個可惜的選擇，不過我會尊重你的決定。一路順風。�

entries.source: Our paths may one day cross again, Abuk. Until then...�
entries.translation: 阿布克，我們的道路或許有朝一日還會再交會。在那之前……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C6_Abuk_LESSON_NO�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C6_Abuk_LESSON_NO�

entries.source: I've spent seventy sovereigns on less interesting subjects. Teach us.�
entries.translation: 我曾把七十枚金幣花在更無趣的事情上。教我們吧。�

entries.source: You must open yourself to new things. This is the first learning. Without this opening you will not be complete. Opening yourself is like opening a lock. If you cannot open, then the lock may not open. You should understand that there is no difference between your self and the lock that you pick. All these things I will demonstrate with a test lock that I carry with me. Now I want you to observe...�
entries.translation: 你必須向新事物敞開自己。這是第一課。不敞開自己，你就不完整。敞開自己，就像打開一把鎖。要是你打不開自己，那把鎖也可能打不開。你該明白，你自己跟你要開的那把鎖之間，並沒有差別。這一切，我會用隨身攜帶的一把試驗用鎖來示範給你看。現在，我要你仔細觀察……�

entries.source: You cover your cantrip poorly. Though I very nearly missed it.�
entries.translation: 你這法術遮掩得不太好。雖然我差點就沒發現。�

entries.source: Can-trip? This is a word that Abuk does not know. Perhaps you will teach me...�
entries.translation: 法……法術？這個詞阿布克不懂。也許你能教教我……�

entries.source: Just now, as you were demonstrating with the lock, I noticed that you motioned only very slightly with your right hand---a casting gesture. What sort of spell did you just effect?�
entries.translation: 剛才你用那把鎖示範的時候，我注意到你右手做了個很細微的動作——那是個施法手勢。你剛才施展了什麼樣的法術？�

entries.source: You observe keenly, but I am not of the magician's breed. I know nothing of cajunlo and yet I have this...ability...I may take a seed of knowledge and plant it in the fertile soil of another man's mind. I have done as requested, however, I have taught you something of the art of picking locks and our deal is still as valid.�
entries.translation: 你觀察得真敏銳，不過我並非法師一族。我對卡尊洛一無所知，可我卻有這種……能力……我能把一粒知識的種子，種進另一個人肥沃的心田裡。不管怎樣，我已經照約定教了你們一些開鎖的技藝，咱們這筆交易依然算數。�

entries.source: Agreed, but a bit of advice if you want to keep your secret hidden. Make sure that your students keep their eyes on the lock. Perhaps you should arrange it so that sparks flew from it or you had it painted in a shiny color. I know that many of the trickers who pose as magicians use that to keep people from seeing what they are doing.�
entries.translation: 同意，不過要是你想保守這個祕密，給你個小建議。務必讓你的學生把目光都盯在那把鎖上。也許你該想個辦法，讓鎖冒出火花，或是把它漆成閃亮的顏色。我知道很多假冒法師的騙子，都是靠這一招，不讓人看清他們在做什麼。�

entries.source: We both learn in this exchange. Your advice is appreciated young magician. My thanks. Travel to the sun on cool sands.�
entries.translation: 這次交流讓我們雙方都有所收穫。年輕的法師，謝謝你的建議。感激不盡。願你踏著清涼的沙，一路走向太陽。�

entries.source: Our paths may one day cross again, Abuk. Until then...�
entries.translation: 阿布克，我們的道路或許有朝一日還會再交會。在那之前……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH :LESSON2_FROM_Abuk_ENOUGH_GOLD�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：LESSON2_FROM_Abuk_ENOUGH_GOLD�

entries.source: Your price is fair, but I have spoken too soon. I haven't enough gold to pay for your services. Perhaps another time.�
entries.translation: 你這價錢很公道，可我話說得太早了。我沒有足夠的金子付你的服務費。也許改天吧。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH :LESSON2_FROM_Abuk_NOT_ENOUGH_GOLD�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：LESSON2_FROM_Abuk_NOT_ENOUGH_GOLD�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The woman nodded, then made her way across the wooden floor until she was standing before them.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名女子點了點頭，穿過木地板走了過來，最後站到了他們面前。�

entries.source: Among you there are injured that need looking after. The ship should return here soon. I would advise you seek help as soon as possible...�
entries.translation: 你們之中有人受了傷，需要照料。船應該很快就會回到這裡。我建議你們盡快尋求幫助……�

entries.source: But that's why we've come. The shipmaster in Silden said we could find a healer on this island who could help us.�
entries.translation: 這正是我們來的原因。錫爾登的船長說，這座島上能找到一位治療者幫助我們。�

entries.source: You have been misinformed. I am not a priestess of Sung and Eortis concerns himself solely with the denizens of his kingdom of the sea. He may act only on their behalf. Thus is his purpose as deigned by the will of Ishap, the One Above All.�
entries.translation: 你們得到的消息有誤。我不是頌神的祭司，而埃奧提斯只關心他海洋王國裡的子民。他只能代表他們行事。這正是至高無上的伊夏神所賦予他的使命。�

entries.source: When I was young, I was fortunate enough to have learned something about how the temples all worked. I thought I remembered that a god can sometimes be compelled outside his purpose in return for a duty of obeisance.�
entries.translation: 我年輕的時候，有幸學過一些神殿運作的道理。我記得，一位神有時候能被說動，超出祂原本的職責範圍行事，只要換來相應的敬奉義務。�

entries.source: That is true, but Eortis is but a shadow of what he once was.  Upon a time, before the Valheru warred with the gods of Midkemia, his influence was as the depth and breadth of the seas and all that moved across them. When at last he vanished, Killian assumed control of his realm but here some essence of what he was still survives. We cannot communicate with a god that is lost...�
entries.translation: 這是真的，不過埃奧提斯如今已是昔日的影子。曾幾何時，在瓦爾赫魯與米德凱米亞諸神開戰之前，祂的影響力如海洋般深廣，涵蓋一切航行其上的事物。祂終於消失之後，基利安接掌了祂的領域，不過這裡仍殘留著祂本質的一絲餘韻。我們沒法跟一位已經消逝的神明溝通……�

entries.source: But if we were to act on his behalf, do you think he would grant us favor?�
entries.translation: 可要是我們代祂行事，你覺得祂會賜予我們恩惠嗎？�

entries.source: I cannot know. If there were more than an essence of him in this place, perhaps we could commune with him and learn his thoughts, but we of the order of Eortis are the servants of a vanished god. We see his will only in very small ways.�
entries.translation: 我無法得知。要是這裡殘留的不只是祂的一絲餘韻，或許我們還能與祂溝通，得知祂的心意，可我們埃奧提斯教團的人，不過是侍奉一位已然消逝的神明。我們只能從極其細微之處窺見祂的意志。�

entries.source: Perhaps we are here to serve that will. What can we do to help you?�
entries.translation: 也許我們來到這裡，正是為了服侍那份意志。我們能幫上你什麼忙？�

entries.source: I can see no harm in your request, but I can guarantee you no measure of success or failure in your efforts. I can depend only on what the omens may tell me. Perhaps Eortis ñwill stir from his slumber to grant his favor. Until then, the óMist óDevil will bring you no longer to this Isle.�
entries.translation: 我看不出你們的請求有什麼壞處，不過我沒法保證你們的努力會成功還是失敗。我只能仰賴徵兆告訴我的事。或許埃奧提斯ñ會從沉睡中甦醒，賜下祂的恩惠。在那之前，ó迷霧ó惡魔號不會再帶你們來這座島了。�

entries.source: Could you at least give us an idea of where to start? You may be able to read the god's will in the falling of a sparrow, but some of us are not half so óclever...�
entries.translation: 你至少能給我們個頭緒，告訴我們該從哪裡著手嗎？你或許能從一隻麻雀的墜落中讀出神的旨意，可我們有些人可沒那麼ó聰明……�

entries.source: Of late, we have had many tell us the órusalki who sometimes linger near the rivers have become disturbed. If you may find them all and lay them to rest, it might serve your purposes. I will warn you however that many of these sisters of Eliaem are wily and will find ways to hide their presence. Many do not wish to be sent into the halls of Lims-Kragma. You will need to be clever in finding them... This is my advice.�
entries.translation: 最近，有許多人告訴我們，有時徘徊在河邊的ó露莎卡水靈變得躁動不安。要是你們能找到牠們全部，並讓牠們得以安息，或許就能達成你們的目的。不過我得警告你們，這些伊萊亞姆的姊妹們大多狡猾，會想方設法隱藏自己的蹤跡。許多水靈都不願意被送進林斯克拉格瑪的殿堂。你們得夠機靈才能找到牠們……這是我的建議。�

entries.source:
As they filed out of the inner sanctum, Beyla suddenly dropped to her knees behind them. They rushed to her side but she had already gained her feet as they reached her.
	"I am sorry," she said breathlessly. "Eortis' touch is sometimes overwhelming. Though I cannot understand the meaning of it, something in you has aroused his interest and he has smiled on you this day. Good luck to you."�
entries.translation:
他們魚貫走出內殿時，貝拉突然在他們身後雙膝跪地。他們連忙衝上前去，可等他們趕到她身邊時，她已經自己站了起來。
	「抱歉，」她喘著氣說道。「埃奧提斯的觸動，有時候讓人難以承受。雖然我不明白這其中的含義，但你們身上有什麼東西引起了祂的興趣，今日祂對你們展露了笑顏。祝你們好運。」�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH :X_Beyla_NO_EORTIS_FAVOR�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：X_Beyla_NO_EORTIS_FAVOR�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The woman nodded, then made her way across the wooden floor until she was standing before them.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名女子點了點頭，穿過木地板走了過來，最後站到了他們面前。�

entries.source: I have been expecting you for many days. My auguries have shown strangers that walk in the favor of Eortis would be coming to us here and now I see you standing before me. You have pleased the god well.�
entries.translation: 我已經期盼你們多日了。我的占卜顯示，蒙受埃奧提斯眷顧的陌生人，將會來到我們這裡，如今我便見到你們站在我面前。你們讓這位神明相當滿意。�

entries.source: We have? What exactly did we ódo?�
entries.translation: 我們讓祂滿意了？我們到底ó做了什麼？�

entries.source: You would know this better than óI. I have no way of telling, except that I must assume in some way your actions have bettered the affairs of those who live either in the sea or in the rivers which feed it, those realms over which our lord once had dominion. But now, I have had a dream and was instructed to receive you well. The Swimmer of the Deeps has allowed I may grant you a boon. So long as you all shall live, any of you that come and petition before me shall be healed of anything that ails you. Such is the nature of Eortis' favor. Have any of you the need of healing?�
entries.translation: 這一點你們該比ó我更清楚。我沒辦法確知，只能猜想，你們的所作所為，在某種程度上，改善了那些住在海裡、或住在滋養海洋的河流裡的生靈的處境，那些正是我們的主宰曾經統治的領域。不過現在，我做了一個夢，受到指示要好好接待你們。深海泳者已經允許我賜予你們一項恩惠。只要你們活著的一天，你們之中任何人前來向我請求，都能治好任何困擾你們的病痛傷勢。這正是埃奧提斯恩惠的本質。你們之中有誰需要治療嗎？�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The woman nodded, then made her way across the wooden floor until she was standing before them.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名女子點了點頭，穿過木地板走了過來，最後站到了他們面前。�

entries.source: I have been expecting you for many days. My auguries have shown strangers that walk in the favor of Eortis. I assume that you must have completed your rites.�
entries.translation: 我已經期盼你們多日了。我的占卜顯示，有蒙受埃奧提斯眷顧的陌生人存在。我猜想，你們想必已經完成了你們的儀式。�

entries.source: It had very little to do with ritual, High Priestess, and much more to do with slaying spirits...�
entries.translation: 大祭司，這跟儀式沒什麼關係，反倒跟消滅亡靈脫不了關係……�

entries.source: You sound somewhat distressed. Be assured that you have slain no one, but have freed those from this world which were unnaturally bound here...The Swimmer of the Deeps is pleased and has allowed I may grant you a boon. So long as you all shall live, any of you that come and petition before me shall be healed of anything that ails you. Such is the nature of Eortis' favor. Have any of you the need of healing?�
entries.translation: 聽起來你們似乎有些苦惱。請放心，你們並沒有殺害任何人，而是解放了那些被不自然地束縛在這個世界上的靈魂……深海泳者對此深感欣慰，已允許我賜予你們一項恩惠。只要你們活著的一天，你們之中任何人前來向我請求，都能治好任何困擾你們的病痛傷勢。這正是埃奧提斯恩惠的本質。你們之中有誰需要治療嗎？�

entries.source: I think some of our injuries may be beyond my ability to heal. What do we need to do?�
entries.translation: 我想我們有些傷勢，恐怕超出了我的治療能力。我們該怎麼做？�

entries.source: You will find that your ills already heal as we speak. You shall feel fully restored by the time the óMist óDevil returns you to Silden.�
entries.translation: 你會發現，我們說話的同時，你的病痛已經開始痊癒了。等ó迷霧ó惡魔號把你們送回錫爾登時，你會感到自己已經完全康復。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH :X_Beyla_FIRST_TIME_HEAL_YES�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：X_Beyla_FIRST_TIME_HEAL_YES�

entries.source: We are well enough for the moment. Thank you, Beyla.�
entries.translation: 我們目前狀況還算不錯。謝謝你，貝拉。�

entries.source: You are most welcome young magician. I must now turn to my duties in the Temple. I believe that you will find that even without Eortis' healing, fortune has smiled upon you.�
entries.translation: 不客氣，年輕的法師。我現在得回去處理神殿裡的事務了。我相信，即便沒有埃奧提斯的治療，你們也會發現幸運女神已經對你們展露了笑顏。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH :X_Beyla_FIRST_TIME_HEAL_NO�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：X_Beyla_FIRST_TIME_HEAL_NO�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The woman nodded, then made her way across the wooden floor until she was standing before them.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名女子點了點頭，穿過木地板走了過來，最後站到了他們面前。�

entries.source: The chimes sounded in the Temple when the óMist óDevil drew near. Are any of you injured?�
entries.translation: 當ó迷霧ó惡魔號靠近時，神殿裡的風鈴便響了起來。你們之中有誰受傷了嗎？�

entries.source: I think some of our injuries may be beyond my ability to heal. What do we need to do?�
entries.translation: 我想我們有些傷勢，恐怕超出了我的治療能力。我們該怎麼做？�

entries.source: You will find that your ills already heal as we speak. You shall feel fully restored by the time the óMist óDevil returns you to Silden.�
entries.translation: 你會發現，我們說話的同時，你的病痛已經開始痊癒了。等ó迷霧ó惡魔號把你們送回錫爾登時，你會感到自己已經完全康復。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH :X_Beyla_SUBSEQUENTLY_INJURED_YES�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：X_Beyla_SUBSEQUENTLY_INJURED_YES�

entries.source: We are well enough for the moment. Thank you, Beyla.�
entries.translation: 我們目前狀況還算不錯。謝謝你，貝拉。�

entries.source: You are most welcome young magician. I must now turn to my duties in the Temple.�
entries.translation: 不客氣，年輕的法師。我現在得回去處理神殿裡的事務了。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH :X_Beyla_SUBSEQUENTLY_INJURED_NO�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：X_Beyla_SUBSEQUENTLY_INJURED_NO�

entries.source:
They were not alone.
	@0's pulse quickened as he saw the lone figure approach; but when it became apparent they were not being attacked, he relaxed a bit, squinted slightly in an attempt to see who was about to join them.�
entries.translation:
他們並非孤身一人。
	@0看見一個孤零零的身影走近，脈搏頓時加快；但看出對方並無攻擊之意後，他才稍稍放鬆下來，瞇起眼想看清楚是誰要加入他們。�

entries.source: You're not Mockers! Who...where did you come from?!�
entries.translation: 你們不是嘲弄幫的人！你們是……你們是從哪來的？！�

entries.source: Above, from the palace. From Krondor.�
entries.translation: 從上面，從王宮來的。從克朗多。�

entries.source: From above? Then you are one of Pug's students? He sent you down to help us?�
entries.translation: 從上面來的？那你們是帕格的學生？他派你們下來幫我們的？�
不是……�

entries.source: I don't understand. Why are you here?�
entries.translation: 我不明白。你們來這裡做什麼？�

entries.source: We believe that Duke Pug knows of magicians who are living in the sewers under Krondor and we need to speak to them about something. Would you know anything about them?�
entries.translation: 我們認為帕格公爵知道有些法師住在克朗多的下水道裡，我們有事需要跟他們談談。你知道關於他們的事嗎？�

entries.source: I have no time for this. I have something that I have to find and the Mockers are making a thorough search of the sewers. If they find me, I'll be floating in the harbor at dawn...�
entries.translation: 我沒空管這個。我有東西非找到不可，而嘲弄幫正在徹底搜查這片下水道。要是被他們找到我，天亮的時候我就會浮在港灣裡了……�

entries.source: The Mockers may be looking for you, but they aren't looking for us. If we find what you're looking for, we might be able to prevent your death. In exchange you answer a few questions for us and in half an hour you can be on the road to Sarth or Malac's Cross or wherever you want to go.�
entries.translation: 嘲弄幫或許在找你，可他們不會找我們。要是我們能找到你在找的東西，或許就能救你一命。作為交換，你回答我們幾個問題，半個鐘頭之內，你就能踏上前往薩斯、馬拉克十字鎮，或是任何你想去的地方的路了。�

entries.source: How do I know you won't have the Thieve's Guild lying in wait for me?�
entries.translation: 我怎麼知道你們不會讓盜賊公會的人埋伏等著抓我？�

entries.source: You don't, but as you've said, without our help you're already as good as dead. As I see it, at least we can give you an option that doesn't end in a grave. Let's help each other---tell me what you're looking for.�
entries.translation: 你沒法確定，不過就像你自己說的，沒有我們幫忙，你已經是個死人了。依我看，至少我們能給你一個不會落得埋進墳墓的選擇。咱們互相幫忙吧——告訴我你在找什麼。�

entries.source: A bronze statue, I believe it's called the Idol of Lassur. The Crawler heard a legend from a Keshian years ago about this object---it's the initial reason that he started looking for magicians to aid him---and it's reputed to endow its owner with the power over health. The legend has it that the idol was aboard a ship that went down near Krondor, but the Crawler believes that it made it to dry land and was eventually buried here when this city was Keshian.�
entries.translation: 一尊青銅雕像，我想它叫『拉蘇爾神像』。爬行者多年前從一個凱許人那裡聽說了一則關於這件東西的傳說——這正是他最初開始尋找法師輔佐自己的原因——據說它能賜予擁有者掌控健康的力量。傳說中，這尊神像原本在一艘於克朗多附近沉沒的船上，可爬行者相信它其實成功上了岸，最終在這座城市還屬於凱許的時候被埋在了這裡。�

entries.source: And if we bring you this statue, you will tell us what we need to know?�
entries.translation: 要是我們把這尊雕像帶給你，你就會告訴我們需要知道的事？�

entries.source: My word. Anything you need to know.�
entries.translation: 我保證。你們需要知道的任何事。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C6_Kat�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C6_Kat�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the chamber.
	The woman nodded, then made her way across the wooden floor until she was standing before them.�
entries.translation:
@4朝密室另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名女子點了點頭，穿過木地板走了過來，最後站到了他們面前。�

entries.source: Three times in the last hour, I've heard the tramp of Mocker feet. Where is the idol?�
entries.translation: 過去這一個鐘頭裡，我已經三次聽見嘲弄幫的腳步聲了。神像在哪？�

entries.source: We haven't located it yet. You need to give us time...�
entries.translation: 我們還沒找到。你得給我們點時間……�

entries.source: I have no time to give you! I'm alive only thanks to the wits that the Crawler gave to me. Find the idol or our deal is off.�
entries.translation: 我沒時間給你們！我還活著，全靠爬行者教我的那點機靈。找到神像，不然咱們這筆交易就算了。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C6_Kat_HAS_NO_IDOL�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C6_Kat_HAS_NO_IDOL�

entries.source:
They were not alone.
	@0's pulse quickened as he saw the lone figure approach; but when it became apparent they were not being attacked, he relaxed a bit. The woman made her way across the wooden floor until she was standing before them.�
entries.translation:
他們並非孤身一人。
	@0看見一個孤零零的身影走近，脈搏頓時加快；但看出對方並無攻擊之意後，他才稍稍放鬆下來。那名女子穿過木地板走了過來，最後站到了他們面前。�

entries.source: I can hear the Mockers getting closer. Have you found the Idol of Lassur for me?�
entries.translation: 我能聽見嘲弄幫的人越來越近了。你們替我找到拉蘇爾神像了嗎？�

entries.source: Aren't you concerned that the Crawler will abuse the Idol? With it he might kill hundreds of people, the Prince or maybe even the King. Are you sure you want to give it to him?�
entries.translation: 你不擔心爬行者會濫用這尊神像嗎？靠著它，他可能會殺死成百上千的人，親王，甚至可能是國王。你確定你想把它交給他？�

entries.source: I'm counting on his using it. You see, he didn't learn everything there is to know about the Idol. The Idol of Lassur does give its owner the power over life, but none on Midkemia can be it's true owner---Lassur is it's owner and that is but another Isalani name for Lims-Kragma, the Goddess of Death. For any else that lay claim to it, they die within the month.�
entries.translation: 我就是指望他去用它。你知道，他並沒有把關於這尊神像的一切都打聽清楚。拉蘇爾神像確實會賜予擁有者掌控生命的力量，可米德凱米亞上沒有任何人能成為它真正的主人——拉蘇爾才是它的主人，而那不過是伊薩拉尼人對死亡女神林斯克拉格瑪的另一個稱呼。任何其他妄稱擁有它的人，都會在一個月內死去。�

entries.source: I thought you worked for the Crawler!�
entries.translation: 我還以為你是替爬行者做事的！�

entries.source: No one works for the Crawler. What men surround him do so out of fear or debt, but none for loyalties sake! I intend to put his plans to ruin, but we don't have time to talk about that. To the matter of our deal. What do you need to know?�
entries.translation: 沒有人真的是替爬行者做事的。圍繞在他身邊的那些人，不是出於恐懼就是欠了債，沒有一個是出於忠誠！我打算讓他的計畫徹底泡湯，不過我們沒時間談這個了。說回我們的交易。你們想知道什麼？�

entries.source: Who leads the Crawler's magicians?�
entries.translation: 誰是爬行者手下法師的頭領？�

entries.source: I'm not certain, but I believe it's the Abbot Graves in Malac's Cross. He was known as an exceptional scribe once, and he was trusted with books coming from Stardock until Pug discovered what was happening.�
entries.translation: 我不確定，不過我認為是馬拉克十字鎮的葛雷夫斯院長。他曾以出色的抄寫員聞名，也曾受託處理來自星塢島的書籍，直到帕格發現了事情的真相為止。�

entries.source: So the Abbot would have been trusted with transcribing books on magic?�
entries.translation: 這麼說，院長曾受託謄抄關於法術的書籍？�

entries.source: All sorts of books. He's the one that found out the Idol of Lassur's true nature and relayed the information to me.�
entries.translation: 各式各樣的書都有。正是他發現了拉蘇爾神像的真正本質，並把這個消息轉告給我的。�

entries.source: I think you've told me what I needed to know. Thank you and I hope you...I wish you well.�
entries.translation: 我想你已經告訴我需要知道的事了。謝謝你，希望你……祝你一切順利。�

entries.source: It always boils down to lesser evils, doesn't it. Perhaps some day our choices won't be so grim. Goodbye boy, and good luck to you as well.�
entries.translation: 到頭來，總是得在兩害之中取其輕，不是嗎。也許有朝一日，我們的選擇不會這麼艱難。再見了，孩子，也祝你好運。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C6_Kat_HAS_IDOL�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C6_Kat_HAS_IDOL�

entries.source:
Gorath halted.
	Staring at Owyn intently, he waited for the boy to explain himself. "You tapped me on the shoulder. You wished to speak to me?" Gorath rumbled.
	"No," a voice answered behind them. "ñI did..."�
entries.translation:
戈拉斯停下了腳步。
	他緊盯著歐文，等著這男孩解釋。「你拍了拍我的肩膀。你是想跟我說話？」戈拉斯低沉地問道。
	「不，」一個聲音在他們身後應道。「ñ是我……」�

entries.source: I had at first thought myself deluded, but I see I am not. How is it that you are here? I heard that your head had been pitted on a stake outside Sar-Sargoth.�
entries.translation: 我起初還以為自己看錯了，可現在我知道不是。你怎麼會在這裡？我聽說你的頭已經被插在薩薩戈斯城外的木樁上了。�

entries.source: Not all who live in the Northlands bend to Delekhan's will. Providence would have it that he posted a guard outside my cell who was a close cousin and sympathetic to my situation. He bought time for my escape.�
entries.translation: 並非所有住在北疆的人都屈服於迪勒肯的意志。天意讓他派了一名守衛看守我的牢房，恰好是我的一位近親堂表兄弟，同情我的處境。他替我爭取到了逃脫的時間。�

entries.source: So your cousin's head now hangs in your stead...You have a grave responsibility on your shoulders.�
entries.translation: 這麼說，如今是你堂表兄弟的頭顱代替你懸掛在那裡了……你肩上扛著一份沉重的責任啊。�

entries.source: All the more reason to see an end to Delekhan's reign, Obkhar! He shall pay his blood for mine; for each offense against my kin, I will redouble it against his flesh. I will allow him no quarter, give him no mercy, stay no blow against him for all he has done to our people. I should think you would agree, Obkhar!�
entries.translation: 奧布卡，這正是我更該終結迪勒肯統治的理由！他要用他的血來償還我的血；他每一次冒犯我的族人，我都要雙倍加諸在他的血肉之上。我不會給他任何喘息的機會，不會對他心慈手軟，也不會因為他對我們族人所做的一切而收手。我想你應該也會同意這一點吧，奧布卡！�

entries.source: On the graves of all he has slain, I swear that my cause is yours Gorath! However I may aid you, you need only ask. But all this talk is fruitless. We must first escape this place or there shall be nothing left to avenge.�
entries.translation: 戈拉斯，我對著他所殺害的一切亡魂之墓起誓，你的事業就是我的事業！不管我能怎麼幫你，你儘管開口就是。不過這些話說了也是白說。我們得先逃出這個地方，不然就沒有什麼可以復仇的了。�

entries.source: I have been told by some who were taken captive here before that there is a river that runs underground and mixes with the Isbandi river.�
entries.translation: 先前被囚禁在這裡的一些人告訴過我，有一條地下河流，會匯入伊斯班迪河。�

entries.source: I have seen it with my own eyes, but the fumes that come from it may rob the strength from a man. On occasion I have seen some of Venutrier's men wearing masks made of bone and cloth...If we three had them, I believe we could make the escape.�
entries.translation: 我親眼見過那條河，不過從那裡冒出來的煙氣，會奪走一個人的力氣。我偶爾會看見維努特里爾的一些手下戴著用骨頭跟布料做成的面罩……要是我們三個能弄到那種面罩，我相信我們就能成功逃脫。�

entries.source: Stay here. Your absence from this place might attract undue attention. The boy and I will find the masks and return.�
entries.translation: 待在這裡。你要是離開這地方，恐怕會引來不必要的注意。我跟這男孩去找面罩，然後回來找你。�

entries.source: It is providence then we have already obtained them. Take this one and make good your escape.�
entries.translation: 那真是天意，我們已經弄到手了。拿去這個，順利逃出去吧。�

entries.source: I see that there are many in the Northlands who will have amends to make once this war of Delekhan's has been halted.�
entries.translation: 看來等迪勒肯這場戰事平息之後，北疆會有許多人得做出補償。�

entries.source: In amends I have no interest, Obkhar. I am long past thoughts of the throne in Sar-Sargoth. I dream only of an end to this nightmare.�
entries.translation: 奧布卡，我對補償沒有興趣。薩薩戈斯的王座，我早已不做此想了。我夢想的，只是這場噩夢的終結。�

entries.source: It is a sadness that those who most should lead often wish anything other. But I will not force you to take that which you do not want. You are an honorable creature, Gorath.�
entries.translation: 可悲的是，最該領導眾人的人，往往最不想要這份責任。不過我不會強迫你接受你不想要的東西。戈拉斯，你是個高尚的人。�

entries.source: Small comfort in a world gone mad. Go, Obkhar, and good health. Let us divide and conquer.�
entries.translation: 在這個瘋狂的世界裡，這只是小小的安慰。去吧，奧布卡，保重身體。我們分頭行動吧。�

entries.source:
Obkhar reappeared.
	Looking in better spirits than when they had last seen him, @4 supposed the possibility of escape had given him back the courage stolen by weeks in the caverns. Like he and Owyn, perhaps he was beginning to see hope...�
entries.translation:
奧布卡再度出現。
	他看起來比上次見面時精神好上不少，@4猜想，逃脫的可能性，想必讓他重新找回了那份被困在洞穴裡好幾週所奪走的勇氣。就像他跟歐文一樣，他或許也開始看見了希望……�

entries.source: Have you returned with the masks?�
entries.translation: 你把面罩帶回來了嗎？�

entries.source: No. We're having some difficulties getting about in the darkness down here.�
entries.translation: 不。我們在這片黑暗裡摸索，是有點困難。�

entries.source: You will grow used to it. It only takes a little time...�
entries.translation: 你們會習慣的。只需要一點時間……�

entries.source: I have no intention of growing ñused ñto any kind of captivity. We will find those masks and return with them, Obkhar. I will stake my death upon it. Until then, stay alive...�
entries.translation: 我可沒打算ñ習慣ñ任何形式的囚禁。奧布卡，我們會找到那些面罩，把它們帶回來。我以性命擔保。在那之前，你可得活著……�

entries.source:
Obkhar reappeared.
	Looking in better spirits than when they had last seen him, @4 supposed the possibility of escape had given him back the courage stolen by weeks in the caverns. Like he and Owyn, perhaps he was beginning to see hope...�
entries.translation:
奧布卡再度出現。
	他看起來比上次見面時精神好上不少，@4猜想，逃脫的可能性，想必讓他重新找回了那份被困在洞穴裡好幾週所奪走的勇氣。就像他跟歐文一樣，他或許也開始看見了希望……�

entries.source: I've been unable to obtain a mask. Have your ventures been any more successful?�
entries.translation: 我還沒能弄到面罩。你們那邊有比較順利嗎？�

entries.source: Yes. Take this one and make good your escape. We shall be doing likewise.�
entries.translation: 有。拿去這個，順利逃出去吧。我們也會這麼做的。�

entries.source: I see that there are many in the Northlands who will have amends to make once this war of Delekhan's has been halted.�
entries.translation: 看來等迪勒肯這場戰事平息之後，北疆會有許多人得做出補償。�

entries.source: In amends I have no interest, Obkhar. I am long past thoughts of the throne in Sar-Sargoth. I dream only of an end to this nightmare.�
entries.translation: 奧布卡，我對補償沒有興趣。薩薩戈斯的王座，我早已不做此想了。我夢想的，只是這場噩夢的終結。�

entries.source: It is a sadness that those who most should lead often wish anything other. But I will not force you to take that which you do not want. You are an honorable creature, Gorath.�
entries.translation: 可悲的是，最該領導眾人的人，往往最不想要這份責任。不過我不會強迫你接受你不想要的東西。戈拉斯，你是個高尚的人。�

entries.source: Small comfort in a world gone mad. Go, Obkhar, and good health. Let us divide and conquer.�
entries.translation: 在這個瘋狂的世界裡，這只是小小的安慰。去吧，奧布卡，保重身體。我們分頭行動吧。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C4_Obkhar�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C4_Obkhar�

entries.source:
@4 spotted Obkhar.
	Glancing up, the balding moredhel favored them with a blank look before staring back at the ground between his feet.�
entries.translation:
@4發現了奧布卡。
	這名頭頂微禿的莫瑞德人抬眼瞥了他們一眼，神情茫然，隨即又低頭盯著自己腳邊的地面。�

entries.source: I had thought you would have already departed...�
entries.translation: 我還以為你們已經走了……�

entries.source: In this gloom I have mislaid a belonging of mine. A bauble, but I wish to find it before I leave. It is nothing you need concern yourself with. Please, go...�
entries.translation: 在這片幽暗之中，我弄丟了自己的一件東西。只是個小玩意兒，不過我想在離開之前找到它。這用不著你們操心。請，走吧……�

entries.source: Very well. We shall meet again someday, friend.�
entries.translation: 好吧。朋友，我們有朝一日還會再見的。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C4_Obkhar_HAVEGIVEN_VAPOR_MASK�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C4_Obkhar_HAVEGIVEN_VAPOR_MASK�

entries.source:
@4 yelped.
	Rubbing his head where he had felt a hard thump, he turned and saw that @3 and @5 were doing likewise. Exchanging puzzled looks, none were prepared for the sudden appearance of a towering moredhel...�
entries.translation:
@4發出一聲驚呼。
	他揉著頭上被重重一擊的地方，轉頭一看，發現@3跟@5也在做著同樣的動作。三人面面相覷，一臉困惑，誰都沒料到會突然冒出一個高大的莫瑞德人……�

entries.source: I too have difficulties. I am Obkhar. Perhaps it may be that we can help one another.�
entries.translation: 我也遇上了麻煩。我是奧布卡。或許我們能互相幫忙。�

entries.source: You're assuming quite a bit. I don't think any of us have good reason to trust you, moredhel.�
entries.translation: 你這假設可不小啊。莫瑞德人，我看我們誰都沒有理由信任你。�

entries.source: Just now you all felt the pelt of my stones, each which hit your heads just as easily as would have a moredhel throwing knife. If I had wished you harm, you would already have been dead.�
entries.translation: 剛才你們都感受到我扔石頭的手法了，每一顆都輕輕鬆鬆打中了你們的頭，換成莫瑞德的飛刀也一樣容易。要是我存心要傷害你們，你們現在早就死了。�

entries.source: You speak the Kingdom tongue remarkably well. Handy skill for a spy.�
entries.translation: 你王國語說得相當流利。當間諜挺方便的技能。�

entries.source: We cannot trade our goods with the traders who come from the Kingdom or from far off places if we speak only our native tongue. It would seem it is beneath them to learn our language...�
entries.translation: 要是我們只說自己的母語，就沒法跟從王國或更遠的地方來的商人做買賣了。看來學我們的語言，對他們來說似乎是件有失身分的事……�

entries.source: Granted. I'm still listening...�
entries.translation: 有道理。我還在聽……�

entries.source: There is a device which is being used by Delekhan to invade this wood. If it is left operational, it will mean utter defeat for you. If Delekhan succeeds in his goal, he will use whatever it is hidden in Sethanon to gain the power that eluded Murmandamus' grasp. It will mean a new tyranny for your Kingdom and for mine.�
entries.translation: 迪勒肯正利用一種裝置入侵這片森林。要是任由它繼續運作，對你們來說就意味著徹底的潰敗。要是迪勒肯達成了他的目標，他就會利用藏在賽瑟儂的那件東西，取得穆爾曼達穆斯當初沒能到手的力量。這對你們的王國、也對我的族人來說，都將意味著一場新的暴政。�

entries.source: We already know about the device. Bled it out of one of the field captains that attacked Northwarden. If you really mean to help us, tell us where to find the device...�
entries.translation: 這件裝置的事我們已經知道了。從一個攻打北衛城的野戰隊長口中逼問出來的。要是你真心想幫我們，就告訴我們去哪能找到那件裝置……�

entries.source: On a peninsula where the rivers meet. It is accessible only by passing through an illusion of a mountain created by the Six, though I am not sure from here where it is located. I have been looking for a magical artifact since I slipped out of the camp.�
entries.translation: 在一座河流交匯處的半島上。得穿過六賢者製造的一座假山幻象才能進去，不過從這裡出發，我也不確定確切位置在哪。自從我偷偷溜出營地以後，我一直在找一件魔法器物。�

entries.source: Artifact? For what purpose?�
entries.translation: 器物？做什麼用的？�

entries.source: Shortly after they began staging soldiers through the rift, I discovered the gate could be disrupted by something they called a Waani, a word foreign to me. I found such an item on a magician who was guarding the gate. Before I slew him, I discovered if thrown into the maelstrom of the gate, it would cause it to collapse. I had thought it permanently destroyed.�
entries.translation: 就在他們開始讓士兵通過裂界之門不久後，我發現這道門能被一種他們稱為『瓦尼』的東西給破壞掉，那是個我很陌生的詞。我在一個看守裂界之門的法師身上找到過這樣一件東西。在我殺了他之前，我發現要是把它扔進裂界之門的漩渦裡，就會讓那道門崩潰瓦解。我原本以為它已經被永久摧毀了。�

entries.source: Delekhan has a number of tricks up his sleeve. So, do you think we might be able to find another of these devices?�
entries.translation: 迪勒肯的手裡花招還真不少。那，你覺得我們有可能再找到一件這種裝置嗎？�

entries.source: From what little I learned before I slew the magician, they are necessary in the creation of a gate. If one is to build a bridge, it is usually wise to bring more planks of wood than necessary in case one should snap.�
entries.translation: 我殺那名法師之前打聽到的一點消息，製造裂界之門少不了這東西。要是有人打算搭一座橋，通常明智的做法，是多帶幾塊木板，以防其中一塊斷裂。�

entries.source: Seems to be a reasonable assumption. Now it's just a matter of locating this...Waani? Who would have them?�
entries.translation: 這個假設聽起來挺合理。現在就只剩找到這個……瓦尼的問題了？誰會有這種東西？�

entries.source: If any would know it would be the leader of the rear guard, Moraeulf. He has his troops preparing themselves for the final advance near the southern tip of this wood.�
entries.translation: 要是有誰會知道，那就是後衛部隊的首領莫萊伍夫了。他正率領部隊，在這片森林南端一帶，為最後的總攻做準備。�

entries.source: Then I suppose it's time we went and had a talk with him.�
entries.translation: 那我看是時候去找他談談了。�

entries.source: Had a talk with him, Jimmy? Do you propose we simply walk up to him and ask for this device that will destroy his campaign?�
entries.translation: 吉米，找他談談？你該不會是打算大搖大擺走上前去，直接跟他要那件能毀掉他整場戰役的裝置吧？�

entries.source: Not without saying hello first. We'll pose as Quegians and hope he doesn't see through us. In all this chaos, he can't possibly know everyone in all his companies.�
entries.translation: 至少也得先打聲招呼再說。我們就假扮成奎格人，希望他看不穿我們。這麼一片混亂之中，他不可能認得他麾下所有連隊裡的每一個人。�

entries.source: An admirable gamble. I approve.�
entries.translation: 好一場值得敬佩的賭局。我贊成。�

entries.source: Hear that, Locky? The moredhel approves. It ñmust be a good idea. Let's get moving before I regain my common sense. Goodbye, Obkhar...�
entries.translation: 聽見沒，洛基？莫瑞德人都贊成了。這ñ肯定是個好主意。趁我還沒恢復理智之前，咱們快行動吧。再見了，奧布卡……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C7_Obkhar�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C7_Obkhar�

entries.source:
A horn sounded in the Inclindel.
	Immediately several additional notes echoed the first, passed on down the bend of the canyon while shadows began to appear along the length of the defile. Rising up from behind rocks and out of ditches, a dozen scattered men responded to the call to arms. Appearing at the mouth of a previously unnoticed cave, a fortyish looking gentleman lumbered down from his hiding and seeing that his guards weren't needed, he whistled for their dismissal.�
entries.translation:
因克林德爾山口響起了號角聲。
	緊接著又是幾聲號角回應第一聲，沿著峽谷的彎道一路傳了開去，狹道兩側也開始浮現出人影。十來個散落各處的士兵，從岩石後方跟溝渠裡起身，響應著召集的號令。一名看起來約莫四十歲的男子，從一處先前未曾被注意到的洞口現身，笨重地從他的藏身處走了下來，見用不著這些守衛，便吹了聲口哨解散他們。�

entries.source: Well, I didn't expect you to be back this way so soon, Seigneur. I actually wondered if you were going to make it anyplace at all, cut up like you were...�
entries.translation: 唉，紳爵，沒想到您這麼快又回到這一帶來了。說實話，我當時還在納悶，您那副被砍得傷痕累累的樣子，到底能不能撐到任何地方……�

entries.source: Where's your company, Lieutenant Finn? Why aren't they standing standard guard on this pass?�
entries.translation: 芬恩中尉，您的部隊呢？他們怎麼沒在這個山口按規矩站崗？�

entries.source: With all due respect, Seigneur we're digging ourselves out of a pretty mess presently. Not long after you and the moredhel trounced through here, a white screamer came up out of nowhere, worst snow storm I've seen in sixteen years. Ten miles on down the dell, the pass is buried under five feet of snow. I sent out guards to help our forward positions but I'm not positive they can do much. Kind of like lighting your pipe under the Bitter Sea.�
entries.translation: 恕我直言，紳爵，我們目前正忙著把自己從一團爛攤子裡挖出來。您跟那個莫瑞德人闖過這裡沒多久，一場白色尖嘯風暴不知從哪冒了出來，是我這十六年來見過最猛的暴風雪。往下十哩的谷地裡，山口埋在五呎深的積雪底下。我派了守衛去支援我們的前哨，可我不確定他們能起什麼作用。就跟想在苦海底下點菸斗差不多。�

entries.source: There's no way to get through the Inclindel at all?�
entries.translation: 完全沒辦法穿過因克林德爾山口了嗎？�

entries.source: Not unless you're a snow burrowing mole or a firedrake, no sir. Whoever may be in the Northlands or in the Kingdom, they've got a long wait on their hands if they need to get down this road.�
entries.translation: 除非您是隻會鑽雪的鼴鼠，或是條火蜥龍，不然沒辦法，大人。不管是北疆那邊還是王國這邊的人，要是非得走這條路不可，那都得等上好一陣子了。�

entries.source: Well that's it then. We'll have to turn back. Take care, Lieutenant.�
entries.translation: 好吧，那就這樣了。我們得回頭了。保重，中尉。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C1_Finn�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C1_Finn�

entries.source:
Horns announced the lieutenant's appearance.
	Working his way down from his cavernous command post, Finn shook his head as he pulled his furred helm down tight over his ears.�
entries.translation:
號角聲宣告了這位中尉的到來。
	芬恩從他那設在洞穴裡的指揮所走下來，一邊搖著頭，一邊把毛皮頭盔往下拉緊，蓋住耳朵。�

entries.source: You must believe in miracles, Seigneur, but I'm afraid the weather isn't nearly so cooperative as that. The Inclindel is still frozen solid. Half my men have frostbite so bad its going to take three years to get the cold out of them.�
entries.translation: 紳爵，您想必是相信奇蹟的人，不過恐怕這天氣可沒那麼配合。因克林德爾山口依然凍得結結實實。我手下有一半的人凍傷得厲害，恐怕得花上三年才能把體內的寒氣驅乾淨。�

entries.source: No getting through then?�
entries.translation: 這麼說是過不去了？�

entries.source: No, sir. Sorry. You might try Cutter's Gap at Highcastle or perhaps Northwarden Pass.�
entries.translation: 是的，大人。很抱歉。您可以試試高堡的割岩隘口，或者北衛山口。�

entries.source: Damn these northern winters. I doubt we'll find any open routes to the north, but thanks for the suggestion. Take care of yourself, Lieutenant.�
entries.translation: 該死的北疆寒冬。我看我們大概找不到任何通往北方的暢通路線了，不過還是謝謝你的建議。保重，中尉。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C1_Finn�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C1_Finn�

entries.source:
Horns announced the lieutenant's appearance.
	Working his way down from his cavernous command post, Finn shook his head as he pulled his furred helm down tight over his ears.�
entries.translation:
號角聲宣告了這位中尉的到來。
	芬恩從他那設在洞穴裡的指揮所走下來，一邊搖著頭，一邊把毛皮頭盔往下拉緊，蓋住耳朵。�

entries.source: There's no getting through those snowdrifts out there. The Inclindel is blocked and it'll likely be spring before we can get through again.�
entries.translation: 外頭那些積雪根本過不去。因克林德爾山口被堵死了，大概得等到春天，我們才能再次通行。�

entries.source: Thanks for the information, Lieutenant.�
entries.translation: 謝謝你的消息，中尉。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C2_Finn�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C2_Finn�

entries.source:
They were not alone.
	@0's pulse quickened as he saw the lone figure approach; but when it became apparent they were not being attacked, he relaxed a bit, squinted slightly in an attempt to see who was about to join them.�
entries.translation:
他們並非孤身一人。
	@0看見一個孤零零的身影走近，脈搏頓時加快；但看出對方並無攻擊之意後，他才稍稍放鬆下來，瞇起眼想看清楚是誰要加入他們。�

entries.source: There's no getting through those snowdrifts out there. The Inclindel is blocked and it'll likely be spring before we can get through.�
entries.translation: 外頭那些積雪根本過不去。因克林德爾山口被堵死了，大概得等到春天，我們才能通行。�

entries.source: Once again, thanks for the information, Lieutenant.�
entries.translation: 再次謝謝你的消息，中尉。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C2_Finn�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C2_Finn�

entries.source:
They were not alone.
	@0's pulse quickened as he saw the lone figure approach; but when it became apparent they were not being attacked, he relaxed a bit, squinted slightly in an attempt to see who was about to join them.�
entries.translation:
他們並非孤身一人。
	@0看見一個孤零零的身影走近，脈搏頓時加快；但看出對方並無攻擊之意後，他才稍稍放鬆下來，瞇起眼想看清楚是誰要加入他們。�

entries.source: I don't know what you're doing here, Seigneur, but I don't think the Inclindel is a place any civilized folk want to be. Even the Hadati hillmen are bundling up and heading south towards Yabon and let me tell you something. Its a sure damn cold day when you get a Hadati thinking about a town for refuge.�
entries.translation: 紳爵，我不知道您來這裡做什麼，不過我看因克林德爾山口可不是什麼文明人會想待的地方。就連哈達提山民都裹緊衣物，朝亞邦南下避難了，我跟您說句實話。連哈達提人都想著要進城避難，那可真是冷到家了。�

entries.source: You must be Lieutenant Finn. Seigneur Locklear spoke highly of your garrison when he returned to Krondor. We were very sorry to hear about your commander's death.�
entries.translation: 您想必就是芬恩中尉了。洛克利爾紳爵回克朗多之後，對您這支駐軍讚不絕口。聽聞您指揮官的死訊，我們深感遺憾。�

entries.source: It happens. We don't get too sentimental up here with our butts cheek out to the moredhel. Too easy to get your best friends killed so you don't get to be best friends. Of course, we depend on each other to protect one another but...not much beyond that. I don't think you came all this way to tell me that you were sorry about our commander. What do you need, Seigneur?�
entries.translation: 這種事難免。我們在這兒屁股都對著莫瑞德人晾著，可沒空太多愁善感。太容易眼睜睜看著最好的朋友送命了，所以乾脆不交最好的朋友。當然，我們還是得互相依靠、彼此照應，不過……也就僅止於此了。我看您大老遠跑來，應該不是為了跟我說您對我們指揮官的死感到遺憾吧。紳爵，您需要什麼？�

entries.source: We were thinking of heading North...�
entries.translation: 我們原本在想往北走……�

entries.source: Not through there, you aren't. Even with the snow starting to melt off, the damn moredhel set off some kind of explosion. Brought down half a mountain of rock and it'll take us some time to get through it.�
entries.translation: 那可過不去。就算積雪開始融化了，那些該死的莫瑞德人還是引爆了什麼東西。炸塌了半座山的岩石，我們得花上一段時間才能清出一條路來。�

entries.source: You say set off. Were they using naphtha in there?�
entries.translation: 你說『引爆』。他們是用那夫沙油嗎？�

entries.source: Very probably. Must of had packs of the stuff planted in the rocks, set up to slap us if we came down the pass. I think someone on their side got jittery when we were poking around. Whatever the case may be, no one's going either way for a little while.�
entries.translation: 很有可能。他們一定是在岩石裡埋了一包包那種東西，就等著我們一從山口下來就給我們狠狠一擊。我猜他們那邊有人是在我們四處查探的時候給嚇著了。不管怎樣，短時間內誰都別想從這條路過去了。�

entries.source: Thanks for the information, Lieutenant.�
entries.translation: 謝謝你的消息，中尉。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C3_Finn�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C3_Finn�

entries.source:
They were not alone.
	@0's pulse quickened as he saw the lone figure approach; but when it became apparent they were not being attacked, he relaxed a bit, squinted slightly in an attempt to see who was about to join them.�
entries.translation:
他們並非孤身一人。
	@0看見一個孤零零的身影走近，脈搏頓時加快；但看出對方並無攻擊之意後，他才稍稍放鬆下來，瞇起眼想看清楚是誰要加入他們。�
