entries.source: I hope you aren't planning on going through here, Seigneur, 'cuz the Inclindel's still plugged tighter than a jug.�
entries.translation: 紳爵，希望您不是打算從這裡過去，因為因克林德爾山口現在還堵得跟酒罐子似的，密不透風。�

entries.source: I was afraid of that. Thanks, Lieutenant.�
entries.translation: 我就怕是這樣。謝了，中尉。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C3_Finn�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C3_Finn�

entries.source:
A man approached them.
	Still breathing heavily from their fight, @3 barely managed to wave a greeting at the Kingdom soldier who lumbered towards them...�
entries.translation:
一名男子朝他們走了過來。
	@3仍因剛才的戰鬥而喘著粗氣，勉強朝那名笨重地走近他們的王國士兵揮了揮手打招呼……�

entries.source: Boy, you're just about the luckiest whore's son I've ever laid eyes on. If we hadn't of heard the commotion down the pass, I think those goblins would have been having noble stew about now. Nearly took out your friend here until I seen that he appeared to be fighting at your side. Now I don't know what you think you're doing in the Northlands with these moredhel...�
entries.translation: 小子，你可真是我這輩子見過最走運的私生子了。要不是我們在山口下聽見了打鬥的聲響，我看那些哥布林現在早就在燉貴族肉湯了。差點就把你這位朋友給收拾了，幸好我看出他好像是站在你這邊打的。我實在搞不懂你跟這些莫瑞德人在北疆搞什麼名堂……�

entries.source: It is very important that you take us to Prince Arutha.�
entries.translation: 麻煩您帶我們去見亞魯莎親王，這非常重要。�

entries.source: What?! The cold's gotten to you, boy. What makes you think I'm going to take time off from my duties and trot your behind down to Krondor?�
entries.translation: 什麼？！小子，你腦子讓寒氣給凍壞了吧。你憑什麼覺得我會放下職責，大老遠帶你去克朗多？�

entries.source: Prince Arutha isn't óin Krondor. He's likely still stationed with his Krondorian Lancers just outside of the Dimwood near Sethanon. We need you to escort us to his camp.�
entries.translation: 亞魯莎親王不ó在克朗多。他很可能還跟他的克朗多長槍騎兵團，駐紮在賽瑟儂附近的幽暗林外。我們需要您護送我們前往他的營地。�

entries.source: Why would he be there? And why would he want to see a boy and a ómoredhel?�
entries.translation: 他為什麼會在那？他又為什麼會想見一個男孩跟一個ó莫瑞德人？�

entries.source: The Prince just sent us to spy on them, all right? They'd never suspect a scrawny nineteen year old boy and a moredhel, so...that's why he sent us. We have information about a planned attack on the Kingdom and it's vital we get this information to him.�
entries.translation: 親王就是派我們去刺探他們的，行嗎？他們絕不會懷疑一個瘦巴巴的十九歲小子跟一個莫瑞德人，所以……這就是他派我們去的原因。我們握有一項針對王國的攻擊計畫情報，必須盡快送到他手上，這至關重要。�

entries.source: How do I know you're telling the truth?�
entries.translation: 我怎麼知道你說的是實話？�

entries.source: You don't, but if you don't take us and the moredhel overrun Northwarden, do you really think you're going to be able to sleep with yourself?�
entries.translation: 你沒法確定，不過要是您不帶我們去，結果莫瑞德人攻陷了北衛城，您覺得自己以後還睡得安穩嗎？�

entries.source: I have to give you one thing. If you're a gambler, you sure don't bid low... Come on, let's get moving. The Dimwood's hell and back from here and the Prince won't want to be kept waiting. Let's move.�
entries.translation: 我不得不承認你這一點。你要是個賭徒，下注可真不手軟……好了，咱們走吧。幽暗林離這兒可有得走了，親王也不會想乾等。我們走。�

entries.source: Just get us the hell out of here, Lieutenant. The sooner the better.�
entries.translation: 中尉，趕緊帶我們離開這鬼地方吧。越快越好。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C4_Finn�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C4_Finn�

entries.source:
They were not alone.
	@0's pulse quickened as he saw the lone figure approach; but when it became apparent they were not being attacked, he relaxed a bit, squinted slightly in an attempt to see who was about to join them.�
entries.translation:
他們並非孤身一人。
	@0看見一個孤零零的身影走近，脈搏頓時加快；但看出對方並無攻擊之意後，他才稍稍放鬆下來，瞇起眼想看清楚是誰要加入他們。�

entries.source: What are you two doing back up here again? Prince Arutha sending you on another secret mission?�
entries.translation: 你們兩個怎麼又跑回這兒來了？亞魯莎親王又派你們執行什麼祕密任務？�

entries.source: Of a sort...We're looking for a book that was lost.�
entries.translation: 算是吧……我們在找一本遺失的書。�

entries.source: Well, just between us, don't you think this would be a damn peculiar place to find a book? It's not like any of us ever get the opportunity to sit still long enough to read a book, and as far as the moredhel go... I don't think that stealing books would be very high on their list of priorities.�
entries.translation: 這麼說吧，就咱們私下聊聊，你不覺得在這種地方找書，未免也太奇怪了嗎？我們這些人可沒機會安安穩穩坐下來看本書，至於莫瑞德人嘛……我看偷書大概也排不上他們優先事項的前幾名。�

entries.source: Is the Inclindel passable?�
entries.translation: 因克林德爾山口能通行了嗎？�

entries.source: Either you two are gluttons for punishment or just down right thick...No, the Inclindel isn't open. A few weeks ago, they blasted it shut again. Personally, I think we should leave the damn thing closed, but our orders are our orders, so my men have starting picking things up again. I don't know why King Lyam is so bent on keeping the passage open to Armengar, but then again, I don't suppose it's my place to wonder why.�
entries.translation: 你們兩個要嘛是自討苦吃，要嘛就是真的不太靈光……不，因克林德爾山口沒開通。幾週前，他們又把它給炸封了。我個人是覺得，乾脆讓那該死的地方就這麼封著算了，不過軍令就是軍令，所以我的人又開始清理起來了。我不知道萊亞姆王為什麼這麼堅持要保持通往阿曼加的道路暢通，不過話說回來，追究原因也輪不到我。�

entries.source: Thanks for your information, Lieutenant Finn.�
entries.translation: 謝謝你的消息，芬恩中尉。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C6_Finn�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C6_Finn�

entries.source:
They were not alone.
	@0's pulse quickened as he saw the lone figure approach; but when it became apparent they were not being attacked, he relaxed a bit, squinted slightly in an attempt to see who was about to join them.�
entries.translation:
他們並非孤身一人。
	@0看見一個孤零零的身影走近，脈搏頓時加快；但看出對方並無攻擊之意後，他才稍稍放鬆下來，瞇起眼想看清楚是誰要加入他們。�

entries.source: The Inclindel is closed...hear me...CLOSED. That means you and your moredhel friend here are going to have to find another way North if you're so all fired bent on going there.�
entries.translation: 因克林德爾山口封閉了……聽清楚了……封閉了。這表示你跟你這位莫瑞德朋友，要是鐵了心非去北邊不可，就得另尋他路了。�

entries.source: We should be on our way again. Thank you for your time, Finn.�
entries.translation: 我們該再次上路了。謝謝你撥空，芬恩。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C6_Finn�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C6_Finn�

entries.source:
@4 spotted a man in a field.
	Bent over, he appeared to be a farmer of some stripe, though his work seemed to become more industrious as they drew closer to him. Undoubtedly, he had seen them as well...�
entries.translation:
@4發現田裡有個男人。
	他彎著腰，看起來像是某種農夫，不過隨著他們越走越近，他的動作似乎變得更加勤快。無疑地，他也看見了他們……�

entries.source: Quite a nice little stead you have here.�
entries.translation: 你這塊小田地經營得挺不錯的嘛。�

entries.source: If you like busting sod, I suppose so. I've had a mind to sell a few times. Events here recently, I'm liking things less and less. I may just sell everything out like I've been telling everybody else. Course I wouldn't expect a kept boy like you to understand.�
entries.translation: 要是你喜歡翻土犁地，我想是吧。我好幾次都動過要賣掉的念頭。最近這裡發生的事，我是越看越不順眼。搞不好我真會像我一直跟大家說的那樣，把這一切全賣了。當然，我也不指望你這種養尊處優的小子能懂。�

entries.source: Probably wouldn't, but this seems like such a nice lot to give up. Why would you want to?�
entries.translation: 大概是不懂，不過這片地看起來這麼好，放棄未免可惜。你為什麼會想賣掉呢？�

entries.source: Everybody knows that something evil happened at the Battle of Sethanon, definitely unnatural. Me myself, I used to live in the center of town before King Lyam offered up the money that I should leave. I didn't think much of leaving, but I thought that the evil would stay there.�
entries.translation: 誰都知道賽瑟儂戰役發生了什麼邪惡的事，絕對不是什麼自然的東西。我自己，以前就住在鎮中心，後來萊亞姆王出錢要我搬走。我當時對搬家沒想太多，只以為那股邪氣會留在那邊不出來。�

entries.source: And it hasn't? It's creeping down the road from Sethanon?�
entries.translation: 難道不是嗎？它正沿著那條路從賽瑟儂爬過來？�

entries.source: Listen boy, I don't care for your attitude. You may be all educated, but it don't mean you know nothing about the world. If you're wise, you'll stay away from Sethanon and take anybody else that'll go with you. There's something evil hereabouts and I don't want to be about when at last it gets here.�
entries.translation: 聽著，小子，我可不喜歡你這種態度。你也許讀過不少書，可那不代表你就懂這個世界。你要是識相，就離賽瑟儂遠一點，能拉多少人跟你一起走就拉多少人。這一帶有什麼邪惡的東西，等它終於到來的時候，我可不想還待在這兒。�

entries.source: So, how much do you want for your land?�
entries.translation: 那，你這塊地想賣多少錢？�

entries.source: I...uh...what?�
entries.translation: 我……呃……什麼？�

entries.source: If this evil is so imminent and you're anxious to be away from it, I'd be interested in buying this little lot of yours. I'm not afraid of ghosts. What will you sell it to me for?�
entries.translation: 要是這股邪氣真的迫在眉睫，你又急著想遠離它，那我倒是有興趣買下你這塊小地。我可不怕鬼。你打算賣我多少錢？�

entries.source: Well I haven't actually decided to make the move as yet...Don't want to get the cart before the horse you know...It'll likely be a while before I sell, see...Don't want to rush it.�
entries.translation: 這個嘛，我其實還沒真正決定要搬……你知道，不能本末倒置嘛……我大概還得過一陣子才會賣，你知道的……不想急著做決定。�

entries.source: Do you know anything about the land that adjoins yours by any chance? Is it for sale?�
entries.translation: 你對緊鄰你這塊地的那片地了解嗎？有在賣嗎？�

entries.source: Uh, no. Not anymore. I bought it when old widow Petrumh moved out...�
entries.translation: 呃，沒有，現在沒在賣了。老寡婦佩特魯姆搬走的時候，我把它買下來了……�

entries.source: Bought it? I thought you said you wished to move?�
entries.translation: 買下來了？我還以為你說你想搬家？�

entries.source: I do and...Look, I haven't time to stand about talking all day. If you're interested in the land go ahead and look around--- just stay clear of my stead. Now, I got things to do. Good day.�
entries.translation: 我是想搬……聽著，我沒空整天站在這兒聊天。你要是對那塊地有興趣，自己去看看吧——只是別靠近我這塊地就行了。好了，我還有事要忙。祝你愉快。�

entries.source: Good day to you, sir.�
entries.translation: 祝您愉快，先生。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_CX_Max_Feeber�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_CX_Max_Feeber�

entries.source:
The farmer was still in his field.
	Looking up at them suspiciously, he pushed the sweat drenched hair out of his eyes with the back of his hand and waited, his eyes narrowed as they drew closer. He didn't seem pleased to have guests.�
entries.translation:
這名農夫仍在田裡。
	他滿臉狐疑地抬頭望向他們，用手背抹開沾滿汗水、擋住眼睛的頭髮，等在原地。隨著他們越走越近，他瞇起了眼。他看起來不太歡迎訪客。�

entries.source: I've been thinking about your offer to buy my land, but I haven't decided yet...Come back some other time and we can discuss it.�
entries.translation: 我一直在考慮你買我這塊地的提議，不過還沒決定……改天再來，我們再談吧。�

entries.source: I'll be around.�
entries.translation: 我會再來的。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_CX_Max_Feeber_CLOTH_NOT_FOUND�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_CX_Max_Feeber_CLOTH_NOT_FOUND�

entries.source:
@4 spotted a man in a field.
	Bent over, he appeared to be a farmer of some stripe, though his work seemed to become more industrious as they drew closer to him. Undoubtedly, he had seen them as well...�
entries.translation:
@4發現田裡有個男人。
	他彎著腰，看起來像是某種農夫，不過隨著他們越走越近，他的動作似乎變得更加勤快。無疑地，他也看見了他們……�

entries.source: Would you happen to know who lives in that house nearby?�
entries.translation: 你知不知道附近那間房子住著誰？�

entries.source: I should. I lived half me life in it. Name's Max Feeber.�
entries.translation: 我當然知道。我大半輩子都住在那裡。我叫麥克斯．費伯。�

entries.source: Are you certain?�
entries.translation: 你確定嗎？�

entries.source: Are you funny in the head, lad? Course I'm sure. How could I not be?�
entries.translation: 小子，你腦子有毛病嗎？我當然確定。我怎麼可能不確定？�

entries.source:
The farmer was still in his field.
	Looking up at them suspiciously, the farmer pushed the sweat drenched hair out of his eyes with the back of his hand and waited, his eyes narrowed as they drew closer. He didn't seem pleased to have guests.�
entries.translation:
這名農夫仍在田裡。
	他滿臉狐疑地抬頭望向他們，用手背抹開沾滿汗水、擋住眼睛的頭髮，等在原地。隨著他們越走越近，他瞇起了眼。他看起來不太歡迎訪客。�

entries.source: Do you often make it a habit to go digging in graveyards?�
entries.translation: 你是不是常有去墓地挖掘的習慣？�

entries.source: What do you mean?�
entries.translation: 你這話什麼意思？�

entries.source: I mean, the three of us found a burial cloth and we think you have something to do with all this evil that is going on around here. You've been desecrating graves haven't you?�
entries.translation: 我是說，我們三個找到了一塊裹屍布，我們認為這一帶所有的邪祟之事都跟你脫不了關係。你一直在褻瀆墳墓，對吧？�

entries.source: You broke into my house! I'll tell the constable for this!�
entries.translation: 你們闖進了我家！我要為這件事去告訴治安官！�

entries.source: If he were still living in town I might feel threatened, but I rather imagine you've already managed to scare him off. Now talk, or I'm going to have a cozy little chat with a friend of mine named Nivek---Prince Arutha's tax collector---Nice fellow. I think the two of you will get along marvelously.�
entries.translation: 要是他還住在鎮上，我或許還會覺得有點威脅，不過我猜你大概早就把他嚇跑了。快說，不然我就要去找我一個朋友，好好聊聊了——他叫尼維克，亞魯莎親王的稅務官——人很不錯。我看你們倆一定能處得非常融洽。�

entries.source: One grave! One grave only, I dug up. I don't remember the fellow's name now, but he used to own the Six Toe Tavern before Nia took over the shop. I thought that maybe I could scare her into moving out and selling to me but she's too darn stubborn.�
entries.translation: 一座墳！我就只挖了一座墳而已！那傢伙的名字我現在也不記得了，不過他以前是六趾客棧的老闆，後來妮雅才接手那間店的。我想說也許能把她嚇跑，好讓她把店賣給我，可她這人固執得要命。�

entries.source: What did you do with the corpse?�
entries.translation: 你把屍體怎麼處理了？�

entries.source: No corpse about him! He was down to his skeleton. I tried to rebury him but I never found one of his hands. It's bound to be near the graveyard. I think I may have dropped it when I was near old Hershel's house...�
entries.translation: 哪來的屍體！他早就只剩一副骨架了。我試著把他重新埋回去，可他有隻手一直找不著。那隻手肯定就在墓地附近。我想我大概是在老赫歇爾家附近的時候把它弄丟的……�

entries.source: What else?�
entries.translation: 還有別的嗎？�

entries.source: That's it. That's all I know! Honest. Dug him up and then I reburied him.�
entries.translation: 就這樣。我知道的就這些了！我發誓。挖出來，然後又埋回去。�

entries.source: We'll need to find that hand then and bury it. No thanks to you. Good bye sir and I would advise that you stay away from the Six Toe Tavern from now on. I doubt you will be warmly greeted.�
entries.translation: 那我們得去找到那隻手，把它埋了。這可不是託你的福。再見了，先生，我勸你以後離六趾客棧遠一點。我看你在那兒大概不會受到什麼熱烈歡迎。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_CX_Max_Feeber_CLOTH_FOUND�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_CX_Max_Feeber_CLOTH_FOUND�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The woman nodded, then made her way across the wooden floor until she was standing before them.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名女子點了點頭，穿過木地板走了過來，最後站到了他們面前。�

entries.source: By my soul our petitions are heard! Finally, one of the Prince's men has come! Have you come about...aigh! You've an elf!�
entries.translation: 我的老天，我們的請願終於有人聽見了！親王的人總算來了一個！你們是為了……啊！你們帶了個精靈！�

entries.source: Though Thorgath looks frightful enough, I assure you that he is of no danger to you. What is this petition you speak of good woman?�
entries.translation: 索爾加斯看起來雖然嚇人，不過我向您保證，他對您不會有任何危險。好心的夫人，您說的這個請願是怎麼回事？�

entries.source: As I live and breathe, not one word more will pass my lips as long as he is here, and that's the truth of it. Not one word more!�
entries.translation: 只要他還在這兒，我這輩子就一個字也不會再多說，這是真話。一個字也不多說！�

entries.source: I will leave you to your duties, Locklear. Should you need me I will be close at hand...�
entries.translation: 洛克利爾，我先讓你去辦你的事。要是需要我，我就在附近……�

entries.source:
Thank You.
	He has gone, now...What cause do you have to call on Prince Arutha's aid?�
entries.translation:
謝謝您。
	他已經走了，現在……您有什麼理由要請求亞魯莎親王的援助？�

entries.source: I sent to the Prince, for something must be done in Sethanon! If he would bend his ear to us, he would hear the tales of what passes in the Dimwood. There are lights there, terrible, awful faerie lights that have been seen in the woods and always they prefigure some calamity...�
entries.translation: 我派人去找親王，是因為賽瑟儂那邊得有人出面處理才行！要是他願意聽我們說話，他就會聽見林子裡到底發生了什麼事。那裡有光，可怕的、駭人的精靈之光，在林子裡出沒，而且每次出現，總是預示著某種災禍……�

entries.source: Surely they are only tales...�
entries.translation: 這些想必只是傳說罷了……�

entries.source: If they are tales, they are tales as sensible folk tell! I have seen these very lights with my own two eyes, watched their demon jig in the night even as my husband fell senseless and breathed his last. There is some terrible evil there.�
entries.translation: 要是這是傳說，那也是明事理的人親口說的傳說！我親眼看見過這些光，看著它們在夜裡跳著惡魔般的舞，就在那時，我丈夫昏死過去，嚥下了最後一口氣。那裡有某種可怕的邪惡存在。�

entries.source: I shall make no promises, but we will do what we can.�
entries.translation: 我不會做出任何承諾，不過我們會盡力而為。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C1_Petrumh�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C1_Petrumh�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The woman nodded, then made her way across the wooden floor until she was standing before them.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名女子點了點頭，穿過木地板走了過來，最後站到了他們面前。�

entries.source: Tell me you've come with a hundred Krondorian Lancers and I shall toast your good health!�
entries.translation: 告訴我你帶了一百個克朗多長槍騎兵來，我就敬你身體健康！�

entries.source: I haven't had the chance to return to Krondor as yet, good woman. If you would give me...�
entries.translation: 好心的夫人，我還沒機會回克朗多呢。要是您能給我……�

entries.source: Goodbye, Seigneur...�
entries.translation: 紳爵，再見了……�

entries.source: Wait...we haven't... Ah, foolish old woman.�
entries.translation: 等等……我們還沒……唉，這個糊塗的老太婆。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C1_Petrumh�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C1_Petrumh�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The woman nodded, then made her way across the wooden floor until she was standing before them.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名女子點了點頭，穿過木地板走了過來，最後站到了他們面前。�

entries.source: Wherever did you get those clothes, Lysle? Must have snitched them off a marquis somewhere! You're getting a mild bit bolder aren't you?�
entries.translation: 萊斯爾，你這身衣服是打哪弄來的？肯定是從哪個侯爵身上順來的吧！你膽子是越來越大了啊？�

entries.source: I am afraid you have me mistaken for someone else. My name is James...�
entries.translation: 恐怕您認錯人了。我叫詹姆士……�

entries.source: James is it? Ha-ho, of course it is! And I'm not your gran Petrumh either, I take it. You're ómasquerading again! This isn't like that time you ran about Malac's Cross for a month begging and chewed up soap is it? Oh, but you made some fine sovereigns with that act! With all that foam coming out of your mouth, a body would think you had the creeping mongus and they'd pay a pretty coin just to have you away from them! You've always been a wily one, Lysle. Did you pinch any bread for me?�
entries.translation: 叫詹姆士是吧？哈哈，那當然囉！那我大概也不是你外婆佩特魯姆了，我猜。你又在ó裝模作樣了！這該不會跟你那次在馬拉克十字鎮裝乞丐、嚼肥皂裝瘋整整一個月一樣吧？噢，不過那齣戲你可賺了不少金幣！嘴裡吐著滿嘴白沫，誰都會以為你得了爬行瘋病，肯花大錢打發你走人！萊斯爾，你一直都是個狡猾的傢伙。有沒有順點麵包回來給我？�

entries.source: Why can't you buy your own bread?�
entries.translation: 你為什麼不能自己買麵包？�

entries.source: Who pissed in your pot, eh? You know perfectly well that I haven't had nothing since Jack died...unless... What are you doing with an elf, boy! Don't you know they bring bad luck?! They're the ones what killed Jack and are stirring up all that trouble in Sethanon! What's got into your head? Have you run mad?�
entries.translation: 誰惹你不高興了，嗯？你明明清楚，傑克死了以後我就什麼都沒有了……除非……小子，你跟個精靈混在一起做什麼！你不知道他們會招來厄運嗎？！就是他們殺了傑克，還在賽瑟儂那邊惹出了一堆麻煩事！你腦子是進水了嗎？你瘋了不成？�

entries.source: What trouble in Sethanon are you referring to, madam?�
entries.translation: 夫人，您說的賽瑟儂那邊的麻煩事，是指什麼？�

entries.source: You're...you really aren't Lysle, are you then? But you're his mirror image, you are. How could this be unless...some kind of faerie evil isn't it? That's what it is! Some kind of faerie magic and you finally come for me! Took Lysle's form!�
entries.translation: 你……你真的不是萊斯爾，是吧？可你長得跟他一模一樣啊。這怎麼可能，除非……是某種精靈的邪術，對不對？就是這樣！某種精靈魔法，你終於是為了我來的！還變成了萊斯爾的模樣！�

entries.source: We aren't brothers of the dark path, miss. Please, trust us. Perhaps I may bear some resemblance to this Lysle character you're talking about, but we're just ordinary folk. I would like to talk to Lysle, however. He sounds like...like he might be a relative.�
entries.translation: 小姐，我們不是走陰暗之道的邪徒。請相信我們。也許我跟您說的這位萊斯爾長得有幾分相似，不過我們只是普通人。不過，我倒是很想跟萊斯爾談談。聽起來……聽起來他可能是我的親人。�

entries.source: Hmm. I guess you don't look like evil faeries...Leastways, none I've ever heard of. So, Lysle might be your brother?�
entries.translation: 唔。我看你不太像邪惡的精靈……至少不像我聽說過的那種。這麼說，萊斯爾可能是你哥哥？�

entries.source: I don't know. I never knew my father and my mother never mentioned a twin, but when I was taken captive in Krondor a few of the men who were guarding me kept asking about places I'd never been to and about people I'd never met. At first I wanted to dismiss what they were saying, but then I got to thinking about some of the events that happened before the battle of Sethanon. Someone tried to slip in a double for Prince Arutha. Maybe the moredhel are repeating their old strategies.�
entries.translation: 我不知道。我從沒見過我父親，我母親也從沒提過有個雙胞胎，可我在克朗多被囚禁的時候，幾個看守我的人一直問我一些我從沒去過的地方、和從沒見過的人。一開始我想把他們說的話當耳邊風，可後來我想起了賽瑟儂戰役之前發生的一些事。有人曾試圖安插一個亞魯莎親王的替身。也許莫瑞德人正在故技重施。�

entries.source: This is all very interesting, but I haven't had a bite to eat in days. Do you think you could spare something for me?�
entries.translation: 這一切都挺有意思的，不過我已經好幾天沒吃東西了。你們能不能勻點吃的給我？�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The woman nodded, then made her way across the wooden floor until she was standing before them.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名女子點了點頭，穿過木地板走了過來，最後站到了他們面前。�

entries.source: So the lord's heart isn't made of stone is it? Come back to help old gran Petrumh? How about giving me some of your rations so I won't have to beg today?�
entries.translation: 這麼說，這位大人的心腸不是石頭做的囉？回來幫老佩特魯姆婆婆了？能不能分點你們的口糧給我，今天我就不用出去乞討了？�

entries.source: I've got a pack of rations that are yours, providing you tell us a little more about this Lysle.�
entries.translation: 我這裡有包口糧可以給你，前提是你多跟我們說說這個萊斯爾的事。�

entries.source: Last I saw of him, he was heading towards Lyton. Said something about wanting to meet some gentlemen there. More than likely he'll be staying away from the main roads. Try as he might, he does have a tendency to get into trouble now and again.�
entries.translation: 我最後一次見到他，他正朝萊頓去。說是要去見那邊的幾位先生什麼的。他多半會避開主要道路走。不管他再怎麼小心，他就是有那種三不五時惹上麻煩的毛病。�

entries.source: Thank you, miss. Watch out for yourself.�
entries.translation: 謝謝妳，小姐。照顧好自己。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C2_Petrumh_NOT_FED_YES_GIVE_FOOD_HAS_RATIONS�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C2_Petrumh_NOT_FED_YES_GIVE_FOOD_HAS_RATIONS�

entries.source: I seem to have gone through my rations. I'm sorry...�
entries.translation: 我的口糧好像用完了。抱歉……�

entries.source: Not half so sorry as I am, James. I've still to get my daily bread, so I'll ask you to leave me be. Good day.�
entries.translation: 詹姆士，你這抱歉還比不上我一半呢。我今天的麵包還沒著落，所以還請你別再打擾我了。祝你愉快。�

entries.source: Sorry, good lady. We will leave you in peace.�
entries.translation: 抱歉了，夫人。我們不打擾您了。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C2_Petrumh_NOT_FED_YES_GIVE_FOOD_HAS_NO_RATIONS�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C2_Petrumh_NOT_FED_YES_GIVE_FOOD_HAS_NO_RATIONS�

entries.source: I can't spare any rations at the moment.�
entries.translation: 我目前抽不出任何口糧。�

entries.source: Spoken like a true lord, just like the rest of those brats what study at the Abbaye Ishap. Don't know how I ever made the error of mistaking you for my kind Lysle. Good day to you.�
entries.translation: 這話說得可真像個真正的大人物，跟那些在伊夏神修道院唸書的臭小子一個樣。我真不知道自己怎麼會犯下這種錯，把你錯認成我那善良的萊斯爾。祝你愉快。�

entries.source: Sorry, good lady. Perhaps the owner can spare a meal.�
entries.translation: 抱歉了，夫人。也許店主能勻頓飯給您。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C2_Petrumh_NOT_FED_NO_GIVE_FOOD�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C2_Petrumh_NOT_FED_NO_GIVE_FOOD�

entries.source:
Petrumh frowned.
	"I'm eating, aren't I?" Petrumh said, stuffing bread into her toothless mouth. "I'm not so healthy I can go on having people interrupt me dinners. Please give me leave to chew in peace."�
entries.translation:
佩特魯姆皺起了眉頭。
	「我這不是在吃嗎？」佩特魯姆一邊說，一邊把麵包塞進她那沒剩幾顆牙的嘴裡。「我身體也沒好到能一直被人打斷吃飯。請容我安安靜靜地嚼完這口飯。」�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C2_Petrumh_FED�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C2_Petrumh_FED�

entries.source:
A woman was moving down the road.
	Judging by her pace and the way she was looking over her shoulder, she seemed to be concerned that someone might be pursuing her. Afraid that the woman might be in danger of some harm, @4 called out to her...�
entries.translation:
一名女子正沿著路走著。
	從她的步伐，以及不時回頭張望的樣子看來，她似乎擔心有人正在追她。@4擔心這名女子可能身陷危險，便出聲喊住了她……�

entries.source: What are you doing on this road! You're not thinking of going into Malac's Cross are you?�
entries.translation: 你們在這條路上做什麼！該不會是想進馬拉克十字鎮吧？�

entries.source: Actually...�
entries.translation: 其實……�

entries.source: The Abbot of the Abbaye Ishap's betrayed his students and his town and it's besieged by some kind of monsters! I should have known that I couldn't escape the evil that brought down Sethanon! And likely your elf friend here had something to do with it!�
entries.translation: 伊夏神修道院的院長背叛了他的學生跟他的鎮子，現在那裡被某種怪物給圍困住了！我早該知道自己躲不過那股扳倒賽瑟儂的邪惡！你這位精靈朋友，大概也脫不了干係！�

entries.source: Gorath has nothing to do with it, I assure you. What are these monsters and why would they be attacking Malac's Cross of all places?�
entries.translation: 我向您保證，戈拉斯跟這件事一點關係都沒有。這些怪物到底是什麼？牠們為什麼偏偏要攻擊馬拉克十字鎮？�

entries.source: If you value you your lives, you'll help the villagers find the Abbot and deliver his head on a stake to those...snakemen! They've promised to leave everyone else alive if the Abbot is turned over to them.�
entries.translation: 你們要是珍惜自己的性命，就該幫村民找到院長，把他的頭插在木樁上送去給那些……蛇人！牠們保證，只要把院長交出去，就會放過其他所有人。�

entries.source: If these are indeed some kind of monsters, what makes you think that they'll be satisfied with killing an Abbot?�
entries.translation: 要是牠們真是某種怪物，您憑什麼認為牠們殺了院長就會善罷甘休？�

entries.source:
Who's for knowing? As for my own self, I'll be in Darkmoor drinking up the...
	Oh my, I've left my ale in the Queen's Row in Malac's Cross! Now I'll have none of the brew for weeks, unless...unless you brave, you ócourageous, boys can go an fetch it for me!�
entries.translation:
誰知道呢？至於我自己，我要去黑沼鎮好好喝上……
	噢，天啊，我把我的麥酒忘在馬拉克十字鎮的王后街了！這下我好幾個禮拜都沒酒喝了，除非……除非你們這幾個勇敢的、ó有膽識的小夥子肯幫我去拿回來！�

entries.source: We have quite a few other things to attend to...�
entries.translation: 我們手頭還有不少別的事要處理……�

entries.source: Oh, please. It'll brighten up an ole missus day, specially one what hasn't a good home anymore. If you get it, you can come and bring it to my friend Ulam's house in Darkmoor...that's where I'll be staying for a bit.�
entries.translation: 噢，拜託嘛。這能讓一個老太婆的日子亮堂一點，尤其是一個已經沒了好好一個家的老太婆。你們要是拿到了，可以送到我朋友尤拉姆在黑沼鎮的家……我暫時會待在那裡。�

entries.source: I will see what we can do, but I can't ópromise you anything.�
entries.translation: 我會看看能做些什麼，不過我不能ó向您保證什麼。�

entries.source: That's fine love, just fine. I'll see you then. And remembers that my friend's name is óUlam. Good travelling to yous.�
entries.translation: 這樣就好，親愛的，這樣就很好了。那就到時候見了。記得我朋友的名字是ó尤拉姆。祝你們一路順風。�

entries.source: And to you as well. Be careful on the way to Darkmoor...�
entries.translation: 您也是。去黑沼鎮的路上小心點……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C6_Petrumh�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C6_Petrumh�

entries.source:
The dwarf drew on his pipe.
	Languid smoke plumed from the old codger's mouth as he studied Locklear, Owyn and Gorath each in turn. Although he had long ago lost the use of his left eye to a moredhel swordstroke, his right eye still burned brightly beneath his bushy eyebrows.�
entries.translation:
這名矮人吸了口菸斗。
	裊裊菸霧從這位老頭子嘴裡緩緩吐出，他的目光在洛克利爾、歐文跟戈拉斯身上輪流打量。儘管他早年因莫瑞德人的一劍失去了左眼的視力，但他那濃密眉毛下的右眼，依然炯炯有神。�

entries.source: Being as a dwarf ne'er forgets as much as his own name, I ken I recognize a strapping young man before me who last I saw was a boy.�
entries.translation: 矮人這輩子不會忘記自己的名字，連帶著我也認得出，眼前這個健壯的年輕人，我上次見到的時候還是個孩子。�

entries.source: No slight intended, but I fear I don't recall the occasion.�
entries.translation: 無意冒犯，不過恐怕我想不起這個場合了。�

entries.source: As like the rest of your human kin...none among you can remember much past a week. If not for we canny dwarves you would have forgotten that you have a Kingdom at all! I fetched you out of a cellar along with a score o' womenfolk at the Battle of Sethanon! Doncha remember me, Locky?�
entries.translation: 跟你們人類同胞一個樣……你們誰都記不住一個禮拜以前的事。要不是有我們精明的矮人，你們大概連自己有個王國都忘了！賽瑟儂戰役的時候，我把你跟二十來個婦女從一間地窖裡救出來的！洛基，你不記得我了嗎？�

entries.source: Dubal, of course! Glad to see you! I hadn't recognized you without the eyepatch.�
entries.translation: 杜巴，當然記得！很高興見到你！沒了眼罩，我都認不出你了。�

entries.source:
What's a dwarf to do? I won this scratch fair an' square and I'll be a dragon's mother before I'll cover it up again. Shouldn't have done so in the first place. Now I just sit here to jabber with that loon of a Tsurani bartender and 'ave me a few beers. Not much to do with the Mac Mordain Cadal all collapsed.
	A Brak Nurr has been seen down there. They'll be offering a hefty reward for its slaying I'll mite you if tradition holds, too. Something of a challenge as they are fierce beasties even by dwarven standards.�
entries.translation:
矮人還能怎麼辦？這道傷疤是我堂堂正正贏來的，我要是再把它遮起來，那我就是龍他媽了。當初就不該遮著。現在我就坐在這兒，跟那個瘋瘋癲癲的圖蘭尼酒保閒聊，喝上幾杯啤酒。反正麥克莫丹卡達爾整個塌了，也沒什麼事好做。
	聽說下面出現了一隻布拉克努爾。要是照老規矩，誰宰了牠肯定會有一筆豐厚的賞金。就算以矮人的標準來看，這也是個不小的挑戰，因為牠們可是兇猛得很的怪物。�

entries.source: I've heard tales of these creatures of stone. Thank-you, Dubal.�
entries.translation: 我聽說過這種石頭生物的傳說。謝謝你，杜巴。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C1_Dubal_An_Loch�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C1_Dubal_An_Loch�

entries.source:
The dwarf frowned at them.
	Apparently resolute not to move from his stool for some time, he puffed heartily on his pipe. "If you'd be ever so kind, I'd prefer it if ya left me unpestered. A dwarf's pipe is a religious matter and a tavern his temple. Perhaps we can jabber a bit later."�
entries.translation:
這名矮人朝他們皺起了眉頭。
	他顯然打定主意暫時不打算離開這張凳子，只顧著使勁抽著菸斗。「勞煩兩位行行好，我倒寧可你們別來煩我。矮人抽菸斗是件神聖的事，酒館就是他的神殿。也許我們晚點再聊。」�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C1_Dubal_An_Loch�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C1_Dubal_An_Loch�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The dwarf walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	這名矮人走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: You think quite a bit o' yourself, doncha lad?�
entries.translation: 小子，你還挺看得起自己的嘛，是吧？�

entries.source: Perhaps. What makes you think so?�
entries.translation: 也許吧。你為什麼會這麼想？�

entries.source: Most folk enter a room, they looks to the left, to the right, check out the lay of a place then they choose where to go. When you come aprancin' in, you walk straight in as an arrow as if nothing could stand in your way. No one does that that's not stupid or very good with a knife.�
entries.translation: 大多數人進房間，都會先看看左邊、看看右邊，摸清楚這地方的格局，再決定往哪走。可你大搖大擺地進來，直直往前走，活像沒什麼能擋在你面前似的。會這麼做的人，要嘛是蠢，要嘛就是耍刀的本事非常了得。�

entries.source: I'm not stupid.�
entries.translation: 我不蠢。�

entries.source: Didna think ya were, but I'd wager a month's salary that you've done some time as a thief.�
entries.translation: 我也沒這麼覺得，不過我敢拿一個月的薪水打賭，你當過一陣子小偷。�

entries.source: I suggest you lay a hefty amount on the wager. You'd win. But all that was a long time ago. I'm in the service of the Prince now.�
entries.translation: 我建議你下重注。你會贏的。不過那都是很久以前的事了。我現在為親王效力。�

entries.source: Are ya now? It's a shame almost. There's a new section of the Mac Mordain Cadal that's just been reopened by the workers---there was a terrible collapse there not too long ago ya know---and they say that there's a chamber there just heaped up with treasure.�
entries.translation: 是嗎？那還真有點可惜。麥克莫丹卡達爾有一段新通道，工人們才剛重新打通——你知道的，不久前那裡發生過一場嚴重的坍塌——聽說那裡有間密室，堆滿了寶藏。�

entries.source: Why tell me? Why not get the treasure yourself?�
entries.translation: 為什麼告訴我？你自己怎麼不去拿那些寶藏？�

entries.source: That would be stealin' from meself---it's dwarven treasure afterall---Besides I wouldna 'ave the desire to try. If you're no thief, I've nothing to worry in telling you, and if you are---again, I've nothing to worry about. We don' exactly leave treasure just laying about unless its for good reason.�
entries.translation: 那等於是偷我自己的東西——畢竟那是矮人的寶藏——再說我也沒那個興致去試。你要是不是小偷，我告訴你也沒什麼好擔心的；你要是小偷——那我也一樣沒什麼好擔心的。我們可不會平白無故把寶藏就這麼擺著不管，總是有原因的。�

entries.source: And what reason would that be?�
entries.translation: 那會是什麼原因？�

entries.source: Let's just say that there are certain things in this world that ya either are or are not supposed to 'ave. If ya were meant to tooch somethin', you will. If not, well then...fate sorts that sort of thing out.�
entries.translation: 這麼說吧，這世上有些東西，你要嘛註定該擁有，要嘛註定不該擁有。要是你命中註定該摸到什麼，你就會摸到。要是不是，那……命運自會安排這種事。�

entries.source: I believe you're right about that, Dubal. A lesson I've learned the hard way.�
entries.translation: 杜巴，我相信你這話說得沒錯。這是我吃了不少苦頭才學到的教訓。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C2_Dubal_An_Loch�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C2_Dubal_An_Loch�

entries.source:
The dwarf frowned at them.
	Apparently resolute not to move from his stool for some time, he puffed heartily on his pipe. "If you'd be ever so kind, I'd prefer it if ya left me unpestered. A dwarf's pipe is a religious matter and a tavern his temple. Perhaps we can jabber a bit later."�
entries.translation:
這名矮人朝他們皺起了眉頭。
	他顯然打定主意暫時不打算離開這張凳子，只顧著使勁抽著菸斗。「勞煩兩位行行好，我倒寧可你們別來煩我。矮人抽菸斗是件神聖的事，酒館就是他的神殿。也許我們晚點再聊。」�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C2_Dubal_An_Loch�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C2_Dubal_An_Loch�

entries.source:
Dubal scowled.
	Bent over his pipe, he prodded a thumb into the meerschaum bowl until a weak blue plume issued forth to fill the room. With a frustrated growl he jammed the smoking thing into his mouth, muttered aloud in his thick dwarven burr.�
entries.translation:
杜巴皺起了臉。
	他俯身對著菸斗，用拇指戳了戳海泡石菸斗鍋，直到一縷微弱的藍色菸霧冒出，瀰漫了整個房間。他不耐煩地低吼一聲，把那冒著煙的東西塞進嘴裡，用他那濃重的矮人口音低聲咕噥著。�

entries.source: Set flame to a Midkemian tobacco and you'll 'ave an hour's respite from the world. Set flame to a Tsurani weed though an' you'll be lucky to get so much as gnat's spit of smoke from it. For all I know, they probably cut it 'alf an' 'alf with gwali dung.�
entries.translation: 點上一斗米德凱米亞菸草，你就能享受一整個鐘頭遠離塵世的清閒。可點上圖蘭尼那種菸草，能冒出蚊子吐的那麼一丁點煙，你就該偷笑了。要我說，他們大概是拿格瓦利獸的糞便摻了一半進去。�

entries.source: Mind if I sit with you a while?�
entries.translation: 介意我陪你坐一會兒嗎？�

entries.source: Sit where ya like, lad. I don' own the stools, but if it's a ramble you're after then Dubal An Loch is the right gaffer. Have a good story to tell, laddie?�
entries.translation: 你想坐哪就坐哪，小子。這些凳子又不是我的，不過你要是想找人閒聊，杜巴．安洛克正是你要找的老頭子。有什麼好故事要說嗎，小夥子？�

entries.source: Dangerous question, but I would be willing to bet yours date back rather longer than mine. Right now I'm a bit preoccupied. We're on the trail of a murderer...�
entries.translation: 這問題可危險，不過我敢打賭你的故事肯定比我的久遠得多。眼下我正忙著別的事。我們正在追查一名殺人犯……�

entries.source: ñAchð, you'll pollute tha Blue Wheel with talk like that. We're happy folk 'ere and I'm not in a mood ta have it put to ruin. Ya need to be a little more cheery, like Sumani...�
entries.translation: ñ啊ð，你這種話會污了藍輪客棧的清淨。我們這兒都是些快活人，我可沒心情讓它給毀了。你得開朗一點，像蘇馬尼那樣……�

entries.source: The ñbarkeepð? He's a nice fellow for a Tsurani I suppose, but he seems sort of stoic...Not exactly a bundle of laughs.�
entries.translation: ñ那個酒保ð？我想他作為圖蘭尼人算是個不錯的傢伙，不過他看起來有點冷淡……不算是個開心果。�

entries.source: 'ees a bloddy riot, that one. Got a joke what'll split your sides and 'ave you peeing your skins in an 'eartbeat. Course, being Tsurani, 'is jokes do take a bit of getting used to. They 'ave a funny wise way o lookin' at a thing.�
entries.translation: 他呀，可是個活寶。他有個笑話能把你笑得肚子疼，笑到尿褲子都不誇張。當然，他畢竟是圖蘭尼人，他的笑話得花點時間才能習慣。他們看事情的角度，總是帶著一種奇特的智慧。�

entries.source: I'll agree they are a strange bunch. I think the only one that I've ever met is a man they call Charles---never could pronounce his given Tsurani name. He works for Duke Martin in Crydee...�
entries.translation: 我同意他們是群奇特的人。我想我唯一見過的一個，是個他們叫他查爾斯的人——他原本的圖蘭尼名字我怎麼都唸不對。他在克萊迪替馬丁公爵做事……�

entries.source: Weel go on an ask Sumani 'bout his joke what he told me earlier. In the meanswhile, I think I'm going to 'ave me a quick smoke in quiet for a bit.�
entries.translation: 好，那你就去問問蘇馬尼，問他剛才跟我說的那個笑話吧。這段時間，我想我要靜靜地快快抽口菸。�

entries.source: Fair enough. Thanks for chatting with us.�
entries.translation: 好啊。謝謝你陪我們聊聊。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C3_Dubal_An_Loch�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C3_Dubal_An_Loch�

entries.source:
The dwarf frowned at them.
	Apparently resolute not to move from his stool for some time, he puffed heartily on his pipe. "If you'd be ever so kind, I'd prefer it if ya left me unpestered. A dwarf's pipe is a religious matter and a tavern his temple. Perhaps we can jabber a bit later."�
entries.translation:
這名矮人朝他們皺起了眉頭。
	他顯然打定主意暫時不打算離開這張凳子，只顧著使勁抽著菸斗。「勞煩兩位行行好，我倒寧可你們別來煩我。矮人抽菸斗是件神聖的事，酒館就是他的神殿。也許我們晚點再聊。」�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C3_Dubal_An_Loch�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C3_Dubal_An_Loch�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The dwarf walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	這名矮人走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: Oh, ya've doone it now, lad. I'd be surprised if that ole Tsurani even ever spoke to ya again.�
entries.translation: 噢，你這下可闖禍了，小子。我看那老圖蘭尼人以後還肯不肯跟你說話，都難講了。�

entries.source: Why? What did I say?�
entries.translation: 為什麼？我說了什麼？�

entries.source: Nothing wrong, not leastways by the standards of the Kingdom. But Sumani, now he's not of the Kingdom, is he? Least not so he 'as the Kingdom way of thinkin'. These folks from Kelewan have queer ways of looking at a thing and by me reckoning you've just insulted his honor by bringing up his getting the boot from the Garrison.�
entries.translation: 沒說錯什麼，至少按王國的標準來說沒有。可蘇馬尼，他又不是王國人，對吧？至少他腦子裡想的不是王國那一套。這些從凱勒旺來的人，看事情的角度總是怪裡怪氣的，依我看，你剛才提起他被駐軍革職的事，已經冒犯了他的榮譽。�

entries.source: I didn't mean to offend him. I was just curious.�
entries.translation: 我不是有意冒犯他的。我只是好奇而已。�

entries.source: As any would be, as any would be. But these Tsurani now, they 'old honor a ways and aboove all else and if they be lacking in honor, then they feel they 'aven't the right to live. If not for a wee lie I told him a year or more ago, I suspected he would 'ave ended 'is life by now.�
entries.translation: 誰都會好奇，誰都會好奇。可這些圖蘭尼人啊，他們把榮譽看得比什麼都重，要是失了榮譽，他們會覺得自己沒了活下去的資格。要不是我一年多前跟他撒了個小謊，我看他現在恐怕早就了結自己的性命了。�

entries.source: But what did he do to warrant a dismissal?�
entries.translation: 可他到底做了什麼，才會落得被革職？�

entries.source: I can't say as he's been exactly talkative about it, but as I'm a dwarf, I've poked around a bit and I think I've pieced the truth of the tale together. It seems aboout three years ago Sumani was mistakenly assigned the duty of standing watch over the LaMutian graveyard. Now he 'ad already stood a double watch that day so that a friend of 'is could tie the marital knot and he 'ad been up late the night before attending to a laboring calf. Unfortunately, some clod working for the Earl forgot to take note of the fact and arranged that Sumani stood watch for twenty six hours! Try as he might, he eventually fell victim to exhaustion and nodded off at 'is poost..�
entries.translation: 他對這件事沒怎麼開過口，不過我畢竟是矮人，四處打聽了一下，我想我已經拼湊出了這故事的真相。大概三年前，蘇馬尼被誤派去看守拉姆特的墓地。那天他已經替一個朋友多站了一班崗，好讓那朋友能去完婚，前一晚他還熬夜幫忙接生一頭小牛，忙到很晚。不幸的是，伯爵手下有個蠢才忘了留意這件事，結果安排蘇馬尼一連站了二十六個小時的崗！他再怎麼撐，最終還是敵不過疲憊，在崗位上打起了瞌睡……�

entries.source: But it wasn't his fault.�
entries.translation: 可那不是他的錯。�

entries.source: True, but tis not the end of the tale. When 'is relief came, it was a certain arrogant bastard captain whose family 'ad some feud with Sumani's family. As punishment, he forced Sumani to sleep the next night in a freshly dug grave along with a corpse recently dead of the consumption. The idiot clerk's mistake was eventually found out by Earl Kasumi, but Sumani felt as if he brought the dishonor upon 'imself and 'is former house by falling asleep.�
entries.translation: 沒錯，不過故事還沒完。等來接班的人時，來的偏偏是個傲慢的混帳隊長，他家跟蘇馬尼家有些世仇。作為懲罰，他逼蘇馬尼隔天晚上睡在一座剛挖好的墳裡，還得跟一具剛因癆病死去的屍體作伴。那個蠢書記的疏失，後來被卡蘇米伯爵查出來了，可蘇馬尼還是覺得，自己打瞌睡這件事，已經給自己跟自己原本的家族帶來了恥辱。�

entries.source: That's terrible! And he is still living with this on his conscience?�
entries.translation: 這太可怕了！他到現在還一直為這件事良心不安？�

entries.source: That's the prooblem. The Tsurani would ordinarily poison themselves or run themselves through with a thing like that on their minds. They simply 'aven't 'ad the experience of knowing 'ow to let go of a mistake and go on. Fortunately 'e's learning the Kingdom way of dealing with a problem.�
entries.translation: 問題就在這兒。換了平常，圖蘭尼人心裡要是裝著這種事，通常會服毒自盡，或是拿劍自刎。他們就是沒學過怎麼放下一個錯誤、繼續往前走。幸好他正在學著用王國人的方式來面對這種事。�

entries.source: What do you mean?�
entries.translation: 你這話什麼意思？�

entries.source: You'd think by meeting most o' the Tsurani that not one among them ever would laugh at anything, least of all themselves. But I've 'ad some luck getting Sumani to have some humor about the situation. In 'is own way, 'e's quite the joke teller.�
entries.translation: 你要是見過大多數圖蘭尼人，大概會覺得他們沒一個人會笑什麼事，尤其是笑自己。可我還算走運，讓蘇馬尼學會用點幽默看待這件事。以他自己的方式來說，他還挺會說笑話的呢。�

entries.source: You can't be serious. He's as jovial as a corpse.�
entries.translation: 你不是認真的吧。他開朗得跟具屍體差不多。�

entries.source: I'd not exactly say that, an certainly not in so many words to his face. But go on, get 'im to tell you the joke 'e told me 'alf an 'our ago. I think it might lift 'is spirits a bit after you've smashed them about. G'won. In the meanswhile, I think I'm going to 'ave me a quick smoke in quiet for a bit.�
entries.translation: 我倒不會這麼說，當著他的面肯定也不會這麼說。不過去吧，讓他跟你說說他半小時前跟我說的那個笑話。我想在你把他的心情搞得一團糟之後，這或許能讓他振作一點。去吧。這段時間，我想我要靜靜地快快抽口菸。�

entries.source: Might be worth a try. Thanks, Dubal.�
entries.translation: 也許值得一試。謝了，杜巴。�

entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C6_Dubal_An_Loch�

	Apparently resolute not to move from his stool for some time, he puffed heartily on his pipe. "If you'd be ever so kind, I'd prefer it if ya left me unpestered. A dwarf's pipe is a religious matter and a tavern his temple. Perhaps we can jabber a bit later."�
entries.translation:
這名矮人朝他們皺起了眉頭。
	他顯然打定主意暫時不打算離開這張凳子，只顧著使勁抽著菸斗。「勞煩兩位行行好，我倒寧可你們別來煩我。矮人抽菸斗是件神聖的事，酒館就是他的神殿。也許我們晚點再聊。」�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: Welcome gentlemen. What brings you to the Abbaye Ishap?�
entries.translation: 歡迎，各位。是什麼風把你們吹來伊夏神修道院的？�

entries.source: My young charge here wished to visit your famed school of nobles. I don't think he would have let us leave Malac's Cross without paying a visit.�
entries.translation: 我這位年輕的受監護人一直想來參觀貴校這所馳名的貴族學堂。我看要是不來拜訪一趟，他是不會讓我們離開馬拉克十字鎮的。�

entries.source: Well, well, well. I am pleased to see that our reputation precedes us. Am I to assume you are interested in becoming a new pupil, or are you visiting from our estimable rival, the Academy of Magicians at Stardock?�
entries.translation: 哎呀呀。很高興見到我們的名聲早已傳開。我能不能假設，您是有意成為我們的新學生，還是您是從我們那令人敬重的對手——星塢島法師學院——來拜訪的？�

entries.source: My father would never allow me to study magic formally. Even though he more than has the financial resources to send me to Stardock, he thinks it's a waste of a young noble's time to spend ten and twenty years with his nose stuck in a book and yet be hardly capable of doing anything else. If it weren't for a magician named Patrus that I met once, I wouldn't know anything of magic at all.�
entries.translation: 我父親絕不會允許我正式學習法術。儘管他的財力綽綽有餘，能送我去星塢島，他卻認為讓一個年輕貴族花上一二十年的光陰埋首書堆，到頭來卻幾乎什麼都不會做，簡直是浪費時間。要不是我曾遇過一位叫派特魯斯的法師，我對法術可說是一竅不通。�

entries.source: It is true that magicians study for longer periods of time with fewer visible results, but no course of study is a waste of time. And while magic is not a primary staple in our directed studies here, magician Pug is kind enough to occasionally send instructors from Stardock to lecture on issues that involve magicians. If you would be interested in enrolling...�
entries.translation: 確實，法師的修習時間較長，顯而易見的成果卻較少，不過沒有一門學問是在浪費時間的。雖然法術並非我們這裡主要教授的科目，但帕格法師相當仁慈，偶爾會從星塢島派講師來，講授一些涉及法師的議題。要是您有興趣入學……�

entries.source: I regret that we don't have time for that kind of detour. He is on crucial business that takes him elsewhere.�
entries.translation: 很遺憾，我們沒有時間繞這個彎路。他還有要緊的事得辦，得趕去別處。�

entries.source: What about you, Seigneur? Is there anything in our curricula that interests you?�
entries.translation: 那紳爵您呢？我們的課程裡有什麼引起您興趣的嗎？�

entries.source: Books and scrolls? I'm a bit too old for that sort of thing now.�
entries.translation: 書本跟卷軸？我現在年紀有點太大，不適合那種東西了。�

entries.source: Really? How unfortunate for you. And I was preparing to offer you a chance to attend a lecture on tactics that is being taught by one of our guest instructors...Now that I think on it, you probably wouldn't be interested. It's being taught by this, well, odd fellow, a one eyed gentleman who goes by the name Bas-Tyra...�
entries.translation: 真的嗎？那真是可惜了。我原本正打算給您一個機會，去聽聽我們一位客座講師教授的戰術課程……不過現在想想，您大概也不會感興趣。授課的是一位，這麼說吧，有點古怪的人物，一位獨眼的紳士，名叫巴斯泰拉……�

entries.source: Bas-Tyra? You mean Guy du Bas-Tyra? King Lyam's First Adviser?�
entries.translation: 巴斯泰拉？您是說居伊．杜．巴斯泰拉？萊亞姆王的首席顧問？�

entries.source: Yes, I believe that's his title...It's part of the Abbaye Ishap's arrangement with King Lyam. In exchange for setting aside part of our facilities here for the purposes of education, the King occasionally will loan us some of the finest minds in the Kingdom. It works to our mutual benefit. I can still arrange to allow you in if you're still interested for a small donation of twenty sovereigns. What do you say, Seigneur?�
entries.translation: 是的，我想那正是他的頭銜……這是伊夏神修道院跟萊亞姆王的一項安排。作為我們撥出部分設施供教育之用的交換，國王偶爾會借調王國裡幾位最傑出的人才過來。這對雙方都有好處。要是您仍有興趣，只需捐獻二十枚金幣，我還是能替您安排入場。紳爵，您意下如何？�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: You're fortunate. There still seem to be a few places open for Guy du Bas Tyra's speech on combat assessment this evening. Do you wish to buy a ticket?�
entries.translation: 你們運氣不錯。今晚居伊．杜．巴斯泰拉那場關於戰場評估的演講，看來還剩幾個名額。你們想買票嗎？�

entries.source: I think we can make time. Where do we need to go?�
entries.translation: 我想我們能抽出時間。我們得去哪？�

entries.source: In town, near the Queen's Row, there's a small hall that we have reserved for Guy's speech. Simply present this ticket at the door and they will admit you all. I believe you will be in for a stimulating evening.�
entries.translation: 鎮上，靠近王后街的地方，有間我們為居伊的演講預留的小廳。只需在門口出示這張票，他們就會放你們進去。我相信你們會度過一個發人深省的夜晚。�

entries.source: Thank-you. We are looking forward to it.�
entries.translation: 謝謝您。我們很期待。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C2_Abbot_Graves_YES_TICKETS_ENOUGH_GOLD�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C2_Abbot_Graves_YES_TICKETS_ENOUGH_GOLD�

entries.source: Where the spirit is willing, the purse strings are loose. I'm short on funds.�
entries.translation: 心有餘而錢包空。我手頭有點緊。�

entries.source: I'm afraid I can't admit you without it. It's one of the small constraints on us. As our abbaye is not in the habit of great enterprise, we pay for our guest's travel expenses with the funds we gather at the door. You'll probably miss tonight's lecture, but we may have a request for a repeat lecture, depending on our student turnout, so perhaps if you can come up with the funds you can still listen to him.�
entries.translation: 恐怕沒有捐獻，我沒法讓你們入場。這是我們這裡的小小限制之一。我們修道院並不習慣經營什麼大生意，所以我們是靠門口募得的資金，來支付客座講師的旅費。你們今晚的演講大概是趕不上了，不過視學生出席的踴躍程度，我們可能會請他再開一場，所以要是你們到時候籌得出資金，或許還能聽到他的演講。�

entries.source: We'll try to fill our purses between now and then. Good day.�
entries.translation: 我們會設法在那之前把荷包填滿的。祝您愉快。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C2_Abbot_Graves_YES_TICKETS_NOT_ENOUGH_GOLD�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C2_Abbot_Graves_YES_TICKETS_NOT_ENOUGH_GOLD�

entries.source: Really, we don't have the time. We appreciate your offer, however.�
entries.translation: 說真的，我們沒有時間。不過還是感謝您的好意。�

entries.source: If you change your mind, I should have tickets available. Good travelling.�
entries.translation: 要是你們改變主意，我這邊應該還有票。一路順風。�

entries.source: We know where to find you. Thanks.�
entries.translation: 我們知道去哪找您。謝謝。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C2_Abbot_Graves_NO_TICKETS�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C2_Abbot_Graves_NO_TICKETS�

@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: Hello Abbot. We were hoping we could speak with you a while.�
entries.translation: 院長您好。我們希望能跟您談一會兒。�

entries.source: As much as I would like to chat, I have some business to attend to. A few of my students require my special attentions. Perhaps I shall see you again some time.�
entries.translation: 儘管我很想跟你們聊聊，不過我還有點事要處理。有幾個學生需要我特別關照。也許改天我們還能再見。�

entries.source: Perhaps you shall. We'll leave you to attend to your students. Goodbye.�
entries.translation: 也許吧。我們就不打擾您照顧學生了。再見。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C2_Abbot_Graves_HAS_TICKET�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C2_Abbot_Graves_HAS_TICKET�
