entries.source: Welcome to the Abbaye Ishap. I am the Abbot Graves. How may we help you?�
entries.translation: 歡迎來到伊夏神修道院。我是葛雷夫斯院長。有什麼能為您效勞的？�

entries.source: Several men were killed in Romney recently and my companions and I are investigating their murder. We were hoping you might be able to give us some information.�
entries.translation: 最近有幾個人在羅姆尼遇害，我跟同伴正在調查這起謀殺案。我們希望您能提供一些線索。�

entries.source: We are always at the disposal of the King's wishes. How can we help?�
entries.translation: 我們永遠聽候國王的差遣。有什麼能幫忙的？�

entries.source: There were two objects found on the bodies of the dead men. One was a rather ordinary looking brass spyglass and the other was a small spider statuette made of silver. Would you know anything about either object?�
entries.translation: 死者身上找到了兩件物品。一件是外觀相當普通的黃銅望遠鏡，另一件是一尊銀製的小蜘蛛雕像。您對這兩樣東西有任何了解嗎？�

entries.source: Spyglasses are common devices, but silver spiders, now those would be quite rare. I've seen them catalogued in books as magical poisoning devices but they would be prohibitively expensive for a common murderer. Whomever used your spider would have to be a man with a great deal of money and would have to have connections with Kesh. That's where they are made.�
entries.translation: 望遠鏡是常見的器具，不過銀蜘蛛，那可就相當稀罕了。我在書上見過相關記載，說那是一種魔法下毒器具，但對一個尋常的殺人犯來說，價格高得離譜。用得起這種蜘蛛的人，必定家財萬貫，還得跟凱許有些淵源。那正是它們的產地。�

entries.source: Thank you, you've been of tremendous help.�
entries.translation: 謝謝您，您幫了大忙。�

entries.source: Glad to be of service. Incidentally, would you gentlemen be interested in attending a lecture this evening on tactics? It's being instructed by Baron Troville in our special lecture hall and it promises to be very enlightening. The tickets are only twenty sovereigns. Do you wish to go?�
entries.translation: 很樂意能幫上忙。順帶一提，兩位對今晚一場戰術講座有沒有興趣？是由特羅維爾男爵在我們的特別講堂授課，保證會發人深省。票價只要二十枚金幣。你們想去嗎？�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: Gentlemen, welcome back to the Abbaye Ishap. How may I help you?�
entries.translation: 兩位，歡迎回到伊夏神修道院。有什麼能為兩位效勞的？�

entries.source: Several men were killed in Romney recently and my companions and I are investigating their murder. We were hoping you might be able to give us some information.�
entries.translation: 最近有幾個人在羅姆尼遇害，我跟同伴正在調查這起謀殺案。我們希望您能提供一些線索。�

entries.source: We are always at the disposal of the King's wishes...Please, ask your questions.�
entries.translation: 我們永遠聽候國王的差遣……請儘管提問。�

entries.source: There were two objects found on the bodies of the dead men. One was a rather ordinary looking brass spyglass and the other was a small spider statuette made of silver. Would you know anything about either object?�
entries.translation: 死者身上找到了兩件物品。一件是外觀相當普通的黃銅望遠鏡，另一件是一尊銀製的小蜘蛛雕像。您對這兩樣東西有任何了解嗎？�

entries.source: Spyglasses are common devices, but silver spiders, now those would be quite rare. I've seen them catalogued in books as magical poisoning devices but they would be prohibitively expensive for a common murderer. Whomever used your spider would have to be a man with a great deal of money and would have to have connections with Kesh. That's where they are made.�
entries.translation: 望遠鏡是常見的器具，不過銀蜘蛛，那可就相當稀罕了。我在書上見過相關記載，說那是一種魔法下毒器具，但對一個尋常的殺人犯來說，價格高得離譜。用得起這種蜘蛛的人，必定家財萬貫，還得跟凱許有些淵源。那正是它們的產地。�

entries.source: Thank you, you've been of tremendous help.�
entries.translation: 謝謝您，您幫了大忙。�

entries.source: Glad to be of service. As I recall, you purchased tickets for the First Adviser's speech on enemy assessment, did you not? I trust it was educational.�
entries.translation: 很樂意能幫上忙。我記得，你們買了首席顧問那場敵情評估演講的票，對吧？我相信那場演講讓你們獲益良多。�

entries.source: Actually, we never got around to it. We ran short of time when we were last in Malac's Cross.�
entries.translation: 其實我們沒去成。上次在馬拉克十字鎮時，時間不夠。�

entries.source: A pity. I understand that one of our bright stars---a Kyle Fischer, if I recall correctly--- decided to stand and debate the First Adviser's tactics on a battle for Deep Taunton. I don't believe I've ever seen that boy look quite so mortified for quite so many days. You're in luck, however, because another of our guest instructors will be lecturing for a while and since you didn't use your ticket, it's still valid.�
entries.translation: 真是可惜。我記得我們一位優秀的學生——要是我沒記錯，是凱爾．費雪——當場站起來，跟首席顧問就深陶頓一役的戰術辯論了起來。我這輩子還沒見過那孩子有哪次像那幾天一樣狼狽不堪。不過你們運氣不錯，因為另一位客座講師接下來會再開一段時間的課，而既然你們的票沒用過，依然有效。�

entries.source: What's the topic?�
entries.translation: 主題是什麼？�

entries.source: A subject that I think is already of interest to you. Tactics, once again, taught by Baron Troville from Highcastle. I believe he will be discussing his battles against the moredhel.�
entries.translation: 我想這個主題，你們應該早就感興趣了。還是戰術，這回由高堡的特羅維爾男爵授課。我相信他會講述他跟莫瑞德人交戰的經歷。�

entries.source: Why isn't he massing his forces in the North?�
entries.translation: 他怎麼沒在北方集結兵力？�

entries.source: He's awaiting a group of soldiers from Darkmoor. Until they arrive, he's been gracious enough to lend us his services. I should like to attend the lecture myself but my duties call me elsewhere. Enjoy yourselves.�
entries.translation: 他正在等黑沼鎮的一批士兵。在他們抵達之前，他相當慷慨地借調來為我們授課。我自己也很想去聽這場演講，可惜職責所在，得去別處。祝兩位玩得愉快。�

entries.source: We shall. Thank-you.�
entries.translation: 我們會的。謝謝您。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C3_Abbot_Graves_HAS_TICKET�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C3_Abbot_Graves_HAS_TICKET�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: You're fortunate. There still seem to be a few places open for Baron Troville's speech this evening. Do you wish to buy a ticket?�
entries.translation: 你們運氣不錯。今晚特羅維爾男爵的演講，看來還剩幾個名額。你們想買票嗎？�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: As much as I would like to chat, I have some business to attend to. A few of my students require my special attentions. Perhaps I shall see you again some time.�
entries.translation: 儘管我很想跟你們聊聊，不過我還有點事要處理。有幾個學生需要我特別關照。也許改天我們還能再見。�

entries.source: Perhaps you shall. Until then, good day.�
entries.translation: 也許吧。在那之前，祝您愉快。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C3_Abbot_Graves_HAS_TICKET�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C3_Abbot_Graves_HAS_TICKET�

entries.source: I think we can make time. Where's the lecture at?�
entries.translation: 我想我們能抽出時間。演講在哪？�

entries.source: In town, next to the Queen's Row, there's a small hall that we have reserved for Troville's speech. Simply present this ticket at the door and the doorman will admit you all. I believe you will be in for a stimulating evening.�
entries.translation: 鎮上，王后街旁邊，有間我們為特羅維爾的演講預留的小廳。只需在門口出示這張票，守門人就會放你們進去。我相信你們會度過一個發人深省的夜晚。�

entries.source: I hope we shall. Thank-you.�
entries.translation: 希望如此。謝謝您。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C3_Abbot_Graves_YES_TICKETS_ENOUGH_GOLD�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C3_Abbot_Graves_YES_TICKETS_ENOUGH_GOLD�

entries.source: Where the spirit it willing, the purse strings are loose. I'm short on funds.�
entries.translation: 心有餘而錢包空。我手頭有點緊。�

entries.source: I'm afraid I can't admit you without it. It's one of the small constraints we have on us here. As our abbaye is not in the habit of great enterprise, we pay for our guest's travel expenses with the funds we gather at the door. You'll probably miss tonight's lecture, but we may have a request for a coda, depending on student turnout, so perhaps if you can come up with the funds you can still listen to him.�
entries.translation: 恐怕沒有捐獻，我沒法讓你們入場。這是我們這裡的小小限制之一。我們修道院並不習慣經營什麼大生意，所以我們是靠門口募得的資金，來支付客座講師的旅費。你們今晚的演講大概是趕不上了，不過視學生出席的踴躍程度，我們可能會請他再開一場，所以要是你們到時候籌得出資金，或許還能聽到他的演講。�

entries.source: Thank-you. We will try.�
entries.translation: 謝謝您。我們會盡力試試。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C3_Abbot_Graves_YES_TICKETS_NOT_ENOUGH_GOLD�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C3_Abbot_Graves_YES_TICKETS_NOT_ENOUGH_GOLD�

entries.source: Really, we don't have the time. We appreciate your offer, however.�
entries.translation: 說真的，我們沒有時間。不過還是感謝您的好意。�

entries.source: If you change your mind, I should have tickets available. Good travelling.�
entries.translation: 要是你們改變主意，我這邊應該還有票。一路順風。�

entries.source: Good travelling to you, as well.�
entries.translation: 您也一路順風。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C3_Abbot_Graves_NO_TICKETS�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C3_Abbot_Graves_NO_TICKETS�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: You have picked an inconvenient time for a visit. I...I have business to attend to.�
entries.translation: 你們挑了個不太方便的時間來訪。我……我還有事要處理。�

entries.source: Why would Pantathians be interested in attacking the Abbaye Ishap and why would they blame you for it? The citizens are terrified, fleeing the city for fear of their lives. They blame you, abbot.�
entries.translation: 潘塔西亞人為什麼會對攻擊伊夏神修道院感興趣？他們又為什麼要怪罪到您頭上？鎮民都嚇壞了，紛紛逃離城鎮，唯恐性命不保。院長，他們都在怪您。�

entries.source: Please...I don't know why they would make these...accusations...I'm not responsible, I will not be responsible.�
entries.translation: 求你……我不知道他們為什麼會提出這些……指控……這不是我的責任，我不會負這個責任。�

entries.source: If you're thinking of fleeing the city, I wouldn't advise it. We've been told that some of the townspeople intend to make you a present to the Pantathians as a prisoner.�
entries.translation: 要是您正打算逃離這座城鎮，我勸您最好打消念頭。我們聽說，有些鎮民打算把您當成戰俘，獻給潘塔西亞人。�

entries.source: The Pantathians don't take prisoners! They kill once they make their minds up on a target! It would be murder!�
entries.translation: 潘塔西亞人才不留活口！他們一旦鎖定目標就會直接殺了對方！這根本是謀殺！�

entries.source: It seems that the Pantathians are willing to do worse than that to Malac's Cross if you aren't turned over to them. Why don't you tell me why they're here? Perhaps we can help you if you help us.�
entries.translation: 看來要是您不被交出去，潘塔西亞人打算對馬拉克十字鎮做出更過分的事。您何不告訴我他們為什麼會來這裡？也許您幫我們，我們就能幫您。�

entries.source: Greed. They're here because a certain spineless brother of the Abbaye Ishap looked up and said I am meant for greater things than this. He was unscrupulous, unflinching, dedicated to a singular selfish cause. With as little conscience as a man has when swatting a fly, he arranged that his abbot should be caught with a sum of money that was discovered missing from the brotherhood's coffers. Naturally, the brother then assumed the abbot's place.�
entries.translation: 貪婪。他們來這裡，是因為伊夏神修道院裡有個沒骨氣的修士，抬起頭來，說自己命中註定要成就比這更大的事業。他這人毫無節操，毫不退縮，一心只為了自己那點自私的目的。他毫不留情，就像拍死一隻蒼蠅那樣，設計讓他的院長被人發現身上帶著一筆從兄弟會金庫裡失竊的錢。順理成章地，這名修士便取代了院長的位子。�

entries.source: You. But you weren't able to keep the secret, were you? Someone discovered your deception.�
entries.translation: 是您。可您沒能保住這個祕密，對吧？有人發現了您的詭計。�

entries.source: My plan was seamless, as perfect as the most perfect pearl but somehow he found out. So we struck an arrangement. The Crawler agreed to silence so long as I contacted Pug and arranged for a magical tutor to be sent periodically to Malac's Cross. The tutors never knew that not all of the men they trained were nobles and things went relatively well for four years...then Pug discovered the truth from one of the Crawler's men in Krondor. Pug withdrew his tutors, stripped us of our books and left me incapable of fulfilling the details of my secret deal. So the Crawler made a new demand. Since I could no longer train his rogues, I was to uncover a certain magical relic for him or forfeit my life. I refused, and his Pantathian masters were not pleased. I responded with a few of the boys that Pug's adviser had taught magic, nobles, but apparently they were overmatched.�
entries.translation: 我的計畫天衣無縫，完美得就像最完美的珍珠，可不知怎的，他還是發現了。於是我們達成了一項協議。爬行者答應保守祕密，條件是我得聯繫帕格，安排一位法術導師定期前來馬拉克十字鎮授課。那些導師從不知道，他們教的人並非個個都是貴族，事情就這樣相安無事地過了四年……直到帕格從他在克朗多的一個手下口中查出了真相。帕格撤走了他的導師，收回了我們的書籍，讓我再也沒法履行那樁祕密交易的細節。於是爬行者又提出了新的要求。既然我沒法再訓練他的爪牙，我就得替他找出一件特定的魔法遺物，不然就得賠上性命。我拒絕了，他背後的潘塔西亞人主子相當不悅。我派出了幾個帕格導師教過法術的男孩——那些貴族子弟——去應戰，可他們顯然不是對手。�

entries.source: The relic the Crawler wanted, was it a book by any chance?�
entries.translation: 爬行者想要的那件遺物，該不會是本書吧？�

entries.source: I will say no more. The time is come that I made arrangements for my escape from Malac's Cross and you two may be my only hope. Find Mitchel Waylander and tell him what has happened. And tell him I don't want anyone else hurt. Once he has made his arrangements, return here and tell me what I must do.�
entries.translation: 我不會再多說了。是時候安排我逃離馬拉克十字鎮了，你們兩個或許是我僅剩的希望。去找米契爾．韋蘭德，告訴他發生了什麼事。也告訴他，我不希望再有任何人受傷。等他安排妥當，回來告訴我該怎麼做。�

entries.source: What? We can't help a criminal escape justice!�
entries.translation: 什麼？我們不能幫一個罪犯逃脫法律制裁！�

entries.source: The men and women of Malac's Cross aren't at all concerned about the criminality of my acts, boy. They know nothing of them. All they know is that the Pantathians have asked for my skin and they will do anything they can to protect themselves, even if it means turning over an innocent man. That is the justice they believe in. If you can still find me guilty after your deliberations, then don't bother coming back.�
entries.translation: 孩子，馬拉克十字鎮的男男女女根本不在乎我犯下的罪行。他們對此一無所知。他們只知道潘塔西亞人要我的命，而他們會不擇手段自保，哪怕這代表交出一個無辜的人。這正是他們所相信的正義。要是你們深思熟慮之後，依然認定我有罪，那就不必再回來了。�

entries.source:
An acolyte fetched the Abbot.
	In a few minutes he appeared, the look in his eyes wary, like those of a beaten dog. Shuffling forward, he spoke quietly to @4.�
entries.translation:
一名見習修士去請院長過來。
	幾分鐘後他現身了，眼神警戒，像隻挨過打的狗。他拖著腳步走上前，低聲對@4說話。�

entries.source: Have you spoken to Mitchel?�
entries.translation: 你們跟米契爾談過了嗎？�

entries.source: He has a plan that he believes will work. He sent along the details.�
entries.translation: 他有個計畫，自認為行得通。他把細節都帶來了。�

entries.source: Tactics, tactics, tactics, always tactics. A justified end to my life as an abbot, I suppose. The priest brought down by the pawn. The circle closes.�
entries.translation: 戰術，戰術，戰術，永遠是戰術。我想，我這院長生涯，也算是理所當然的下場了。祭司被一枚小卒扳倒。這循環總算圓滿了。�

entries.source: It's not too late to do the right thing, abbot. You have a chance to strike back at the Crawler. You can tell me how to get the relic so that he doesn't gain it. Tell me how to get the Book of Macros.�
entries.translation: 院長，現在做正確的事還不晚。您有機會回擊爬行者。您可以告訴我怎麼取得那件遺物，不讓他得手。告訴我怎麼拿到馬克羅斯之書。�

entries.source: Book of Macros? I've never heard of it. I transcribed quite a few of the books that came from his library when he left Midkemia, but I believe I would have remembered reading a book by that title. I know very little about that magician except for what is written in Pug's or Tomas' historical commentaries on the Riftwar with the Tsurani. No, the Crawler was after a magical sword that was reputedly lost near Malac's Cross in the dim past. Personally, I don't believe the Guarda Revanche is anything but a myth...�
entries.translation: 馬克羅斯之書？我從沒聽說過這本書。他離開米德凱米亞時留下的藏書，我謄抄過不少，可要是真讀過一本這個書名的書，我想我應該會記得才對。除了帕格跟托馬斯對圖蘭尼裂界戰爭所寫的史評裡提到的以外，我對那位法師所知甚少。不，爬行者要的其實是一把據傳早年在馬拉克十字鎮附近失落的魔法劍。就我個人來說，我不相信瓜爾達雷凡什真有其物，不過是個神話罷了……�

entries.source: You just mentioned someone named Tomas. Who is that?�
entries.translation: 您剛才提到一個叫托馬斯的人。那是誰？�

entries.source: Hmph? Tomas? He's Warleader of the Elves in Elvandar and Consort to Queen Aglaranna. He was very close to Pug as I understand it and I believe he also spent some little time with Macros. Perhaps he may know about your Book of Macros.�
entries.translation: 嗯？托馬斯？他是艾爾凡達精靈的統帥，亞葛拉蘭娜王后的夫婿。據我所知，他跟帕格交情很深，我想他也曾與馬克羅斯有過一段淵源。也許他會知道你們要找的馬克羅斯之書的事。�

entries.source: It's a lead. Thin, but a lead. Thank you, abbot. I think we have a book to find. Perhaps we will meet again under happier circumstances.�
entries.translation: 這算是條線索。雖然單薄，但也是條線索。謝謝您，院長。看來我們還有本書要找。也許我們還會在更愉快的情況下再見面。�

entries.source: Unlikely, unless you set your feet on the road to Kesh. I imagine that's where I go next. Goodbye and farewell.�
entries.translation: 不太可能，除非你們也踏上通往凱許的路。我想那正是我接下來要去的地方。再見，珍重。�

entries.source: Kesh is it? Good luck.�
entries.translation: 凱許啊？祝您好運。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C6_Abbot_Graves_YES_NOTE�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C6_Abbot_Graves_YES_NOTE�

entries.source: Have you spoken to Mitchel?�
entries.translation: 你們跟米契爾談過了嗎？�

entries.source: We haven't located him yet.�
entries.translation: 我們還沒找到他。�

entries.source: The citizens of the town won't wait much longer. It's imperative you find Mitchel Waylander. Now go, I have a few final details I must attend to here before I leave.�
entries.translation: 鎮上的居民不會再等太久了。你們一定要找到米契爾．韋蘭德。快去吧，我離開之前還有幾件最後的事要處理。�

entries.source: We will return when we find him.�
entries.translation: 我們找到他就回來。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C6_Abbot_Graves_NO_NOTE�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C6_Abbot_Graves_NO_NOTE�

entries.source:
Locklear smiled.
	Although the approaching man seemed half a hand shorter for the passage of eleven years, his halting stride was still as personal to him as his signature. Ages past Isaac had suffered his limp proudly, worn it like an injury sustained on a field of battle and for that he had gained the respect and admiration of Krondor's young squires, Locklear among them. His tragic expulsion from Arutha's court had been a blow to them all...�
entries.translation:
洛克利爾露出了微笑。
	儘管歷經十一年歲月，眼前這名走來的男子似乎矮了半個手掌，但他那略帶跛行的步態，依然像他的簽名一樣，獨屬於他自己。多年前，艾薩克曾自豪地忍受這一瘸，把它當成戰場上留下的傷痕般看待，也因此贏得了克朗多年輕扈從們的敬重與欽佩，洛克利爾也在其中。他當年被亞魯莎宮廷悲慘地驅逐，對他們所有人來說都是一記重擊……�

entries.source: The years have worn you well old squire, despite the fact it seems to have darkened your hair a bit. What did you do? Stick your head in a barrel of pitch?�
entries.translation: 老扈從，這些年你保養得挺不錯的嘛，雖然你的頭髮似乎變深了些。你幹了什麼好事？把頭伸進瀝青桶裡了？�

entries.source: Scoundrel, I would have thought you strung up for impersonating a Duke by now! How are you, Isaac?! It's been since Arutha's wedding, hasn't it?�
entries.translation: 你這個惡棍，我還以為你早就因為冒充公爵被吊死了呢！艾薩克，你近來如何？！自從亞魯莎的婚禮以來，我們就沒見過了吧？�

entries.source: The very day. You should have heard the fit Master of Ceremonies deLacy threw when he found out I wasn't the Count of Dorgin's son. I daresay he would have tossed me over the palace walls himself if he hadn't been busy with the details of the blessed event. I've kept busy since then, spent the last few years on the road doing odd jobs along the border. You'd be surprised at all the things I've learned and seen since I've left Krondor.�
entries.translation: 就是那天。你真該聽聽司儀官德萊西發現我不是多爾金伯爵的兒子時，發的那頓脾氣。要不是他當時正忙著那場喜事的種種細節，我敢說他肯定會親自把我扔出王宮圍牆。從那之後我一直忙個不停，這幾年都在邊境一帶到處打零工。自從離開克朗多以後，我學到、見識到的事情，肯定會讓你大吃一驚。�

entries.source: Surprise me then. You always ówere a rumormonger...�
entries.translation: 那就讓我開開眼界吧。你一直都是個ó長舌鬼……�

entries.source: Well...what would you like to know about?�
entries.translation: 好吧……你想知道些什麼？�

entries.source: As much as I would like to stand about gossiping, I suppose we three need to hie back to the road before Prince Arutha sends out a search party for us.�
entries.translation: 儘管我很想留下來閒聊八卦，不過我看我們三個還是得趕緊上路，免得亞魯莎親王派搜索隊來找我們。�

entries.source: The Prince óis expecting you then...Please send his highness my regards.�
entries.translation: 這麼說，親王ó在等著你們了……請替我向殿下致意。�

entries.source: I shall. Take care of yourself, Isaac!�
entries.translation: 我會的。保重，艾薩克！�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C1_Isaac�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C1_Isaac�

entries.source:
Locklear caught sight of Isaac.
	Whistling to his old associate, the Seigneur motioned for him to join their company...�
entries.translation:
洛克利爾看見了艾薩克。
	這位紳爵朝這位老相識吹了聲口哨，示意他加入他們一行人……�

entries.source: I thought you were off to meet with Prince Arutha.�
entries.translation: 我還以為你去見亞魯莎親王了。�

entries.source: So did I, but we've been muddling about here taking care of a few other errands. It's just luck we happened on you again.�
entries.translation: 我也是這麼想的，不過我們一直在這一帶瞎忙，處理些別的事。碰巧又遇上你，算我們走運。�

entries.source: I shall consider it good fortune then. So, what can I do for you?�
entries.translation: 那我就當這是好運氣了。那，我能為你做點什麼？�

entries.source: As much as I would like to stand about gossiping, I suppose we three need to hie back to the road before Prince Arutha sends out a search party for us.�
entries.translation: 儘管我很想留下來閒聊八卦，不過我看我們三個還是得趕緊上路，免得亞魯莎親王派搜索隊來找我們。�

entries.source: I wouldn't dream of impeding your progress then, but...just watch yourself, seigneur. There are dangerous fellows abroad.�
entries.translation: 那我可不敢耽誤你們趕路，不過……紳爵，自己小心點。外頭有些危險人物。�

entries.source: We shall keep an eye out for them then. Goodbye, Isaac.�
entries.translation: 那我們會多留意的。再見了，艾薩克。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C1_Isaac�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C1_Isaac�

entries.source:
James scrutinized his old acquaintance's disguise.
	Casually he noted Isaac still mimicked a convincing limp, his method likely lifted from the style of Krondor's beggars. At his waist dangled a number of purses, each doubtless filled with clinking iron chips that would lead the ótypical traveller to believe him a business man, but James was far from typical...�
entries.translation:
詹姆士打量著這位老相識的偽裝。
	他不經意地注意到，艾薩克依然裝出一副以假亂真的跛行姿態，手法多半是從克朗多的乞丐那裡學來的。他腰間掛著好幾個錢袋，裡頭想必都裝著叮噹作響的鐵片，足以讓ó一般旅人相信他是個商人，可詹姆士絕非一般人……�

entries.source: Squire James. Have you travelled all this way to unmask me once more?�
entries.translation: 詹姆士扈從。你大老遠跑來這一趟，是要再一次揭穿我的真面目嗎？�

entries.source: That was eleven years ago. You were an impostor and we were facing threats against the life of the Prince. Without knowing who you really were, I couldn't conscience deLacy placing you within striking range of Arutha and Anita.�
entries.translation: 那是十一年前的事了。你當時是個冒名頂替的人，而我們正面臨著威脅親王性命的危機。在不知道你真實身分的情況下，我沒法昧著良心讓德萊西把你安排到亞魯莎跟安妮塔的攻擊範圍之內。�

entries.source: No matter, as fortune would have it, I have fallen on perhaps better times than you might imagine. I conduct my own business, go about my own affairs without the concern of the state...�
entries.translation: 沒關係，承蒙運氣眷顧，我現在的日子過得，或許比你想像的還要好。我經營自己的生意，打理自己的事務，不必操心國家大事……�

entries.source: Without the concern or in spite of their concern, Isaac? I have heard grim rumors of you.�
entries.translation: 艾薩克，是不必操心，還是不顧他們的擔憂？我聽過關於你的一些不太妙的傳聞。�

entries.source: If there are rumors of me they are spread by my competitors. I assure you noble Seigneur that I am entirely at the ódisposal of the Kingdom. How may I be of service to you?�
entries.translation: 要是有關於我的傳聞，那都是我的競爭對手放出來的。尊貴的紳爵，我向您保證，我完全ó聽候王國差遣。有什麼能為您效勞的？�

entries.source: It's time we were going. I would tell you to take care of yourself Isaac, but you were always quite good at doing that.�
entries.translation: 我們該走了。我本想叫你保重，艾薩克，不過你這方面向來很在行。�

entries.source: You never allow your grudges to die, do you?�
entries.translation: 你這人從來不肯放下心結，是吧？�

entries.source: Grudges have nothing to do with this. I simply know to trust my bump of trouble when someone is trying to ófool me. Goodbye, Isaac. I have a suspicion we may meet again.�
entries.translation: 這跟心結沒關係。我只是知道，有人想ó耍我的時候，該相信自己的直覺。再見了，艾薩克。我有預感我們還會再見面。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_CX_Isaac�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_CX_Isaac�

entries.source:
James caught sight of Isaac.
	Whistling, the Seigneur motioned for him to join their company...�
entries.translation:
詹姆士看見了艾薩克。
	這位紳爵吹了聲口哨，示意他加入他們一行人……�

entries.source: For someone who doesn't trust me, you certainly seem interested in speaking to me. Why have you come back, Jimmy? Didn't get your fill of abusing me the last time we spoke?�
entries.translation: 對一個不信任我的人來說，你倒是挺有興致找我說話的嘛。吉米，你怎麼又回來了？上次跟我說話還沒罵夠嗎？�

entries.source: Stop your whining. I need some answers and you may be the only person that can give them to me.�
entries.translation: 別發牢騷了。我需要一些答案，而你或許是唯一能給我答案的人。�

entries.source: Fine. What do you wish to know?�
entries.translation: 好吧。你想知道什麼？�

entries.source: It's time we were going. I would tell you to take care of yourself Isaac, but you were always quite good at doing that.�
entries.translation: 我們該走了。我本想叫你保重，艾薩克，不過你這方面向來很在行。�

entries.source: You never allow your grudges to die, do you?�
entries.translation: 你這人從來不肯放下心結，是吧？�

entries.source: Grudges have nothing to do with this. I simply know to trust my bump of trouble when someone is trying to ófool me. Goodbye, Isaac. I have a suspicion we may meet again.�
entries.translation: 這跟心結沒關係。我只是知道，有人想ó耍我的時候，該相信自己的直覺。再見了，艾薩克。我有預感我們還會再見面。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_CX_Isaac�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_CX_Isaac�

entries.source:
Owyn scrutinized the approaching man.
	Something seemed unusual about the fellow beyond the fact that he walked with an odd limp. At his waist dangled a number of purses, each doubtless filled with gold or silver or whatever medium of exchange the business man chose to trade in...�
entries.translation:
歐文打量著這名走近的男子。
	除了走路姿勢有些古怪的跛行之外，這人似乎還有些不尋常之處。他腰間掛著好幾個錢袋，裡頭想必裝著金幣、銀幣，或是這位商人選擇用來交易的任何貨幣……�

entries.source: You chanced along at an opportune moment. I was just thinking it would be nice to have a bit of company. Getting so bad I thought I was going to begin speaking to the trees. Any way I can be of service to you?�
entries.translation: 你們來得正是時候。我剛才還在想，要是有人陪陪就好了。都快孤單到要跟樹說話了。有什麼我能為你們效勞的嗎？�

entries.source: It's time we were going.  We've things to do. It's been an interesting chat.�
entries.translation: 我們該走了。還有事要辦。這次聊天挺有意思的。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C6_Isaac�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C6_Isaac�

entries.source:
A farmer was ahead of them.
	Debating for a moment whether it would be more prudent to hide before they were seen or to behave normally, @4 decided that the man was probably of no immediate threat to them...�
entries.translation:
前方有個農夫。
	@4猶豫了片刻，考慮著在被發現之前躲起來會不會比較明智，還是照常行動比較好，最後判斷這人應該對他們不構成立即的威脅……�

entries.source: I hope for your good health that you have found shelter against the coming tempest, good sirs.�
entries.translation: 兩位先生，為了你們的健康著想，希望你們已經找到地方躲避即將到來的暴風雨了。�

entries.source: Tempest?�
entries.translation: 暴風雨？�

entries.source: Surely you have heard. The learned monks of Sarth have predicted a terrible storm is coming this way and I would hate to think of anyone caught out in it. Why a man could catch his death of the fevers. If you would like, you may ride it out in my barn.�
entries.translation: 你們想必聽說了吧。薩斯那些博學的修士預言，一場可怕的風暴正朝這裡襲來，我實在不願想像有人被困在外頭的樣子。畢竟，一個人可能會因此染上要命的熱病。要是你們願意，可以到我的穀倉躲一躲。�

entries.source: And what profit would you turn in this enterprise?�
entries.translation: 那你打算從這樁買賣中賺點什麼？�

entries.source: Five golden sovereigns, a reasonable sum, and the guard over my cows. You can sleep in the hay loft of my barn but my wife and I don't take in elves...�
entries.translation: 五枚金幣，這個數目算合理了，再加上幫我看顧牛群。你們可以睡在我穀倉的乾草閣樓上，不過我跟我老婆不收留精靈……�

entries.source: Seven gold pieces, the elf stays with us and we each get a hard roll for breakfast.�
entries.translation: 七枚金幣，精靈跟我們待在一起，而且我們每人早餐都要有一塊硬麵包捲。�

entries.source: Ten gold and the lot of you milk cows the next morning. That's the offer. Take it or leave it.�
entries.translation: 十枚金幣，而且你們三個隔天早上都得幫忙擠牛奶。這是我的條件。要嘛接受，要嘛拉倒。�

entries.source:
A farmer was ahead of them.
	Debating for a moment whether it would be more prudent to hide before they were seen or to behave normally, @4 decided that the man was probably of no immediate threat to them...�
entries.translation:
前方有個農夫。
	@4猶豫了片刻，考慮著在被發現之前躲起來會不會比較明智，還是照常行動比較好，最後判斷這人應該對他們不構成立即的威脅……�

entries.source: Why hello again. Have you reconsidered my offer for lodging?�
entries.translation: 哎呀，又見面了。你們重新考慮過我住宿的提議了嗎？�

entries.source: Reconsidered yes, but I haven't come to a decision. The price is a bit steep.�
entries.translation: 是考慮過了，不過還沒做出決定。這個價錢有點高。�

entries.source: Eight gold, then and you won't have to watch over my cows. How does that sound to you? I cannot in good conscience come much lower than that.�
entries.translation: 那就八枚金幣，而且你們不用幫我看顧牛群。這樣如何？昧著良心我也沒法再壓低多少了。�

entries.source: Deal. Where is this barn of yours?�
entries.translation: 成交。你這穀倉在哪？�

entries.source: Keep heading south---you should pass the Abbaye of Ishap at Sarth. You'll know you're right close to it when you've passed up the Temple of Sung. From there it's just around Yellow Mule mountain. When you find the barn, just go knock on the door and my wife will fix you up.�
entries.translation: 一直往南走——你們應該會經過薩斯的伊夏神修道院。等你們經過頌神神殿，就知道快到了。從那裡再繞過黃騾山就是。找到穀倉之後，敲敲門，我老婆會幫你們安頓好的。�

entries.source: Thank you, farmer. Your hospitality will be remembered.�
entries.translation: 謝謝你，老鄉。你的款待我們會記在心上的。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : Cx_Rowe_TAKE_IT_ENOUGH_GOLD�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：Cx_Rowe_TAKE_IT_ENOUGH_GOLD�

entries.source: You'll have to forgive me, but I'm afraid I've misspoken myself. I don't have the money to pay you.�
entries.translation: 還請你見諒，恐怕我剛才說錯話了。我沒錢付你。�

entries.source: Do you think you're likely to have any soon?�
entries.translation: 你覺得你很快就會有錢了嗎？�

entries.source: I can't be certain. We should be going anyway. Good day to you.�
entries.translation: 我不能確定。不管怎樣我們該走了。祝你愉快。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : Cx_Rowe_TAKE_IT_NOT_ENOUGH_GOLD�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：Cx_Rowe_TAKE_IT_NOT_ENOUGH_GOLD�

entries.source: I think we'll try our chances on foot. Good day to you, farmer.�
entries.translation: 我看我們還是靠自己碰碰運氣好了。祝你愉快，老鄉。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : Cx_Rowe_LEAVE_IT�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：Cx_Rowe_LEAVE_IT�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: Drink what you can for Delekhan will have the rivers running piss and chickens laying dust for us once this is at an end. There is nothing to be gained in this campaign, but the sparks in his eyes have blinded him. Damn the Six! Damn those magicians that lead us to death and imprison us all...�
entries.translation: 有酒儘管喝，因為等這一切結束，迪勒肯只會讓我們的河流淌著尿、母雞下出灰塵。這場戰役根本一無所獲，可他眼裡的那點火花卻讓他瞎了眼。去他的六賢者！去他的那些法師，帶著我們走向死亡，把我們全都囚禁起來……�

entries.source:
I see that you have little wish to keep your head attached to your shoulders, Irmelyn.
	Your tongue wags and you drool your brains onto the table for all to see. Your drink makes you a fool.�
entries.translation:
伊爾梅林，看來你不太想讓自己的腦袋繼續留在肩膀上啊。
	你這張嘴不停地說，把自己的腦子都口水似的流到了桌上，讓所有人都看在眼裡。你這是喝酒喝成了個傻子。�

entries.source: What the drink makes me is only of concern to me and the tavern keeper. Leave me be yellowtail...�
entries.translation: 喝酒讓我變成什麼樣，只干我跟酒館老闆的事。別管我，黃尾巴……�

entries.source: I suggest you consider advice from one who has suffered Delekhan's wrath and lived to tell the tale. I take it that some acquaintances of yours have been detained by Delekhan's magicians?�
entries.translation: 我建議你聽聽一個承受過迪勒肯之怒、還活著能講述這段經歷的人的忠告。我猜你有些相識的人，被迪勒肯的法師們給扣押了？�

entries.source: What of it? Nothing's to be done. The Six have thrown Obkhar to Venutrier and his dogs and tomorrow they'll come round and hurry the lot of us to our deaths...�
entries.translation: 那又如何？反正也無計可施。六賢者把奧布卡丟給了維努特里爾跟他那群走狗，明天他們就會過來，把我們這群人統統趕去送死……�

entries.source: I propose we help one another rather than work against. What could you offer in exchange for Obkhar's release from the naphtha mines?�
entries.translation: 我提議我們互相幫忙，而不是互相為難。你能提供什麼，來交換奧布卡從那夫沙礦坑裡獲釋？�

entries.source: If you can manage that, I can get you half the boy's weight in gold or the equivalent thereof. Obkhar's tribe alone would willing pay such a ransom.�
entries.translation: 要是你們辦得到，我能給你們相當於那男孩半個體重的黃金，或等值的東西。光是奧布卡的部族，就願意付這樣一筆贖金。�

entries.source: Then get you hence and gather those fees and we will see what may be engineered. We will meet you again in this tavern when we have achieved Obkhar's release.�
entries.translation: 那就去籌措這筆錢吧，我們再看看能安排些什麼。等我們讓奧布卡獲釋之後，會再來這間酒館找你。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C4_Irmelyn�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C4_Irmelyn�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: What word of Obkhar?�
entries.translation: 奧布卡有消息了嗎？�

entries.source: As yet we have not penetrated the defenses of the Six, but we shall do so soon enough. Do not worry about your friend, Irmelyn. He will be free.�
entries.translation: 我們還沒能突破六賢者的防禦，不過很快就會了。伊爾梅林，別擔心你的朋友。他會獲釋的。�

entries.source: Then go about your business, yellowtail and I will be about mine.�
entries.translation: 那你就去忙你的事吧，黃尾巴，我也去忙我的。�

entries.source: I will return.�
entries.translation: 我會回來的。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C4_Irmelyn_HAVENOTGIVEN_VAPOR_MASK�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C4_Irmelyn_HAVENOTGIVEN_VAPOR_MASK�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: Obkhar arrived here shortly before you and described a pair... a human boy and Gorath of the Ardanien. I was going to keep the reward for myself, but he insisted you were deserving of it.�
entries.translation: 奧布卡在你們之前不久就到了這裡，還描述了兩個人……一個人類男孩，還有阿爾達尼恩氏族的戈拉斯。我原本打算把賞金自己留著，可他堅持說這是你們應得的。�

entries.source: He is as reputable as I have heard of him. It could also be that he wished to save you your life...�
entries.translation: 他確實名不虛傳。也可能是他想救你一命……�

entries.source: Save your blade for someone more deserving. I will pay your fee. Two hundred gold and not a royal more of it...�
entries.translation: 把你的劍留給更該死的人吧。我會付你錢。兩百枚金幣，一個銅板都不會多給……�

entries.source: Food in our bellies and beds to rest on, an acceptable exchange for a man's life. I would ask one more thing of you, and then we will be gone from this place. Would you know where we could find a certain witch woman who is known as Cullich?�
entries.translation: 讓我們填飽肚子、有床可睡，這樣的交換，換一條人命也算划算。我還想再請教你一件事，之後我們就會離開這裡。你知不知道去哪能找到一位人稱庫利奇的女巫？�

entries.source: I have heard word of her, yes. Fled south of Caern and west of the fork which leads to Wyke. Probably down there healing up Delekhan's dogs...�
entries.translation: 有，我聽說過她的消息。她逃去了凱恩以南、通往懷克的岔路以西一帶。多半是在那裡替迪勒肯那群走狗療傷……�

entries.source: I wouldn't know. Our business is at an end, Irmelyn. Good fortune and health to you...�
entries.translation: 這我就不清楚了。伊爾梅林，我們的交易就到此為止了。祝你好運、身體健康……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C4_Irmelyn_HAVEGIVEN_VAPOR_MASK�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C4_Irmelyn_HAVEGIVEN_VAPOR_MASK�

entries.source: Food in our bellies and beds to rest on, an acceptable exchange for a man's life. Our business is at an end, Irmelyn. Good fortune and health to you...�
entries.translation: 讓我們填飽肚子、有床可睡，這樣的交換，換一條人命也算划算。伊爾梅林，我們的交易就到此為止了。祝你好運、身體健康……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C4_Irmelyn_HAVEGIVEN_VAPOR_MASK�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C4_Irmelyn_HAVEGIVEN_VAPOR_MASK�

entries.source:
Music drifted on the wind.
	At first believing himself losing his wits to the grind of travelling, Locklear paused, then picked out the very melodic strains of óThe óShores óof óCarse coming from a clump of trees near them. Abruptly the music stopped as an unhappy looking young man dropped out of a tree, his lute slung over back...�
entries.translation:
樂音隨風飄來。
	洛克利爾一開始還以為自己是被旅途的勞頓給累糊塗了，隨即他分辨出附近一叢樹林裡，傳來〈ó卡爾斯ó海ó岸ó謠〉那優美的旋律。音樂忽然停了下來，一個神情不悅的年輕人從樹上跳了下來，魯特琴斜背在背上……�

entries.source: I've just ócome from Northwarden and I don't feel like playing for him anymore today. My fingers are numb, my mind empty, and my stomach grumbling...�
entries.translation: 我剛ó從北衛城回來，今天不想再為他彈奏了。我的手指麻木，腦子空空，肚子還咕嚕作響……�

entries.source: Calm yourself. We óhaven't come from the castle. We're just travellers wandering through who heard your music and thought we would see who was responsible. So, what óis a songbird doing among the falcons?�
entries.translation: 冷靜點。我們ó不是從城堡來的。我們只是路過的旅人，聽見你的樂聲，想看看是誰彈的。話說，一隻鳴禽ó怎麼會混在獵鷹群裡？�

entries.source: Expiring, I fear. Do you know that I can sing the love theme from óAelia óand óTryphus, I can play most of the óRise óof óthe óKingdom cycle and I know by heart the whole of the óTears óof óValerinsis. But these men, these monsters only have one song they want to hear and the ask for it over and over --- óThe óOld óMan's óWind! A song about, about... eating beans!�
entries.translation: 快枯竭了，我怕是這樣。你知道嗎，我能唱〈ó艾莉亞ó與ó特里弗斯〉的愛情主題曲，還能彈奏大半部〈ó王國ó興起ó之ó篇〉組曲，也能一字不漏背出整首〈ó瓦勒林西斯ó之ó淚〉。可這些傢伙，這些怪物，就只想聽一首歌，還一遍又一遍地點——〈ó老ó頭ó的ó風〉！一首唱的是……唱的是吃豆子的歌！�

entries.source: Why do you stay here then?�
entries.translation: 那你怎麼還留在這裡？�

entries.source: I haven't the choice! While sharing a cask of ale with a friend, he told me of a small village where the wine was exceptionally strong and the ladies exceptionally thin. Once sobered, I resolved to take myself to this wondrous place and avail myself of its pleasures. To my horror, I found that my friend had mixed his metaphors and I was laid upon by a lady who could tear the teeth from a bull bare-handed. Before I could extricate myself from such humiliable circumstances, her father, a Baronet of some note, exiled me here to entertain for the Baron Gabot or else sacrifice my head.�
entries.translation: 我沒得選啊！有次跟一個朋友共飲一桶麥酒時，他跟我說起一個小村莊，那裡的酒格外濃烈，姑娘們也格外苗條。等我酒醒之後，便決心親自去這個奇妙的地方，好好享受一番。誰知道，讓我驚恐萬分的是，原來我朋友把比喻給搞混了，結果撲上我身的，是個能徒手把公牛的牙齒拔下來的女子。我還沒能從這種丟人的處境中脫身，她父親——一位頗有名望的準男爵——就把我流放到這裡，要我來替加博特男爵表演娛興，不然就要我的腦袋。�

entries.source: I'm surprised he didn't have you beheaded.�
entries.translation: 我很意外他沒把你砍了頭。�

entries.source:
Well, his daughter was less than maidenly and secondly, he hadn't his fealty to pay for the year. As the Baron Gabot is fond of music, they settled that I should make even the debt.
	I see that you are a noble of some note. If you could do me a favor, perhaps you could ease the stress of a minstrel's life.�
entries.translation:
這個嘛，首先他女兒也不算多清白，其次他那年的效忠金也還沒繳清。既然加博特男爵喜愛音樂，他們便講定，由我來抵這筆債。
	我看得出兩位是有些名望的貴族。要是能幫我個忙，或許能減輕一個吟遊詩人生活的壓力。�

entries.source: Perhaps. What can you want?�
entries.translation: 也許吧。你需要什麼？�

entries.source: A length of light bowstring. While it is not immediately useable to me, I have found a resin that can be applied to it that will allow me to restring my lute. I have a feeling that I may need new strings soon.�
entries.translation: 一段輕型的弓弦。雖然它沒法直接派上用場，不過我找到了一種樹脂，塗上去之後就能拿來替魯特琴換弦。我有預感自己很快就需要新的琴弦了。�

entries.source: As luck would have it, we have one with us and I imagine we can part with it.�
entries.translation: 算你走運，我們身上剛好帶著一條，我想我們可以割愛。�

entries.source: I'm afraid we don't have one that we could lend you at the moment. Perhaps one of Baron Gabot's soldiers can be of assistance to you.�
entries.translation: 恐怕我們目前沒有能借給你的。也許加博特男爵手下的某個士兵能幫上你的忙。�

entries.source: Perhaps, though I doubt it. Farewell to you, gentlemen.�
entries.translation: 也許吧，不過我很懷疑。兩位，告辭了。�

entries.source: And to you, Tamney. We shall meet again, I believe.�
entries.translation: 你也是，坦尼。我相信我們還會再見面的。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C1_Tamney_the_Minstrel�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C1_Tamney_the_Minstrel�

entries.source:
They were not alone.
	@0's pulse quickened as he saw the lone figure approach; but when it became apparent they were not being attacked, he relaxed a bit, squinted slightly in an attempt to see who was about to join them.�
entries.translation:
他們並非孤身一人。
	@0看見一個孤零零的身影走近，脈搏頓時加快；但看出對方並無攻擊之意後，他才稍稍放鬆下來，瞇起眼想看清楚是誰要加入他們。�

entries.source: Oh...it's you three. Did you manage to bring me back that bowstring I requested?�
entries.translation: 噢……是你們三個。你們有把我要的弓弦帶回來嗎？�

entries.source: I'm afraid we don't have one that we could lend you at the moment. Perhaps one of Baron Gabot's soldiers can be of assistance to you.�
entries.translation: 恐怕我們目前沒有能借給你的。也許加博特男爵手下的某個士兵能幫上你的忙。�

entries.source: Perhaps, though I doubt it. Farewell to you, gentlemen.�
entries.translation: 也許吧，不過我很懷疑。兩位，告辭了。�

entries.source: And to you, Tamney. We shall meet again, I believe.�
entries.translation: 你也是，坦尼。我相信我們還會再見面的。�

entries.source:
Tamney was nearby.
	Alerted by the ójongleur's faint lute playing, @4 called for him to come out from wherever he was hiding. Sulkily, the minstrel complied...�
entries.translation:
坦尼就在附近。
	這位ó吟遊藝人微弱的魯特琴聲引起了注意，@4喊他從藏身之處出來。這名吟遊詩人悶悶不樂地照做了……�

entries.source: Oh...it is óyou! Did you manage to bring me back that bowstring I requested?�
entries.translation: 噢……是ó你啊！你們有把我要的弓弦帶回來嗎？�

entries.source: A favor for a favor then! Over the past few weeks there have been several sows stolen from Northwarden, so I wrote this little song to commemorate the event. It's silly and short, but I hope you like it. It's called óNorthwarden óPigs...�
entries.translation: 那就禮尚往來！過去幾週，北衛城陸續有幾頭母豬被偷，所以我寫了這首小曲子來紀念這件事。這曲子又蠢又短，不過希望你們會喜歡。它叫〈ó北衛城ó的豬〉……�

entries.source:
ò-- Northwarden Pigs ò--
	
	óIn óthe óNorth óthe ómoredhel
	óAre óvicious óto óa óman
	óGet ótoo óclose óthey'll órun óyou óthrough
	óAny óway óthey ócan!
	óBut óknow óat ónight óthe óKingdom's ósafe
	óWith ó'Warden óat óthe ópass,
	óBut ócount óyour ópiggies óby óthe ódawn
	óThe ósoldiers ólose ó'em ófast.
	óThey ósqueal ówith ójoy óand óoink ódelight
	óThese ópiggies óof óthe órealm
	óBut ócount ó'em óup óhead óand óall
	óThe ósoldiers ólose ó'em ófast.�
entries.translation:
ò-- 北衛城的豬 ò--
	
	ó北方ó莫瑞德ó人ó兇ó殘暴
	ó對ó人ó從不ó留ó情
	ó你ó若ó靠得ó太近ó他們ó就ó殺你
	ó怎麼ó樣ó都ó要殺
	ó可ó入夜ó之後ó王國ó依然ó十分ó安全
	ó因為ó守衛ó駐守ó在ó隘口
	ó可是ó天亮ó一到ó清點ó豬崽ó的ó時候
	ó士兵ó早就ó把ó牠們ó弄丟
	ó豬崽ó歡歡喜喜ó又ó哼哼ó作樂ó開心ó不已
	ó這些ó王國ó裡ó的ó豬崽
	ó可是ó仔仔細細ó一頭ó一頭ó數ó過ó去
	ó士兵ó早就ó把ó牠們ó弄丟�

entries.source: Thank you, Tamney. That was most enjoyable, but I am afraid that my companions and I must be off again. Things to do.�
entries.translation: 謝謝你，坦尼。這真是太有意思了，不過恐怕我跟同伴又得上路了。還有事要辦。�

entries.source: I bid you farewell then. Come and see me again.�
entries.translation: 那我就此告辭了。歡迎再來找我。�

entries.source: If ever I come to Northwarden again, you can be assured of it. Good day.�
entries.translation: 要是我還會再來北衛城，你儘管放心，我一定會的。祝你愉快。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C1_Tamney_the_Minstrel_HAS_STRING�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C1_Tamney_the_Minstrel_HAS_STRING�

entries.source: Too bad. Oh well, if you should find some any time soon, please bring it by and perhaps I can sing a tune for you. You'll pardon me, but I have to go and practice a few tunes that the Baron requested for dinner hour tomorrow night.�
entries.translation: 真可惜。唉，算了，要是你們哪天找到了，請帶過來，也許我能為你們唱首曲子。容我先失陪了，男爵要我明晚晚餐時段表演幾首曲子，我得去練習了。�

entries.source: Good luck. Play well, bard.�
entries.translation: 祝你好運。彈得好一點，吟遊詩人。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C1_Tamney_the_Minstrel_GIVE_NO�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C1_Tamney_the_Minstrel_GIVE_NO�

entries.source:
Music drifted on the wind.
	At first believing himself losing his wits to the grind of travelling, James paused, then picked out the very melodic strains of óThe óFishwife's óDaughter coming from a clump of trees near them. Abruptly the music stopped as an unhappy looking young man dropped out of a tree, his lute slung over back...�
entries.translation:
樂音隨風飄來。
	詹姆士一開始還以為自己是被旅途的勞頓給累糊塗了，隨即他分辨出附近一叢樹林裡，傳來〈ó漁婦ó的ó女兒〉那優美的旋律。音樂忽然停了下來，一個神情不悅的年輕人從樹上跳了下來，魯特琴斜背在背上……�

entries.source: Please tell me óhe hasn't sent you. I'm too exhausted right now to play and I've run all the things I know into the ground.�
entries.translation: 拜託告訴我，ó不是他派你們來的。我現在累得沒法彈奏了，我會的曲子也都彈到爛熟了。�

entries.source: Hmm. I've heard its a dire day in the keep when the minstrel is without charm. What's bothering you?�
entries.translation: 唔。我聽說城堡裡要是連吟遊詩人都沒了魅力，那可真是不祥的一天。你在煩惱什麼？�

entries.source: When one of the Baron's new recruits asked for musical instruction, I heartily agreed, sacrificing my morning walks to make time for his lessons. We started immediately. I demonstrated for him a simple royal scale---ascending eighth notes, progression from C abdicant to A coronant in half steps, Kingdom time. Even after two weeks he couldn't find all the notes. He refuses to practice, he can't tell the difference between a tuned and untuned lute, and he patently refuses to learn how to read minstrel writs. I don't understand why he desired lessons at all.�
entries.translation: 男爵手下有個新兵想學音樂，我欣然答應了，還犧牲了自己早晨散步的時間，好挪出空來教他。我們馬上就開始上課。我示範了一段簡單的王家音階給他看——上行的八分音符，從C退位音到A加冕音，以半音階、王國拍子進行。可教了兩個禮拜，他連音符都認不全。他不肯練習，分不清調好音跟沒調音的魯特琴有什麼差別，還死活不肯學怎麼讀吟遊詩人的樂譜。我實在不明白他當初幹嘛想學。�

entries.source: Perhaps he thought it would be easier.�
entries.translation: 也許他以為會比較簡單。�

entries.source: Everyone does. They believe you simply pick up an instrument and it magically makes sounds of its own accord without so much as a whit of your concentration. Learning music takes discipline, the same as learning how to use a sword.�
entries.translation: 大家都這麼想。他們以為只要拿起樂器，它就會自己神奇地發出聲音，根本不需要花半點心思。學音樂需要紀律，就跟學劍術一樣。�

entries.source: Perhaps you could give us a lesson sometime.�
entries.translation: 也許你哪天能教教我們。�

entries.source: You're in luck, I'm free just now and I've recently restringed my lute. There is, of course, the matter of a small fee which Baron Gabot imposes for services rendered outside of the garrison compliment. It would be seventy five sovereigns for the lesson. I realize it's a bit steep, but part of the cost covers the price of the practice lute itself. Do you still want the instruction?�
entries.translation: 算你們走運，我現在剛好有空，而且魯特琴才剛換過弦。當然，加博特男爵對駐軍編制之外提供的服務，會收取一筆小額費用。這堂課要七十五枚金幣。我知道這價錢有點高，不過部分費用是拿來支付練習用魯特琴本身的成本。你們還要上課嗎？�

entries.source:
Tamney was nearby.
	Alerted by the ójongleur's faint lute playing, @4 called for him to come out from wherever he was hiding. Sulkily, the minstrel complied...�
entries.translation:
坦尼就在附近。
	這位ó吟遊藝人微弱的魯特琴聲引起了注意，@4喊他從藏身之處出來。這名吟遊詩人悶悶不樂地照做了……�

entries.source: Have you changed your mind about the music lesson? It's a handy thing to know how to play a lute when a lady flutters her eyes at you! Seventy five sovereigns may gain you a night in paradise. What do you say?�
entries.translation: 你們對音樂課改變主意了嗎？要是有位小姐對你拋媚眼，會彈魯特琴可是件方便的事！七十五枚金幣，或許能換來一夜銷魂。你們覺得如何？�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : CX_Tamney_Lesson_1_ENOUGH_GOLD�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：CX_Tamney_Lesson_1_ENOUGH_GOLD�

entries.source: I believe I may have spoken too soon. It seems that I didn't bring along sufficient funds for the lesson.�
entries.translation: 我想我話說得太早了。看來我沒帶夠付這堂課的錢。�

entries.source: I'm usually around here, so if you get the money, I'd be more than happy to instruct you. You'll have to forgive me but I have to go. I'm in the midst of preparing a new rendition of óHer óEyes óof óHoney for the men. They didn't like my last arrangement.�
entries.translation: 我通常都在這附近，要是你們湊到了錢，我很樂意教你們。容我先失陪了，我正忙著替弟兄們準備一個新版本的〈ó她ó蜜色ó的ó眼眸〉。他們不喜歡我上次的編曲。�

entries.source: Good luck with the rendition. We'll be back when we can.�
entries.translation: 祝你的新編曲順利。我們有空會再回來的。�
