entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：CX_Tamney_Lesson_1_NOT_ENOUGH_GOLD�

entries.source: I regret that we have obligations elsewhere. Perhaps another time, minstrel.�
entries.translation: 很遺憾，我們還有別的事要辦。吟遊詩人，也許改天吧。�

entries.source: I'm usually around here, so if you get the money, I'd be more than happy to instruct you. You'll have to forgive me, but I must go and prepare a new rendition of óHer óEyes óof óHoney for the men. They didn't like my last arrangement.�
entries.translation: 我通常都在這附近，要是你們湊到了錢，我很樂意教你們。容我先失陪了，我正忙著替弟兄們準備一個新版本的〈ó她ó蜜色ó的ó眼眸〉。他們不喜歡我上次的編曲。�

entries.source: Good luck with the rendition. We'll be back when we can.�
entries.translation: 祝你的新編曲順利。我們有空會再回來的。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : CX_Tamney_Lesson_1_NO_LESSONS�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：CX_Tamney_Lesson_1_NO_LESSONS�

entries.source:
Music drifted on the wind.
	At first believing himself losing his wits to the grind of travelling, James paused, then picked out the very sorrowful strains of óSethanon, óBloody óSethanon coming from a clump of trees near them. Abruptly the music stopped as an unhappy looking young man dropped out of a tree, his lute slung over back...�
entries.translation:
樂音隨風飄來。
	詹姆士一開始還以為自己是被旅途的勞頓給累糊塗了，隨即他分辨出附近一叢樹林裡，傳來〈ó賽瑟儂ó血染ó賽瑟儂〉那哀傷的旋律。音樂忽然停了下來，一個神情不悅的年輕人從樹上跳了下來，魯特琴斜背在背上……�

entries.source: I haven't seen you in a while. Have you three been practicing what I taught you before?�
entries.translation: 好一陣子沒見到你們了。你們三個有沒有練習我之前教的東西？�

entries.source: A little. We've been occupied with a search for the Nighthawks. Do you know anything about them?�
entries.translation: 練了一點。我們一直忙著搜尋夜鷹會的下落。你知道他們的事嗎？�

entries.source: I try not to know things about the Guild of Assassins. The greatly knowledgeable on the subject tend to rapidly progress to the greatly dead. Call me a coward, but I tend to stick to topics which don't endanger my life.�
entries.translation: 我盡量不去了解刺客公會的事。對這種事知道得太多的人，通常很快就會變成知道得太多的死人。你可以說我是膽小鬼，不過我還是傾向只談些不會危及性命的話題。�

entries.source: Understandable. Are you still giving your musical lessons?�
entries.translation: 可以理解。你還在教音樂課嗎？�

entries.source: Yes. Since you've already purchased your practice lute, its only twenty sovereigns this time around. Do you want more instruction?�
entries.translation: 是啊。既然你們已經買過練習用的魯特琴了，這次只要二十枚金幣。還要繼續上課嗎？�

entries.source:
Tamney was nearby.
	Alerted by the ójongleur's faint lute playing, @4 called for him to come out from wherever he was hiding. Sulkily, the minstrel complied...�
entries.translation:
坦尼就在附近。
	這位ó吟遊藝人微弱的魯特琴聲引起了注意，@4喊他從藏身之處出來。這名吟遊詩人悶悶不樂地照做了……�

entries.source: Have you changed your mind about the music lesson? I promise you'll learn enough to impress your friends at home. What do you say?�
entries.translation: 你們對音樂課改變主意了嗎？我保證能讓你們學到足以在家鄉朋友面前露一手的程度。你們覺得如何？�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : CX_Tamney_Lesson_2_YES_ENOUGH_GOLD�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：CX_Tamney_Lesson_2_YES_ENOUGH_GOLD�

entries.source: I believe I may have spoken too soon. It seems that I didn't bring along sufficient funds for the lesson.�
entries.translation: 我想我話說得太早了。看來我沒帶夠付這堂課的錢。�

entries.source: I'm usually around here, so if you get the money, I'd be more than happy to instruct you. You'll have to forgive me but I have to go. One of the men in the garrison brought me the entire libretto for óThe óReign óof óOvern óDeep and I'm poring over it to see if I can simplify it enough for just one performer. It'll be a task, but I believe it might be done.�
entries.translation: 我通常都在這附近，要是你們湊到了錢，我很樂意教你們。容我先失陪了，駐軍裡有個弟兄拿了整本〈ó歐文ó深淵ó之ó統ó治〉的劇本給我，我正埋頭研究，看能不能把它簡化到讓一個人就能單獨演出。這會是個大工程，不過我相信應該辦得到。�

entries.source: If anyone can do it, I'm sure you can, Tamney. Good luck to you.�
entries.translation: 要是有誰辦得到，我相信一定是你，坦尼。祝你好運。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : CX_Tamney_Lesson_2_YES_NOT_ENOUGH_GOLD�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：CX_Tamney_Lesson_2_YES_NOT_ENOUGH_GOLD�

entries.source: I regret that we have obligations elsewhere. Perhaps another time, minstrel.�
entries.translation: 很遺憾，我們還有別的事要辦。吟遊詩人，也許改天吧。�

entries.source: I'm usually around here, so if you get the money, I'd be more than happy to instruct you. You'll have to forgive me, but I must go. One of the men in the garrison brought me the entire libretto for óThe óReign óof óOvern óDeep and I'm poring over it to see if I can simplify it enough for just one performer. It'll be a task, but I believe it might be done.�
entries.translation: 我通常都在這附近，要是你們湊到了錢，我很樂意教你們。容我先失陪了，駐軍裡有個弟兄拿了整本〈ó歐文ó深淵ó之ó統ó治〉的劇本給我，我正埋頭研究，看能不能把它簡化到讓一個人就能單獨演出。這會是個大工程，不過我相信應該辦得到。�

entries.source: If anyone can do it I'm sure you can. Good luck to you, Tamney.�
entries.translation: 要是有誰辦得到，我相信一定是你。祝你好運，坦尼。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : CX_Tamney_Lesson_2_NO�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：CX_Tamney_Lesson_2_NO�

entries.source: We are your obedient pupils, musician. I already know where to find the notes on the lute, but beyond that I'm completely in the dark...�
entries.translation: 樂師，我們是您順從的學生。我已經知道魯特琴上音符的位置了，不過除此之外，我可是一頭霧水……�

entries.source:
I'm sure of it. You'll find a lute there behind you.
	Play all scale the notes from middle C to the G in quarter notes, playing only the coronant notes and then come back down to middle C again.�
entries.translation:
我相信是這樣。你身後就有一把魯特琴。
	從中央C彈到G，用四分音符彈完整個音階，只彈加冕音，然後再彈回中央C。�

entries.source: Good. That is the royal scale. Now I want you to play the same scale but instead of playing E coronant, play the E abdicant . All the rest of the notes are the same.�
entries.translation: 很好。這就是王家音階。現在我要你彈同一個音階，不過把E加冕音換成E退位音。其餘的音符都一樣。�

entries.source: Exactly. That's the noble's scale. Together, the royal scale and the noble's scale are the basis of most of our music, though we occasionally use the empress or Keshian scale. The empress' scale is played by playing C coronant, D abdicant, E abdicant, progress to F coronant, G coronant, A abdicant, B coronant, and finally C coronant. I know it sounds complicated, but try it...�
entries.translation: 沒錯。這就是貴族音階。王家音階跟貴族音階，合在一起就是我們大部分音樂的基礎，不過我們偶爾也會用女皇音階，也就是凱許音階。女皇音階的彈法是：C加冕音、D退位音、E退位音，接著F加冕音、G加冕音、A退位音、B加冕音，最後回到C加冕音。我知道聽起來很複雜，不過試試看吧……�

entries.source:
You may master the lute yet. I want you to repeat the things that I've taught you for an hour every day. Once you can play those comfortably, we can have another lesson.
	Forgive me, but I have to go and prepare some songs for the Baron Gabot's dinner tomorrow night. Take care and keep practicing with your lute.�
entries.translation:
你或許還是能學會魯特琴的。我要你每天花一個鐘頭，反覆練習我教你的東西。等你能彈得得心應手了，我們再上下一課。
	抱歉，我得去準備幾首歌，明天晚上加博特男爵的晚宴要用。保重，繼續練習你的魯特琴。�

entries.source: We shall. Thanks for the lesson.�
entries.translation: 我們會的。謝謝這堂課。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH :Tamney_the_Minstrel_LESSON_1�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：Tamney_the_Minstrel_LESSON_1�

entries.source: We are at your command, musician.�
entries.translation: 樂師，我們聽候您的吩咐。�

entries.source:
Go ahead and use my spare lute. It's there behind you.
	Do me a favor and strum the strings...�
entries.translation:
用我的備用魯特琴吧。就在你身後。
	幫我個忙，先撥一下琴弦……�

entries.source: Ach, it's what I thought. I haven't gotten around to tuning it today. Okay, strum the top string. Since someone stole my tuning fork last week, we'll just have to call that string E. Now, put your finger on the fifth fret of the first string and strum the first and second strings together.�
entries.translation: 啊，我就猜是這樣。我今天還沒來得及調音。好，撥一下最上面那根弦。既然我的調音叉上禮拜被人偷了，我們就姑且把那根弦稱作E弦。現在，把手指放在第一弦的第五格，同時撥第一弦跟第二弦。�

entries.source: Okay, that's good. The second string's in tune. Try doing the same thing with the second and third strings.�
entries.translation: 好，這樣就對了。第二弦調好音了。試試用同樣的方法調第二弦跟第三弦。�

entries.source: The third string is a bit abdicant. Turn the tuning peg for the third string until the two strings are in harmony...�
entries.translation: 第三弦有點偏退位音。轉一下第三弦的調音栓，直到兩根弦的音和諧為止……�

entries.source: Try the fourth string now...�
entries.translation: 現在試試第四弦……�

entries.source: Good. The fifth string is a bit odd. Rather than putting your finger on the fifth fret, put your finger on the fourth fret of the forth string and strum the fourth and fifth.�
entries.translation: 很好。第五弦有點特殊。不是把手指放在第五格，而是把手指放在第四弦的第四格，同時撥第四弦跟第五弦。�

entries.source: And the last string is tuned like the second string. Finger on the fifth fret, fifth string and strum the fifth and sixth.�
entries.translation: 最後一根弦的調法跟第二弦一樣。手指放在第五弦的第五格，同時撥第五弦跟第六弦。�

entries.source:
Excellent...unfortunately, I don't have time to teach you anything else but at least now you'll know how to tune your instrument---after all, if your lute is out of tune, how will anyone know you're playing the song correctly?
	Please forgive me, but I've got to get an arrangement put together before dinner time tomorrow night, so I have to go. Keep practicing. You're showing real promise.�
entries.translation:
太好了……可惜我沒時間再教你別的了，不過至少你現在知道怎麼替樂器調音了——畢竟，要是你的魯特琴走音，別人怎麼知道你彈對了曲子呢？
	抱歉，我得趕在明晚晚餐時間之前把編曲弄好，得先走了。繼續練習。你很有天賦。�

entries.source: We shall. Thanks for the lesson.�
entries.translation: 我們會的。謝謝這堂課。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH :Tamney_the_Minstrel_LESSON_2�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：Tamney_the_Minstrel_LESSON_2�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, shifting nervously.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，緊張地來回挪動著身子。�

entries.source: I didn't expect to see...I didn't think anyone would...uh...�
entries.translation: 我沒想到會見到……我沒想到會有人……呃……�

entries.source: ...come after ya! Pah! I shoulda' known it. You come a prancin' into Northwarden with that little twanging box of yours and you sing a blue streak about honor and glory, but when it comes down to it, you ain't got the picture. Instead you got's this yella streak---ya never stand and eyeball your problems face ta face, ya let other folks run you around. One day somebody's gonna run your life right off a cliff...�
entries.translation: ……會來找你！呸！我早該想到的。你大搖大擺地跑進北衛城，帶著你那個叮叮咚咚的小盒子，滿嘴都是榮耀跟光榮的歌，可真到緊要關頭，你根本不是那麼回事。你身上有的，是一條膽小的黃線——你從來不敢正面直視自己的問題，只會任由別人牽著你的鼻子走。總有一天，會有人把你的人生一路牽到懸崖邊去……�

entries.source: I'm the one telling me to leave Northwarden. Me. That's Tamney the Minstrel's decision, not someone else's. I'm making the decision to live.�
entries.translation: 是我自己決定要離開北衛城的。是我。這是吟遊詩人坦尼自己的決定，不是別人的。我決定要活下去。�

entries.source: The moredhel done run you off an they ain't even got here yet. They done a better job on you than any duke or baron you crossed swords with before. I'd not be in a castle with a coward like you anyway.�
entries.translation: 莫瑞德人連影子都還沒出現，就已經把你嚇跑了。他們對你的效果，比你以前交手過的任何公爵或男爵都管用。反正我也不想跟你這種懦夫待在同一座城堡裡。�

entries.source: That isn't fair. I'm a minstrel! What good would I be...I don't know how to use a sword, I don't know how to heal wounds or direct a battle...I'd just be in the way. What good would I be? I'm just...one...óinsignificant...man.�
entries.translation: 這不公平。我是個吟遊詩人！我能有什麼用……我不會用劍，不會治傷，也不會指揮作戰……我只會礙事。我能有什麼用？我只是……一個……ó微不足道的……人。�

entries.source: Not so insignificant, Tamney. Before I went to serve in Krondor, my father used to advise me: When you have earned your title, make sure your minstrel is well paid. I hadn't a clue what that meant until I saw the battles at Armengar and Highcastle and Sethanon and others since. When men sit and listen to songs about great battles, they remember men like themselves have faced terrible dangers and emerged alive and that gives them óhope. Sometimes that's the only thing that an army needs.�
entries.translation: 坦尼，你沒那麼微不足道。我去克朗多任職之前，我父親常常告誡我：等你贏得了頭銜，一定要好好善待你的吟遊詩人。我當時完全不明白這句話是什麼意思，直到我親眼見識了阿曼加、高堡、賽瑟儂，以及後來的其他幾場戰役。當士兵們坐下來聽關於偉大戰役的歌謠時，他們會想起像自己一樣的人，曾面對過可怕的危險，卻活著走了出來，而這會給他們帶來ó希望。有時候，這正是一支軍隊唯一需要的東西。�

entries.source: But why do they all have to depend on me? Why did fate arrange it that I was the minstrel who happened to be at Northwarden?�
entries.translation: 可他們為什麼非得依靠我不可？命運為什麼偏偏安排我這個吟遊詩人，恰好人在北衛城？�

entries.source: We aren't going to force you to go, Tamney. It's your life, your decision. If you choose to leave...that's your own business.�
entries.translation: 坦尼，我們不會強迫你留下的。這是你的人生，你的決定。要是你選擇離開……那是你自己的事。�

entries.source: Could I request a favor of you before I make a final decision?�
entries.translation: 在我做出最終決定之前，能請你們幫我一個忙嗎？�

entries.source: Anything, if it will set your feet back on the road to Northwarden.�
entries.translation: 只要能讓你重新踏上回北衛城的路，什麼都行。�

entries.source: There is a cave not too far from here that is known as the Diviner's Halls. Within, there are several small stones---called pattern stones by geomancers---which can foretell a man's future. If you return with one, I will make my decision.�
entries.translation: 離這裡不遠有個洞穴，人稱『占卜者廳堂』。裡頭有幾顆小石頭——占地師稱之為『命紋石』——能預知一個人的未來。要是你們帶一顆回來，我就做出決定。�

entries.source: Geomancy! Shoulda figured you'd go in for that hozum-pozum...Just another way for somethin' else to make your hard decisions for you!�
entries.translation: 占地術！早該猜到你會信這套裝神弄鬼的玩意兒……不過又是另一種讓別的東西替你做出艱難決定的辦法罷了！�

entries.source: Quiet, Patrus. We will see what we can do, Tamney.�
entries.translation: 派特魯斯，安靜點。坦尼，我們會看看能做些什麼。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C5_Tamney_the_Minstrel�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C5_Tamney_the_Minstrel�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: Did you go to the Diviner's Halls? Did you bring back a pattern stone?�
entries.translation: 你們去過占卜者廳堂了嗎？有帶命紋石回來嗎？�

entries.source: Don't get yourself into a tiz, Tamney. We got your silly rocks...Now you walkin' back to Northwarden or are we draggin' you?�
entries.translation: 坦尼，別自己嚇自己了。你那些傻石頭我們拿到了……那，你是自己走回北衛城，還是要我們拖你回去？�

entries.source: I will walk back myself after...I've studied the rock. Tell Baron Gabot that I will be there soon. I think he will be rather more relieved than you might imagine.�
entries.translation: 等我……研究過這顆石頭之後，我會自己走回去的。告訴加博特男爵，我很快就會到。我想他鬆的那口氣，大概會比你們想像的還要大。�

entries.source: Oh? And why is that?�
entries.translation: 噢？為什麼這麼說？�

entries.source: Before I was off from the castle, I had it in mind I wasn't to leave until I had at least made some provisions that I could survive. Even assuming I slipped out of the castle without notice, there was still the issue of how I would pay my way until I reached a safe haven. So, after a bit of investigation, I found the treasury. It was being guarded by a fellow by the name of Corbi, a fellow whose tryst with a certain girl by the name of Thea I have had the vicarious pleasure of orchestrating over the past several months. Once I had convinced him that she was awaiting him, it was a simple matter of slipping inside and grabbing up a pouch.�
entries.translation: 我離開城堡之前，心裡就打定主意，至少得先安排好能讓自己活下去的東西才走。就算我能神不知鬼不覺地溜出城堡，也還是得面對一個問題：在抵達安全的地方之前，我要靠什麼過活。所以，調查了一番之後，我找到了金庫。看守金庫的是個叫科比的傢伙，過去幾個月來，我一直暗中撮合他跟一個叫席雅的姑娘幽會，樂在其中。我讓他相信她正在等他之後，溜進去抓走一個錢袋，便是輕而易舉的事了。�

entries.source: Not as if the Baron's missed a few golden sovereigns. I think he's involved with other things at the moment.�
entries.translation: 男爵大概也不會少掉幾枚金幣就發現。我看他現在忙著別的事。�

entries.source: Exactly as I was thinking, but it seems that what I picked up in the dark was worth rather more than a few dozen sovereigns. Several ñhundreds more...Once I realized what I'd done, I became terrified of going back.�
entries.translation: 我當初也是這麼想的，可看來我在黑暗中抓走的東西，價值遠不止幾十枚金幣。是好幾ñ百枚……我一意識到自己做了什麼，就嚇得不敢回去了。�

entries.source: I could see why, but when the Baron told us to come and get you, he made no mention of missing money. It's entirely possible that no one has noticed the missing funds as yet. You can take them back to him...�
entries.translation: 我能理解你為什麼會怕，不過男爵叫我們來找你的時候，完全沒提到錢財失竊的事。很有可能到現在都還沒人發現這筆錢不見了。你可以把錢還給他……�

entries.source: I can't. Even if I return them, the Baron will be aware that Corbi left his post open for me to plunder. Though I can't say I've behaved much like a friend to him, I don't wish to betray him twice with the same crime...Actually, I have something of an admission to make. He is the reason why I asked you to retrieve the geomancy stones for me. They aren't worth much, even to a gem's dealer, but they can be used to make an attractive stone for a wedding band...�
entries.translation: 我不能。就算我把錢還回去，男爵還是會知道，是科比擅離職守，讓我有機可乘。雖然我這樣做，實在算不上是他的朋友，可我不想再用同一樁罪，背叛他第二次……其實，我有件事得向你們坦白。我請你們替我找那些占地石頭，正是為了他。就算是對寶石商來說，那些石頭也不值幾個錢，可它們能用來做一枚吸引人的結婚戒指石……�

entries.source: For Corbi. Of course. So you've been considering returning all this time, but you wanted to wait until you could cover all possibilities.�
entries.translation: 是為了科比。原來如此。這麼說，你這段時間一直在考慮要回去，只是想先把所有可能的狀況都安排妥當。�

entries.source: All but one. I was wondering if you would take the pouch of diamonds and hold on to it until after the battle was over. This way, no one gets hurt and we can all do what we need to do. Tell him you took them off a dead Nighthawk or something...�
entries.translation: 除了一件事之外都安排好了。我在想，你們能不能把這袋鑽石收下，等這場戰事結束之後再說。這樣一來，誰都不會受傷，我們也都能做各自該做的事。就跟他說，這是你們從一個死掉的夜鷹會成員身上搜出來的，還是隨便編個理由……�

entries.source: When you go back to the castle, its a possibility they will search you since your behavior has been a little odd. I'll take the diamonds, but I'll worry about how I will tell him later. My only concern is that you return immediately. We have other things we need to be doing for Duke Martin.�
entries.translation: 你回城堡的時候，既然你的行為有點不對勁，他們有可能會搜你的身。這些鑽石我先收下，不過我晚點再來煩惱怎麼跟他說。我唯一在意的是，你得立刻回去。我們還有其他事要替馬丁公爵去辦。�

entries.source: Done. I'll see you all back at the castle.�
entries.translation: 就這麼說定了。我們城堡裡見。�

entries.source: Don't be too happy about this, Tamney. You and I will have a big score to settle on later. Don't let yourself get killed getting back there.�
entries.translation: 坦尼，你可別太得意了。你跟我以後有一筆大帳要算。別讓自己在回去的路上送了命。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C5_Tamney_the_Minstrel_WITH_STONE�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C5_Tamney_the_Minstrel_WITH_STONE�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: Did you bring a pattern stone?�
entries.translation: 你們帶命紋石回來了嗎？�

entries.source: We haven't found them yet. What do you think you'll find out from these rocks anyway?�
entries.translation: 我們還沒找到。你到底覺得自己能從這些石頭裡看出什麼？�

entries.source: Whether I will survive the battle at Northwarden or not. If not, I must send word to my relatives.�
entries.translation: 我在北衛城這場戰事裡能不能活下來。要是不能，我得先給親人捎個信。�

entries.source: And you honestly believe staring at a rock is going to tell you that? That's nearly the dumbest thing I've ever heard.�
entries.translation: 你真心相信盯著一顆石頭看就能告訴你這種事？這大概是我聽過最蠢的事了。�

entries.source: He's got a right to stupid ideas. If he just wants to sit here and wait for a rock to tell him that it's safe to come out into the daylight, that's all right by me. I say let him rot.�
entries.translation: 他有權利有蠢念頭。他要是想坐在這兒，等一顆石頭告訴他外頭安不安全再出來，那也隨他去。我看就讓他自生自滅吧。�

entries.source: You're not going to humiliate me into making a decision, so you two might as well quit it. You may be Seigneurs, but right now I have more respect for rocks than I do anything that the two of you have to say. Goodbye.�
entries.translation: 你們休想用羞辱來逼我做決定，你們兩個乾脆省省吧。你們也許是紳爵，可眼下，我對石頭的敬重，都比對你們兩個說的任何話還多。再見。�

entries.source: Tamney, wait...�
entries.translation: 坦尼，等等……�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C5_Tamney_the_Minstrel_WITHOUT_STONE�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C5_Tamney_the_Minstrel_WITHOUT_STONE�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: The boy has the look of a magician about him. Has he been...educated?�
entries.translation: 這男孩看起來有法師的樣子。他有沒有受過……教育？�

entries.source: I had a few tutors when I was young---my father brought them to our manor---I had an instructor once named Patrus in Tib...�
entries.translation: 我小時候有過幾位家教——我父親請他們到我們莊園來的——我曾經有位教過我的老師，叫派特魯斯，在提……�

entries.source: Ha ha. Impressive background, my young friend.�
entries.translation: 哈哈。背景真了不起啊，年輕的朋友。�

entries.source:
Owyn...please, you shouldn't brag so much. People might think you're someone that you're not.
	Why the interest in my nephew's education, tavernkeep? Are you looking for a tutor for your children.�
entries.translation:
歐文……拜託，你別這麼愛吹噓。別人會以為你是什麼了不起的人物。
	老闆，你怎麼會對我姪兒的教育這麼感興趣？你是在替自己的孩子找家教嗎？�

entries.source: No children have I, at the least, none that I know of. I was merely concerned that a boy with talent should go to waste.�
entries.translation: 我沒有孩子，至少我知道的沒有。我只是擔心一個有天賦的男孩會被埋沒。�

entries.source: So far, the only talent that my wayward nephew has shown is a talent for eating too much and complaining too volubly. I assure you he won't be wasted on anything.�
entries.translation: 到目前為止，我這個不成材的姪兒展現出來的唯一天賦，就是吃得太多、抱怨得太多。我向你保證，他絕不會被埋沒在任何事上。�

entries.source: I feel certain of that. Could I interest you in something to eat? I would offer you something fresh, but a thief slipped in during the night and stole most of our provisions. I have some older provisions that you might take a chance on.�
entries.translation: 這我完全相信。要不要考慮吃點什麼？我本想提供新鮮的東西，可昨晚有個小偷溜了進來，偷走了我們大部分的存糧。我這裡還有些舊存糧，你們可以碰碰運氣。�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: Could I interest you in something to eat? I would offer you something fresh, but a thief slipped in during the night and stole most of our provisions. I have some older provisions that you might take a chance on.�
entries.translation: 這我完全相信。要不要考慮吃點什麼？我本想提供新鮮的東西，可昨晚有個小偷溜了進來，偷走了我們大部分的存糧。我這裡還有些舊存糧，你們可以碰碰運氣。�

entries.source: Fetch them for us. I believe I have enough.�
entries.translation: 拿給我們吧。我想錢應該夠。�

entries.source: Pleasure doing business with you.�
entries.translation: 很高興跟你們做這筆生意。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C1_Joftaz_ENOUGH_GOLD�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C1_Joftaz_ENOUGH_GOLD�

entries.source: Ye...hmm. Seems I've run short on funds. I guess we will have to pass this time around.�
entries.translation: 呃……唔。看來我錢不太夠。我看這次就先算了。�

entries.source: I have been here for many years and I am sure I shall be here for many years to come. If you wish to buy from Joftaz, I will be here.�
entries.translation: 我在這裡待了很多年了，我相信未來也還會待很多年。你們要是想跟喬夫塔茲買東西，我會在這裡。�

entries.source: That's good to know. We will try to return.�
entries.translation: 很高興知道這一點。我們會設法再回來的。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C1_Joftaz_NOT_ENOUGH_GOLD�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C1_Joftaz_NOT_ENOUGH_GOLD�

entries.source: I don't like the sound of old rations...No thank you, tavernkeep. Perhaps when you get fresh provisions in.�
entries.translation: 舊存糧聽起來就不太妙……不用了，謝謝，老闆。也許等你進了新鮮的存糧再說。�

entries.source: Whatever you wish, strangers. Joftaz and the Anchorhead shall be here should you ever wish to return.�
entries.translation: 悉聽尊便，陌生人。喬夫塔茲跟錨首酒館會一直在這裡，等著你們回來。�

entries.source: That's good to know. Thanks.�
entries.translation: 很高興知道這一點。謝謝。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C1_Joftaz_DONT_BUY�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C1_Joftaz_DONT_BUY�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the barkeep.
	The man looked up from the goblets he was washing and smiled in their direction, obviously happy to have more customers. But his welcome expression changed to a mixture of fear and outrage and he began to scream at them in a language @4 didn't understand...�
entries.translation:
@4朝酒保打了個手勢。
	這名男子從他正在清洗的酒杯中抬起頭，朝他們的方向露出微笑，顯然很高興又有客人上門。可他那歡迎的表情，隨即轉為混雜著恐懼與憤怒的神色，開始用一種@4聽不懂的語言，朝他們尖聲喊叫……�

entries.source: óRuthi óa'dibi óabas! The contagion! The contagion!�
entries.translation: óRuthi óa'dibi óabas！瘟疫！瘟疫啊！�

entries.source: Please...my companions and I are ill and in need of help. Where might we find someone who knows how to heal us?�
entries.translation: 拜託……我跟同伴生病了，需要幫助。我們去哪能找到懂得治病的人？�

entries.source: None may heal you! The Dancer Through Men's Hearts has marked you for her dance and none may save you! Go now, please before you infect me!�
entries.translation: 沒有人能治好你們！『穿梭人心之舞者』已經標記你們，要你們共赴她的死亡之舞了，沒有人能救你們！快走吧，拜託，趁還沒把病傳給我之前！�

entries.source: If a goddess has marked us, then only a goddess may be able to save us. What temples may be close by? Who is the local patron goddess?�
entries.translation: 要是一位女神標記了我們，那也只有女神才能救我們。附近有什麼神殿？這一帶的守護女神是誰？�

entries.source: My men will be here soon! You will regret waiting...�
entries.translation: 我的人手很快就會到！你們留在這兒會後悔的……�

entries.source: Tell me where the nearest temple is or I will come over there, pin you to the floor and my companions and I will take turns spitting down your throat until you crawl with this disease! Where is a temple?!�
entries.translation: 告訴我最近的神殿在哪，不然我就過去把你按在地上，跟同伴輪流朝你喉嚨裡吐口水，直到你也染上這種病為止！神殿在哪？！�

entries.source: The Mist Devil is anchored in harbor and it sometimes will take passengers to the Temple of Eortis on Temple Isle. The man on board will ask for ten gold pieces. I hope the boat crashes and takes the three of you to your deaths! Now be gone!�
entries.translation: 迷霧惡魔號停在港裡，有時候會載乘客去神殿島上的埃奧提斯神殿。船上那個人會跟你們要十枚金幣。我希望那艘船撞毀，把你們三個一起帶去送死！現在滾吧！�

entries.source: And none too soon. Expect another visit from us, barkeep.�
entries.translation: 也是時候了。等著我們再來拜訪吧，老闆。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C2_Joftaz�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C2_Joftaz�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them...�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們……�

entries.source: You will bring ill luck on all our heads...I do not wish your business!�
entries.translation: 你們會給我們所有人招來厄運……我不想做你們的生意！�

entries.source: Why do you wish us gone?�
entries.translation: 你為什麼希望我們離開？�

entries.source: If you are here, you have crossed paths with those who work for the Crawler. All who cross him die.�
entries.translation: 你們既然在這裡，想必是跟替爬行者做事的人打過交道了。凡是招惹過他的人都會死。�

entries.source: You wouldn't happen to mean some men who ñwere waiting outside of town, would you?�
entries.translation: 你該不會是指幾個ñ在鎮外守著的人吧？�

entries.source: I will say nothing more to you. I am content as a living man...�
entries.translation: 我不會再跟你們多說了。我還想活著……�

entries.source: I can understand your fears. I will ask no more questions of you for now.�
entries.translation: 我能理解你的恐懼。我暫時不會再問你問題了。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C2_Joftaz�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C2_Joftaz�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: As the keeper of a tavern, I imagine you get quite a bit of traffic through here, lots of people wanting to buy or sell items that were---shall we say---indiscriminately acquired? Who would I speak to if my interests lay in that direction?�
entries.translation: 身為酒館老闆，我想這裡的人來人往應該不少，很多人想買賣一些——這麼說吧——來路不明的東西？要是我對這方面感興趣，該找誰談？�

entries.source: Any that walks the streets. Silden is not known for its reputable patronage as you no doubt have seen. Why would this interest you?�
entries.translation: 街上隨便一個人都行。錫爾登的顧客可不以名聲清白著稱，這你想必也看出來了。你為什麼對這個感興趣？�

entries.source: I need to find out about the possible purchase of two very special items that might have been picked up here in Silden. I'm looking for whoever might have sold them.�
entries.translation: 我需要打聽兩件非常特別的物品，可能在錫爾登這裡被人買走了。我在找可能賣掉它們的人。�

entries.source: If an item is sold in Silden then I am the only man that you should speak to. Any other transactions are done the Silden way.�
entries.translation: 要是有東西在錫爾登出售，那我就是你唯一該找的人。其他的交易，都是照錫爾登的規矩來的。�

entries.source: Very well, Joftaz. I need to find out what you may know about either a brass spyglass or a silver spider. I would be willing pay in gold.�
entries.translation: 好吧，喬夫塔茲。我需要知道你對一支黃銅望遠鏡或一隻銀蜘蛛了解多少。我願意付金子。�

entries.source: You will pay, most undoubtedly for that information, but I am not interested in your Kingdom coins. If it were gold I could come up with the sum I want myself. No, what I require is the assistance of a thief.�
entries.translation: 你當然得為這個消息付出代價，不過我對你們王國的錢幣沒興趣。要是要金子，我自己就能湊出想要的數目。不，我需要的是一個竊賊的協助。�

entries.source: Why do you think I would be of any help?�
entries.translation: 你為什麼覺得我能幫上忙？�

entries.source:
I live in a city of thieves. I have spent my life knowing how to sense them and I know most assuredly that you have a thieve's instincts. This is the bargain. I will tell you about the silver spiders that I sell on occasion, and you will find a bag of powder that was stolen by the Crawler.
	It has most likely been taken to his house near here. The house is locked and I suspect that the pouch will be hidden away in a chest or cabinet or such.�
entries.translation:
我住在一座竊賊之城。我這輩子都在鍛鍊嗅出竊賊的本事，我非常確定你有竊賊的直覺。這就是我的條件。我會告訴你我偶爾出售的銀蜘蛛的事，你則要幫我找到一包被爬行者偷走的粉末。
	那東西很可能已經被帶去他這附近的宅邸了。那棟房子是上鎖的，我猜那袋粉末大概被藏在某個箱子或櫃子之類的地方。�

entries.source: Any thief could do that for you. Why would ówe be especially qualified for this?�
entries.translation: 隨便一個竊賊都能替你辦這件事。為什麼ó我們特別適合幹這個？�

entries.source: Because all the thieves in this place---they all are the hands and eyes of the Crawler. To be working for me, that would be death for them.�
entries.translation: 因為這地方的竊賊——他們全都是爬行者的耳目。替我做事，對他們來說就等於是死路一條。�

entries.source: Why? What is it that is in this powder bag?�
entries.translation: 為什麼？這袋粉末裡到底是什麼？�

entries.source: I have made my offer. The information for the pouch. Do we have a deal?�
entries.translation: 我的提議已經說了。用消息換那個袋子。成交嗎？�

entries.source: My bump of trouble is telling me that I shouldn't be agreeing to this, but you have a deal, Joftaz. I'll get your pouch. A straight exchange, the information for the item.�
entries.translation: 我的直覺告訴我不該答應這件事，不過喬夫塔茲，成交。我會替你找到那個袋子。乾脆俐落地交換，消息換物品。�

entries.source: Consider it a deal then. I will wait for you here in the Anchorhead until you return with the item.�
entries.translation: 那就這麼說定了。我會在錨首酒館這裡等你們，直到你們帶著東西回來。�

entries.source: We will be back. Do not leave this place.�
entries.translation: 我們會回來的。別離開這裡。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C3_Joftaz_YES_DEAL_HAS_NO_POUCH�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C3_Joftaz_YES_DEAL_HAS_NO_POUCH�

entries.source: There was a time when I was considered the best thief in Krondor, but that time has long passed. I am a seigneur in Prince Arutha's court and I've fought hard to deserve that title...�
entries.translation: 曾幾何時，我被認為是克朗多最好的竊賊，不過那早已是過去式了。我現在是亞魯莎親王宮廷裡的紳爵，我可是拚了命才配得上這個頭銜的……�

entries.source: No doubt, but I think you will change your mind if you really wish to know the things you have asked about. No rumormonger in Silden knows more than Joftaz and very few of them can be so easily bought. I shall see you again, I am quite certain.�
entries.translation: 這我不懷疑，不過我想，要是你真心想知道你問的那些事，你會改變主意的。錫爾登沒有哪個包打聽比喬夫塔茲知道得更多，也很少有人能像我這麼容易收買。我很確定我們還會再見面的。�

entries.source: Your arrogance will one day get you into trouble. Do not presume to know the minds of others. Good day.�
entries.translation: 你這份傲慢，總有一天會給你惹來麻煩。別自以為能看透別人的心思。祝你愉快。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C3_Joftaz_NO_DEAL�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C3_Joftaz_NO_DEAL�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: So, the honorable seigneur from Krondor returns. Have you brought along the pouch I asked you for?�
entries.translation: 這麼說，克朗多那位尊貴的紳爵回來了。你把我要的那個袋子帶來了嗎？�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: I am assuming that you are here to speak about the item which we discussed. You have been óexpedient in finding it.�
entries.translation: 我猜你們是為了我們談過的那件東西來的。你們找得ó真快啊。�

entries.source: Before you ask, no we don't have it. I was just hoping that perhaps you would open up a bit more about...�
entries.translation: 在你開口問之前，先說，我們還沒找到。我只是希望你能對……多透露一點……�

entries.source: You forget quickly, but Joftaz is not so slow witted. We have a ódeal and these lips remain sealed until I see that which I have asked for. Good bye.�
entries.translation: 你忘性倒是挺快的，不過喬夫塔茲可沒那麼遲鈍。我們有ó約在先，在我看到我要的東西之前，這張嘴不會再開口。再見。�

entries.source: No, no...we haven't found it yet. His house is quite difficult to enter. We were hoping that perhaps if you told us more of Silden and the people here...�
entries.translation: 不，不……我們還沒找到。他那棟房子很難進去。我們原本希望，要是你能多跟我們說說錫爾登跟這裡的人……�

entries.source: You would play me the fool, but I have lived among sailors too long for such trickery. Our deal stands. Joftaz tells nothing until you return to me the powder bag for which I have asked.�
entries.translation: 你們想把我當傻子耍，可我在水手堆裡混得夠久了，這種把戲騙不了我。我們的約定不變。在你們把我要的那袋粉末還給我之前，喬夫塔茲什麼都不會說。�

entries.source: If we, uh, find it we will return it to you. Good day.�
entries.translation: 要是我們……呃……找到了，我們會還給你的。祝你愉快。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C3_Joftaz_SAY_NO�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C3_Joftaz_SAY_NO�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: Your patronage is most heartily appreciated, but I warn you that further visits to the Anchorhead might be...dangerous? Now that you have returned my pouch, they will be looking for the thief who took it and most assuredly I haven't the skills to perform the task. It would be best if you left as quickly as possible.�
entries.translation: 非常感謝你們的惠顧，不過我得警告你們，再來錨首酒館走動可能會……有危險？既然你們已經把我的袋子還回來了，他們就會開始搜尋偷走它的賊，而我肯定沒那個本事幹這種事。你們最好盡快離開。�

entries.source: Perhaps you are right. Good day.�
entries.translation: 也許你說得對。祝你愉快。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HM_C3_Joftaz_YES_GAVE_POUCH_TO_JOFTAZ�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HM_C3_Joftaz_YES_GAVE_POUCH_TO_JOFTAZ�

entries.source: It seems that today Banath has smiled on the both of us. I have what you want, and you apparently know what I need to know. The pouch in exchange for the story. That was the deal. I want to hear a story about a silver spider.�
entries.translation: 看來今天巴納斯神對我們倆都露出了笑容。我有你們想要的東西，你們顯然也知道我需要知道的事。袋子換故事，這就是我們的約定。我想聽一個關於銀蜘蛛的故事。�

entries.source: Heh. Yes, Banath has gifted you most certainly. I wouldn't have thought anyone wily enough to defeat the Crawler, but if the Happy Prankster has given you the knack then I'll happily help you as best I can. Now---the silver spider is a rare item so I remember when I get one and am most assuredly pleased when I can turn a profit from one. They are heartily sought here in the Kingdom. It's been several months since last I sold one.�
entries.translation: 嘿。沒錯，巴納斯神確實眷顧了你們。我還真沒想過有誰能狡猾到擊敗爬行者，不過既然這位『快活的惡作劇者』賜給了你們這份本事，我就樂意盡力幫幫你們。好了——銀蜘蛛是件稀罕物，所以每次拿到一件我都會記得，能靠它賺一筆，我肯定很高興。這東西在王國這邊需求可旺了。我上一次賣出一件，已經是好幾個月前的事了。�

entries.source: Can you describe the last man who bought one?�
entries.translation: 你能形容一下最後買走的那個人嗎？�

entries.source: Oh, aye, I can describe him. Stoop backed, crass, hard bartering fellow. He was wearing a black cloak and a bird---an eagle---was blazed across his chest.�
entries.translation: 噢，能，我能形容他。駝著背，粗魯無禮，討價還價很兇的傢伙。他披著一件黑斗篷，胸口上有隻鳥的圖案——一隻老鷹。�

entries.source: You mean a hawk? A golden hawk?�
entries.translation: 你是說鷹嗎？一隻金鷹？�

entries.source: I have lived the greater part of my days here in Silden. It might have been a hawk or it could have been a gull. All I know is that I lost a great deal that day between he and the trader named Abuk who brought in some sailor's trinkets he appropriated from Prank's Stone. As for the man with the bird on his chest, the last I heard of him he was asking to purchase a ticket on a ship called the Mocker's Folly bound for Krondor.�
entries.translation: 我這輩子大半時間都待在錫爾登。可能是鷹，也可能是鷗。我只知道，那天我在他跟一個叫阿布克的商人之間，虧了不少——阿布克帶來了幾件從惡作劇石那邊順來的水手小玩意兒。至於胸口有鳥圖案的那個人，我最後聽到他的消息時，他正打算買一張前往克朗多、名叫『嘲弄者的愚行號』的船票。�

entries.source: A Nighthawk bound for Krondor? Where could I find the ship's captain?�
entries.translation: 一個要去克朗多的夜鷹會成員？我上哪能找到那艘船的船長？�

entries.source: Krondor, I suspect, though I don't see why that would be important to you.�
entries.translation: 我猜是克朗多吧，不過我不明白這對你們有什麼重要的。�

entries.source: I will decide what is important or unimportant. Now, what about the brass spyglass? Would you know anything about that?�
entries.translation: 什麼重要、什麼不重要，由我來決定。那，黃銅望遠鏡呢？你對那個有了解嗎？�

entries.source: As I told you before, sailor's trinkets are common here in Silden. If it is a special glass you covet I would urge you to seek out the trader, Abuk. I could hope only to make five, perhaps ten gold sovereigns from such an item so I decided they were not really worth ñmy time bothering with them.�
entries.translation: 就像我先前跟你們說的，水手的小玩意兒在錫爾登很常見。要是你們想要的是件特別的望遠鏡，我建議你們去找那個商人阿布克。這種東西我頂多也就賺個五、十枚金幣，所以我覺得不太值得ñ花時間去管它。�

entries.source: You may find that bothering with silver spiders has cost you more than imagined, Joftaz. If I find that any of the Prince's family have died of poisoning when I return there, you'll have a great deal more to worry about than turning a profit.�
entries.translation: 喬夫塔茲，你會發現，經手銀蜘蛛的代價，恐怕比你想像的還要慘重。要是我回去以後發現親王家裡有誰死於中毒，你要擔心的可就不只是賺不賺得到錢了。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH :GIVE_POUCH_TO_JOFTAZ // END GIVING JOFTAZ THE POUCH�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：GIVE_POUCH_TO_JOFTAZ // END GIVING JOFTAZ THE POUCH�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: Could I interest you in something to eat? I would offer you something fresh, but a thief slipped in during the night and stole most of our provisions. I have some older provisions that you might take a chance on.�
entries.translation: 這我完全相信。要不要考慮吃點什麼？我本想提供新鮮的東西，可昨晚有個小偷溜了進來，偷走了我們大部分的存糧。我這裡還有些舊存糧，你們可以碰碰運氣。�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The man walked over to join them. He stood before them, eyebrows arched inquisitively.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名男子走了過來，加入他們。他站在他們面前，饒富興味地挑起眉毛。�

entries.source: Could I interest you in something to eat? I would offer you something fresh, but a thief slipped in during the night and stole most of our provisions. I have some older provisions that you might take a chance on.�
entries.translation: 這我完全相信。要不要考慮吃點什麼？我本想提供新鮮的東西，可昨晚有個小偷溜了進來，偷走了我們大部分的存糧。我這裡還有些舊存糧，你們可以碰碰運氣。�

entries.source: Fetch them for us. I believe I have enough.�
entries.translation: 拿給我們吧。我想錢應該夠。�

entries.source: Pleasure doing business with you.�
entries.translation: 很高興跟你們做這筆生意。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C6_Joftaz�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C6_Joftaz�

entries.source: Ye...hmm. Seems I've run short on funds. I guess we will have to pass this time around.�
entries.translation: 呃……唔。看來我錢不太夠。我看這次就先算了。�

entries.source: I have been here for many years and I am sure I shall be here for many years to come. If you wish to buy from Joftaz, I will be here.�
entries.translation: 我在這裡待了很多年了，我相信未來也還會待很多年。你們要是想跟喬夫塔茲買東西，我會在這裡。�

entries.source: Thank-you. We may return.�
entries.translation: 謝謝。我們或許會再回來。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C6_Joftaz�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C6_Joftaz�

entries.source: I don't like the sound of old rations...No thank you, tavernkeep. Perhaps when you get fresh provisions in.�
entries.translation: 舊存糧聽起來就不太妙……不用了，謝謝，老闆。也許等你進了新鮮的存糧再說。�

entries.source: Whatever you wish, strangers. Joftaz and the Anchorhead shall be here should you ever wish to return.�
entries.translation: 悉聽尊便，陌生人。喬夫塔茲跟錨首酒館會一直在這裡，等著你們回來。�

entries.source: Hmm. I'll remember your offer.�
entries.translation: 唔。我會記住你的提議的。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : C6_Joftaz�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：C6_Joftaz�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The woman nodded, then made her way across the wooden floor until she was standing before them.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名女子點了點頭，穿過木地板走了過來，最後站到了他們面前。�

entries.source: Welcome to the Six Toe Tavern. What can I do for you?�
entries.translation: 歡迎光臨六趾客棧。有什麼我能為你們做的？�

entries.source: What's a shop doing open out here? I thought everybody packed up and left when King Lyam helped the people evacuate Sethanon.�
entries.translation: 這裡怎麼還有店開著？我還以為萊亞姆王協助撤離賽瑟儂的時候，大家都收拾東西離開了。�

entries.source: Everybody didn't leave as you can see, and it's not been easy keeping up and all, not since my father died. But I don't really wish to talk about it at the moment. Would you like something to eat? I have some rations I just prepared and they're only seven gold a bundle. Please say you'll say yes. Shall I get some for you?�
entries.translation: 你也看到了，不是所有人都走了，而且自從我父親過世以後，要撐下去也不容易。不過我現在不太想談這個。你們想吃點什麼嗎？我剛準備了些口糧，一份只要七枚金幣。拜託說願意吧。要我幫你們拿一些嗎？�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The woman nodded, then made her way across the wooden floor until she was standing before them.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名女子點了點頭，穿過木地板走了過來，最後站到了他們面前。�

entries.source: Hello again. Would you like something to eat? I have some rations I prepared and as I told you before, they're only seven gold a bundle. Please say you'll say yes. Shall I get some for you?�
entries.translation: 又見面了。你們想吃點什麼嗎？我準備了些口糧，就像我之前說的，一份只要七枚金幣。拜託說願意吧。要我幫你們拿一些嗎？�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The woman made her way across the wooden floor until she was standing before them.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名女子穿過木地板走了過來，最後站到了他們面前。�

entries.source: Hello there, may I buy...�
entries.translation: 你好，我能不能買……�

entries.source: I can't open up the shop! I don't care how much you have to offer or who you are. I can't go in there again...�
entries.translation: 我沒法把店打開！我不管你們出多少錢，也不管你們是誰。我沒法再進去那裡了……�

entries.source: I was ñoffering, miss, to buy you a drink.�
entries.translation: 小姐，我剛才是ñ想請妳喝一杯。�

entries.source: Oh...oh, sorry. I was thinking you were stopping in to buy something from my goods store across the road. Since my father's death I've had the run of these two places, the tavern here and the goods store across the way. You know, I've had folks in here, four a week by last count, all offering money for a sword made by a hermit up North. Fool that I am, I sent the word out, but that was before things started happening in my store. I've since closed up things for a bit.�
entries.translation: 噢……噢，抱歉。我還以為你們是要來我對街的雜貨店買東西的。自從我父親過世以後，我就一手打理著這兩間店，這間酒館跟對街的雜貨店。你知道嗎，一直有人到這兒來，上次算下來一週有四個，都想出錢買一把北方隱士打造的劍。我這人真傻，把消息放了出去，可那是在我店裡開始發生怪事之前的事了。從那之後，我就把店暫時關了起來。�

entries.source: Closed your store? Why? What sorts of things were going on in there?�
entries.translation: 把店關了？為什麼？裡頭發生了什麼事？�

entries.source: You'll think I'm foolish... óI think I'm foolish.�
entries.translation: 你們會覺得我很傻……我ó自己也覺得傻。�

entries.source: Tell me and I'll listen. If I laugh once, even once, you may upend a cask of ale over my head.�
entries.translation: 告訴我吧，我會聽的。要是我笑了哪怕一次，妳都可以把一桶麥酒倒扣在我頭上。�

entries.source: You'll pay for the cask if I do...All right then. I'll tell you. In the past few weeks, I've seen a man prowling about in my shop.�
entries.translation: 要是我真那麼做，你可得賠這桶酒錢……好吧，那我告訴你。過去這幾週，我看見一個男人在我店裡鬼鬼祟祟地走動。�

entries.source: That's easy enough. Between companions and myself, we can get rid of your prowler by dinner time tomorrow. .�
entries.translation: 這簡單。我跟同伴聯手，明天晚餐時間之前就能替妳把那個鬼祟的傢伙解決掉。�

entries.source: Can you now? You run through ghosts as easy as that, poleax poltergeists in your spare time?�
entries.translation: 你們辦得到嗎？你們就這麼輕鬆地能刺穿鬼魂，閒暇之餘還能拿斧頭劈劈騷靈？�

entries.source: Ghosts? This prowler of yours is a ghost?�
entries.translation: 鬼魂？妳說的這個鬼祟傢伙是個鬼？�

entries.source: Told you that you wouldn't believe me. I'll put it to you though. If you can find a way to put the ghost in my shop to rest, then I'll reopen my shop and give you the Galon Griefmaker that I bought from the hermit. Simple as that.�
entries.translation: 就說你們不會相信我。不過我把話說清楚。要是你們能想辦法讓我店裡那個鬼魂安息，我就重新開店，把我跟那隱士買的蓋隆「悲愴使者」給你們。就這麼簡單。�

entries.source: That offer is nearly as attractive as the woman delivering it. Thank-you, fair lady.�
entries.translation: 這提議幾乎跟提出它的這位女士一樣誘人。謝謝妳，美麗的女士。�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The woman nodded, then made her way across the wooden floor until she was standing before them.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名女子點了點頭，穿過木地板走了過來，最後站到了他們面前。�

entries.source: I hope you haven't come by the tavern for a drink. Tapped out the last of my supplies this morning and I don't know how long it'll be before the wagons come round again. No one wants to come anywhere close to Nia's Goods, even though its across the crossroad!�
entries.translation: 希望你們不是為了喝一杯才來酒館的。我今天早上把最後的存貨用光了，也不知道貨車什麼時候才會再來。沒人願意靠近『妮雅雜貨』，就算它其實只在十字路口對面而已！�

entries.source: We'll do what we can, good lady.�
entries.translation: 我們會盡力而為的，夫人。�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The woman nodded, then made her way across the wooden floor until she was standing before them.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名女子點了點頭，穿過木地板走了過來，最後站到了他們面前。�

entries.source: I don't know how you've done it, but bless you. I've not heard a knock or a bump coming from my shop for hours! First time in weeks! After I do a little dusting, I should be able to reopen it for business. And seeing that you've held up your end of the bargain, I'll hold up mine. As requested, you can have the Galon Griefmaker I told you about. Thank you again and please come by the shop across the street anytime. I promise I'll give you the best bargains you'll find!�
entries.translation: 我不知道你們是怎麼辦到的，不過真是謝天謝地。我這幾個鐘頭都沒再聽見店裡傳來敲擊聲或撞擊聲了！這是這幾週來第一次！等我打掃一下灰塵，應該就能重新開店做生意了。既然你們履行了自己那部分的約定，我也會履行我的。就像你們要求的，我把我跟你們說過的蓋隆「悲愴使者」給你們。再次謝謝你們，歡迎隨時來對街的店裡逛逛。我保證會給你們找得到的最優惠的價錢！�

entries.source: Thank-you, fine lady. It was our pleasure to serve you.�
entries.translation: 謝謝妳，好心的女士。能為妳效勞是我們的榮幸。�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The woman nodded, then made her way across the wooden floor until she was standing before them.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名女子點了點頭，穿過木地板走了過來，最後站到了他們面前。�

entries.source: Welcome to the Six Toe Tavern. What can I do for you?�
entries.translation: 歡迎光臨六趾客棧。有什麼我能為你們做的？�

entries.source: Well, seeing as how this is a tavern and we were a bit thirsty, I thought we would come in for a bit to eat...�
entries.translation: 這個嘛，既然這裡是酒館，我們又有點口渴，我想我們就進來吃點東西……�

entries.source: I have some rations I just prepared and they're only seven gold a bundle. Please say you'll say yes. Shall I get some for you?�
entries.translation: 我剛準備了些口糧，一份只要七枚金幣。拜託說願意吧。要我幫你們拿一些嗎？�

entries.source:
@4 motioned to the figure across the room.
	The woman nodded, then made her way across the wooden floor until she was standing before them.�
entries.translation:
@4朝房間另一頭的身影打了個手勢。
	那名女子點了點頭，穿過木地板走了過來，最後站到了他們面前。�

entries.source: Aha! Something told me that I would see the three of you again. So, how about a fresh meal? Would that do?�
entries.translation: 啊哈！我就有預感會再見到你們三個。那，來份新鮮的餐點如何？這樣行嗎？�

entries.source: We don't really have time to sit down and eat. Do you have standard rations?�
entries.translation: 我們其實沒空坐下來吃飯。妳有一般的口糧嗎？�

entries.source: Only the best this side of Krondor...�
entries.translation: 這一帶最好的，就在克朗多這邊……�

entries.source: Since you asked so nicely, I hardly think I'd be a gentleman to refuse. We'll take @3.�
entries.translation: 既然妳問得這麼客氣，我要是拒絕就太不紳士了。我們要@3。�

entries.source: Sit tight and I'll fetch them quick as I can.�
entries.translation: 稍等一下，我盡快去拿。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH :Nia�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：Nia�

entries.source: I'd like to take you up on your offer, but I'm afraid that I'm low on funds at the moment. Perhaps we will swing by again later.�
entries.translation: 我很想接受妳的提議，不過恐怕我現在手頭有點緊。也許我們晚點再過來。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH :Nia�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：Nia�

entries.source: Thank you but no. I think we're well enough disposed for supplies at the moment. Perhaps another time.�
entries.translation: 謝謝，不過不用了。我想我們目前的存糧還算充足。也許改天吧。�

entries.source: You'll come back. The Six Toe has the best prices in the area so I'm fairly certain I'll see you again...And if you should run into someone named Locklear, would you send him my regards? It would mean quite a bit to me.�
entries.translation: 你們會回來的。六趾客棧的價錢是這一帶最優惠的，我相當確定我們還會再見面……還有，要是你們遇到一個叫洛克利爾的人，能不能替我向他問聲好？這對我來說意義重大。�

entries.source: Certainly. Good day to you.�
entries.translation: 當然。祝妳愉快。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH :Nia�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：Nia�

@4 motioned to the figure across the room.

entries.source: Welcome to the Six Toe Tavern and...oh, hello again! I haven't seen you since you came through last. You were headed towards Krondor, in quite a hurry as I recall...ah, Orel wasn't it? And your elf friend here was Thorgath?�
entries.translation: 歡迎光臨六趾客棧，還有……噢，又見面了！自從你們上次路過以後就沒再見過了。我記得你們當時正急著趕往克朗多……啊，你是叫奧瑞爾吧？你這位精靈朋友是索爾加斯？�

entries.source: What? Oh, yes...Thorgath, certainly, but ómy name is Owyn. We were passing back through and I thought we'd stop in for a rest or something to eat.�
entries.translation: 什麼？噢，對……索爾加斯沒錯，不過ó我的名字是歐文。我們又路過這裡，想說進來歇歇腳，吃點東西。�

entries.source: If it's a rest you're after then you're more than welcome to have a seat, but all my food's been requisitioned.�
entries.translation: 要是你們想歇腳，儘管坐，不過我的食物全都被徵用了。�

entries.source: óRequisitioned? By whom?�
entries.translation: ó被徵用了？被誰徵用的？�

entries.source: By the Krondorian Lancers, or at least that's who the captain said they were. He said that the Prince requested that I turn over my provisions for them. They compensated me for my trouble of course, one thousand sovereigns...�
entries.translation: 被克朗多長槍騎兵團，至少那位隊長是這麼說的。他說親王要求我把存糧交給他們。他們當然也給了我補償，一千枚金幣……�

entries.source: Congratulations! Any plans for your newly found wealth?�
entries.translation: 恭喜！對這筆意外之財有什麼打算嗎？�

entries.source: No, not really. I think I'll just concentrate on tidying up things around here, maybe find a dashing young seigneur or baronet who needs a rich mistress.�
entries.translation: 不，沒什麼特別的。我想我會專心把這裡收拾整齊，說不定再找個瀟灑的年輕紳爵或準男爵，需要個有錢的情婦。�

entries.source: Where do I stand in line?�
entries.translation: 我排第幾位？�

entries.source: Sorry, but I already have someone in mind. What say I make it up to you with a bottle of port? Obviously I couldn't let the soldiers take everything, so I kept a few bottles to sell until I restocked here. Why don't you take a look at the stock?�
entries.translation: 抱歉，不過我心裡已經有人選了。不如我用一瓶波特酒補償你，如何？顯然我不能讓那些士兵把東西全拿走，所以我留了幾瓶下來賣，等這裡補貨為止。你要不要看看有什麼存貨？�

entries.source: One bottle sounds good, doesn't it Gor...Thorgath. I could use something to get the dust out of my throat.�
entries.translation: 一瓶聽起來不錯，是吧，戈……索爾加斯。我正好需要點東西潤潤喉嚨裡的沙塵。�

entries.source: Certainly. That would be no problem.�
entries.translation: 當然。沒問題。�

entries.source: I'm not certain that's wise, Owyn.�
entries.translation: 歐文，我不確定這樣做明不明智。�

entries.source: Oh, posh...I'll fetch your bottle from the back.�
entries.translation: 噢，別掃興嘛……我去後面幫你們拿瓶酒。�

entries.source: I'd like to take you up on your offer, but I'm afraid that I'm low on funds at the moment. Perhaps we will swing by again another time.�
entries.translation: 我很想接受妳的提議，不過恐怕我現在手頭有點緊。也許我們改天再過來。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C6_Nia�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C6_Nia�

entries.source: None right now, thank you. We actually probably need to get moving.�
entries.translation: 現在不用了，謝謝。我們其實該上路了。�

entries.source: Suit yourselves. I'll be around should you get thirsty. If you want into the shop across the street, I'll come over and let you in. Goodbye.�
entries.translation: 隨你們便。要是你們口渴了，我就在附近。要是你們想進對街的店，我會過去幫你們開門。再見。�

entries.source: Your kindness will someday be rewarded. Thank-you.�
entries.translation: 妳的善心總有一天會得到回報的。謝謝妳。�

entries.source: THIS IS THE END OF DIALOG PATH : HNM_C6_Nia�
entries.translation: 這是對話路徑的結尾：HNM_C6_Nia�
